title: Dynamic Governance of Multi-LLM Agent Systems for Collaborative Conversational Outcomes
comments: 13 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to AI Engineer World's Fair 2026
summary: When two LLM agents with structurally opposed objectives interact across multiple turns, the absence of a shared goal function produces not competition but collapse: the visitor capitulates, the site agent stops varying its approach, and the conversation terminates without achieving either agent's stated objective. This paper asks whether a control-theoretic governance layer can substitute for that missing goal function. The Experience Orchestrator (EO) addresses this in a simulated financial services environment where a site agent guides a visitor toward advisor contact while the visitor maintains psychologically realistic resistance. EO governs the joint trajectory through three mechanisms: a Contextual Bandit (CB) that selects content arms calibrated from real-world web analytics, a PID controller that enforces behavioral consistency via dynamic schema constraints, and a POMDP belief tracker that maintains a probabilistic model of visitor intent. Across 60,000 simulations, EO achieves a +32 percentage point lift in high-intent advisor contact rate (78.1% vs. 46.1% over a naive LLM control), with CB variant selection accounting for 97% of between-factor outcome variance -- confirming that the governance policy, not environmental initial conditions, determines where trajectories end up. Persona-level analysis reveals two distinct regimes: for visitors with no natural inclination toward conversion, the governance layer is the difference between a functional system and a non-functional one; for visitors already near alignment, a naive LLM's empathetic defaults are largely sufficient. All findings are conditional on LLM-to-LLM simulation. The PID controller has not been calibrated against real human unpredictability, and validating EO on live traffic is the critical next step.
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to AI Engineer World's Fair 2026

AI.title_translation: 多大语言模型智能体系统的动态治理以实现协作对话结果
AI.tldr: 本文提出了体验编排器（EO）治理框架，结合控制理论（CB、PID和POMDP）解决了目标对立的多LLM智能体交互崩溃问题，显著提升了高质量转化率。
AI.motivation: 当两个目标结构性对立的LLM智能体进行多轮交互时，因缺乏共享的目标函数容易引发对话崩溃（如一方妥协或停止调整策略）。本研究旨在探讨控制理论治理层能否替代缺失的共享目标函数，从而避免崩溃并实现协作性对话结果。
AI.method: 提出了体验编排器（EO）治理层，包含三大核心机制：1）上下文多臂老虎机（CB）：基于真实网页分析校准内容臂的选择；2）PID控制器：通过动态模式约束维持行为一致性；3）POMDP信念跟踪器：维护访客意图的概率模型。在模拟金融服务场景下开展了60,000次LLM与LLM之间的交互模拟。
AI.result: 在60,000次模拟中，EO使高意向顾问联系率相比天真的LLM对照组提升了32个百分点（78.1% vs. 46.1%），其中CB变体选择贡献了97%的因子间结果方差。分析还表明，对于缺乏转化意向的访客，治理层是系统可用的关键；而对接近对齐的访客，天真的LLM共情响应已基本足够。
AI.conclusion: 控制理论治理层（EO）能够替代缺失的共享目标函数，有效提升多智能体协作对话的成功率。然而，当前结论完全建立在LLM对LLM的模拟之上，PID控制器尚未针对人类用户的真实随机性进行校准，未来需要在真实流量上对该系统进行验证。
AI.translation: 当两个具有结构性对立目标的LLM智能体在多轮交互中碰撞时，由于缺乏共享的目标函数，产生的不是竞争而是崩溃：访客妥协屈服，站点智能体停止改变其策略，对话在未实现任何一方既定目标的情况下终止。本文探讨了控制理论治理层是否可以替代这一缺失的目标函数。体验编排器（EO）在一个模拟金融服务环境中解决了这一问题，其中站点智能体引导访客联系顾问，而访客保持心理上真实的抵抗力。EO通过三种机制治理联合轨迹：利用根据真实网页分析校准的上下文多臂老虎机（CB）选择内容臂；利用PID控制器通过动态模式约束强制维持行为一致性；利用POMDP信念跟踪器维护访客意图的概率模型。在60,000次模拟中，相比天真的LLM对照组，EO实现了高意向顾问联系率提升32个百分点（78.1%对46.1%），其中CB变体选择占因子间结果方差的97%——这证实了是治理策略而非环境初始条件决定了轨迹的最终走向。画像层面的分析揭示了两种不同的模式：对于没有自然转化倾向的访客，治理层决定了系统是有效还是瘫痪；对于已经接近对齐的访客，天真LLM的共情默认设置已基本足够。所有研究结果均受限于LLM对LLM的模拟。PID控制器尚未针对真实人类的不确定性进行校准，在真实流量上验证EO是关键的下一步。
AI.summary: 本研究针对目标对立的多LLM智能体在交互中易出现“对话崩溃”的问题，提出了基于控制理论的“体验编排器（EO）”治理框架。EO结合了上下文多臂老虎机、PID控制器和POMDP信念跟踪，在模拟金融场景中对智能体轨迹进行动态控制。60,000次模拟实验表明，EO显著提升了高意向转化率，证实了治理策略在引导多智能体协同对话中的决定性作用。
AI.keywords: Multi-LLM Agents, Dynamic Governance, Contextual Bandit, PID Controller, POMDP
AI.comments:
创新性：巧妙地将控制理论（PID控制器、POMDP信念跟踪、上下文多臂老虎机）融合引入多大语言模型（LLM）智能体系统的治理中，解决了目标对立时对话易崩溃的问题。
重要性：为多智能体协同与对话管理提供了结构化的控制框架，显著提升了目标达成率。
局限性：所有评估均基于LLM对LLM的模拟环境，PID控制器未经真实人类行为随机性的校准，缺乏真实用户流量的验证。

title: Distribird: Literature-Informed Prior Distribution Design for Bayesian Model Calibration
summary: Bayesian calibration of process-based models requires a prior distribution for each model parameter. Despite decades of methodological work, researchers almost always fall back on uniform priors. The main reason is that building informative priors from scientific literature is slow and needs both domain and statistical expertise. We present \textbf{Distribird}, an agentic web application that automates this process. Given a parameter name, physical description, and domain context, Distribird deploys a multi-agent pipeline that searches the literature, extracts and weights reported values by domain relevance, and fits a probability distribution via AIC model selection. When no literature is available, the system falls back to sensible uninformative alternatives, and clearly reports both the evidence behind and the confidence level of every prior it produces. It is designed for the problems where the models have physically interpretable parameters, where domain knowledge exists in the published literature. We evaluate the tool on 24~parameters across 10 scientific domains comparing three open-weight models (Qwen3.6 27B, Gemma 4 31B, Mistral Small 4 119B) with a single-prompt LLM baseline. On prior quality the full pipeline \emph{matches} this baseline. Every prior is traced to the specific papers and values from which it was constructed; a built-in validity layer declines to produce priors for out-of-scope requests, whereas the single-prompt baseline returns confident but unfounded priors for them in 11 of 30~model--parameter cases; and every language-model call runs locally, so no parameter description or unpublished modelling detail is transmitted to a third-party LLM provider (only generated search terms reach the public literature databases). For scientific use, we argue these properties matter more than a marginal improvement in point-estimate accuracy.

AI.title_translation: Distribird：基于文献的贝叶斯模型校准先验分布设计
AI.tldr: Distribird是一个自动化代理网络应用，通过搜索文献、提取并加权报告值、拟合概率分布来为贝叶斯模型校准设计信息丰富的先验分布，解决了传统方法构建先验缓慢且需要专业知识的问题。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯模型校准需要为每个模型参数提供先验分布，但研究人员几乎总是使用均匀先验，因为从科学文献中构建信息丰富的先验分布既耗时又需要领域和统计专业知识。
AI.method: Distribird是一个代理网络应用，它部署了一个多代理管道。给定参数名称、物理描述和领域上下文，该管道搜索文献，根据领域相关性提取并加权报告值，并通过AIC模型选择拟合概率分布。如果没有可用文献，系统会退回到合理的非信息性替代方案，并明确报告每个先验的证据和置信水平。
AI.result: 在24个参数和10个科学领域上的评估显示，完整的管道在先验质量上与单提示LLM基线相当。每个先验都可以追溯到构建它的具体论文和数值；内置的有效性层会拒绝为超出范围的请求生成先验，而单提示基线在30个模型-参数案例中的11个返回了自信但无根据的先验；所有语言模型调用都在本地运行，确保数据隐私。
AI.conclusion: 对于科学用途，Distribird的这些特性（可追溯性、有效性检查和数据隐私）比点估计精度上的边际改进更重要。
AI.translation: 贝叶斯过程模型校准需要为每个模型参数提供先验分布。尽管经过数十年的方法论研究，研究人员几乎总是退回到均匀先验。主要原因是，从科学文献中构建信息丰富的先验分布既缓慢又需要领域和统计专业知识。我们提出了 \textbf{Distribird}，一个代理网络应用程序，可以自动化这个过程。给定参数名称、物理描述和领域上下文，Distribird 部署一个多代理管道，该管道搜索文献，根据领域相关性提取并加权报告值，并通过 AIC 模型选择拟合概率分布。当没有可用文献时，系统会退回到合理的非信息性替代方案，并清楚地报告其生成的每个先验的证据和置信水平。它专为模型具有物理可解释参数且领域知识存在于已发表文献中的问题而设计。我们评估了该工具在10个科学领域的24个参数上，比较了三个开源模型（Qwen3.6 27B、Gemma 4 31B、Mistral Small 4 119B）与单提示LLM基线。在先验质量方面，完整管道\emph{匹配}了该基线。每个先验都可以追溯到构建它的具体论文和数值；内置的有效性层拒绝为超出范围的请求生成先验，而单提示基线在30个模型-参数案例中的11个返回了自信但无根据的先验；并且每个语言模型调用都在本地运行，因此参数描述或未发布的建模细节不会传输给第三方LLM提供商（只有生成的搜索词会到达公共文献数据库）。对于科学用途，我们认为这些特性比点估计精度上的边际改进更重要。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Distribird，一个代理网络应用程序，旨在自动化贝叶斯模型校准中信息丰富先验分布的设计过程。传统方法因耗时且需专业知识而常使用均匀先验。Distribird通过多代理管道搜索文献、提取加权值并拟合概率分布，解决了这一问题。它在缺乏文献时提供合理替代方案，并明确报告证据和置信度。评估结果显示，Distribird在先验质量上与LLM基线相当，但提供了更好的可追溯性、有效性检查和数据隐私保护，这些特性对于科学应用至关重要。
AI.keywords: 贝叶斯模型校准, 先验分布, 代理系统, 文献分析, 自动化
AI.comments: Distribird的创新之处在于它将多代理系统应用于自动化科学文献中先验分布的提取和构建，显著提高了贝叶斯模型校准的效率和质量。其强调可追溯性、有效性检查和本地运行LLM以保护数据隐私的特性，在科学研究中具有重要意义，解决了传统LLM应用中可能存在的透明度和数据安全问题。它为物理可解释参数模型提供了一个强大的工具，有望推动更健壮和可信赖的贝叶斯建模实践。

title: A Forced-Structure Reduction and Verifiable Bounds for Conway's 99-Graph
comments: This paper is accepted to the first Conference For AI Scientists (CAISc)
summary: Conway's 99-graph problem asks whether a strongly regular graph with parameters $\mathrm{srg}(99,14,1,2)$ exists. We report a systematic, fully reproducible attack by an autonomous AI research agent, scored under the track's partial-credit metric. Our verifiable contributions are: (1) an exhaustive proof that no circulant graph on $\mathbb{Z}/99$ satisfies more than $3366/4950=68.0\%$ of the constraints ($33$ of $49$ difference-classes), with the same ceiling for the other abelian group of order $99$; (2) a forced-structure reduction: $λ=1$ makes each neighbourhood a perfect matching and $μ=2$ puts the outer vertices in bijection with non-matched neighbour-pairs, collapsing existence to a $12$-regular graph on $84$ vertices, encoded for CP-SAT and validated by recovering the unique $\mathrm{srg}(9,4,1,2)$; (3) a validated prescribed-automorphism orbit-existence framework (fixed-point-free and single-fixed-point actions, checked on $\mathrm{srg}(9,4,1,2)$ and the Paley graph $\mathrm{srg}(13,6,2,3)$), and (4) a best verified artifact at $69.43\%$, with evidence that this is a robust frontier (fourteen distinct methods, none exceeding it) entangled with the open question, since any provable bound below $4950$ is a non-existence proof.
comment: This paper is accepted to the first Conference For AI Scientists (CAISc)

AI.title_translation: 康威99图的强制结构约简和可验证界限
AI.tldr: 本文使用自主AI研究代理系统性地攻击康威99图问题，报告了关于其非存在性的可验证界限和结构约简，并得到了目前最佳的验证结果。
AI.motivation: 康威99图问题询问是否存在一个参数为srg(99,14,1,2)的强正则图。
AI.method: 本文通过自主AI研究代理进行系统性、可复现的攻击。具体方法包括：对$\mathbb{Z}/99$上的循环图进行穷举证明；利用$\lambda=1$和$\mu=2$的性质进行强制结构约简，将问题转化为84个顶点上的12正则图，并用CP-SAT编码验证；以及验证了规定自同构轨道存在性框架。
AI.result: 1. 穷举证明了在$\mathbb{Z}/99$上的循环图不能满足超过68.0%的约束（33/49个差类），对于阶数为99的其他阿贝尔群也存在相同的上限。 2. 通过强制结构约简，将存在性问题简化为84个顶点上的12正则图，并通过恢复唯一的srg(9,4,1,2)进行了验证。 3. 验证了规定自同构轨道存在性框架（在srg(9,4,1,2)和Paley图srg(13,6,2,3)上检查）。 4. 获得了最佳验证结果为69.43%，并有证据表明这是一个稳健的边界，且有十四种不同的方法均未超过此结果。
AI.conclusion: 任何低于4950的可证明界限都将是非存在性证明。目前研究获得了69.43%的最佳验证结果，表明这是一个稳健的边界，但尚未达到完全的非存在性证明，该问题仍与开放问题纠缠在一起。
AI.translation: 康威99图问题询问是否存在一个参数为$\mathrm{srg}(99,14,1,2)$的强正则图。我们报告了一个由自主AI研究代理进行的系统性、完全可复现的攻击，并根据该轨道的偏信用度量进行了评分。我们可验证的贡献包括：(1) 一个穷举证明，表明在$\mathbb{Z}/99$上的循环图不能满足超过$3366/4950=68.0\%$的约束（$49$个差类中的$33$个），对于阶数为$99$的其他阿贝尔群也存在相同的上限；(2) 一个强制结构约简：$\lambda=1$使得每个邻域都是一个完美匹配，$\mu=2$使得外部顶点与未匹配的邻居对之间存在双射，将存在性问题简化为84个顶点上的12正则图，该图用CP-SAT编码并通过恢复唯一的$\mathrm{srg}(9,4,1,2)$进行了验证；(3) 一个已验证的规定自同构轨道存在性框架（在$\mathrm{srg}(9,4,1,2)$和Paley图$\mathrm{srg}(13,6,2,3)$上检查了不动点自由和单不动点作用），以及 (4) 最佳验证结果为$69.43\%$，有证据表明这是一个稳健的边界（十四种不同的方法都没有超过它），并且与开放问题纠缠在一起，因为任何低于$4950$的可证明界限都是一个非存在性证明。
AI.summary: 本文利用自主AI研究代理系统性地探究康威99图问题，即是否存在参数为srg(99,14,1,2)的强正则图。研究通过穷举证明、强制结构约简和自同构轨道存在性框架，推导了关于该图非存在性的可验证界限。主要贡献包括证明了循环图的约束满足上限、将问题约简为84个顶点的12正则图，并得到了目前最佳的69.43%验证结果，表明这是一个稳健的边界，且任何低于4950的界限都将是非存在性证明。
AI.keywords: 康威99图, 强正则图, AI研究代理, 结构约简, 非存在性证明
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于利用自主AI研究代理系统性地攻击一个著名的图论开放问题，并结合了多种数学和计算方法（如穷举证明、结构约简和CP-SAT编码）。其通过提供可验证的非存在性界限，为解决康威99图问题提供了重要进展，尽管尚未完全解决。强调了AI在纯数学问题探索中的潜力。

title: Detecting a Route Flip Is Easier Than Knowing Whether to Fix It: Causal Route-Mediated Damage in Quantized Mixture-of-Experts
comments: 13 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Pre-registered pilot study
summary: Top-k Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing is discontinuous, so a deployment-motivated numerical disturbance -- simulated 4-bit KV-cache quantization read by a protected BF16 gate -- pushes tokens across decision boundaries and flips which experts fire. This paper proposes no new mitigation; it supplies a causal apparatus, empirical findings, and a detection-limit result. A four-run apparatus prices the route-mediated fraction (RMF) of quantization damage, a token-level attribution decomposes it by mechanism, and pre-registered probes carry the findings across three architectures. On OLMoE-1B-7B at 4-bit KV (pilot), about a third of the damage is routing-mediated: RMF ~ 0.31 (discovery 0.31 [0.20, 0.41]; process-replicated mean 0.313 +/- 0.020; pre-registered re-execution 0.231). The deployable router margin detects that a flip occurred (AUC 0.772) but cannot tell a harmful flip from a helpful one (at chance): among the tested local, inference-observable router statistics we find no predictor of a flip's loss sign above chance -- an empirical benefit-detection barrier bounding selective repair restricted to this feature family. The signed-flip tax and sign-inseparability carry cross-model; the clean-reference remedy's payout is architecture-modulated; a controlled same-checkpoint flag-swap re-scopes the gate's normalization convention to a damage-magnitude moderator, not a route-recoverability mechanism. A real int4 KV kernel yields a fraction compatible with the fake-quant dose curve but underpowered (95% CI [-0.111, 0.394] includes zero) -- ruling out gross disagreement, not an independent replication. Hypotheses, thresholds, and evaluations were pre-registered before measurement, with misses reported; a pre-registered held-out read replicates the partition and the near-cancelling tax out of sample, while the strict impossibility exclusion narrowly misses.
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Pre-registered pilot study

AI.title_translation: 检测路由翻转比知道是否修复它更容易：量化混合专家模型中的因果路由介导损伤
AI.tldr: 量化会导致MoE模型中路由翻转，本文量化了路由介导的损伤，发现虽然能检测到翻转，但无法区分有害或有益的翻转，且未提出新的缓解措施。
AI.motivation: Top-k混合专家模型（MoE）的路由是不连续的，部署驱动的数值扰动（例如，模拟4位KV缓存量化）会使token越过决策边界，导致专家触发翻转。本文旨在提供一个因果分析工具、经验发现和检测极限结果，以理解和量化这种“路由介导的损伤”，并探究翻转的可检测性以及修复的难度，特别是难以判断何时需要修复。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个因果分析工具、经验发现和检测极限结果。使用一个四次运行的装置来评估量化损伤中路由介导的部分（RMF）。通过token级别的归因来分解损伤机制，并使用预注册的探针在三种架构上验证发现。研究了可部署的路由器裕度检测翻转的能力，并测试了局部、推理可观测的路由器统计量是否能预测翻转的损益符号。此外，还进行了受控的同检查点标志交换实验，并使用真实的int4 KV内核进行验证。所有假设、阈值和评估均在测量前预注册。
AI.result: 在OLMoE-1B-7B模型上，使用4位KV时，约三分之一的损伤是路由介导的，RMF约为0.31（发现值为0.31 [0.20, 0.41]；过程复制均值为0.313 +/- 0.020；预注册重新执行为0.231）。可部署的路由器裕度能够检测到翻转的发生（AUC 0.772）。然而，在测试的局部、推理可观测的路由器统计量中，没有发现任何能预测翻转损益符号的指标高于偶然水平，这意味着无法区分有害翻转和有益翻转。签名的翻转代价和符号不可分离性在跨模型中成立；干净参考补救措施的收益受架构调节；门控的归一化约定是损伤幅度的调节器，而非路由可恢复机制。真实的int4 KV内核产生的损伤比例与假量化剂量曲线兼容，但功率不足（95%置信区间[-0.111, 0.394]包含零）。
AI.conclusion: 检测路由翻转比知道是否修复它更容易，因为在测试的局部、推理可观测的路由器统计量中，无法预测翻转的损益符号，这构成了一个限制选择性修复的经验性效益检测障碍。签名的翻转代价和符号不可分离性是跨模型的。门控的归一化约定是损伤幅度的调节器，而不是路由可恢复机制。
AI.translation: Top-k混合专家模型（MoE）的路由是不连续的，因此部署驱动的数值扰动——模拟4位KV缓存量化由受保护的BF16门读取——将token推过决策边界，并翻转激活的专家。本文没有提出新的缓解措施；它提供了一个因果分析工具、经验发现和检测极限结果。一个四次运行的装置评估量化损伤中路由介导的部分（RMF），token级别的归因按机制分解损伤，预注册的探针将这些发现推广到三种架构。在OLMoE-1B-7B模型上，使用4位KV时（初步），约三分之一的损伤是路由介导的：RMF约为0.31（发现值为0.31 [0.20, 0.41]；过程复制均值为0.313 +/- 0.020；预注册重新执行为0.231）。可部署的路由器裕度可以检测到翻转的发生（AUC 0.772），但无法区分有害翻转和有益翻转（与偶然水平相同）：在测试的局部、推理可观测的路由器统计量中，我们没有发现任何能预测翻转损益符号的指标高于偶然水平——这是一个经验性的效益检测障碍，限制了仅限于此特征族的选择性修复。签名的翻转代价和符号不可分离性在跨模型中成立；干净参考补救措施的收益受架构调节；受控的同检查点标志交换将门控的归一化约定重新定义为损伤幅度的调节器，而非路由可恢复机制。真实的int4 KV内核产生的比例与假量化剂量曲线兼容，但功率不足（95%置信区间[-0.111, 0.394]包含零）——排除了严重分歧，而非独立复制。假设、阈值和评估在测量前已预注册，并报告了遗漏；预注册的保留读取复制了分区和样本外几乎抵消的代价，而严格的不可能性排除则险些错过。
AI.summary: 本论文研究了量化（例如4位KV缓存）对Top-k混合专家模型（MoE）路由的影响，这种影响会导致“路由翻转”。尽管论文没有提出新的缓解措施，但它引入了一个因果框架来量化量化损伤中路由介导的部分（RMF），发现其约为31%。关键的是，论文表明虽然可以检测到路由翻转（AUC 0.772），但现有的局部、推理可观测的路由器统计量无法预测翻转是有害还是有益的，从而建立了一个用于选择性修复的“经验性效益检测障碍”。这些发现，包括“符号不可分离性”，在不同架构中具有普遍性，突出了有效解决此类问题的挑战。
AI.keywords: 混合专家模型, 量化, 路由翻转, 因果损伤, 检测极限
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过严格量化量化MoE模型中路由介导的性能下降，在高效部署的关键领域具有重要意义。其主要创新在于用于损伤归因的因果分析工具和关键的“检测极限结果”，这突显了一个固有的挑战：虽然可以检测到翻转，但无法使用现有的局部统计量预测其影响（有益或有害）。这为有针对性的缓解策略设定了一个基本障碍，将焦点从简单的检测转向更复杂的效应预测。预注册的方法论增强了其经验发现的可信度。论文的局限性在于明确声明“没有提出新的缓解措施”，但其价值在于界定问题及其边界。

title: Poor Man's Agentic Modeling: Simulating Large LLM-Agent Societies on a Laptop
comments: 25 pages, 12 figures. Code and data at github.com/YehudaItkin/poor-mans-agentic-modeling; systematic review and pre-registration archived at Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.21198322, doi:10.5281/zenodo.21340310)
summary: Simulating societies of many large language model (LLM) agents is expensive, yet the questions asked of such simulations are usually macroscopic: phase behaviour, stylised facts, and scaling with the number of agents $N$, not the cognition of any single agent. We turn a statistical-physics observation into a method: replace each LLM agent by a low-parameter model fitted from a few hundred to a few thousand cheap queries, then run the society at any $N$ on a laptop. Whether this works is decided before the simulation runs, chiefly by what each agent perceives. We introduce an [interaction order x memory] taxonomy that maps perception and memory to an effective theory and a predicted $N$-trend of the surrogate error. We validate it on a faithful reimplementation of the LLM macroeconomy EconAgent and seven further named LLM simulations, with agent decisions cloned from genuine LLM elicitations (primarily DeepSeek) for a few dollars; the predicted error trends hold cell by cell, and the two refuted predictions, both on a strongly saturating response and traced to its curvature, are themselves matched quantitatively by the theory with no free parameters.
comment: 25 pages, 12 figures. Code and data at github.com/YehudaItkin/poor-mans-agentic-modeling; systematic review and pre-registration archived at Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.21198322, doi:10.5281/zenodo.21340310)

AI.title_translation: 穷人的Agentic建模：在笔记本电脑上模拟大型LLM代理社会
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种廉价方法，用低参数模型替代大型LLM代理，以在笔记本电脑上模拟大规模LLM代理社会，并通过理论和实验验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 模拟大量的LLM代理社会成本高昂，而这类模拟通常关注宏观行为而非单个代理的认知。
AI.method: 将统计物理学观察转化为方法：用通过少量廉价查询拟合的低参数模型替代每个LLM代理，然后在笔记本电脑上模拟任意数量的社会。引入一个[交互顺序 x 记忆]分类法，将感知和记忆映射到有效理论和替代误差的N趋势预测。
AI.result: 该方法在LLM宏观经济模型EconAgent和七个其他LLM模拟上进行了验证，代理决策克隆自真实的LLM启发（主要是DeepSeek），仅花费少量资金。预测的误差趋势逐单元格成立，两个被驳斥的预测（关于强烈饱和响应及其曲率）也通过无自由参数的理论进行了定量匹配。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功实现了在笔记本电脑上廉价模拟大型LLM代理社会，并且其理论预测与实验结果高度一致。
AI.translation: 模拟许多大型语言模型（LLM）代理的社会成本高昂，然而这类模拟所提出的问题通常是宏观的：相行为、风格化事实以及随代理数量N的扩展，而不是任何单个代理的认知。我们将一个统计物理学观察转化为一种方法：用一个低参数模型取代每个LLM代理，该模型通过数百到数千次廉价查询拟合，然后在笔记本电脑上以任意N值运行社会。这种方法是否有效在模拟运行之前就已经确定，主要取决于每个代理的感知。我们引入了一个[交互顺序 x 记忆]分类法，将感知和记忆映射到有效理论和替代误差的预测N趋势。我们在LLM宏观经济模型EconAgent的忠实重新实现和七个进一步命名的LLM模拟上验证了它，代理决策是从真实的LLM启发（主要是DeepSeek）中克隆出来的，只花费了几美元；预测的误差趋势逐单元格成立，两个被驳斥的预测，都关于强烈的饱和响应并追溯到其曲率，它们本身通过无自由参数的理论进行了定量匹配。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种“穷人的代理建模”方法，旨在解决大规模LLM代理社会模拟成本高昂的问题。通过用廉价查询拟合的低参数模型替代复杂的LLM代理，该方法允许在普通笔记本电脑上模拟大规模代理社会。研究引入了一种基于交互顺序和记忆的分类法来预测模型误差趋势，并在多个LLM模拟（包括EconAgent）上验证了其有效性，结果显示理论预测与实验观察高度一致，证明了该方法在低成本下进行宏观LLM代理社会模拟的可行性。
AI.keywords: LLM代理, 社会模拟, 低参数模型, 成本效益, 统计物理
AI.comments: 这项工作通过将复杂的LLM代理替换为低参数模型，提供了一种极具创新性和成本效益的大规模LLM代理社会模拟方法。其核心贡献在于将统计物理学思想应用于LLM模拟，并提出了一个理论框架来预测和解释替代模型的误差，这对于推动LLM社会模拟研究具有重要意义，尤其是在资源受限的环境下。该方法能够以较低成本探索LLM代理社会的宏观行为，为未来的研究开辟了新途径。

title: AutoWorldModel-Bench: A State-Centric Benchmark for Automated World-Model Research
summary: World modeling is an unsettled field: architectures, training objectives, and state representations interact in complex ways, and no single recipe dominates across environments. This makes it an ideal testbed for AI coding agents acting as autonomous researchers--a setting in which the improvement direction is not specified in advance, unlike the engineering-to-spec tasks that dominate current agent benchmarks. We introduce AutoWorldModel-Bench, a closed-loop benchmark in which frontier coding agents autonomously improve a provided world-model starter under a fixed compute budget. The benchmark spans eight game environments under a unified structured-state representation--ground-truth entity state extracted from each game and consumed through a shared tensor format--which isolates dynamics modeling from perception and enables minutes-per-run iteration. Across 64 sessions, Codex-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.6 improve their starter on 63; in 91% of sessions the winning edit is a non-trivial research-style modification--a new objective, representation, rollout procedure, or architectural change--rather than a hyperparameter tweak. Our benchmark offers a setting in which frontier coding agents can be evaluated on open-ended research rather than engineering-to-spec problems.

AI.title_translation: AutoWorldModel-Bench：一个以状态为中心的自动化世界模型研究基准
AI.tldr: 提出了AutoWorldModel-Bench，一个用于评估AI编码智能体进行开放式世界模型研究的闭环基准，它使用统一的状态表示并在多个环境中测试，结果显示智能体能有效改进世界模型。
AI.motivation: 世界建模领域复杂且没有统一的最佳方案，使其成为评估AI编码智能体作为自主研究人员的理想测试平台，与现有智能体基准中以规范为导向的任务不同，本研究旨在评估智能体进行开放式研究的能力。
AI.method: 引入了AutoWorldModel-Bench，一个闭环基准。在该基准中，前沿编码智能体在固定的计算预算下自主改进提供的世界模型启动器。该基准涵盖八个游戏环境，采用统一的结构化状态表示（从游戏中提取的真实实体状态，并通过共享张量格式使用），从而将动态建模与感知分离，并实现每分钟运行的迭代。
AI.result: 在64个会话中，Codex-5.4和Claude Opus 4.6在63个会话中改进了它们的启动器；在91%的会话中，获胜的修改是“非平凡”的研究式修改（如新的目标、表示、推出过程或架构更改），而不是超参数调整。
AI.conclusion: AutoWorldModel-Bench 提供了一个可以评估前沿编码智能体进行开放式研究而非以规范为导向工程问题的环境。
AI.translation: 世界建模是一个尚未解决的领域：架构、训练目标和状态表示以复杂的方式相互作用，并且没有单一的方案在所有环境中占据主导地位。这使其成为AI编码智能体作为自主研究人员的理想测试平台——在这种设置下，改进方向不是预先指定的，这与当前智能体基准中主导的以规范为导向的工程任务不同。我们引入了AutoWorldModel-Bench，一个闭环基准，其中前沿编码智能体在固定的计算预算下自主改进提供的世界模型启动器。该基准涵盖八个游戏环境，采用统一的结构化状态表示——从每个游戏中提取的真实实体状态并通过共享张量格式使用——这使得动态建模与感知分离，并实现了每分钟运行的迭代。在64个会话中，Codex-5.4和Claude Opus 4.6在63个会话中改进了它们的启动器；在91%的会话中，获胜的修改是“非平凡”的研究式修改——新的目标、表示、推出过程或架构更改——而不是超参数调整。我们的基准提供了一个可以评估前沿编码智能体进行开放式研究而非以规范为导向工程问题的环境。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了AutoWorldModel-Bench，这是一个以状态为中心的闭环基准，旨在评估AI编码智能体作为自主研究人员在世界建模领域的开放式研究能力。该基准采用统一的结构化状态表示，涵盖八个游戏环境，并允许智能体在固定计算预算下自主改进世界模型。实验结果表明，前沿编码智能体能够显著改进世界模型，且大部分改进属于非平凡的研究型修改。该基准为评估智能体在开放式研究问题上的表现提供了一个新颖的设置。
AI.keywords: 世界模型, 基准, 自动化研究, AI编码智能体, 状态表示
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个全新的基准，用于评估AI编码智能体进行“开放式研究”的能力，而非传统的“工程到规范”任务。通过统一的状态表示和闭环设计，它有效地将感知与动态建模分离，并使迭代速度加快。结果显示智能体能够进行复杂的、研究式的修改，这对于推动AI自主研究的发展具有重要意义。该基准为未来评估和开发更通用、更具创造性的AI智能体提供了方向。

title: MaSRead: Content-Addressed Reading of Replicated Latent Stores
summary: Independent agents that reason in latent space can share computed state as key-value cache fragments rather than text. Merged by a conflict-free replicated data type, these fragments form a store that converges under any delivery order or duplication. Yet a later query, unknown at encode time, cannot reliably read the merged cache: colocated fragments interfere, so colocation is not addressability. MaSRead addresses the read to content. It routes through opaque keyed tag sets derived from fragment words and decodes each selected fragment under a hard attention mask that hides the rest. Under lexical connectivity, a graph walk reaches the fragments required by a multi-hop query. Across chain, pipeline, symmetric, hub, and natural-language stores, MaSRead recovers visited fragments in isolation, remains effective as unrelated fragments accumulate, and transfers to another model family. After routing, materialized decoding depends on fragment length rather than total store size; end-to-end work still includes store-dependent routing and one read per visited fragment. The limits are explicit: lexical routing can miss disconnected evidence, and answer composition remains bounded by the frozen reader. Thus a replicated latent store becomes selectively readable for later queries when the needed fragments connect to the query through content.

AI.title_translation: MaSRead：复制潜在存储的内容寻址读取
AI.tldr: MaSRead通过内容寻址和硬注意力机制，解决了多智能体系统中共享潜在缓存的干扰问题，实现了对复制潜在状态的高效、选择性读取。
AI.motivation: 独立智能体在潜在空间中共享计算状态（键值缓存片段）时，由于合并后的片段会相互干扰，导致后续未知查询无法可靠地读取合并后的缓存（即共置不等同于可寻址性）。
AI.method: 通过从片段词汇中派生出的不透明键控标签集进行路由，并在解码每个选定片段时使用隐藏其余部分的硬注意力掩码，结合图遍历以满足多跳查询的需求。
AI.result: MaSRead能够在隔离状态下恢复访问过的片段，随着不相关片段的积累依然保持有效，并且能够迁移到其他模型系列；物化解码的计算量取决于片段长度而非总存储大小。
AI.conclusion: MaSRead通过内容寻址和硬注意力机制，成功实现了对复制潜在存储的高效、选择性读取，克服了传统潜在状态共享中的片段干扰问题。
AI.translation: 在潜在空间中进行推理的独立 agents 可以将计算出的状态作为键值缓存片段而非文本进行共享。这些片段通过无冲突复制数据类型进行合并，形成一个在任何交付顺序或重复情况下都能收敛的存储库。然而，在编码时未知的后续查询无法可靠地读取合并后的缓存：共置的片段会产生干扰，因此共置并不等同于可寻址性。MaSRead 实现了按内容读取。它通过派生自片段词汇的不透明键控标签集进行路由，并在隐藏其余部分的硬注意力掩码下解码每个选定的片段。在词汇连通性下，图遍历可以到达多跳查询所需的片段。在链式、管道式、对称式、中心式和自然语言存储中，MaSRead 能够独立恢复访问过的片段，在不相关片段累积时依然有效，并可迁移到另一个模型系列。路由之后，物化解码取决于片段长度而不是总存储大小；端到端的工作仍然包括存储依赖的路由和对每个访问片段的一次读取。其局限性是显式的：词汇路由可能会错过不连通的证据，答案组合仍然受到冻结阅读器的限制。因此，当所需的片段通过内容连接到查询时，复制的潜在存储就可以针对后续查询进行选择性读取。
AI.summary: MaSRead是一种用于复制潜在存储的内容寻址读取方法，它通过基于内容的标签路由和硬注意力掩码，解决了多智能体潜在状态共享中的片段干扰问题，实现了高效且可扩展的潜在缓存检索。
AI.keywords: 潜在空间, 键值缓存, 内容寻址, 冲突无关复制数据类型, 多智能体推理
AI.comments: 该论文提出了MaSRead方法，解决了独立智能体在潜在空间中共享和读取键值缓存片段时的冲突与干扰问题，通过基于内容的寻址和硬注意力掩蔽实现了高效、可扩展且跨模型家族的潜在状态检索。其创新性在于将CRDT与内容寻址机制相结合，为多智能体系统的隐空间协作提供了新的途径。

title: From Monolithic to Modular: Segment-level Automatic Prompt Optimization
comments: Accepted at the IJCAI-ECAI 2026 Workshop on Robustifying Generative AI for Reliable, Safe, and Human-Centric Systems (RobustifAI)
summary: Automatic Prompt Optimization (APO) often rewrites prompts monolithically, which can improve one behavior while degrading others. We present SAPO, a segment-level APO method that decomposes prompts into role, context, tasks, and output format, then applies targeted improvements based on top-5 and bottom-5 examples. The optimization loop uses one LLM with static meta-prompts and structured outputs for segmentation, weakness analysis, and candidate generation. We describe a train/validation protocol and a two-stage generation process: (1) segment-level diagnosis and recommendation extraction, (2) candidate synthesis constrained by weak/strong segment signals. Using the evaluation setup across SQuADv2, TweetEval, XSUM, CommonGen, and GSM8K on GPT-3.5-Turbo and GPT-4o-mini, SAPO achieves the best average score against Zero-shot and strong APO baselines including APE, OPRO, EvoPrompt, GEPA, and StraGO.
comment: Accepted at the IJCAI-ECAI 2026 Workshop on Robustifying Generative AI for Reliable, Safe, and Human-Centric Systems (RobustifAI)

AI.title_translation: 从整体到模块化：分段级自动提示优化
AI.tldr: SAPO是一种分段级自动提示优化方法，通过将提示分解并进行有针对性的改进，在多个基准测试中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动提示优化（APO）方法通常以整体方式重写提示，这可能在改善某个行为的同时损害其他行为，因此需要一种更精细的优化方法。
AI.method: 本文提出了SAPO，一种分段级自动提示优化方法。它将提示分解为角色、上下文、任务和输出格式，然后根据表现最好的5个和最差的5个示例应用有针对性的改进。优化循环使用一个带有静态元提示和结构化输出的大型语言模型（LLM），用于分段、弱点分析和候选生成。该方法采用训练/验证协议和两阶段生成过程：(1) 分段级诊断和推荐提取，(2) 受弱/强分段信号约束的候选合成。
AI.result: 在SQuADv2、TweetEval、XSUM、CommonGen和GSM8K数据集上，使用GPT-3.5-Turbo和GPT-4o-mini进行评估，SAPO在与零样本和包括APE、OPRO、EvoPrompt、GEPA、StraGO在内的强大APO基线方法比较中，取得了最佳平均分数。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的SAPO方法通过分段级优化，有效地解决了整体提示优化可能带来的负面影响，并在多个任务和模型上取得了优于现有基线方法的性能。
AI.translation: 自动提示优化（APO）通常以整体方式重写提示，这可能在改善某个行为的同时损害其他行为。我们提出了SAPO，一种分段级APO方法，它将提示分解为角色、上下文、任务和输出格式，然后根据表现最好的5个和最差的5个示例应用有针对性的改进。优化循环使用一个带有静态元提示和结构化输出的大型语言模型（LLM），用于分段、弱点分析和候选生成。我们描述了一个训练/验证协议和两阶段生成过程：(1) 分段级诊断和推荐提取，(2) 受弱/强分段信号约束的候选合成。在SQuADv2、TweetEval、XSUM、CommonGen和GSM8K数据集上，使用GPT-3.5-Turbo和GPT-4o-mini进行评估，SAPO在与零样本和包括APE、OPRO、EvoPrompt、GEPA、StraGO在内的强大APO基线方法比较中，取得了最佳平均分数。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为SAPO的分段级自动提示优化（APO）方法，旨在解决传统整体APO可能导致的性能下降问题。SAPO将提示分解为多个语义段（如角色、上下文、任务），并基于示例进行有针对性的优化。通过一个LLM驱动的两阶段过程进行诊断和候选生成，SAPO在多个基准测试和大型语言模型上，显著优于零样本和包括APE、OPRO等在内的现有APO基线方法，实现了更好的平均性能。
AI.keywords: 自动提示优化, 分段级优化, 大型语言模型, 提示工程, SAPO
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了分段级的提示优化策略，而非传统的整体优化，这能够更精细地解决提示优化中的局部问题，避免“顾此失彼”的情况。其模块化的方法和LLM驱动的优化循环显示了在提示工程自动化方面的进步，对于提升大型语言模型在复杂任务上的表现具有重要意义。

title: LLMs in Process Diagram Engineering: From Optimal PFDs to Validated P&IDs
summary: Nowadays, the creation of a process flow diagram (PFD) and its subsequent transformation into a piping and instrumentation diagram (P&ID) is predominantly performed manually. Applying artificial intelligence in the task could potentially lead not only to process automation and time savings, but also to financial gains by exploring numerous diagram's topology options and reducing manual labor. This research presents P&ID Pilot - a practical end-to-end AI pipeline capable of handling flowsheet developing for both stages. The first stage focuses on PFD synthesis, whereas the second is directed toward modifying the generated PFD into P&ID. After comparing four different methods, the hybrid approach combining genetic algorithms (GA) and large language models (LLM) is shown to generate the optimal valid PFD topology, achieving the lowest loss value among all the methods, while satisfying the required outlet flow parameters without engineering-rule violations. For the second stage, the proposed LLM-based agent successfully transforms the generated PFD into a source-grounded P&ID by producing validated, executable modifications through a restricted engineering software development kit, achieving 100% execution success while maintaining compliance with domain-specific rules and reference graph structures. This unified pipeline - coupling GA/LLM-driven synthesis with an LLM-based transformation agent - offers a feasible path toward end-to-end process design automation by producing validated, deployable outputs and substantially reduces manual engineering effort.

AI.title_translation: 大语言模型在过程图工程中的应用：从最优PFD到验证过的P&ID
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合遗传算法与大语言模型的端到端AI管道（P&ID Pilot），实现了工艺流程图（PFD）到管道与仪表流程图（P&ID）的自动化、优化生成与转换。
AI.motivation: 目前工艺流程图(PFD)的创建及其向管道与仪表流程图(P&ID)的转化主要依靠人工完成，应用人工智能可以实现过程自动化、节省时间、获得经济效益并减少人工劳动。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为P&ID Pilot的端到端AI管道，第一阶段采用结合遗传算法与大语言模型的混合方法进行PFD合成，第二阶段采用基于大语言模型的智能体通过受限的工程软件开发工具包将PFD转换为P&ID。
AI.result: 混合方法在PFD合成中生成了最优且有效的拓扑结构，损失值最低且无工程规则违规；在P&ID转换阶段，基于LLM的智能体实现了100%的执行成功率，同时保持了对领域特定规则和参考图结构的遵从。
AI.conclusion: 提出的P&ID Pilot端到端AI管道能够有效实现过程图工程的自动化，通过GA/LLM结合与LLM智能体转换，达成100%的执行成功率并满足领域规则。
AI.translation: 如今，工艺流程图（PFD）的创建及其随后向管道与仪表流程图（P&ID）的转化主要由人工完成。在该任务中应用人工智能不仅可以实现过程自动化和节省时间，还可以通过探索图的众多拓扑选项和减少人工劳动带来经济效益。本研究提出了P&ID Pilot——一个实用的端到端AI管道，能够处理两个阶段的流程图开发。第一阶段侧重于PFD合成，第二阶段则致力于将生成的PFD修改为P&ID。在比较了四种不同的方法后，结合遗传算法（GA）和大语言模型（LLM）的混合方法被证明能够生成最优的有效PFD拓扑结构，在所有方法中实现最低的损失值，同时满足所需的出口流参数且没有违反工程规则。对于第二阶段，所提出的基于LLM的智能体通过受限的工程软件开发工具包产生经过验证的可执行修改，成功地将生成的PFD转换为基于源的P&ID，在保持符合特定领域规则和参考图结构的同时，实现了100%的执行成功率。这个统一的管道——将GA/LLM驱动的合成与基于LLM的转换智能体相结合——通过产生经过验证的可部署输出，为端到端过程设计自动化提供了一条可行的途径，并大大减少了手动工程工作。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了P&ID Pilot，一个能够处理工艺流程图（PFD）合成与管道仪表流程图（P&ID）转换的端到端AI管道。该管道结合了遗传算法与大语言模型，成功实现了最优PFD拓扑结构的生成以及向合规P&ID的自动化转换。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 遗传算法, 工艺流程图, 管道与仪表流程图, 过程设计自动化
AI.comments: 本文创新性地结合了遗传算法与大语言模型，实现了化工流程图中工艺流程图(PFD)的最优化合成以及向管道与仪表流程图(P&ID)的自动化转换，显著减少了人工工程量并确保了工程规范性。

title: A Conceptual Framework for Refining Influence Knowledge from Simulation Evidence in Cyber-Physical Systems
summary: Cyber-physical systems (CPS) are typically developed by multiple stakeholders who produce artefacts tailored to their specific domains of expertise. The behaviour of these systems emerges from the interaction between those artefacts and their operational environment. Simulation and co-simulation have become essential approaches for analysing CPS behaviour and, through simulation campaigns, developers can explore system responses under changing conditions, including interactions with the environment. However, the lack of details and understanding of some environmentmediated interactions (typically the ones beyond direct sensing and actuation), which remain unmodelled due to their complexity, a lack of time, or a lack of domain experience, hinders the proper comprehension and exploitation of simulation results. To address these limitations, we propose a conceptual framework leveraging the novel concept of Influences to support the iterative and incremental refinement of simulation campaigns and deepen the understanding of the system behaviour. We demonstrate the proposed approach through a case study involving a mobile robot implemented using Simulink/Gazebo co-simulation.

AI.title_translation: 从网络物理系统仿真证据中提炼影响知识的概念框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于“影响”概念的概念框架，用于解决网络物理系统中未建模环境交互带来的仿真理解难题，并通过移动机器人案例进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 网络物理系统中存在许多因复杂性、时间限制或领域经验不足而未建模的环境介导交互，这阻碍了对仿真结果的正确理解和利用，因此需要一种方法来提炼和精化这些影响知识。
AI.method: 提出一个利用“影响（Influences）”概念的概念框架，支持仿真活动的迭代和增量细化，并通过一个涉及使用 Simulink/Gazebo 协同实现的移动机器人的案例研究进行了演示。
AI.result: 通过移动机器人的案例研究（使用 Simulink/Gazebo 协同仿真），成功演示了所提出的方法，验证了其在深化系统行为理解方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本论文提出的概念框架能够有效利用仿真证据提炼影响知识，并通过移动机器人的案例研究验证了其可行性，从而深化了对网络物理系统行为的理解。
AI.translation: 网络物理系统（CPS）通常由多个利益相关者开发，他们各自生产适合其专业领域的制品。这些系统的行为源于这些制品与其操作环境之间的相互作用。仿真和协同仿真已成为分析CPS行为的重要方法，通过仿真活动，开发人员可以在变化的条件下探索系统响应，包括与环境的交互。然而，由于复杂性、时间缺乏或领域经验缺乏而未建模的某些环境介导交互（通常是超越直接传感和驱动的交互）缺乏细节和理解，阻碍了对仿真结果的正确理解和利用。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一个利用“影响”这一新概念的概念框架，以支持仿真活动的迭代和增量细化，并加深对系统行为的理解。我们通过一个涉及使用 Simulink/Gazebo 协同仿真实现的移动机器人的案例研究来证明所提出的方法。
AI.summary: 本文针对网络物理系统（CPS）中由于未建模环境交互而导致仿真结果难以理解的问题，提出了一种基于“影响”概念的新型概念框架，用于迭代改进仿真并加深对系统行为的理解，并通过移动机器人协同仿真案例进行了验证。
AI.keywords: 信息物理系统, 协同仿真, 影响知识, 概念框架, 行为分析
AI.comments: 该论文针对信息物理系统（CPS）中未建模的环境交互带来的仿真理解局限性，提出了一种新颖的概念框架，通过引入“影响（Influences）”的概念来迭代细化仿真。这对于提高CPS设计的可靠性和深入理解系统行为具有重要意义。

title: Harnessing agent memory to build lifelong AI partners for materials scientists
summary: Materials research advances through accumulated experience - scripts that work, protocols that are trusted, warnings attached to failed calculations or experiments, and judgement that links a new question to an old result. This experience is essential for reproducibility and knowledge transfer, yet it is usually fragmented across notebooks, repositories, job logs and individual memory, and it is rarely portable across artificial-intelligence agents. Here we argue that a lifelong AI partner for materials science can be designed around persistent memory rather than around a particular agent implementation. We introduce a self-evolving memory framework that stores scientific experience as inspectable facts and executable skills, so that observations, failure boundaries, protocols and validation checks can be retrieved, revised and migrated across models. We evaluate the idea in three computational settings that expose different layers of materials-research competence. In 49 real-world materials-tool-use questions comprising 138 executable subtasks, memory nearly doubles GPT-5.2 task success without model-parameter updates. In elemental-solid equation-of-state calculations, memory converts a wavefunction-initialization failure into a pre-execution guardrail, improving outcomes from 22/1/4 to 25/2/0 Correct/Partial/Error and avoiding 92% of repeated errors. In 13 practical material simulation workflows, remembered skills and failure facts halve the aggregate trace burden (tokens) and reduce tool calls by over a factor of two by the third round, while preserving physically meaningful outputs in band-gap, phonon, vacancy and work-function analyses. These results show that agent memory can serve as a durable scientific asset; a portable, self-improving record of materials-research experience that outlives any single model or agent stack.

AI.title_translation: 利用代理记忆为材料科学家构建终身AI伙伴
AI.tldr: 通过引入自进化记忆框架，使AI代理能够积累、迁移和利用材料科学研究经验，从而显著提升复杂计算和模拟任务的成功率与效率。
AI.motivation: 材料研究依赖于积累的经验，但这些经验通常碎片化且难以在不同的AI代理之间移植，因此需要构建一个围绕持久化记忆设计、能够作为终身AI伙伴的系统。
AI.method: 引入一个自 evolving（自进化）的记忆框架，将科学经验存储为可检查的事实和可执行的技能，使其能够在不同模型间检索、修改和迁移。
AI.result: 在49个真实材料工具使用问题中，记忆使GPT-5.2的任务成功率接近翻倍；在状态方程计算中避免了92%的重复错误；在13个实际模拟工作流中，将总token消耗减半，并将工具调用次数减少了一半以上。
AI.conclusion: 代理记忆能够作为一种持久的科学资产，超越单一模型或代理栈，显著提升材料科学AI研究的成功率、效率和可靠性。
AI.translation: 材料研究通过积累的经验不断进展——起作用的脚本、受信任的协议、附加在失败计算或实验上的警告，以及将新问题与旧结果联系起来的判断。这种经验对于可重复性和知识转移至关重要，但它通常碎片化地散落在使用手册、仓库、作业日志和个人记忆中，且很少能在不同的AI代理之间移植。在此，我们认为可以围绕持久化记忆而非特定的代理实现来设计材料科学的终身AI伙伴。我们引入了一个自进化的记忆框架，将科学经验存储为可检查的事实和可执行的技能，以便检索、修改观察结果、失败边界、协议和验证检查，并在不同模型间进行迁移。我们在三个暴露材料研究不同层级能力的计算设置中评估了这一理念。在包含138个可执行子任务的49个真实材料工具使用问题中，记忆在没有更新模型参数的情况下，使GPT-5.2的任务成功率接近翻倍。在元素固态状态方程计算中，记忆将波函数初始化失败转化为执行前防护栏，将结果从22/1/4（正确/部分/错误）改善至25/2/0，并避免了92%的重复错误。在13个实际材料模拟工作流中，到第三轮时，被记住的技能和失败事实使总体轨迹负担（token）减半，工具调用次数减少了一半以上，同时在能带隙、声子、空位和功函数分析中保持了物理上有意义的输出。这些结果表明，代理记忆可以作为一种持久的科学资产；一个超越任何单一模型或代理栈的、可移植且自我改进的材料研究经验记录。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种基于自进化持久记忆框架的终身AI材料科学伙伴，通过将科学经验转化为可检查的事实和可执行的技能，显著提高了材料计算和模拟的成功率、效率并减少了重复错误。
AI.keywords: AI代理, 材料科学, 持久记忆, 科学计算, 自进化框架
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出以持久化、自进化记忆架构赋能AI材料科学家，有效解决了传统AI跨模型知识不通、经验碎片化和重复犯错的问题，对科学大模型的发展具有重要推动作用。

title: Identity from the Outside: A Conceptual Framework and Research Program for AI Personality Clones
summary: AI "personality clones" force a re-examination of personal identity in operational terms. Setting aside the hard problem of consciousness, we approach identity through the indiscernibility of manifestations, as assessed by an observer over a duration. We distinguish three criteria that "identity" conflates: fidelity to a target person, generic human-likeness, and individuality. We propose a six-term factorization of observed identity (substrate, dispositions, memory, update dynamics, context, exogenous contingencies), with a state-space formulation. Indiscernibility is defined as one minus a judge's distinguishing advantage, and the factorization's coefficients become local sensitivities estimable by randomized ablation. The central claim is a conditional conjecture: given hypotheses about the agent's information on its own persistence and about consequences bearing on its own stakes, versionability tends to degrade long-horizon indiscernibility. An analogy with lambda-calculus, linear typing, and bisimulation clarifies what linearity does and does not establish. Between product-clone and individual we identify a third object, the delegate: a task-limited, bounded-lifespan partial clone ending in a bandwidth-limited testament. We map the empirical literature onto the three criteria, propose an experimental program, and argue that the correct long-horizon criterion is not trajectory fidelity but climate fidelity: matching the conditional distribution of a person's possible responses. The best clone is the one that diverges from the original as the original would have diverged from itself.

AI.title_translation: 外部视角下的身份：AI个性克隆的概念框架与研究计划
AI.tldr: 本文为AI个性克隆建立了一个严谨的概念和数学框架，提出评估AI克隆的终极标准不是轨迹保真度，而是“气候保真度”——即像原主一样发生自我分化的能力。
AI.motivation: AI“个性克隆”技术迫使人们在操作层面上重新审视个人身份，但现有的关于身份认同的讨论往往混淆了多个标准，缺乏一个严谨的理论和数学框架来界定、评估和研究AI克隆体与真实人物之间的相符程度。
AI.method: 提出一个六项因子分解的观测身份模型（基质、性格、记忆、更新动态、上下文、外生偶然性），采用状态空间表述，利用随机消融估计局部敏感性，并借助lambda演算和双模拟进行理论澄清。
AI.result: 将身份区分为了三个标准（对目标人物的保真度、通用拟人度、个体性），识别出介于产品克隆和个体之间的第三种对象——“代表”（delegate），并论证了版本控制往往会降低长期不可区分性。
AI.conclusion: 长远来看，“气候保真度”（即匹配个人可能反应的条件分布）优于传统的轨迹保真度。最好的克隆体应该是那些能像原始人物自身一样发生分化的系统。
AI.translation: AI“个性克隆”迫使人们在操作层面上重新审视个人身份。抛开意识的难题，我们通过观察者在一段时间内评估的表现的不可区分性来探讨身份。我们区分了“身份”所混淆的三种标准：对目标人物的保真度、通用拟人度和个体性。我们提出了观测身份的六项因子分解（基质、性格、记忆、更新动态、上下文、外生偶然性），并采用了状态空间表述。不可区分性定义为1减去裁判的区分优势，因子分解的系数则变为可通过随机消融估计的局部敏感性。核心主张是一个条件猜想：鉴于关于代理对其自身持久性的信息以及关于影响其自身利益的后果的假设，版本化往往会降低长期不可区分性。与lambda演算、线性类型学和双模拟的类比阐明了线性所建立和未建立的内容。在产品克隆和个体之间，我们识别出了第三个对象——代表（delegate）：一个任务受限、寿命有限、以带宽受限的遗嘱结束的部分克隆体。我们将实证文献映射到这三个标准上，提出了一个实验计划，并认为正确的长期标准不是轨迹保真度，而是气候保真度：匹配一个人可能反应的条件分布。最好的克隆体是当原始人自己会发生分化时，它也以同样方式与原始人分化的克隆体。
AI.summary: 该论文针对AI个性克隆提出了一个概念框架与研究计划，通过外在表现的不可区分性来探讨个人身份。文章将身份混淆的三个标准进行了解构，提出了六项因子分解的观测身份状态空间模型，引入了“气候保真度”作为长远评估标准，并规划了相应的实验路线图。
AI.keywords: AI personality clones, personal identity, indiscernibility, trajectory fidelity, climate fidelity
AI.comments: 该论文从外在表现（由观察者评估）的角度切入，对AI“个性克隆”的个人身份问题进行了高度原创且系统化的理论建构，将模糊的“身份”拆解为可量化的维度和可操作的数学/计算框架，为数字人及AI人格研究提供了重要的理论基础。

title: Cutting AI Datacenter Energy with Reinforcement Learning: Measured Power Control of LLM Training from One GPU to the Fleet
summary: Reinforcement-learning post-training dominates modern language-model development, yet its power behavior on GPU hardware has not been characterized, and datacenters manage GPU power with workload-blind mechanisms, static caps and reactive throttling, that slow hardware indiscriminately. We instrument GRPO training with half-second power telemetry at 7B, 14B, and 72B scales on one to four A100s (380,000+ samples), and train a PPO meta-controller that adapts the workload's own generation parameters to measured power. Against the full 500-step 7B trace, the controller cuts power-limit violations by 89.8% while increasing token output by 18.1% and energy efficiency by 26.2% (tokens per MWh). Deployed live at 72B, the same controller family yields replicated null results, diagnosed as the group-size actuator losing authority under model sharding. An actuator-authority sweep shows the same parameters applied as generation concurrency retain 17-22% power authority, isolating an occupancy-versus-volume principle; a controller rebuilt on that actuator controls a live 72B rollout-generation workload across three replications: 35.7% more output than a static safe baseline at 2.27 +/- 1.08% budget violations, 87.2% fewer violations than uncontrolled operation, and the best mean throughput and energy per token among constrained controllers, with an adaptive threshold rule matching it in one of three operating conditions. Under realistic measurement windows the original 72B transients fall from 23.6% at half-second resolution to 1.6% at 30 s and zero at 5 min; a composed 16-GPU fleet shows zero violations at 30 s and longer, with peak demand at 50-56% of nameplate. For this fleet mix, roughly twofold oversubscription of nameplate appears feasible, subject to operator validation. We quantify the economic and carbon consequences and specify a low-cost operator pilot.

AI.title_translation: 利用强化学习削减AI数据中心能耗：从单个GPU到集群的大语言模型训练实测功率控制
AI.tldr: 通过强化学习动态调整LLM训练参数，该研究成功将GPU功耗违规率大幅降低，同时显著提升了能源效率和代币输出，为AI数据中心节能和集群超额订阅提供了新方案。
AI.motivation: 现代语言模型开发中由强化学习后训练占据主导，但其在GPU硬件上的功耗行为尚未得到充分表征；目前数据中心普遍采用工作负载盲区机制、静态上限和反应式节流阀来管理GPU功率，这些方法会无差别地拖慢硬件性能。
AI.method: 研究团队在单台至四台A100 GPU上，以7B、14B和72B规模对GRPO训练进行了0.5秒级别的功耗遥测（超38万个样本），并训练了一个PPO元控制器，通过动态调整工作负载自身的生成参数来适应测量的功耗。
AI.result: 在7B模型的全长500步测试中，控制器将功耗超标违规减少了89.8%，同时代币输出增加了18.1%，能效提升了26.2%；在72B模型的实时部署中，通过调整执行器恢复功率控制权限，控制器在实现比静态安全基线多35.7%的产出的同时，违规率减少了87.2%，并使16GPU集群在30秒及以上时间窗口内实现零违规，名义功率峰值降至50-56%。
AI.conclusion: 基于强化学习的功率控制能够有效解决LLM训练中的功耗违规问题，在提升能源效率和代币产出的同时，为数据中心的安全超额订阅（oversubscription）提供了切实可行的技术路径。
AI.translation: 强化学习后训练在现代语言模型开发中占主导地位，然而其在GPU硬件上的功耗行为尚未被表征，且数据中心采用工作负载盲区机制、静态上限和反应式节流来管理GPU功率，这无差别地拖慢了硬件。我们在1到4个A100上以7B、14B和72B规模、以0.5秒的功率遥测对GRPO训练进行了仪器化测量（超过38万个样本），并训练了一个PPO元控制器，根据测量的功率调整工作负载自身的生成参数。针对完整的500步7B追踪，该控制器在将代币输出增加18.1%、能效（每MWh代币数）提高26.2%的同时，将功率超标违规减少了89.8%。在72B规模下实时部署时，由于模型分片导致组大小执行器丧失控制权，相同的控制器家族产生了重复的无效结果。执行器控制权扫描表明，作为生成并发应用的相同参数保留了17-22%的功率控制权，从而分离出了占用率与容量原则；在此执行器上重建的控制器在三个重复实验中控制了实时的72B rollout生成工作负载：比静态安全基线多35.7%的输出（预算违规率为2.27 +/- 1.08%），比非受控操作违规减少87.2%，并具有受约束控制器中最佳的平均吞吐量和每个代币的能量，自适应阈值规则在三种运行条件之一中与其相匹配。在现实的测量窗口下，原始72B瞬态从0.5秒分辨率下的23.6%下降到30秒时的1.6%以及5分钟时的零；一个由16个GPU组成的混合集群在30秒及以上时间内显示零违规，峰值需求为名义额定值的50-56%。对于这种集群组合，大约两倍的名义过载似乎是可行的，具体取决于运营商验证。我们量化了经济和碳后果，并指定了一个低成本的操作员试点。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种利用强化学习元控制器根据测量功耗动态调整LLM训练生成参数的方法，显著降低了GPU功耗违规率，提高了能源效率和代币吞吐量，并验证了其在大规模GPU集群中的可行性。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 大模型训练, 能耗控制, 数据中心, GPU功率管理
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将强化学习元控制器应用于大语言模型训练中的GPU功耗控制，打破了传统数据中心工作负载盲区（workload-blind）的静态功耗管理限制，在提升能效的同时显著增加了代币输出，对降低AI数据中心能耗具有重要实践意义。

title: Forecasting Side Effects of Activation Steering
summary: Activation steering modifies a language model by adding a learned direction to its hidden activations, enabling targeted behavioral changes without retraining. While effective, steering often produces unintended side effects on other behaviors, making it difficult to deploy safely. We therefore ask: can these side effects be forecasted before steering is applied? We answer this question by constructing a cross-effect matrix over a taxonomy of 67 behaviors across three open-weight language models. We find that side effects are common, structured, and often asymmetric, revealing interactions that cannot be explained by existing similarity-based heuristics. Despite this complexity, we show that side effects are largely predictable before steering is performed. Their magnitude depends primarily on the target behavior, while their direction can be forecasted from the model's unsteered representations with substantially higher accuracy than simple baselines. Our results demonstrate that activation steering has systematic and forecastable side effects, enabling proactive safety auditing and more informed deployment of steering interventions.

AI.title_translation: 预测激活引导的副作用
AI.tldr: 大语言模型激活引导的副作用可以在应用前被准确预测，从而实现更安全的主动审计。
AI.motivation: 激活引导虽然能有效改变模型行为，但常常会产生未知的副作用，从而妨碍其安全部署。因此，论文旨在探讨在应用引导之前是否能够预测这些副作用。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含3个开源大语言模型、覆盖67种行为分类的交叉效应矩阵，并利用模型未引导的表征来预测副作用的幅度和方向。
AI.result: 副作用很常见、具有结构性且往往是不对称的；其幅度主要取决于目标行为，而其方向可以从模型未引导的表征中以显著高于简单基线的高准确率进行预测。
AI.conclusion: 激活引导产生的副作用并非完全随机，而是具有系统性和可预测性，这为实现主动的安全审计和更安全的模型部署奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 激活通过在隐藏激活中添加学习到的方向来修改语言模型，从而实现有针对性的行为更改，而无需重新训练。虽然有效，但引导通常会对其他行为产生意想不到的副作用，使其难以安全部署。因此，我们提出这样一个问题：在应用引导之前能否预测这些副作用？通过在三个开源语言模型的67种行为分类上构建交叉效应矩阵，我们回答了这个问题。我们发现，副作用很常见、具有结构性且往往是不对称的，这揭示了无法用现有的基于相似性的启发式方法解释的交互。尽管存在这种复杂性，但我们证明，在执行引导之前，副作用在很大程度上是可预测的。它们的幅度主要取决于目标行为，而它们的方向可以从模型未引导的表征中预测出来，其准确率明显高于简单的基线。我们的结果表明，激活引导具有系统性和可预测的副作用，从而能够进行主动的安全审计和更明智的引导干预部署。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了大语言模型激活引导中的副作用预测问题。通过构建交叉效应矩阵，作者发现副作用虽然复杂且呈非对称性，但其幅度和方向可以通过模型未引导的表征在引导应用前被高精度预测，从而支持了主动的安全审计。
AI.keywords: 激活引导, 语言模型, 副作用预测, 安全审计, 模型表征
AI.comments: 该论文探讨了激活引导（Activation Steering）中不可避免的副作用问题，首次系统性地研究了如何通过模型未引导的表征预测这些副作用，为大语言模型的安全审计和可控干预提供了重要的新思路。创新点在于构建了跨行为的交叉效应矩阵并实现了副作用的可预测性。

title: Synchronizing Beliefs with Second-Order Theory-of-Mind in Human-Autonomy Teams (Extended Version)
summary: Comparative feedback, asking people which of two behaviors they prefer, has become a standard way to align robot and agent behavior with human intent when the reward itself cannot be specified directly. Preference-based reward learning typically casts the human teacher as a passive oracle answering learner-generated queries. We argue this forfeits the teacher's defining advantage: knowledge of the objective. A teacher who knows the target can construct training examples more efficiently than any learner-driven acquisition strategy, an advantage that widens as the reward's feature dimension grows. However, exploiting this advantage requires an accurate model of what the learner currently knows. We therefore recast preference learning as a human-autonomy team problem coupling two behavioral models: the teacher maintains a model of the learner to design an informative curriculum, and the learner maintains a second-order model of the teacher's model, emitting structured preference constraints (understanding statements) that keep the teacher's model of the learner synchronized. In simulation, an informed teacher outperforms learner-led selection; teacher-model drift under alternating teachers erodes this advantage; and understanding statements repair it, with second-order (ToM-2) statements outperforming mean-belief statements when the teacher's error about the learner is concentrated in a particular direction rather than spread evenly.

AI.title_translation: 人机团队中利用二阶心智理论同步信念（扩展版）
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用二阶心智理论在人机团队中同步信念的方法，使知情的人类教师和自主学习者能够通过结构化偏好约束更高效地进行奖励学习。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于偏好的奖励学习将人类教师视为被动预言机，这放弃了教师拥有目标知识的优势；为了利用这一优势并随着奖励特征维度增长保持高效，需要一个准确的模型来了解学习者当前的已知信息。
AI.method: 提出将偏好学习转化为一个耦合两个行为模型的团队问题：教师维护一个学习者模型来设计课程，而学习者维护一个关于教师模型的二阶模型，发出结构化的偏好约束（理解语句）来同步教师对学习者的模型。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，知情教师优于学习者主导的选择；交替教师导致的教师模型漂移会削弱这种优势；而理解语句可以修复这种漂移，其中在教师错误集中时，二阶心智理论（ToM-2）语句优于平均信念语句。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合二阶心智理论的信念同步机制，知情教师和自主学习者能够构建更高效的训练课程，理解语句能有效修复教师模型漂移带来的性能下降。
AI.translation: 比较反馈（询问人们更喜欢哪种行为）已成为当无法直接指定奖励时，使机器人和智能体行为与人类意图保持一致的标准方法。基于偏好的奖励学习通常将人类教师视为回答学习者生成查询的被动预言机。我们认为这放弃了教师的决定性优势：对目标的了解。了解目标的教师比任何学习者驱动的获取策略都能更高效地构建训练示例，随着奖励特征维度的增长，这种优势会扩大。然而，利用这一优势需要准确的模型来了解学习者当前已知的信息。因此，我们将偏好学习重新定义为一个耦合两个行为模型的人机团队问题：教师维护一个学习者模型来设计信息丰富的课程，而学习者维护一个关于教师模型的二阶模型，发出结构化的偏好约束（理解语句），以保持教师对学习者的模型同步。在仿真中，知情教师的表现优于学习者主导的选择；交替教师下的教师模型漂移会削弱这种优势；而理解语句可以修复它，当教师对学习者的错误集中在特定方向而不是均匀分布时，二阶（ToM-2）语句的表现优于平均信念语句。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种在人机团队中利用二阶心智理论同步信念的方法，将人类视为拥有目标知识的主动教师，通过学习者发出的结构化偏好约束来保持教师模型同步，从而提高奖励学习的效率。
AI.keywords: 心智理论, 人机协作, 偏好学习, 奖励学习, 信念同步
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将二阶心智理论（Second-Order Theory-of-Mind）引入人机协同的偏好学习中，打破了传统偏好学习中人类仅作为被动预言机的假设，展示了交互式信念同步在高效奖励学习中的重要作用。

title: The Edge-based Contiguous p-median Problem with Connections to Logistics Districting
summary: This paper introduces the edge-based contiguous p-median (ECpM) problem to partition the roads in a network into a given number of compact and contiguous territories. Two binary programming models are introduced, both of which incorporate a network distance. The first model requires an exponential number of cut set-based constraints to model contiguity; it is paired with a separation scheme that usually generates only a small number of these constraints, namely, a branch-and-cut (B&C) algorithm. The second model utilizes a polynomial number of shortest-path constraints to model contiguity and can be solved with off-the-shelf solvers. The respective solution approaches are tested on road networks with over 2,700 nodes and close to 3,400 edges, yielding models with over 9.6 million binary variables. Solving the model based on shortest path contiguity (SPC) constraints via standard branch and bound attains speedups in computational time of up to 17x relative to the cut set-based B&C implementation. In addition, the SPC constraints are demonstrated to be supervalid inequalities of the edge-based p-median (EpM) model (i.e., for which contiguity is not explicitly required), meaning that they may cut off integer-feasible solutions and some, but not all, of the optimal solutions of this simpler problem. Finally, the paper explores structural insights and connections between ECpM and the edge-based districting (EBD) problem, which enforces an additional work balance criterion. An existing model that utilizes cut set-based contiguity constraints was unable to find a feasible solution within 12 hours for any of the tested instances, while an SPC-based EBD model was able to solve most of these to optimality.

title: LinearKV: One Cached State Suffices for Position-Independent Caching in Hybrid LLMs
summary: LLM serving is increasingly accelerated by position-independent caching (PIC). Existing PIC methods, however, are built for full-attention models, where a token-indexed KV cache underlies its core operations: matching reusable token chunks, concatenating their KV entries, and selectively recomputing a few tokens to restore cross-chunk context. Hybrid LLMs break these primitives---they replace most attention layers with linear recurrences that expose only a fixed-size state, leaving no token-indexed KV to concatenate or to locally repair. This raises a natural question: can PIC benefit hybrid models, and what would it take? We present LinearKV, a training-free hybrid-PIC framework. Its key insight is a \emph{decoupled initialization}: each linear layer maps its $K$ matched local states to a single initial state, while full-attention layers concatenate their KV as before. LinearKV is therefore compatible with existing PIC methods, reusing their token selection and recomputation as-is. Under this framework, we find that a \emph{single cached state} suffices as the linear layer's initializer. The algebraically principled alternative---composing all $K$ cached states into the exact full-prefix state, as concurrent work HYPIC does---is unnecessary and, on some architectures, even harmful. We compare the two across three hybrid models and three PIC selectors. On the two GDN models the two tie, both recovering most of full quality (up to $92\%$); on the Mamba-2 model, exact composition instead collapses under every selector---under EPIC, for instance, it recovers only $46.6\%$ of full quality, versus $86.8\%$ for a single cached block initializer. A single state initializer is also cheaper, cutting time-to-first-token to $0.46\times$ full prefill versus a further $5$--$17\%$ overhead for exact composition; results hold across LongBench QA and RULER at 8K--32K.

title: Backtrader-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Algorithmic Trading with Self-Generated MCQs
comments: Accepted to the FinLLM Workshop at IJCAI 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/rzhao999/Backtrader-Bench
summary: Evaluating LLM coding agents in algorithmic trading is difficult because static benchmarks risk data contamination and numerical backtest outputs require ground truth from actual code execution. We present Backtrader-Bench, a framework with two complementary pipelines. A deterministic multiple-choice question (MCQ) pipeline generates questions from backtest configurations across five trading strategies, 33 templates, and three difficulty tiers, with an independent checker that re-derives every answer. A generator-solver filtering pipeline autonomously mines harder questions: a generator writes questions verified by executable code, converts them to MCQs, and discards any that a no-tool solver can answer without code execution. We evaluate 11 models without tools (10 runs each) and four with-tools configurations on a 30-question curated set. Tool-augmented agents reach 90.0% accuracy in a single pass (GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.7), outperforming the best no-tools baselines (73.0%, averaged over 10 runs) by 17 percentage points. On 38 separately mined questions, no-tools accuracy drops further, with half the models falling to roughly random-chance level (25%). Beyond evaluation, the scalable MCQ infrastructure is designed to produce a training corpus for reinforcement learning, with the ultimate goal of building a specialized agent for quantitative trading workflows.

title: Retrofitting Recurrent Depth into a Pretrained Language Model: Installation, Extrapolation, Transfer, and Retention at Two Parameter Budgets
summary: A dense, pretrained language model can be retrofitted with recurrent depth and learn an iterative latent transition that persists after outcome-only annealing. Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct is split into a Prelude, a weight-tied Recurrent Block, and a Coda, with an identity-preserving one-loop path and a re-entry bridge on later loops. At loop 1 the retrofit remains non-inferior to its base on a preregistered ARC battery. Three findings. First, the mechanism is a reusable procedure rather than terminal-answer lookup, and installs at two budgets: 6M trained parameters over frozen base weights and 180M full-block. With intermediate-step supervision, the model computes one task step per loop and persists when only final answers are graded. The adapter matched the full block overall (83.8% versus 84.0%), led through depth 11, and trailed beyond. Verbal fine-tuning reached 79-86% on controlled verbal renderings (zero-shot transfer was minimal), and adapter verbal training begun from the installed mechanism outpaced matched fresh training by 18.6 points, including on a held-out test set. Second, the operation extrapolates to roughly 1.5 times its supervised depth, holding 70% accuracy through depth 18. Third, a same-size scratchpad-trained model matched the recurrent model within its learned horizon but collapsed beyond it. The recurrent model won overall, 84% versus 72%, retained 53% versus 2.5% beyond depth 10, and answered 7.6 times faster. An iterative transformer can therefore perform deeper reasoning in latent space faster than comparable or larger models fine-tuned on the same task, in a system-level comparison. A second task, running the rule in reverse, exposed the limits: the inverse was learnable in isolation, but no continuation acquired it while preserving the installed mechanism and general capability, a catastrophic-interference boundary. Learned depth selection remains open.

title: InfraBench: Evaluating Infrastructure Agents Across Layers, Lifecycle, and Risk
summary: Managing modern computing infrastructure has become a steadily harder problem due to the ever-increasing complexity. Recent advances in AI agents create a timely opportunity to automate infrastructure management tasks, but it remains unclear how well such agents can handle real-world infrastructure complexity. We present InfraBench, a benchmark suite for evaluating AI agents on realistic infrastructure tasks across the full system stack and full operational lifecycle with fine-grained risk assessment. Experiments with 15 agent-model configurations show that even the strongest agent cannot secure a full score across all tasks. Mean effective scores range from roughly 40% to 88% (with per-configuration standard errors of 6-12 points), repeating every task three times reveals that top configurations still pass only a fraction of their attempts, and per-check scoring exposes a general failure pattern: agents may routinely satisfy short-term objectives while leaving non-durable changes, broken distributed invariants, unsafe side effects, and uncleaned state behind. INFRABENCH, including its live leaderboard, tasks, and evaluation harness, is publicly available at infraben.ch.

title: CORA-Diff: Confidence-Oriented Residual Acceptance for Efficient Diffusion Language Model Inference
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) update many tokens in parallel, yet practical decoders often use a fixed denoising horizon. Many predictions stabilize early, but blockwise decoding continues until all positions are resolved, causing repeated dense forward passes. Existing accelerators often rely on learned filters, modified scores, dependency models, or cache-specific mechanisms. We ask whether native trajectory signals can identify residual positions likely to match the deterministic dense endpoint. We propose CORA-Diff, a training-free method that preserves the original transfer rule and applies confidence-and-persistence gating only to positions that rule leaves unresolved. Accepted tokens remain visible as context, and the block terminates once all positions are resolved. This requires no backbone change, learned acceptance model, or logit modification. Our theory explains why high-confidence, persistent predictions are more likely to match the fixed-horizon dense endpoint, and paired post-intervention trajectories provide direct empirical support. We select one operating point on a separate GSM8K calibration subset and freeze it for all evaluations. Under a matched Learn2PD-style LLaDA protocol, CORA-Diff has the lowest measured runtime in all eight task-length settings. Task scores match or exceed dense decoding in five settings, and the largest observed drop is 1.22 points. Its incremental speedups over EOS-aware dense decoding are 2.70x and 3.32x on GSM8K and HumanEval. It also reaches 13.14x under the fixed-horizon 1024/1024 mechanism-isolation protocol and transfers to Dream without retuning at 3.18x-3.53x. These results show that native confidence and persistence enable reliable residual acceptance, reducing repeated denoising computation while preserving task quality.

title: TRACE Bench: Task-driven Roleplay Agentic Checklist Evaluation
summary: Roleplay evaluation should do more than assign a single score: it should reveal which role requirements were tested, which failed, and which dialogue evidence supports the judgment. We propose TRACE Bench, a task-driven agentic checklist evaluation framework. It decomposes each role profile offline into a fixed checklist, then uses a User Agent to converse naturally with the target roleplay model while privately updating checklist states from model responses. Scores therefore trace back to checklist items and supporting dialogue turns rather than a black-box holistic impression. For coverage cross-validation, we audit released M2 free-dialogue transcripts from the MiniMax Role-play Benchmark against the same role-derived checklist. The released free-chat transcripts cover only 73.74% of key role-profile points, whereas TRACE Bench reaches 99.91% coverage in fewer turns. Robustness experiments show stable rankings under repeated runs and User Agent replacement. Across 26 models, TRACE Bench reports overall rankings together with capability breakdowns and checklist traces. It also supports Closed-Loop Benchmark Evolution, distilling verification methods proven effective in failed traces so later evaluations can more reliably elicit and examine observed failure modes.

title: Geometry-aware Incremental Neural Operator for Long-Horizon PDE prediction
summary: Neural operators have shown strong potential for learning solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs). However, long-horizon autoregressive prediction remains challenging: local errors accumulate as spectral inconsistency, phase misalignment, or mean drift. Existing methods mainly improve state representations and operator backbones, while leaving the repeatedly applied latent transition increment weakly structured, allowing spectral errors and unstable channel couplings to accumulate during rollout. To address these issues, we propose a geometry-aware incremental neural operator (GeoIncNO) for stable long-horizon PDE prediction. GeoIncNO predicts latent increments for residual advancement and uses lightweight low-rank projectors to regulate channel coupling within active frequency bands derived from the increment spectral energy distribution. To reduce physical-space reconstruction errors, GeoIncNO further introduces a mean--fluctuation decoupled reconstruction mechanism, where stable mean structures and dynamic fluctuations are fused separately, and phase correction is applied only to the zero-mean fluctuation component. Extensive experiments on six PDE benchmarks, covering 1D, 2D, and 3D dynamical systems, show that GeoIncNO achieves consistently strong prediction accuracy, improved rollout stability, and better spectral fidelity compared with competitive neural-operator baselines.

title: Towards Query-Agnostic RAG Evaluation via Query Coverage and Claim Verifiability
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation improves the factuality of large language models by grounding responses in retrieved evidence, yet existing evaluation frameworks struggle to provide consistent, fine-grained diagnostics across the diverse spectrum of user queries, ranging from close-ended fact-seeking to open-ended explanatory requests. We propose Q-CARE, a query-agnostic and fully reference-free framework that enables fine-grained assessment by decomposing queries into sub-queries and answers into atomic claims. Q-CARE establishes a unified evaluation principle based on query coverage and claim verifiability, yielding coverage-aware retriever metrics (C-Prec@k, C-nDCG@k) and claim-level generator metrics (Completeness, Conciseness, and Verifiableness). On a human-annotated benchmark spanning eight datasets, Q-CARE achieves higher correlation with human judgments than four existing RAG evaluation metrics, including RAGEval and RAGChecker, proving its effectiveness as a reliable, automated evaluation framework. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/DISL-Lab/Q-CaRE-COLM-26.

title: Reinforcement Learning based DBMS Buffer Pool Auto-Tuning for Optimal Memory Utilization
summary: Administering Database Management Systems (DBMS) instances requires Database Administrators (DBA) to balance performance in terms of Service Level Agreement (SLA) against resource usage, often prompting RAM over-allocation that wastes memory. We introduce MicroTune, an online RL-based buffer adjustment system that minimizes unnecessary memory allocation while ensuring SLA compliance. To identify the most effective RL core, we evaluate multiple algorithms under diverse benchmark workloads, training MicroTune on extensive traces of both external metrics (latency, throughput) and internal DBMS metrics (status variables and performance statistics). Experimental results demonstrate that MicroTune dynamically adapts buffer sizes to workload fluctuations, outperforming baselines by achieving significant memory savings with fewer SLA violations. These findings underscore the promise of reinforcement learning for adaptive resource management in DBMS environments.

title: VQ-bench: A Composable Vector Quantization Framework
summary: Vector quantization is an old problem but has recently become central to AI infrastructure. It is therefore experiencing a surge of renewed engineering and research activity. This paper provides a unified framework for developing and benchmarking new quantization algorithms. We describe 7 common conceptual quantization primitives and show how to compose them arbitrarily. We then re-express 25 common quantizers as pipelines of these primitives. Finally, we publish VQ-bench as open-source to be extended further and make reproducible benchmarks publicly available.

title: RecSys Factory: Bounding LLM Agent Autonomy to Decision Points in the Industrial Recommender Lifecycle
comments: 21 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. Reports a 78-day deployment across three heterogeneous industrial recommender business lines (1,624 CLI-tool dispatches). Companion paper: AutoResearch (P3b), which instantiates the same substrate for autonomous research
summary: Deploying LLM agents into industrial recommender operations exposes a three-way tension we frame as the autonomy-determinism-efficiency trilemma: general autonomy (interpreting operator intent, generating glue code zero-shot), industrial determinism (schema-conforming feature extraction, non-crashing A/B, zero compliance-path hallucination), and end-to-end efficiency. Any two can be maximized against the third. We present RecSys Factory, an LLM-agent platform deployed for 78 days across three heterogeneous Tencent recommender business lines. The design principle is autonomy at decision points, not over pipelines, made concrete through three deconstructions that each discharge one vertex of the trilemma. Runtime is deconstructed into three host-emitted event sources (Claude Code Stop hooks, corporate-IM webhooks, workflow scheduler APIs): the platform carries no long-running daemon during the wait phase and consumes zero CPU during the 94% of wall-clock spent waiting on Spark or GPU jobs. Capability is deconstructed into a 29-file skill ecosystem (8,971 lines of SKILL.md) whose per-skill pitfall tables mechanically compile into a 400-entry PitfallStore, confining autonomy to bounded typed decision surfaces inside pre-committed pipelines. Deployment spans three business lines with disjoint label semantics, A/B layer topologies, and operator personas; an onboarding-time compression is observed on two of the three and is reported as a case-study observation, not a generalization claim, and not measured against a controlled pre-platform baseline. The human is retained at the diagnostic-versus-execution boundary via a human-in-the-loop card protocol, deployed as an audit-trail primitive (schema-validated, idempotent, replayable) and reported from an 8-day 16-run pilot. Across the 78-day window the platform recorded 1,624 CLI-tool dispatches at a 78.6% aggregate success rate.

title: Lost in Compaction: Evaluating Side-Constraint Loss under Context Compaction
summary:
When the context window is under pressure, LLM systems compact prior context to continue ongoing tasks. We identify a class of user-issued instructions, Session Constraints (SCs), such as "do not delete any emails until I confirm," that are meant to constrain LLM's behavior for the remainder of a session but are silently dropped during compaction. To quantify this loss, we introduce COMPINT, an evaluation suite that evaluates compactors across three long-context scenarios: multi-turn chat, agentic trajectory, and long-horizon research.
  Current compactors retain only 17% of injected SCs on average, and most perform worse than running the same task without compaction. Retention varies sharply with compactor, prompt, context length, SC phrasing, and injection location, showing that the loss is systematic rather than tied to any single setting. We propose an SC-aware extractor that runs alongside the compactor as a plug-and-play module, achieving over 90% retention across all three scenarios without modifying the compactor or LLM. The COMPINT evaluation suite and accompanying implementation are available at https://github.com/ZhiqiEliWang/compaction-integrity.

title: The Off-Support Barrier: Why Semantic Safety Constraints Are Not Learning-Problem Invariants, and What Follows for Prior Design, Containment, and Verification
summary: We argue that a single structural fact organizes a wide range of phenomena in contemporary AI safety: a semantic safety constraint (e.g., the agent does not escape its sandbox) is an off-support object. Formally, if q is the data distribution and \(p(\cdot\mid w)\) the model, the safety predicate B is not measurable with respect to \(σ(\text{model}, q)\), whereas the real log-canonical threshold (RLCT) of singular learning theory (SLT) is. From this non-invariance we derive, as corollaries rather than independent observations: (i) why reward hacking and sandbox escape arise under outcome-based optimization; (ii) why encoding such constraints through Bayesian prior design or soft penalty weighting has poor leverage in singular models; (iii) why hard invariants belong in the harness and soft dispositions in the model; (iv) why the same B is nonetheless soundly and locally certifiable by formal verification, exactly as the local learning coefficient (LLC) locally pins the same RLCT --- with two precise points of disanalogy; and (v) why the residual difficulty, identifying which off-support region matters, coincides with performative prediction and self-referential functional dynamics, where SLT's analytic machinery breaks down. We use the July 2026 OpenAI--Hugging Face evaluation incident as the motivating case. Numerical experiments code and related proofs in lean are available at https://github.com/xiangze/Preventing_Jailbreak_as_regularization

title: BEST-KAG: Enhancing Question Answering of Building Engineering Standards with Multimodal Knowledge Graph Modeling and Large Language Model
summary: Construction standards are critical for building safety and sustainability. Existing standard application workflows rely on keyword-based document retrieval and manual cross-clause interpretation, which cannot reliably support multi-clause reasoning, multimodal knowledge utilization, or traceable clause-level evidence linkage. To address these limitations, this study develops a multimodal knowledge-driven framework that supports question answering on standard knowledge named BEST-KAG (Knowledge-Augmented Generation for Building Engineering STandards). The framework introduces 1) a multimodal knowledge graph (MKG) for unified representation of document hierarchy and heterogeneous standard knowledge with various connections, 2) a rule-LLM hybrid knowledge construction pipeline for scalable multimodal knowledge extraction, creating a large MAG with 251 building engineering standards, 171,652 nodes and 310,914 edges, and 3) a graph-retrieval-based knowledge-augmented generation architecture for clause-grounded and traceable question answering. Experiments demonstrate that BEST-KAG consistently outperforms multiple mainstream LLMs in terms of Expert evaluation, and metrics including BLEU, and ROUGE, with the best improvement up to 74.01% compared to the baselines.

title: Towards Sustainable Learning in Online Education: A Reinforcement Learning Approach
summary: Online education offers unprecedented scalability and accessibility to global learners from diverse backgrounds, but it often suffers from low engagement and poor long term learning effectiveness. To address these challenges, we introduce AI Tutor, a reinforcement learning based model designed to promote sustainable learning by optimizing both short and longterm learning outcomes. In the short term, AI-Tutor draws on cognitive theory to guide learners through a balance of acquiring new knowledge and reinforcing prior learning. In the long term, it models learner engagement to inform strategies that sustain motivation and reduce dropout. These enhancements enable AI-Tutor to provide personalized guidance that fosters both effective learning and sustained participation. Empirical evaluations on 23 million learning records from 33,700 learners show that AI Tutor consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across engagement, knowledge retention, and final learning outcomes. Learning path analyses further reveal how AI-Tutor adapts its strategies to learners with diverse profiles, offering adaptive and human-centered support.

title: Towards the Harness of Embodied Agents
summary: The success of coding agents has established the harness as a paradigm: what an agent achieves depends not on the model alone, but on the infrastructure around it. We ask whether the same paradigm extends to embodied agents in the physical world. We present Thea, a harness in which an agentic loop orchestrates robot capabilities, each wrapped as a callable tool. It inherits the core components of coding agents, modified as the physical world requires. The world, however, withholds two abilities that software grants for free: reading the state of the world, and judging the outcome of an action. To bridge these gaps, Thea introduces Scene Graph as Context, a persistent, symbolic representation of the world, and Evaluation as Exit Codes, which detects when an action should terminate, judges whether it succeeded, and on failure diagnoses the cause. Together they close the loop between the agent and the physical world. Rich behaviors then emerge from the composition of tools, and the closed loop carries long-horizon tasks to completion in real environments.
