AI.summary: ContactIPM是一种新颖的内点求解器，专为接触隐式轨迹优化中的互补约束数学规划问题（MPCCs）设计。它结合了利用结构的最优控制求解器和处理互补约束的鲁健性。该方法通过障碍耦合弹性内点松弛嵌入互补不等式，分阶段消除变量，并使用Riccati递归求解。实验结果表明，ContactIPM在多个基准测试中比现有的接触特定MPCC求解器（如CRISP和IMPACT）更快且成功率更高。
AI.keywords: 接触隐式轨迹优化, 内点求解器, 互补约束, Riccati递归, 结构利用
AI.comments: ContactIPM的创新之处在于它成功地将结构利用的最优控制方法与对互补约束的鲁棒处理相结合，解决了现有方法在处理接触隐式轨迹优化中的MPCCs时的局限性。其分阶段变量消除和Riccati递归的应用提高了计算效率。该方法在实际应用中对于需要处理复杂接触动力学的机器人和运动规划任务具有重要意义。

title: Fingerprinting Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Collapsed Generation
summary: Proprietary text-to-image diffusion models are increasingly distributed as hosted services and downloadable checkpoints, making their intellectual property (IP) protection an increasingly critical concern when model leakage, copying, or unauthorized fine-tuning is disputed. In this work, we present a non-invasive model fingerprinting framework based on \emph{collapsed generation}, a phenomenon where certain input conditions produce highly consistent images across multiple stochastic seeds. We show that collapsed generation is an intrinsic, model-dependent property of the learned generation process. These collapse-prone conditions therefore expose model-specific behavioral signatures, enabling reliable ownership verification without embedding invasive watermarks. After preparing conditions on the source model, the framework verifies a suspect model under two access settings: (1) white-box pipeline access, where optimized continuous embeddings can be injected into the generation process, and (2) black-box API-only access, where natural language prompts are queried through the service interface. In both cases, ownership evidence is measured by whether the suspect model reproduces the source model's collapse behavior across stochastic samplings. Extensive experiments across UNet- and transformer-based diffusion models show that collapsed generation fingerprints can distinguish different source models with low confusion. These fingerprints remain verifiable in fine-tuned derivatives and under common and adaptive model- or query-level obfuscations, while requiring only a modest verification query budget. Together, these results establish collapsed generation as a reliable intrinsic evidence source for non-invasive diffusion model ownership verification.

AI.title_translation: 通过坍缩生成给文本到图像扩散模型打指纹
AI.tldr: 利用文本到图像扩散模型的“坍缩生成”内在现象，提出了一种无需侵入式水印的可靠模型所有权验证框架。
AI.motivation: 专有文本到图像扩散模型的知识产权保护日益重要，亟需解决模型泄露、复制或未经授权微调时的归属争议问题，现有的侵入式水印存在局限。
AI.method: 提出基于坍缩生成的非侵入式模型指纹框架，利用特定输入条件在多个随机种子下产生高度一致图像的内在属性，通过白盒连续嵌入注入或黑盒自然语言提示查询来验证可疑模型。
AI.result: 实验表明，坍缩生成指纹能够以低混淆度区分不同的源模型，在微调衍生物以及常见和自适应的混淆攻击下依然可验证，且只需适度的验证查询预算。
AI.conclusion: 坍缩生成是一种可靠的文本到图像扩散模型内在指纹，能够有效支持白盒和黑盒场景下的非侵入式所有权验证。
AI.translation: 专有的文本到图像扩散模型越来越多地作为托管服务和可下载检查点进行分发，当模型泄露、复制或未经授权的微调引发争议时，它们的知识产权（IP）保护成为一个日益关键的问题。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于“坍缩生成”的非侵入式模型指纹框架，该现象是指某些输入条件在多个随机种子下会产生高度一致的图像。我们证明了坍缩生成是学习到的生成过程的一种内在的、依赖于模型的属性。因此，这些易发生坍缩的条件暴露了模型特定的行为特征，从而能够在不嵌入侵入式水印的情况下实现可靠的所有权验证。在源模型上准备好条件后，该框架在两种访问设置下验证可疑模型：（1）白盒流水线访问，其中优化的连续嵌入可以注入到生成过程中；（2）黑盒仅API访问，其中自然语言提示通过服务接口进行查询。在这两种情况下，所有权证据都是通过可疑模型是否在随机采样中重现源模型坍缩行为来衡量的。对基于UNet和transformer的扩散模型的广泛实验表明，坍缩生成指纹能够以低混淆度区分不同的源模型。这些指纹在微调衍生模型以及常见和自适应的模型或查询级混淆下仍然可验证，同时仅需要适度的验证查询预算。总之，这些结果确立了坍缩生成作为非侵入式扩散模型所有权验证的可靠内在证据来源。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种基于“坍缩生成”现象的文本到图像扩散模型非侵入式指纹框架。通过利用模型特定的行为特征（即某些输入条件在多随机种子下生成高度一致的图像），该框架在白盒和黑盒设置下实现了可靠的所有权验证，且对微调和混淆攻击具有鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 文本到图像扩散模型, 模型指纹, 知识产权保护, 坍缩生成, 所有权验证
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地利用了文本到图像扩散模型中固有的“坍缩生成”现象来进行模型指纹识别，无需侵入式水印即可实现所有权验证，具有抗微调和混淆攻击的鲁棒性。

title: Locating and Controlling Implicit Personalization in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often shift their outputs in response to implicit demographic cues even when users never state a demographic identity. Previous work has documented this behavior, but the connection between these behavioral changes and the model's internal activations remains unclear. Using matched cued and neutral conversations across five LLMs, we establish that a localized internal activation signal tracks changes in recommendations, with correlations up to r=0.87. When multiple cues appear together, their internal signals largely combine, but the changes in output do not simply add up. We further show that removing the internal signal associated with one cue can suppress its influence, often more effectively than asking the model to ignore demographics via prompting, while largely preserving general benchmark performance. However, the ability to selectively remove one dimension's influence while leaving co-present dimensions intact remains highly model- and attribute-specific. These results connect implicit personalization behavior to an internal signal that can be analyzed and causally controlled.

AI.title_translation: 定位与控制大型语言模型中的隐式个性化
AI.tldr: 本研究发现大语言模型的隐式个性化行为由局域内部激活信号驱动，并且通过移除该内部信号可以有效控制和抑制模型对人口统计学线索的偏见，效果优于传统提示词方法。
AI.motivation: 尽管先前研究发现大型语言模型会对隐式人口统计学线索产生输出偏移，但这些行为变化与模型内部激活之间的联系仍不明确，因此需要深入探究其背后的内部机制并寻求因果控制方法。
AI.method: 通过使用配对的提示和中性对话，跨五个大语言模型分析内部激活状态，并探索了通过移除特定内部信号来控制模型输出的方法。
AI.result: 研究发现了一个与推荐变化高度相关的局域内部激活信号（相关系数最高达0.87）；移除该信号能够有效抑制特定线索的影响，效果优于提示词干预，且能保持基准性能，但选择性地移除特定维度而保留其他维度则具有高度的模型和属性特异性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功将大语言模型的隐式个性化行为与内部激活信号相联系，证明了通过因果控制内部信号来抑制隐式人口统计学偏见的可行性，同时指出了其在复杂多维情况下的局限性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）经常在没有用户明确声明人口统计学身份的情况下，根据隐式的人口统计学线索改变其输出。先前的研究已经记录了这种行为，但这种行为变化与模型内部激活之间的联系仍不清楚。通过在五个LLM中使用匹配的提示和中性对话，我们确定了一个局域内部激活信号，该信号追踪了推荐的变化，相关性高达r=0.87。当多个线索同时出现时，它们的内部信号大体上会组合，但输出的变化并不只是简单的叠加。我们进一步表明，移除与单个线索相关的内部信号可以抑制其影响，通常比通过提示要求模型忽略人口统计学特征更有效，同时在很大程度上保持了通用的基准性能。然而，在保持同时存在的其他维度完好的同时，选择性地移除一个维度的影响仍然高度依赖于模型和属性。这些结果将隐式个性化行为与可以被分析和因果控制的内部信号联系起来。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了大语言模型对隐式人口统计学线索反应的内部机制，发现了一个追踪推荐变化的局域内部激活信号，并证明了通过干预该信号可以有效且安全地控制模型的隐式个性化行为。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 隐式个性化, 内部激活信号, 因果控制, 人口统计学偏见
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将大语言模型中的隐式个性化行为与其内部激活状态联系起来，并证明了可以通过干预内部激活信号来控制模型的隐式个性化，这为解决AI偏见和提升模型可控性提供了新的研究方向和技术手段。

title: Phoenix TTS: High-Fidelity Synthesis and Voice Conversion via Flow-Matching-Driven Speech Tokenization
summary: In current zero-shot text-to-speech systems, conventional semantic tokenizers are typically optimized using supervised automatic speech recognition or self-supervised learning objectives. However, due to the inherent nature of speech, semantic and acoustic information cannot be completely decoupled, and ASR-based tokenizers discard acoustic details to focus on linguistic content; models relying on them usually struggle to achieve optimal speaker similarity. Furthermore, these tokenizers are optimized independently and lack direct supervision from downstream acoustic generation tasks. This isolated training creates a feature gap between the extracted discrete tokens and the continuous space required by acoustic models, fundamentally bottlenecking the upper bound of synthesis quality. To bridge this gap, we propose Phoenix TTS, a unified framework that tightly couples representation learning with generative acoustic modeling. Specifically, our speech tokenizer is optimized to reconstruct self-supervised features to maintain semantic richness, while simultaneously receiving direct supervision from a Flow Matching training loss. Through this joint training paradigm, the extracted discrete tokens successfully preserve essential semantic information and natively align with the feature space of the downstream Flow Matching model. Comprehensive evaluations highlight the efficiency and effectiveness of Phoenix TTS. Trained on 110K hours of data, the system achieves excellent speech intelligibility, yielding WER that consistently falls below that of ground-truth recordings. Simultaneously, it maintains robust zero-shot speaker similarity, rivaling or outperforming several prominent large-scale baselines. Furthermore, as an advantageous byproduct of this unified training, the learned tokenizer can be seamlessly adapted to zero-shot voice conversion tasks without requiring task-specific fine-tuning.

AI.title_translation: Phoenix TTS：通过流匹配驱动的语音分词实现高保真合成与声音转换
AI.tldr: Phoenix TTS 通过将语音分词与流匹配声学模型联合训练，消除了特征鸿沟，实现了高质量的零样本语音合成与声音转换。
AI.motivation: 传统的零-shot TTS系统中，语义分词器通常独立优化，会丢失声学细节且与下游声学模型的连续空间存在特征鸿沟，从而限制了合成质量的上界。为此，需要一种能够将表征学习与生成式声学建模紧密耦合的方法。
AI.method: 提出 Phoenix TTS 统一框架，其语音分词器通过重建自监督特征来保持语义丰富性，同时直接接受流匹配（Flow Matching）训练损失的监督，实现联合训练。
AI.result: 在110K小时数据上训练后，Phoenix TTS 实现了极高的语音可懂度（WER甚至低于真实录音），具备强大的零样本说话人相似度（达到或超越了主流的大规模基线模型），并且其分词器可直接无缝应用于零样本声音转换任务。
AI.conclusion: Phoenix TTS 证明了将语音分词器与下游流匹配生成模型进行联合训练的有效性，成功克服了传统方法的特征鸿沟，在零样本语音合成与声音转换任务上均取得了优异的性能。
AI.translation: 在当前的零样本文本转语音系统中，传统的语义分词器通常使用监督式自动语音识别或自监督学习目标进行优化。然而，由于语音的固有特性，语义和声学信息无法完全解耦，基于ASR的分词器为了聚焦于语言内容而丢弃了声学细节，依赖它们模型通常难以达到最佳的说话人相似度。此外，这些分词器是独立优化的，缺乏来自下游声学生成任务的直接监督。这种孤立的训练在提取的离散标记与声学模型所需的连续空间之间造成了特征鸿沟，从根本上制约了合成质量的上限。为了弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出了 Phoenix TTS，一个将表征学习与生成式声学建模紧密耦合的统一框架。具体而言，我们的语音分词器经过优化以重建自监督特征以保持语义丰富性，同时直接接收来自流匹配（Flow Matching）训练损失的监督。通过这种联合训练范式，提取的离散标记成功地保留了必要的语义信息，并原生对齐了下游流匹配模型的特征空间。广泛的评估凸显了 Phoenix TTS 的高效性和有效性。该系统在110K小时的数据上进行训练，实现了出色的语音可懂度，其字错率（WER）持续低于真实录音。同时，它保持了强健的零样本说话人相似度，能够媲美甚至超越几个著名的大规模基线模型。此外，作为这种统一训练的有利副产品，所学习的分词器可以无缝适应零样本声音转换任务，而无需进行特定任务的微调。
AI.summary: Phoenix TTS 是一个统一的语音合成与转换框架，它通过引入流匹配驱动的联合训练范式，克服了传统分词器独立优化导致的特征鸿沟，在保持丰富语义的同时完美对齐了下游生成模型的特征空间，从而在零样本语音合成和声音转换中实现了高保真度和出色的说话人相似度。
AI.keywords: Zero-shot TTS, Flow Matching, Speech Tokenization, Voice Conversion, Representation Learning
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种统一的架构，通过流匹配驱动的语音分词（Flow-Matching-Driven Speech Tokenization）将表征学习与生成式声学建模紧密耦合，有效解决了传统语音分词器语义与声学信息解耦不彻底、特征空间不匹配的痛点，兼顾了高语音可懂度和零样本说话人相似度，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Advancing MLLM-based UAV Image Understanding and Reasoning: A Benchmark and a Training-Free Multi-Agent System
summary: Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based UAV aerial image understanding and reasoning is essential for aerial intelligence yet poses distinct challenges arising from extreme scale variation, arbitrary camera orientations, and high object density. Despite growing interest, existing evaluations remain fragmented across individual datasets and narrow tasks, leaving a critical gap in unified assessment of UAV understanding and reasoning capabilities. To fill this gap, we construct UAVQA-Bench, a benchmark of 1,500 human-annotated QA pairs drawn from 13 public UAV datasets, covering 6 capability dimensions and 16 tasks in both multiple-choice and visual grounding formats. Systematic evaluation of a broad range of open-source and closed-source MLLMs as well as agent-based systems on UAVQA-Bench identifies three key failure modes: domain-toolset mismatch, unchecked error propagation, and static reasoning. Motivated by these findings, we propose UAV-MAS, a training-free multi-agent system for MLLM-based UAV aerial image understanding and reasoning, comprising a Domain-Specific Perception Engine (DSPE) that routes queries to task-appropriate visual tools, a Context-Aware Iterative Refinement module (CAIR) that validates intermediate reasoning to curb error accumulation, and a Difficulty-Aware Adaptive Search mechanism (DAAS) that adjusts search depth to question difficulty. UAV-MAS with a 32B open-source MLLM achieves 77.0% overall accuracy on UAVQA-Bench, surpassing Gemini 3 Pro by 4.0\%, while the 8B variant improves 8.7\% over its base model.

AI.title_translation: 推进基于 MLLM 的无人机图像理解与推理：一个基准与一个无需训练的多智能体系统
AI.tldr: 本文提出了用于无人机图像理解的基准 UAVQA-Bench 和无需训练的多智能体系统 UAV-MAS，显著提升了 MLLM 在航拍图像推理上的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型在处理无人机航拍图像时面临极端的尺度变化、任意相机方向和高对象密度等挑战，且缺乏一个统一的评估基准来全面衡量其理解和推理能力。
AI.method: 构建了包含 1,500 个问答对的 UAVQA-Bench 基准测试，并提出了无需训练的多智能体系统 UAV-MAS，包含特定领域感知引擎（DSPE）、上下文感知迭代求精模块（CAIR）和难度感知自适应搜索机制（DAAS）。
AI.result: 基于 UAV-MAS 的 32B 开源 MLLM 在 UAVQA-Bench 上取得了 77.0% 的总体准确率，超越了 Gemini 3 Pro 4.0%，而 8B 版本相较于基础模型提升了 8.7%。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出的 UAVQA-Bench 填补了无人机多模态评估的空白，而 UAV-MAS 系统则在无需额外训练的情况下，显著提升了开源 MLLM 在复杂无人机图像理解任务上的性能，超越了部分商业闭源模型。
AI.translation: 基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的无人机航拍图像理解与推理对于空中智能至关重要，但由于极端的尺度变化、任意的相机方向和高对象密度，带来了独特的挑战。尽管人们的兴趣日益浓厚，但现有的评估仍然分散在各个数据集和狭窄的任务中，导致在统一评估无人机理解和推理能力方面存在关键空白。为了填补这一空白，我们构建了 UAVQA-Bench，这是一个包含 1,500 个由人工标注的问答对的基准，取自 13 个公开的无人机数据集，涵盖了多选题和视觉接地格式中的 6 个能力维度和 16 个任务。对 UAVQA-Bench 上广泛的开源和闭源 MLLM 以及基于智能体的系统进行的系统评估，确定了三种主要的失败模式：领域-工具集不匹配、未经检查的错误传播和静态推理。受这些发现的启发，我们提出了 UAV-MAS，这是一个用于基于 MLLM 的无人机航拍图像理解和推理的无需训练的多智能体系统，它包含一个将查询路由到任务合适视觉工具的特定领域感知引擎（DSPE）、一个验证中间推理以遏制错误积累的上下文感知迭代求精模块（CAIR），以及一个根据问题难度调整搜索深度的难度感知自适应搜索机制（DAAS）。搭载 32B 开源 MLLM 的 UAV-MAS 在 UAVQA-Bench 上取得了 77.0% 的总体准确率，比 Gemini 3 Pro 高出 4.0%，而 8B 变体比其基础模型提升了 8.7%。
AI.summary: 本文针对无人机航拍图像理解与推理，构建了全新的基准数据集 UAVQA-Bench，并分析了现有模型的失败模式；在此基础上，提出了一种名为 UAV-MAS 的无需训练的多智能体系统，通过特定领域感知、迭代求精和自适应搜索机制，显著提升了 MLLM 在无人机图像任务上的性能。
AI.keywords: 无人机图像理解, 多模态大语言模型, 基准测试, 多智能体系统, 视觉接地
AI.comments: 该论文针对无人机航拍图像理解与推理的挑战，不仅提出了全面的基准数据集 UAVQA-Bench，还创新性地设计了一个无需训练的多智能体系统 UAV-MAS，有效解决了现有 MLLM 在航拍领域面临的尺度变化大、误差累积和静态推理等痛点，具有很高的实用价值。

title: G0.5: One Autoregressive Stream for Robot Reasoning and Action
summary: The prevailing recipe for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models couples a pretrained VLM with a separately trained flow-matching action expert. This makes the VLM a context encoder rather than a decision-maker. We introduce G0.5, a pretrained autoregressive VLA in which a single transformer decoder emits reasoning and action tokens under a single objective. Three components make this tractable at foundation-model scale: a learnable cross-embodiment action tokenizer that maps heterogeneous robot actions into a shared vocabulary; a native chain-of-thought stream interleaving task decomposition, object grounding, and action hints with action tokens; and a visual memory module that injects multi-second history through the vision encoder. Because reasoning and action share a single set of weights, the pretrained VLM's capabilities carry over to physical behavior: the model follows instructions closely, and prompts directly steer action granularity, task horizon, and out-of-distribution scene handling without further training. Pretrained on a large collection of robot datasets together with VQA samples, G0.5 surpasses state-of-the-art models across 7 independent regimes: real-world fine-tuning on R1lite and R1pro robots (76.7\% vs.\ 53.3\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 24.4\% for GR00T-N1.7), the 2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge on 50 long-horizon household mobile manipulation tasks using a generalist policy (31.4\% vs.\ 26.3\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 26.1\% for the challenge winner), DROID post-training followed by zero-shot transfer to an unseen environment and objects (82.5\%), a language-following Pick-and-Place benchmark, LIBERO (98.9\%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.3\%), and SimplerEnv-Bridge (87.3\%).

AI.title_translation: G0.5：机器人推理与行动的单一自回归流
AI.tldr: G0.5是一个新的自回归VLA模型，它使用单一Transformer解码器来生成推理和行动token，并在多种机器人任务中超越了现有SOTA模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型通常将预训练的VLM与单独训练的行动专家耦合，这使得VLM更像一个上下文编码器而非决策者。作者旨在开发一个能够直接进行决策的、统一的VLA模型。
AI.method: G0.5是一个预训练的自回归VLA模型，其中单个Transformer解码器在单一目标下同时发出推理和行动token。其核心包含三个组件：1. 可学习的跨实体行动tokenizer，将异构机器人行动映射到共享词汇。2. 原生思维链流，将任务分解、对象定位和行动提示与行动token交织。3. 视觉记忆模块，通过视觉编码器注入多秒历史信息。推理和行动共享一套权重，使得预训练VLM的能力能够迁移到实际物理行为。
AI.result: G0.5在7个独立的场景中超越了现有最先进的模型：R1lite和R1pro机器人上的真实世界微调（76.7% vs. $π_{0.5}$的53.3%和GR00T-N1.7的24.4%）；2025 BEHAVIOR挑战赛中50个长时程家庭移动操作任务（31.4% vs. $π_{0.5}$的26.3%和挑战赛冠军的26.1%）；DROID后训练后零样本迁移到未见环境和物体（82.5%）；语言遵循的Pick-and-Place基准测试LIBERO（98.9%）；RoboTwin 2.0（93.3%）；以及SimplerEnv-Bridge（87.3%）。
AI.conclusion: G0.5通过单一自回归流统一了机器人推理和行动，并在广泛的机器人任务中展现出卓越的性能，超越了现有SOTA模型，表明其作为通用机器人基础模型的潜力。
AI.translation: 当前视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型的主流方法是将预训练的VLM与单独训练的流匹配行动专家耦合。这使得VLM成为上下文编码器而非决策者。我们引入了G0.5，一个预训练的自回归VLA模型，其中一个单一的Transformer解码器在单一目标下发出推理和行动token。三个组件使其在基础模型规模上变得可行：一个可学习的跨实体行动tokenizer，将异构机器人行动映射到共享词汇；一个原生思维链流，将任务分解、对象定位和行动提示与行动token交织；以及一个视觉记忆模块，通过视觉编码器注入多秒历史信息。由于推理和行动共享一套权重，预训练VLM的能力可以迁移到物理行为：模型严格遵循指令，并且提示可以直接引导行动粒度、任务范围和分布外场景处理，无需进一步训练。G0.5在大量机器人数据集和VQA样本上进行预训练，在7个独立的场景中超越了现有最先进的模型：R1lite和R1pro机器人上的真实世界微调（76.7% vs. $π_{0.5}$的53.3%和GR00T-N1.7的24.4%），使用通用策略在50个长时程家庭移动操作任务上的2025 BEHAVIOR挑战赛（31.4% vs. $π_{0.5}$的26.3%和挑战赛冠军的26.1%），DROID后训练后零样本迁移到未见环境和物体（82.5%），一个语言遵循的Pick-and-Place基准测试LIBERO（98.9%），RoboTwin 2.0（93.3%），以及SimplerEnv-Bridge（87.3%）。
AI.summary: G0.5是一个创新的预训练自回归视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型，通过单一Transformer解码器统一了机器人推理和行动。它克服了传统VLA模型中VLM仅作为上下文编码器的问题，通过引入跨实体行动tokenizer、原生思维链流和视觉记忆模块，实现了在基础模型规模上的可行性。G0.5在多项机器人任务和基准测试中表现出色，显著超越了现有SOTA模型，展示了其在通用机器人行为方面的强大能力。
AI.keywords: 机器人,视觉-语言-行动模型,自回归,基础模型,思维链
AI.comments: G0.5的创新之处在于将机器人推理和行动整合到一个单一的自回归流中，使得预训练的VLM能力可以直接应用于物理行为。这种统一的方法简化了模型架构，并提高了模型的泛化能力。其在多个基准测试中取得的显著SOTA结果，特别是零样本迁移能力，表明了其作为未来通用机器人基础模型的巨大潜力。

title: JieZi: A Large-Scale Expert-Audited Dataset and Benchmark for Ancient Chinese Character Exegesis
comments: 19 pages, 13 figures. Accepted to the Dataset Track of ACM Multimedia 2026 for oral presentation
summary: The scholarly exegesis of ancient Chinese characters demands integrating visual observation, linguistic analysis, and historical context. However, existing computational approaches focus narrowly on subtasks such as character recognition and retrieval, lacking the structured datasets and benchmarks required for comprehensive scholarly analysis. To address this limitation, we introduce Ancient Chinese Character Exegesis (ACCE), a vision-language question answering (VQA) task that models the scholarly exegesis process. ACCE is organized into four progressive levels: basic character identification, glyph-form analysis, meaning exegesis, and diachronic evolution analysis. To support this task, we construct two complementary resources. JieZi-Dataset is the first large-scale, expert-audited VQA training dataset for ACCE, comprising over 500K QA pairs. It is constructed via a pipeline that reduces factual errors by constraining generation with expert-designed templates and source-text references. Human verification is further applied at each key stage to ensure scholarly accuracy. JieZi-Bench is an evaluation benchmark aligned with the exegesis process, constructed and verified by human experts to ensure evaluation reliability. It consists of four levels with reference answers curated from authoritative lexicographic works held separate from the training data. Experiments on multimodal large language models show that current models perform well on basic identification but struggle with glyph analysis, semantic reasoning, and diachronic understanding. Fine-tuning on JieZi-Dataset substantially improves performance across all four levels. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Ran00w/JieZi.
comment: 19 pages, 13 figures. Accepted to the Dataset Track of ACM Multimedia 2026 for oral presentation

AI.title_translation: JieZi：一个用于古汉字释义的大规模专家审核数据集与基准
AI.tldr: 本文提出了 JieZi 数据集与基准，用于通过多模态大语言模型进行古汉字学释义任务（ACCE），填补了该领域的空白。
AI.motivation: 现有的计算方法主要集中在字符识别和检索等子任务上，缺乏用于全面学术分析的结构化数据集和基准，无法满足古汉字释义对视觉观察、语言分析和历史背景整合的需求。
AI.method: 提出了 ACCE 任务，构建了包含 500K 以上 QA 对的训练集 JieZi-Dataset（采用专家设计模板和源文本引用约束生成，并经人工验证），以及评估基准 JieZi-Bench，并在多模态大语言模型上进行了实验与微调。
AI.result: 实验表明，当前多模态大语言模型在基础识别上表现良好，但在字形分析、语义推理和历时理解方面表现不佳；在 JieZi-Dataset 上进行微调显著提升了模型在这四个层面的性能。
AI.conclusion: JieZi 数据集和基准有效推动了古汉字计算释义的发展，实验表明当前多模态大语言模型在复杂字形分析和历史演变理解上仍有很大提升空间。
AI.translation: 古汉字学者的释义需要整合视觉观察、语言分析和历史背景。然而，现有的计算方法主要集中在字符识别和检索等子任务上，缺乏全面学术分析所需的结构化数据集和基准。为解决这一局限性，我们引入了古汉字释义（ACCE）任务，这是一个模拟学者释义过程的视觉问答（VQA）任务。ACCE 分为四个渐进级别：基础字符识别、字形分析、字义释义和历时演变分析。为了支持这项任务，我们构建了两个互补的资源。JieZi-Dataset 是第一个用于 ACCE 的大规模、经专家审核的 VQA 训练数据集，包含 500K 以上的问答对。它是通过一个流水线构建的，该流水线通过专家设计的模板和源文本引用来约束生成，从而减少事实错误。每个关键阶段进一步应用人工验证以确保学术准确性。JieZi-Bench 是一个与释义过程对齐的评估基准，由人类专家构建和验证以确保评估的可靠性。它由四个级别组成，参考答案取自与训练数据隔离的权威辞书作品。对多模态大语言模型的实验表明，当前模型在基础识别上表现良好，但在字形分析、语义推理和历时理解方面表现不佳。在 JieZi-Dataset 上进行微调显著提高了所有四个级别的性能。代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/Ran00w/JieZi 获取。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了 JieZi，这是一个大规模、经专家审核的数据集和基准，旨在解决古汉字释义问题。通过提出 ACCE 任务、构建 JieZi-Dataset 和 JieZi-Bench，并进行多模态大语言模型的评估与微调，本研究填补了古汉字计算分析领域的空白。
AI.keywords: 古汉字释义, 多模态大语言模型, 视觉问答, 数据集与基准
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将古汉字释义转化为视觉问答（VQA）任务，填补了该领域大规模、专家审核数据集的空白，对推动多模态大语言模型在古文字学交叉领域的发展具有重要意义。

title: Ripple-Pivot Search: Active Parallel Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a competitive alternative to autoregressive language models, offering the potential for substantially faster inference through parallel decoding. Existing parallel decoding schedulers typically commit positions only after they meet a per-position criterion, overlooking how early commitments may benefit subsequent decoding. We identify a ripple effect in dLLM decoding: proactively committing a mid-entropy pivot position can induce a pronounced reduction in uncertainty across the remaining masked positions. This uncertainty reduction allows subsequent steps to unmask more tokens in parallel, thereby accelerating the overall decoding process. To exploit the ripple effect, we propose Ripple-Pivot Search (RPS), a novel training-free decoding method that seeks mid-entropy positions as promising candidate pivots (where to decode), and determines their token assignment that yields the greatest downstream benefit via lookahead evaluation (what to decode). Across 3 dLLMs and 4 reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, RPS achieves 4-10$\times$ wall-clock speedup over the standard decoder while preserving generation quality, and improves accuracy over the previous lookahead baseline by up to 5.49% while delivering higher throughput in most settings. When integrated with KV caching, RPS further achieves up to 18$\times$ wall-clock speedup over the standard decoder.

AI.title_translation: 涟漪支点搜索：扩散大语言模型的主动并行解码
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Ripple-Pivot Search (RPS)的扩散大语言模型并行解码方法，通过利用“涟漪效应”主动提交中等熵值支点，实现了高达4-18倍的推理加速并提升了生成精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散大语言模型并行解码调度器通常只在位置满足特定标准后才提交，忽视了早期提交对后续解码的潜在益处。为了克服这一局限并加速整体解码过程，作者希望利用解码过程中的“涟漪效应”。
AI.method: 提出了 Ripple-Pivot Search (RPS) 算法，这是一种无需训练的解码方法，通过寻找中等熵值位置作为候选支点，并利用前瞻评估确定能产生最大下游效益的词元分配。
AI.result: 在3个扩散大语言模型和4个推理与代码生成基准测试中，RPS在保持生成质量的同时，比标准解码器实现了4-10倍的实际运行加速；与先前的前瞻基线相比，准确率提升了高达5.49%，并且在大多数设置下提供了更高的吞吐量；结合KV缓存后，加速比最高可达18倍。
AI.conclusion: Ripple-Pivot Search (RPS) 是一种有效且无需训练的扩散大语言模型并行解码方法，通过利用涟漪效应和前瞻评估，在保持生成质量的同时实现了大幅加速和精度提升。
AI.translation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）已成为自回归语言模型的一个有竞争力的替代方案，通过并行解码提供了显著加快推理速度的潜力。现有的并行解码调度器通常仅在位置满足逐位置标准后才提交，忽视了早期提交如何有益于后续解码。我们发现了dLLM解码中的涟漪效应：主动提交一个中等熵值的支点位置可以显著降低其余掩码位置的不确定性。这种不确定性的降低使得后续步骤能够并行解掩码更多词元，从而加速整体解码过程。为了利用涟漪效应，我们提出了涟漪支点搜索（RPS），这是一种新颖的、无需训练的解码方法，它寻找中等熵值位置作为有希望的候选支点（在哪里解码），并通过前瞻评估确定产生最大下游效益的词元分配（解码什么）。在3个dLLM和4个推理及代码生成基准上，RPS在保持生成质量的同时，实现了比标准解码器4-10倍的实际运行加速，在大多数设置下提供更高吞吐量的同时，比先前的前瞻基线将准确率提高了多达5.49%。当与KV缓存集成时，RPS进一步实现了比标准解码器高达18倍的实际运行加速。
AI.summary: 该论文发现了扩散大语言模型中的“涟漪效应”，即主动提交中等熵值的支点位置可以减少其余掩码位置的不确定性。基于此，作者提出了 Ripple-Pivot Search (RPS) 方法，通过寻找候选支点并通过前瞻评估确定词元分配，从而在无需训练的情况下大幅加速了解码过程并提升了生成精度。
AI.keywords: 扩散大语言模型, 并行解码, 涟漪效应, 支点搜索, 推理加速
AI.comments: 该论文提出的Ripple-Pivot Search (RPS)方法创新性地利用了扩散大语言模型中的“涟漪效应”（ripple effect），通过主动选择并提前提交中等熵值的支点位置，显著降低了其余掩码位置的不确定性，从而加速并行解码过程。无需重新训练即可部署，且在多个推理和代码生成基准上实现了显著的加速和精度提升，具有重要的实用价值。

title: Harnessing LLMs for Document-Guided Fuzzing of Python Libraries
summary: Python libraries underpin deep learning, scientific computing, data analysis, and computer vision, making their reliability critical to downstream applications. Testing their APIs requires inputs that satisfy both per-parameter constraints and dependencies among parameters. Existing approaches either leave such constraints implicit in generated programs or rely on library-specific parsing rules. This paper introduces VistaFuzz, a document-guided fuzzing technique that uses a locally served open-sourced LLM to extract parameter specifications from API documents and generate inputs that satisfy both parameter constraints and inter-parameter dependencies. We evaluate VistaFuzz on 7,718 APIs across twelve Python libraries. Inter-parameter relationships occur in 40.1\% of tested APIs, and disabling their resolution reduces the valid generation rate on those APIs from above 95\% to 31.6\%--52.8\%. VistaFuzz reports 74 issues, of which 43 have been confirmed by developers and 29 have been fixed.

AI.title_translation: 利用大语言模型对Python库进行文档引导的模糊测试
AI.tldr: VistaFuzz利用大语言模型解析API文档，自动生成满足复杂参数约束的测试输入，成功在多个Python库中发现了大量漏洞。
AI.motivation: Python库的可靠性至关重要，但现有API测试方法要么忽略参数间的隐式约束，要么依赖于特定库的解析规则，难以满足复杂的参数依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出VistaFuzz技术，利用本地部署的开源LLM从API文档中提取参数规范，并生成满足参数约束及参数间依赖关系的输入。
AI.result: 在12个Python库的7,718个API上进行了评估，发现40.1%的API存在参数间依赖关系，禁用依赖解析会导致有效生成率从95%以上跌至31.6%--52.8%，共发现74个问题（43个已确认，29个已修复）。
AI.conclusion: VistaFuzz通过结合LLM解析API文档，能够有效提取参数约束与依赖关系，显著提升Python库模糊测试的有效性和有效输入生成率。
AI.translation: Python库是深度学习、科学计算、数据分析和计算机 vision 的基石，因此其可靠性对下游应用至关重要。测试其API需要满足每个参数的约束以及参数之间依赖关系的输入。现有方法要么使生成的程序中的此类约束保持隐式，要么依赖于特定库的解析规则。本文介绍了VistaFuzz，这是一种文档引导的模糊测试技术，它使用本地服务的开源LLM从API文档中提取参数规范，并生成既满足参数约束又满足参数间依赖关系的输入。我们在12个Python库的7,718个API上评估了VistaFuzz。参数间的关系出现在40.1%的测试API中，禁用它们的解析会将这些API上的有效生成率从95%以上降低到31.6%--52.8%。VistaFuzz报告了74个问题，其中43个已被开发人员确认，29个已被修复。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了VistaFuzz，这是一种文档引导的模糊测试技术，它利用本地开源LLM提取API文档中的参数规范，以自动生成满足复杂参数约束和依赖关系的Python库测试输入，并在多个主流库的测试中取得了显著成效。
AI.keywords: 文档导向模糊测试, 大语言模型, Python库, API测试, 参数依赖
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地利用开源大语言模型解析API文档以提取参数规范和依赖关系，有效解决了Python库文档导向模糊测试中的参数约束难题，具有极高的实用价值和工业界影响力。

title: LiveAnimate: Stable Long-Form Streaming Human Animation in Real-Time
summary: Pose-driven human animation synthesizes a video of a target person from a single reference image and a driving pose stream. Real-time generation is essential for interactive applications such as live streaming, telepresence, and virtual avatars, yet diffusion-based systems require minutes to hours per clip, precluding responsive interaction. We present LiveAnimate, to our knowledge the first animation system to combine real-time streaming with stable long-form generation at billion scale, built on a 14B-parameter video Diffusion Transformer (DiT). A two-stage training pipeline first adapts a pretrained bidirectional DiT into a block-causal autoregressive generator through Reference-Anchored Teacher-Forcing Adaptation, and then reduces the sampling budget to three steps through Block-wise Self-Forcing Distillation. To preserve appearance over extended streams, we introduce Pose-Retrieval Sink Attention (PR-Sink), a bounded KV-cache mechanism combining a Static Sink that permanently anchors the first generated block, a Dynamic Sink that holds a pose-retrieved historical block, and a three-slot Rolling Window. When a pose recurs, PR-Sink restores the relevant appearance context without retaining the entire sequence, so memory and per-block latency remain constant regardless of stream duration. Together with Ulysses sequence parallelism and operator fusion, these designs enable 19.63\,FPS streaming inference on two NVIDIA H100 GPUs. On a three-minute benchmark, LiveAnimate maintains nearly constant perceptual quality and identity from the first 30 seconds to the final minute (IQA 4.047 vs.\ 4.026), while prior systems degrade substantially or require hours of offline computation for the same rollout. These results establish a new operating point in quality, latency, and duration for interactive full-body animation.

AI.title_translation: LiveAnimate：实时稳定的长视频流式人体动画
AI.tldr: LiveAnimate 是首个支持实时流式传输与十亿级稳定长视频生成的动作驱动人体动画系统，在 14B 参数下实现了约 20 FPS 的推理速度。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于扩散模型的人体动画系统生成每段视频需要几分钟到几小时，无法满足直播、远程呈现和虚拟化身等交互式应用所需的实时性，且长视频生成容易出现外观和身份退化的问题。
AI.method: 提出两阶段训练管线（Reference-Anchored Teacher-Forcing Adaptation 和 Block-wise Self-Forcing Distillation）以及 Pose-Retrieval Sink Attention (PR-Sink) 机制，并结合 Ulysses 序列并行与算子融合技术。
AI.result: 在两块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上实现了 19.63 FPS 的流式推理，在三分钟的基准测试中，从前30秒到最后1分钟保持了几乎恒定的感知质量和身份保真度（IQA 4.047 对比 4.026）。
AI.conclusion: LiveAnimate 成功实现了首个兼具实时流式传输与十亿级稳定长视频生成的动作驱动人体动画系统，为虚拟化身和实时互动设立了新的技术标杆。
AI.translation: 姿态驱动的人体动画通过单张参考图像和驱动姿态流合成目标人物的视频。实时生成对于直播、远程呈现和虚拟 avatar 等交互式应用至关重要，然而基于扩散系统的方案每个片段需要几分钟到几小时，无法满足响应式交互的需求。我们提出了 LiveAnimate，据我们所知，这是第一个将实时流式传输与十亿级稳定长视频生成相结合的动画系统，它构建在一个 14B 参数的视频 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 之上。两阶段训练管线首先通过参考锚定教师强制适配（Reference-Anchored Teacher-Forcing Adaptation）将预训练的双向 DiT 适应为块因果自回归生成器，然后通过块级自强制蒸馏（Block-wise Self-Forcing Distillation）将采样预算减少到三步。为了在扩展的视频流中保持外观，我们引入了姿态检索汇聚注意力（Pose-Retrieval Sink Attention, PR-Sink），这是一种有界 KV 缓存机制，结合了永久锚定首个生成块的静态汇聚、保存姿态检索历史块的动态汇聚以及三槽滚动窗口。当姿态重复出现时，PR-Sink 可以在不保留整个序列的情况下恢复相关外观上下文，从而使内存和每个块的延迟无论流持续时间如何都保持恒定。结合 Ulysses 序列并行和算子融合，这些设计使得在两个 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上实现了 19.63 FPS 的流式推理。在一个三分钟的基准测试中，LiveAnimate 从前 30 秒到最后 1 分钟保持了近乎恒定的感知质量和身份（IQA 4.047 对比 4.026），而先前的系统则大幅退化或需要数小时的离线计算才能完成相同的卷展。这些结果为交互式全身动画的质量、延迟和持续时间确立了一个新的运行点。
AI.summary: LiveAnimate 是一个基于 14B 参数视频 Diffusion Transformer 的实时长视频流式人体动画系统。通过两阶段训练优化、PR-Sink 注意力机制以及并行加速技术，它在保证恒定内存和低延迟的同时，实现了高质量、长时间的稳定人体动画生成。
AI.keywords: Human Animation, Diffusion Transformer, Real-Time Streaming, Long-Form Generation, Video Synthesis
AI.comments: LiveAnimate 在实时性、长视频稳定性和生成质量方面取得了重大突破，特别是在14B大模型下实现了每秒约20帧的流式推理，解决了扩散模型在交互式应用中的延迟痛点。

title: Epiplexity Guided Data Selection and Generation for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
comments: Code available for EpiSelect (https://github.com/eysu35/EpiSelect) and EpiGen (https://github.com/eysu35/EpiGen)
summary: Modern systems are increasingly expected to transfer across tasks not specified during training. What data facilitates generalization in these new, unanticipated settings? One hypothesis is that data with more structural information could contain shared circuits and subprograms that could be recycled in a wider array of downstream settings. Epiplexity, a recently proposed measure of the structural information a compute-bounded learner can extract from data, provides a mechanism to reason about this relationship. In this paper, we show how to operationalize epiplexity as an online training signal for data selection and synthetic data generation. For selection, we fit scaling laws to the training loss curves of natural data domains to predict the expected epiplexity gain as a function of training tokens, and use this signal to adaptively determine the sampling weights over domains during training. For synthetic data generation, we define a generator's reward as the change in learner epiplexity over a buffer of previously generated data and use REINFORCE policy gradients to guide the generator toward an epiplexity-maximizing distribution. In both cases, higher epiplexity predicts improved downstream performance on zero-shot and fine-tuning based tasks, supporting the hypothesis that data rich in structural information yield representations that transfer across domains.
comment: Code available for EpiSelect (https://github.com/eysu35/EpiSelect) and EpiGen (https://github.com/eysu35/EpiGen)

AI.title_translation: 基于外显复杂性引导的数据选择与生成用于分布外泛化
AI.tldr: 本文利用外显复杂性（epiplexity）作为衡量数据结构信息的指标，设计了数据选择和合成生成策略，成功提升了模型的分布外泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现代系统需要具备跨任务泛化能力，而探讨什么样的数据能够促进这种泛化至关重要。本文旨在通过外显复杂性（epiplexity）这一衡量结构信息的指标，来指导数据的选择和合成，以提升模型的分布外泛化能力。
AI.method: 对于数据选择，通过拟合训练损失曲线的缩放定律来预测期望的外显复杂性增益，从而自适应调整领域采样权重；对于合成数据生成，将生成器的奖励定义为学习器在生成缓冲区数据上的外显复杂性变化，利用REINFORCE策略梯度引导生成器最大化外显复杂性。
AI.result: 实验与应用表明，在数据选择和合成中追求更高的外显复杂性能显著提升模型在零样本和微调任务上的下游性能，验证了结构丰富的数据能产生可跨领域迁移的表征。
AI.conclusion: 基于外显复杂性的数据选择和生成策略能够有效提高模型对未指定任务的泛化能力，验证了富含结构信息的数据在跨领域迁移中的关键作用。
AI.translation: 现代系统越来越被期望能够在训练未指定的任务之间进行迁移。什么样的数据能促进这些新且预料之外的设置中的泛化呢？一个假设是，具有更多结构Data的数据可能包含可在更广泛的下游设置中循环使用的共享电路和子程序。外显复杂性（Epiplexity）是最近提出的一种度量受计算限制的学习者可以从数据中提取的结构信息的指标，它提供了一种推理这种关系的机制。在本文中，我们展示了如何将外显复杂性操作化为用于数据选择和合成数据生成的在线训练信号。对于选择，我们将缩放定律拟合到自然数据域的训练损失曲线上，以预测预期的外显复杂性增益随训练令牌的变化函数，并使用该信号在训练期间自适应确定域上的采样权重。对于合成数据生成，我们将生成器的奖励定义为学习者在先前生成的数据缓冲区上的外显复杂性变化，并使用REINFORCE策略梯度引导生成器朝向最大化外显复杂性的分布。在这两种情况下，更高的外显复杂性都预示着在零样本和基于微调的任务上改进的下游性能，这支持了以下假设：富含结构信息的数据产生的表征可以跨领域迁移。
AI.summary: 本文提出了基于外显复杂性（epiplexity）的数据选择与生成方法，旨在提升模型的分布外泛化能力。通过将外显复杂性作为在线训练信号，文章设计了自适应领域采样权重调整方案和基于策略梯度的合成数据生成奖励机制，证明了高结构信息的数据能显著改善下游泛化性能。
AI.keywords: 外显复杂性, 分布外泛化, 数据选择, 合成数据生成, 结构信息
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将“外显复杂性（epiplexity）”这一度量结构信息的概念引入数据选择与合成中，不仅在理论上支持了结构丰富的数据有助泛化的假说，还为提升模型分布外泛化能力提供了实用的在线训练信号和强化学习方案。

title: Making Every Step Count: Spatio-Temporal Information Allocation for Imaging Inverse Problems
summary: Flow-based generative models have emerged as powerful image priors for training-free inverse problem solving, capturing coherent semantics and fine-grained structure. Despite these strengths, existing flow-based inverse solvers primarily focus on the design of individual updates, largely overlooking spatio-temporal information allocation under a fixed number of function evaluations (NFEs). Temporally, insufficient early exploration can trap the flow trajectory in an incorrect semantic basin, whereas excessive allocation of NFEs to early stages leaves little budget for late-stage refinement. Spatially, data consistency provides direct constraints only within observed regions, whereas the recovery of missing regions relies mainly on the generative prior. To address these two issues, we introduce two complementary and training-free components, i.e., Spectrum-Adaptive Scheduling (SAS) and Measurement-Prioritized Attention (MPA). For temporal allocation, SAS distributes the available NFEs over flow time according to the degradation spectrum and logSNR geometry, thus better balancing semantic exploration and detail refinement. For spatial propagation, MPA exploits data-prior conflicts to guide information toward weakly constrained regions, thereby enhancing semantic and structural fidelity. Extensive experiments on standard image inverse problems, e.g., super-resolution, motion deblurring, and inpainting, demonstrate that the proposed components can be integrated into existing flow-based inverse solvers in a plug-and-play manner without retraining or additional flow-model evaluations, and can also significantly improve the restoration quality of existing solvers.

AI.title_translation: 让每一步都有意义：成像反问题的时空信息分配
AI.tldr: 提出了谱自适应调度（SAS）和测量优先注意力（MPA）两种即插即用组件，优化了基于流模型的图像反问题求解中的时空信息分配，在不增加计算成本的情况下显著提升了恢复质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于流模型的图像反问题求解器主要关注单步更新的设计，忽视了在固定函数评估次数（NFEs）下的时空信息分配问题。时间上，早期探索不足或晚期精炼预算不够会导致错误语义或细节丢失；空间上，数据一致性仅在观测区域提供约束，缺失区域的恢复依赖生成先验。
AI.method: 提出了两个互补且无需训练的组件：1. 谱自适应调度（SAS），根据退化谱和logSNR几何形状在流时间上分配可用的NFE；2. 测量优先注意力（MPA），利用数据-先验冲突指导信息流向弱约束区域。
AI.result: 在超分辨率、运动去模糊和图像修复等标准图像反问题上的广泛实验表明，该方法能够以即插即用方式集成到现有求解器中，在不增加额外NFE或重新训练的情况下显著提高恢复质量。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出的SAS和测量优先注意力MPA能够无缝集成到现有基于流模型的图像反问题求解器中，在不增加计算成本的前提下，显著提升各类图像恢复任务的质量。
AI.translation: 基于流的生成模型已成为用于免训练反问题求解的强大图像先验，能够捕获连贯的语义和细粒度的结构。尽管具有这些优势，现有的基于流的反问题求解器主要关注单个更新的设计，在很大程度上忽略了在固定数量的函数评估（NFE）下的时空信息分配。在时间上，早期探索不足会将流轨迹困在不正确的语义盆地中，而将过多NFE分配给早期阶段则几乎不给后期精炼留出预算。在空间上，数据一致性仅在观察到的区域内提供直接约束，而缺失区域的恢复主要依赖于生成先验。为了解决这两个问题，我们引入了两个互补且无需训练的组件，即谱自适应调度（SAS）和测量优先注意力（MPA）。对于时间分配，SAS根据退化谱和logSNR几何形状在流时间上分配可用的NFE，从而更好地平衡语义探索和细节精炼。对于空间传播，MPA利用数据-先验冲突引导信息流向弱约束区域，从而增强语义和结构保真度。在超分辨率、运动去模糊和图像修复等标准图像反问题上的广泛实验表明，所提出的组件可以以即插即用的方式集成到现有的基于流的反问题求解器中，无需重新训练或额外的流模型评估，并且可以显著提高现有求解器的恢复质量。
AI.summary: 该论文针对基于流模型的图像逆问题求解，提出了一种新颖的时空信息分配策略。通过引入谱自适应调度（SAS）和测量优先注意力（MPA），有效平衡了时间上的语义探索与细节精炼，并优化了空间上的信息传播，从而在无需额外计算成本的情况下大幅提升了图像恢复性能。
AI.keywords: 流生成模型, 图像反问题, 时空信息分配, 谱自适应调度, 测量优先注意力
AI.comments: 该论文针对基于流模型的无训练图像反问题求解器中普遍存在的时空信息分配不均问题，提出了谱自适应调度（SAS）和测量优先注意力（MPA）两种即插即用的组件。创新点在于无需重新训练或增加函数评估次数（NFE），即可有效平衡语义探索与细节精炼，并在空间上指导信息流向弱约束区域，显著提升了图像恢复质量。

title: Dual Modality Prompted Diffusion Priors for Zero Shot Hyperspectral Pansharpening
summary: Hyperspectral pansharpening aims to reconstruct a high resolution hyperspectral (HRHS) image from a panchromatic (PAN) image and a low resolution hyperspectral (LRHS) image while preserving both spatial details and spectral fidelity. Recent diffusion based methods exploit pretrained image priors by generating a low dimensional representation and subsequently mapping it to the hyperspectral domain. However, the observed panchromatic and hyperspectral images are typically imposed only through external reconstruction objectives, limiting their direct interaction with the diffusion prior. To address this issue, we propose dual-modality image-prompted diffusion model (DIDM) for zero shot hyperspectral pansharpening. DIDM encodes the low resolution hyperspectral and panchromatic observations into spectral and spatial prompt tokens, respectively, and injects them into intermediate features of a frozen remote sensing diffusion model through cross attention, allowing complementary spectral and spatial information to directly guide diffusion feature evolution. In addition, we introduce a panchromatic guided weighted pixel aware total variation regularizer that combines low resolution hyperspectral degradation fidelity and panchromatic response fidelity with gradient adaptive structural regularization, thereby preserving structural discontinuities while suppressing spurious variations in homogeneous regions. Extensive experiments on Pavia, Chikusei, and Houston under reduced resolution protocols show that DIDM achieves the best performance across all evaluated metrics, while full resolution evaluation on FR1 yields the highest HQNR among the compared methods. These results demonstrate that internal dual modality prompting and panchromatic guided structural regularization provide an effective balance between spatial detail enhancement and spectral preservation.

AI.title_translation: 用于零样本高光谱全色锐化的双模态提示扩散先验模型
AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于零样本高光谱全色锐化的双模态提示扩散模型（DIDM），通过空间和光谱提示直接引导扩散特征演化，实现了出色的空间细节增强与光谱保持。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的方法虽然利用了预训练的图像先验，但观测到的全色图像和高光谱图像通常仅通过外部重建目标施加影响，限制了它们与扩散先验的直接交互。
AI.method: 提出了一种双模态图像提示扩散模型（DIDM），将低分辨率高光谱图像和全色图像编码为光谱和空间提示词，通过交叉注意力注入冻结的遥感扩散模型中；同时引入了全色引导的加权像素感知全变分正则化器。
AI.result: 在Pavia、Chikusei和Houston数据集上的降分辨率协议实验表明，DIDM在所有评估指标上均取得了最佳性能；FR1上的全分辨率评估也产生了最高的HQNR。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出的DIDM和全色引导的加权像素感知全变分正则化器，为零样本高光谱全色锐化提供了一种有效平衡空间细节增强与光谱保持的方法，在多个数据集上取得了优异的性能。
AI.translation: 高光谱全色锐化旨在从全景（PAN）图像和低分辨率高光谱（LRHS）图像中重建高分辨率高光谱（HRHS）图像，同时保持空间细节和光谱保真度。最近基于扩散的方法通过生成低维表示并随后将其映射到高光谱域来利用预训练的图像先验。然而，观察到的全色和高光谱图像通常仅通过外部重建目标施加，限制了它们与扩散先验的直接交互。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了用于零样本高光谱全色锐化的双模态图像提示扩散模型（DIDM）。DIDM分别将低分辨率高光谱和全色观测数据编码为光谱和空间提示词，并通过交叉 attention 将它们注入冻结的遥感扩散模型的中间特征中，允许互补的光谱和空间信息直接指导扩散特征的演化。此外，我们引入了一种全色引导的加权像素感知全变分正则化器，它将低分辨率高光谱退化保真度和全色响应保真度与梯度自适应结构正则化相结合，从而在保持结构不连续性的同时抑制同质区域中的虚假变化。在Pavia、Chikusei和Houston上基于降分辨率协议的大量实验表明，DIDM在所有评估指标上都实现了最佳性能，而FR1上的全分辨率评估产生了比对方法中最高的HQNR。这些结果表明，内部双模态提示和全色引导的结构正则化在空间细节增强和光谱保持之间提供了有效的平衡。
AI.summary: 该文针对高光谱全色锐化问题，提出了一种名为DIDM的双模态提示扩散模型。通过将全色和低分辨率高光谱观测数据编码为空间和光谱提示词注入扩散模型，并结合全色引导的正则化器，有效平衡了空间细节和光谱保真度，在多个数据集上验证了其优越性能。
AI.keywords: 高光谱全色锐化, 扩散模型, 双模态提示, 零样本学习, 遥感图像处理
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的双模态提示扩散模型（DIDM），用于零样本高光谱全色锐化。其创新之处在于将全色图像和低分辨率高光谱图像编码为空间和光谱提示词，并通过交叉注意力直接注入冻结的扩散模型中，有效平衡了空间细节与光谱保真度。

title: MOON: Multi-Objective OrthoNormalized Updates for Multitask Learning
summary: Multi-objective optimization (MOO) has demonstrated significant success in multi-task learning by mitigating task conflicts through gradient manipulation. However, most existing methods flatten model parameters into vectors and perform gradient manipulation under Euclidean geometry, thereby overlooking the matrix structure prevalent in modern architectures such as Transformers. In this paper, we show that gradient manipulation in Euclidean space does not generally yield the steepest descent direction under matrix geometry, potentially limiting optimization efficiency. Drawing from the theory of steepest descent for matrix-valued parameters, we propose MOON (Multi-Objective OrthoNormalized Updates), which performs gradient manipulation under spectral--nuclear norm geometry and uses the orthonormalized manipulated gradient for parameter updates. Theoretically, for smooth non-convex objectives, we establish convergence of the averaged Pareto-stationarity measure at rates of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ in the deterministic setting and $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/4})$ under stochastic gradients. Empirical results across various benchmarks show that MOON consistently improves both optimization efficiency and final multi-task performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/KunlinLyu/MOON.

AI.title_translation: MOON：多任务学习的多目标正交归一化更新
AI.tldr: 针对多任务学习提出MOON方法，通过在矩阵几何下进行梯度操纵来克服欧氏空间优化的局限性，显著提升了现代模型架构的优化效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的多任务学习多目标优化方法将模型参数展平为向量并在欧氏几何下进行梯度操纵，忽视了现代架构（如Transformer）中普遍存在的矩阵结构，导致无法在矩阵几何下产生最速下降方向，从而限制了优化效率。
AI.method: 提出MOON（Multi-Objective OrthoNormalized Updates）方法，在谱-核范数几何下进行梯度操纵，并使用正交归一化后的操纵梯度进行参数更新。
AI.result: 理论上证明了对于平滑非凸目标，在确定性设置下平均帕累托平稳性测度的收敛速率为 $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$，在随机梯度下为 $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/4})$；实验表明MOON在各种基准测试中均持续提高了优化效率和多任务性能。
AI.conclusion: MOON方法通过在矩阵几何下进行梯度操作，有效提升了多任务学习中Transformer等现代架构的优化效率和最终性能。
AI.translation: 多目标优化（MOO）通过梯度操纵缓解任务冲突，在多任务 learning 中取得了显著成功。然而，大多数现有方法将模型参数展平为向量，并在欧氏几何下执行梯度操纵，从而忽视了Transformer等现代架构中普遍存在的矩阵结构。在本文中，我们表明欧氏空间中的梯度操纵在矩阵几何下通常无法产生最速下降方向，这可能会限制优化效率。借鉴矩阵值参数最速下降理论，我们提出了MOON（多目标正交归一化更新），它在谱-核范数几何下执行梯度操纵，并使用正交归一化的操纵梯度进行参数更新。在理论上，对于平滑非凸目标，我们在确定性设置下建立了平均帕累托平稳性测度以 $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ 的速率收敛，在随机梯度下以 $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/4})$ 的速率收敛。各种基准测试的经验结果表明，MOON始终如一地提高了优化效率和最终的多任务性能。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/KunlinLyu/MOON 获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对多任务学习中的多目标优化问题，指出传统欧氏空间梯度操纵忽视了矩阵结构的问题，并基于矩阵值参数的最速下降理论提出了MOON方法。该方法在谱-核范数几何下进行梯度操作和正交归一化更新，理论和实验均证明了其在优化效率和性能上的优势。
AI.keywords: 多任务学习, 多目标优化, 矩阵几何, 梯度操纵, 谱核范数
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将矩阵几何（谱-核范数几何）引入多任务学习的多目标优化中，突破了传统欧氏空间梯度操作的限制，不仅理论证明了收敛性，还在实验中取得了显著的性能提升。

title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Output Feedback LQR for Continuous-Time MIMO Systems
summary: This article studies model-free output feedback linear quadratic regulation (LQR) for continuous-time linear systems with an $n$-dimensional state, an $m$-dimensional input, and a $p$-dimensional output, using filtered input--output data. Since the system state is unavailable, existing methods rely on dynamic filters to parameterize the hidden state using measurable input--output signals. However, the intrinsic dimension of the resulting filter-based parametrization can be smaller than the dimension of the complete filtered vector, and this deterministic redundancy can make the Bellman regressions rank deficient. We characterize this intrinsic dimension and show that the conventional filtered vector contains only $2n$ independent components for single-input multi-output (SIMO) systems and $n(m+1)$ independent components for general multi-input multi-output (MIMO) systems. Based on this characterization, a reduced filtered vector is extracted directly from data and used to develop reduced model-free output feedback policy iteration and value iteration equations, eliminating the redundant directions and decreasing the number of unknown parameters while retaining a fully input--output data-based implementation. A numerical example illustrates the rank reduction and the effectiveness of the learned controller.

AI.title_translation: 基于强化学习的连续时间MIMO系统输出反馈LQR
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于降维滤波输入输出数据的无模型输出反馈LQR方法，解决了传统方法中的Bellman回归矩阵降秩问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于动态滤波器的无模型输出反馈LQR方法中，由于滤波器参数化产生的内在维度可能小于完整滤波向量的维度，导致确定性冗余并使Bellman回归矩阵降秩，因此需要解决这一冗余和降秩问题。
AI.method: 通过特征化传统滤波向量的内在维度（SIMO系统为2n，一般MIMO系统为n(m+1)），直接从数据中提取降维的滤波向量，进而开发出消除冗余方向并减少未知参数的无模型输出反馈策略迭代和值迭代方程。
AI.result: 明确了单输入多输出（SIMO）系统和一般多输入多输出（MIMO）系统传统滤波向量中独立成分的数量，并通过数值算例验证了降秩效果以及所学控制器的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过理论刻画滤波向量的本质维度并提取降维滤波向量，有效消除了Bellman回归中的冗余方向和降秩问题，成功开发了基于全输入输出数据的降维无模型输出反馈策略迭代和值迭代算法。
AI.translation: 本文研究了使用滤波输入输出数据的连续时间线性系统（具有n维状态、m维输入和p维输出）的无模型输出反馈线性二次调节（LQR）问题。由于系统状态不可用，现有方法依赖动态滤波器使用可测量的输入输出信号来参数化隐藏状态。然而，由此产生的基于滤波器的参数化的内在维度可能小于完整滤波向量的维度，这种确定性冗余会使Bellman回归矩阵降秩。我们刻画了这一内在维度，并证明了传统的滤波向量对于单输入多输出（SIMO）系统仅包含2n个独立分量，对于一般多输入多输出（MIMO）系统包含n(m+1)个独立分量。基于这一刻画，直接从数据中提取降维滤波向量，并用于开发降维的无模型输出反馈策略迭代和值迭代方程，在保持全输入输出数据实现的同时，消除了冗余方向并减少了未知参数的数量。数值算例说明了降秩效果和所学控制器的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了基于滤波输入输出数据的连续时间多输入多输出（MIMO）系统无模型输出反馈线性二次调节（LQR）问题。针对传统方法中由于确定性冗余导致Bellman回归矩阵降秩的问题，论文定量刻画了滤波向量的内在维度（SIMO系统为2n，MIMO系统为n(m+1)），并提出了提取降维滤波向量的无模型输出反馈策略迭代与值迭代方法，有效减少了未知参数并保持了基于输入输出数据的实现。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 输出反馈, 线性二次调节器, 连续时间系统, 多输入多输出系统
AI.comments: 该论文针对连续时间MIMO系统的无模型输出反馈LQR问题，指出了传统滤波方法中存在的确定性冗余问题，并通过理论刻画其本质维度，提出了降维的策略迭代和值迭代方程。这在减少未知参数、避免Bellman回归矩阵降秩方面具有重要的理论和实际意义。

title: UniSwap: Streaming Audio-Visual Identity Swapping for Talking Videos
summary: Talking-video character replacement requires coordinated transfer of appearance and voice while preserving the source motion, scene, linguistic content, and audio-video timing. Existing methods use separately optimized models for the two modalities, making audio-visual consistency difficult to enforce. We present UniSwap, the first framework for streaming joint audio-visual identity replacement in talking videos. Given a source video, a reference image, and a reference voice clip, UniSwap transfers the reference appearance and vocal timbre within a single audio-visual diffusion transformer while preserving the source content and dynamics. To address the scarcity of aligned cross-identity training pairs, we introduce a swap-and-reconstruct pipeline that removes visual and vocal identity from real clips and uses the original clips as reconstruction targets. Starting from a bidirectional backbone, we progressively adapt the model through In-context Pretraining for joint replacement, Conditional Streaming Adaptation for block-causal KV-cached generation, and Efficient Self-forcing DMD for mitigating exposure bias and reducing sampling from 30 to 3 denoising steps per block. Efficient Multi-LoRA Switching enables the three DMD roles to share a single frozen backbone. Feature-RoPE Decomposition keeps cached positions within the training range, supporting stable long-form inference. Experiments demonstrate strong audio-visual synchronization, competitive identity preservation, efficient streaming, and stable long-form generation.

AI.title_translation: UniSwap：会话视频的流式视听身份替换
AI.tldr: UniSwap是首个实现会话视频流式联合视听身份替换的框架，通过单一扩散模型和创新训练策略，高效实现了视听同步和身份转换。
AI.motivation: 现有的会话视频角色替换方法通常对视觉和声音两种模态使用单独优化的模型，难以强制保证视听一致性，且缺乏高效的流式联合视听身份替换框架。
AI.method: 提出UniSwap框架，采用单一的音频-视频扩散Transformer；引入swap-and-reconstruct流水线解决配对数据稀缺问题；通过In-context Pretraining、Conditional Streaming Adaptation和Efficient Self-forcing DMD进行模型逐步适配与加速。
AI.result: 实验表明，UniSwap具备极强的视听同步性、竞争力的身份保持能力、高效的流式传输以及稳定的长视频生成能力，且能将每个块的采样步骤从30步减少到3步。
AI.conclusion: UniSwap成功实现了会话视频中的联合视听身份替换，兼顾了高效的流式推理和高质量的视听同步，为该领域设定了新的基准。
AI.translation: 说话视频的角色替换需要协调转移外貌和声音，同时保留源动作、场景、语言内容和视听时序。现有方法对这两种模态使用单独优化的模型，使得视听一致性难以保证。我们提出了UniSwap，这是第一个用于说话视频中流式联合视听身份替换的框架。给定源视频、参考图像和参考语音片段，UniSwap在一个单一的视听扩散Transformer中传输参考外貌和声乐音色，同时保留源内容和动态。为了解决对齐的跨身份训练对稀缺的问题，我们引入了一个交换和重建流水线，从真实片段中去除视觉和声乐身份，并使用原始片段作为重建目标。从双向主干网络开始，我们通过上下文预训练进行联合替换，通过条件流式适配进行块因果KV缓存生成，并通过高效的自强迫DMD来缓解暴露偏差并将每个块的采样从30个去噪步骤减少到3个，从而逐步适应模型。高效的多LoRA切换使三个DMD角色能够共享单个冻结的主干网络。特征-RoPE分解将缓存位置保持在训练范围内，支持稳定的长格式推理。实验证明了强大的视听同步、有竞争力的身份保持、高效的流式传输和稳定的长格式生成。
AI.summary: UniSwap是首个用于会话视频中流式联合视听身份替换的框架，它利用单一的视听扩散Transformer来同步转换外貌和声音，并通过自研的训练流水线与加速策略实现了高效、稳定的长视频生成。
AI.keywords: 视听身份替换, 扩散Transformer, 流式生成, 说话视频, 身份保持
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了首个流式联合视听身份替换框架，通过单一的音频-视频扩散Transformer同时处理外貌和声音的转换，并引入了交换重建流水线、上下文预训练、条件流式适配以及高效的自强迫DMD蒸馏技术，实现了极高的生成效率和视听同步性。

title: LabelFusion-TS: Fusing Large Language Models, Transformer Encoders, and Financial Time Series for Monetary-Policy Stance Classification
summary: Financial text is produced and interpreted within a market environment, yet financial text classifiers almost always receive text alone. We study whether financial time series are useful as an additional input on the task of classifying sentences from Federal Reserve communication as hawkish, dovish, or neutral. Our system, \lfts{}, extends the \lf{} architecture with this modality: a small voting network combines three independently trained components, a fine-tuned RoBERTa encoder, a prompted large language model (LLM), and a fused ensemble of time-series transformers over the market series of the months preceding publication. Because only about a thousand annotated sentences are available for training, the RoBERTa encoder is first pre-trained on sentences annotated automatically by the LLM and only then fine-tuned on the human labels. Trained on Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) communication up to 2015 and evaluated on 2015--2022, the fused system achieves 70.2\% weighted F1 -- against 64.1\% for the zero-shot LLM -- and overtakes it with as few as 240 human-labelled sentences. We take this as initial evidence for market time series as an input modality in financial text classification.

AI.title_translation: LabelFusion-TS：融合大语言模型、Transformer编码器与金融时间序列用于货币政策立场分类
AI.tldr: 该论文开发了一个名为LabelFusion-TS的多模态系统，通过将金融时间序列与文本大语言模型和Transformer编码器相结合，显著提升了美联储货币政策立场的分类准确率。
AI.motivation: 金融文本虽然是在市场环境中产生和解释的，但现有的金融文本分类器几乎只接收文本输入。本研究旨在探讨金融时间序列作为额外输入模态是否对美联储沟通文本的鹰派、鸽派或中性立场分类任务有用。
AI.method: 提出LabelFusion-TS系统，使用一个小型的投票网络组合三个独立训练的组件：一个经过自动标注预训练和人工标签微调的RoBERTa编码器、一个提示词大语言模型（LLM），以及一个在发布前几个月市场序列上运行的时间序列Transformer融合集成。
AI.result: 在2015年之前的FOMC通信数据上训练并在2015-2022年进行评估，融合系统实现了70.2%的加权F1分数（零样本LLM为64.1%），并且仅需240个由人工标注的句子就能超越纯LLM的表现。
AI.conclusion: 结合金融时间序列、微调的RoBERTa编码器和大语言模型的多模态系统（LabelFusion-TS）能够有效提升货币政策立场分类的性能，证明了市场时间序列作为金融文本分类输入模态的有效性。
AI.translation: 金融文本是在市场环境中产生和解释的，然而金融文本分类器几乎总是仅接收文本。我们研究了金融时间序列作为额外输入对于将美联储沟通句子分类为鹰派、鸽派或中性任务的有用性。我们的系统LabelFusion-TS将LabelFusion架构扩展到这一模态：一个小型投票网络结合了三个独立训练的组件，即微调的RoBERTa编码器、提示词大语言模型（LLM），以及在发布前几个月市场序列上运行的时间序列Transformer融合集成。由于只有大约一千个带注释的句子可用于训练，RoBERTa编码器首先使用LLM自动注释的句子进行预训练，然后才在人工标签上进行微调。在2015年之前的联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）沟通数据上训练并在2015-2022年评估，该融合系统实现了70.2%的加权F1分数——相比之下零样本LLM为64.1%——并且仅需240个由人工标注的句子就能超越它。我们将此视为市场时间序列作为金融文本分类输入模态的初步证据。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了LabelFusion-TS，一个将大语言模型、RoBERTa编码器和金融时间序列Transformer相结合的多模态系统，用于美联储货币政策立场的分类。研究表明，引入市场时间序列作为额外输入模态，显著提升了在少样本条件下的文本分类准确率。
AI.keywords: 货币政策立场分类, 大语言模型, 金融时间序列, Transformer编码器, 多模态融合
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将金融时间序列数据引入文本分类任务中，通过结合大语言模型、Transformer编码器和时间序列模型，有效提升了美联储货币政策立场分类的准确性。在训练数据有限的情况下表现出色的少样本学习能力，为多模态金融文本分析提供了有价值的参考。

title: MuseCritic: Learning Multi-Aspect Song Rewards through Natural-Language Aesthetic Critiques
summary: Long-form song generation models continue to improve in duration, structural integrity, and acoustic complexity, making reliable aesthetic rewards increasingly important for aligning these models with human preferences. However, reward models for complete songs remain limited, and existing evaluators typically predict scores in a single forward pass without providing readable explanations. We introduce MUSECRITIC, a semi-scalar reward model that generates a natural-language critique covering five aesthetic dimensions and uses it as an intermediate representation to predict continuous reward scores. MUSECRITIC follows a two-stage training pipeline: a teacher model first provides high-quality critiques for supervised fine-tuning, after which the fine-tuned model generates its own critiques for reward learning, mitigating distribution shift between training and inference. On an in-domain test set of 200 SongEval songs, MUSECRITIC reduces macro-averaged mean squared error from 0.2875 to 0.2316 and improves macro-averaged LCC, SRCC, and Kendall's tau to 0.9068, 0.8838, and 0.7178, respectively. On the out-of-domain Music Arena benchmark with 733 preference pairs, it achieves the highest accuracy of 71.35%. Moreover, using MUSECRITIC with GRPO improves Muse-0.6B on all nine aesthetic metrics from SongEval and Audiobox Aesthetics. These results demonstrate that critique-conditioned reward modeling reduces scoring error and provides an effective optimization signal for song generation. The project repository is available at https://github.com/WuqnEl/MuseCritic.

AI.title_translation: MuseCritic：通过自然语言审美批判学习多方面歌曲奖励
AI.tldr: MuseCritic 通过先生成自然语言审美批判再预测评分的两阶段方法，显著提升了歌曲生成模型的奖励准确性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 长音频生成模型不断发展，但现有的歌曲奖励模型多为单次前向预测单分数的评估器，缺乏可读性解释，无法提供可靠且可解释的审美奖励来对齐人类偏好。
AI.method: 提出 MuseCritic 半标量奖励模型，采用两阶段训练流程（教师模型监督微调加自生成批判训练），先生成覆盖五个审美维度的自然语言批判，再基于此预测连续奖励分数。
AI.result: 在 SongEval 数据集上将宏平均均方误差降至 0.2316 并提升了相关系数，在 Music Arena 基准测试中达到 71.35% 的最高准确率，且结合 GRPO 优化提升了 Muse-0.6B 在多个审美指标上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 基于自然语言批判的半标量奖励模型 MuseCritic 有效提升了歌曲生成模型对人类偏好的对齐效果，减少了评分误差，并在多项指标上表现优异。
AI.translation: 长音频生成模型在持续时间、结构完整性和声学复杂度方面不断改进，这使得可靠的审美奖励对于将这些模型与人类偏好进行对齐变得越来越重要。然而，针对完整歌曲的奖励模型仍然有限，现有的评估器通常在单次前向传递中预测分数，而不提供可读的解释。我们介绍了 MUSECRITIC，这是一种半标量奖励模型，它生成涵盖五个审美维度的自然语言批判，并将其用作中间表示来预测连续的奖励分数。MUSECRITIC 遵循两阶段训练流程：教师模型首先为监督微调提供高质量的批判，随后微调后的模型生成自己的批判用于奖励学习，从而缓解训练和推理之间的分布偏移。在包含 200 首 SongEval 歌曲的域内测试集上，MUSECRITIC 将宏平均均方误差从 0.2875 降低到 0.2316，并将宏平均 LCC、SRCC 和 Kendall's tau 分别提升至 0.9068、0.8838 和 0.7178。在包含 733 个偏好对的域外 Music Arena 基准测试中，它实现了 71.35% 的最高准确率。此外，将 MUSECRITIC 与 GRPO 结合使用改善了 Muse-0.6B 在 SongEval 和 Audiobox Aesthetics 的所有九个审美指标上的表现。这些结果表明，以批判为条件的奖励建模减少了评分误差，并为歌曲生成提供了有效的优化信号。项目代码库可在 https://github.com/WuqnEl/MuseCritic 获取。
AI.summary: MuseCritic 是一种通过生成自然语言审美批判来进行多方面歌曲奖励学习的半标量奖励模型。它通过两阶段训练缓解分布偏移，在各项评估和生成对齐任务中均取得了优异的性能。
AI.keywords: 歌曲生成, 奖励模型, 自然语言批判, 人类偏好对齐, 强化学习
AI.comments: MuseCritic 提出了一种基于自然语言审美批判的多维度歌曲奖励模型，不仅降低了评分误差，还为长音频生成模型的对齐与优化提供了高质量的可解释信号。

title: Complete characterization of the differential spectrum of a Niho type power function
summary: Power functions with Niho exponents have attracted considerable attention due to their important applications in sequence design, coding theory, and cryptography. This paper investigates the differential properties of Niho type power functions of the form $F(x)=x^{s(2^m-1)+1}$ over $\mathbb{F}_{2^{2m}}$ with $2\leq s\leq 2^m$. We first establish a general characterization of the differential spectrum of $F(x)$ having at most three nonzero values via its Walsh spectrum. Focusing subsequently on the case $s=(2^k+1)^{-1} \pmod{2^m+1}$ where $\gcd(k,m)=e$, we employ a refined analysis of the number of solutions to certain equations over finite fields. Specifically, it is proved that $F(x)$ is locally differentially $2^e$-uniform when $\gcd(2^k-1,2^m+1)=2^e+1$ and locally differentially $(2^{2e}-2^e)$-uniform when $\gcd(2^k-1,2^m+1)=1$, and their differential spectra are completely determined. These results completely characterize the differential properties of this family and yield new infinite families of locally differentially $4$-uniform power functions.

title: AWARe: Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting via Activation-Weighted Adaptive REtention
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) exhibit strong generalization and reasoning abilities due to large-scale multimodal pre-training. However, fine-tuning these models on downstream tasks often leads to catastrophic forgetting, where newly learned task-specific knowledge degrades previously acquired capabilities. This issue arises because gradient updates for new tasks overwrite parameters critical to prior knowledge, limiting the practical deployment of MLLMs. To address this challenge, we propose Activation-Weighted Adaptive REtention (AWARe), a fine-tuning method that mitigates catastrophic forgetting by dynamically controlling parameter updates based on activation patterns. AWARe assigns activation-based importance scores to parameters, selectively freezing those essential for preserving prior capabilities while allowing less important parameters to adapt to new tasks. Importantly, AWARe operates without modifying model architectures, ensuring compatibility with existing inference engines. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AWARe effectively preserves upstream capabilities while achieving superior downstream performance compared to existing methods. Code is available at https://github.com/kaln27/AWARe.

AI.title_translation: 通过激活加权自适应保留来缓解灾难性遗忘
AI.tldr: AWARe是一种新的微调方法，通过根据激活模式动态控制参数更新来防止灾难性遗忘，从而在不改变模型架构的情况下，有效保留先前的能力并提高下游性能。
AI.motivation: 微调大型多模态语言模型（MLLMs）以适应下游任务时，会出现灾难性遗忘问题，即新学习的任务知识会损害模型先前获得的通用能力，这限制了MLLMs的实际应用。
AI.method: AWARe通过为参数分配基于激活的重要性分数，选择性地冻结对保留先前能力至关重要的参数，同时允许不太重要的参数适应新任务，从而动态控制参数更新。
AI.result: 实验表明，AWARe能够有效保留上游能力，并在下游任务上取得优于现有方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: AWARe通过激活加权自适应保留，能够有效缓解灾难性遗忘，在不修改模型架构的情况下，实现良好的下游任务性能和保留先前能力。
AI.translation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）由于大规模多模态预训练，展现出强大的泛化和推理能力。然而，在下游任务上微调这些模型常常会导致灾难性遗忘，即新学习到的特定任务知识会损害先前获得的能力。这个问题产生的原因是新任务的梯度更新会覆盖掉对先前知识至关重要的参数，从而限制了MLLMs的实际部署。为了解决这个挑战，我们提出了激活加权自适应保留（AWARe），一种通过根据激活模式动态控制参数更新来缓解灾难性遗忘的微调方法。AWARe为参数分配基于激活的重要性分数，选择性地冻结那些对保留先前能力至关重要的参数，同时允许不太重要的参数适应新任务。重要的是，AWARe在不修改模型架构的情况下运行，确保了与现有推理引擎的兼容性。广泛的实验表明，AWARe能够有效保留上游能力，并在下游任务上取得优于现有方法的性能。代码可在https://github.com/kaln27/AWARe获取。
AI.summary: AWARe是一种新颖的微调方法，旨在解决多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在微调过程中遇到的灾难性遗忘问题。该方法通过计算参数的激活重要性分数，动态地调整参数更新，优先保留对先前知识重要的参数，同时允许其他参数适应新任务。AWARe的优势在于它无需修改模型架构，保证了与现有推理引擎的兼容性，并通过实验证明了其在有效保留通用能力的同时，显著提升了下游任务的性能。
AI.keywords: 灾难性遗忘,多模态大语言模型,微调,激活加权,自适应保留
AI.comments: 这项研究提出了一种巧妙的解决方案来解决MLLMs微调中的一个关键挑战——灾难性遗忘。AWARe方法通过激活加权自适应保留，在不改变模型架构的前提下，实现了对先前知识的有效保护和新任务的适应，这对于模型的实际应用具有重要意义。其动态控制参数更新的机制具有创新性，并且实验结果也证实了其有效性。未来的工作可以进一步探索该方法在更广泛的模型和任务上的适用性，以及其在计算效率方面的优化。

title: Automated binary classification of hazelnut X-ray images: A deep-learning benchmark for quality assessment
comments: 26 pages (including 5 pages of supplementary material), 4 figures, 5 tables. Dataset available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21739932
summary: Non-destructive X-ray imaging can reveal internal hazelnut defects that are difficult to detect by external inspection alone; however, automated interpretation remains challenging because of subtle radiographic differences among classes, marked class imbalance, and limited annotated data. Here, we present a benchmark for binary hazelnut quality classification (healthy versus defective) based on 799 segmented single-kernel X-ray images (224 x 224 pixels, grayscale), grouped into 101 acquisition units. Seven single-model configurations and ten probability-aggregation ensembles were evaluated using a group-wise split-rotation protocol across five data splits generated using different random seeds. Decision thresholds were selected on the validation set, and performance was assessed deterministically on validation and test sets. Under the expert-reassessed annotation condition, the average-probability ensemble of the binary cross-entropy-trained convolutional neural network and frozen Swin Transformer achieved the highest mean balanced accuracy (86.3% +/- 1.8%, five seeds), with several other ensembles providing comparable performance. Across methods, substantial split-to-split variability was observed, indicating that multi-split evaluation is essential for reliable model comparison at this dataset scale. Expert reassessment of ambiguous samples improved the performance of all 17 evaluated methods by 2.8-8.1 percentage points, while having only a limited effect on cross-split variance. The results highlight both the potential of deep learning for automated X-ray-based hazelnut quality assessment and the importance of rigorous evaluation and label curation in small, imbalanced agricultural imaging datasets.

AI.title_translation: 榛子X射线图像的自动化二分类：质量评估的深度学习基准
AI.tldr: 本研究建立了基于X射线图像的榛子质量自动化分类深度学习基准，证明了深度学习结合专家标签校准可有效提升榛子内部缺陷检测的准确性。
AI.motivation: 非破坏性X射线成像可揭示榛子内部缺陷，但由于类间射线照相差异微细、显著的类别不平衡以及有限的标注数据，自动化解释仍然具有挑战性，因此需要建立一个深度学习基准以进行质量评估。
AI.method: 评估了七种单模型配置和十种概率聚合集成方法，采用基于五个数据分割的逐组分割-旋转协议，并在验证集上选择决策阈值、在验证集和测试集上进行确定性评估。
AI.result: 在专家重新评估的标注条件下，使用二元交叉熵训练的卷积神经网络与冻结Swin Transformer的平均概率集成获得了最高的平均平衡准确率（86.3% ± 1.8%），且专家重新评估使所有17种方法的性能提升了2.8-8.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习结合专家标签校准可有效实现基于X射线图像的榛子质量自动化评估，但严谨的评估协议与数据管理对获取可靠性能至关重要。
AI.translation: 非破坏性的X射线成像可以揭示仅通过外部检查难以发现的榛子内部缺陷；然而，由于各类别之间细微的放射学差异、显著的类别不平衡以及有限的注释数据，自动化解释仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们基于799张分割的单仁X射线图像（224 x 224像素，灰度图，分为101个采集单元），提出了一个二分类榛子质量分类（健康与缺陷）的基准。使用基于五个由不同随机种子生成的分割-旋转协议，评估了七种单模型配置和十种概率聚合集成方法。决策阈值在验证集上选定，性能在验证集和测试集上进行确定性评估。在专家重新评估的注释条件下，使用二元交叉熵训练的卷积神经网络和冻结的Swin Transformer的平均概率集成实现了最高的平均平衡准确率（86.3% +/- 1.8%，五个种子），其他几种集成也提供了相当的性能。在各种方法中，观察到了显著的分割间变异性，这表明多分割评估对于在此数据集规模下进行可靠的模型比较至关重要。对模糊样本的专家重新评估使所有17种评估方法的性能提高了2.8-8.1个百分点，而对跨分割方差的影响有限。结果既突出了深度学习在基于X剂量的榛子质量自动评估中的潜力，也强调了严谨评估和标签整理在小型、不平衡农业成像数据集中的重要性。
AI.summary: 该论文建立了一个基于799张榛子X射线图像的二分类质量评估深度学习基准。通过对比多种单模型和集成方法，并引入专家标签校准与多划分评估协议，验证了深度学习在榛子内部缺陷检测中的潜力及严谨数据集管理的重要性。
AI.keywords: 榛子质量评估, X射线成像, 深度学习, 二分类, 数据不平衡
AI.comments: 该论文为基于X射线图像的榛子质量自动化二分类提供了一个深度学习基准。其创新点在于评估了多种单模型配置和概率聚合集成方法，并强调了专家重新标注样本以及多划分评估协议在处理小型、不平衡农业影像数据集时的重要性。不足之处在于数据集规模相对较小，且跨划分变异性显著。

title: Variational Enrichment of Adaptive Finite Element Spaces Beyond Polynomials
summary:
Adaptive finite elements refine meshes or increase polynomial degree, but coherent non-polynomial structure may remain expensive in either coordinate. We introduce variational enrichment, in which compact problem-informed functions complement ordinary h- and p-refinement. The framework applies to Galerkin and minimum-residual formulations whenever admissible functions and their residual value can be evaluated; it is not tied to one PDE class. Quotient-Schur analysis removes redundant additions and measures their variational value. For symmetric coercive problems, the present theory also gives an exact energy-error reduction and a reference-independent upper bound.
  Across heterogeneous media, stochastic coefficients, irregular domains, singularities, interfaces, transport, and oscillatory tests, hc helps when a compact function captures unresolved structure aligned with the PDE operator; it offers little benefit when that structure is redundant or mismatched. On SPE10 Models 1 and 2, coefficient-adapted functions improve polynomial enrichment in all eleven prescribed cases at equal dimension, by up to $41.6\%$. The wider positive and negative evidence supports the same conclusion: hc selects useful operator-compatible structure and otherwise falls back to ordinary hp refinement.

AI.title_translation: 超越多项式的自适应有限元空间变分丰富化
AI.tldr: 提出了一种自适应有限元空间的变分丰富化方法，通过引入算子相容的紧凑函数显著提升了解的精度和效率。
AI.motivation: 传统的自适应有限元通过网格加密（h）或提高多项式阶数（p）来提高精度，但在处理相干的非多项式结构时计算成本依然很高。
AI.method: 引入紧凑的问题引导函数来补充常规的h-和p-细化，并应用Quotient-Schur分析来去除冗余添加并衡量其变分价值。
AI.result: 在包括SPE10模型在内的11个算例中，系数自适应函数在同等维度下将多项式丰富化效果提升了高达41.6%。
AI.conclusion: 变分丰富化方法能够有效捕捉未解析的算筹结构，在保持相同维度的前提下显著提升精度，且在无效时能自动退回常规的 hp 自适应细化。
AI.translation:
自适应有限元通过加密网格或提高多项式次数来进行，但在任一坐标下，相干的非多项式结构可能仍然代价高昂。我们引入了变分丰富化方法，其中紧凑的问题引导函数补充了普通的h-和p-细化。只要能评估允许函数及其残差值，该框架就适用于Galerkin和最小残差公式，且不限于某一类PDE。Quotient-Schur分析消除了冗余添加并衡量了它们的变分价值。对于对称强制问题，本理论还给出了精确的能量误差减少和与参考无关的上界。
在异质介质、随机系数、不规则域、奇点、界面、输运和振荡测试中，当紧凑函数捕获与PDE算子对齐的未解析结构时，hc方法会派上用场；当该结构是冗余的或不匹配的时，它提供的好处很小。在SPE10模型1和2上，在相同维度下，系数自适应函数在所有11种规定情况下都改进了多项式丰富化，幅度高达41.6%。更广泛的正反面证据支持了相同的结论：hc选择有用的算子相容结构，否则退回到普通的hp细化。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种自适应有限元空间的变分丰富化框架，利用紧凑的问题引导函数补充常规的h-和p-细化。通过Quotient-Schur分析剔除冗余并评估变分价值，该方法能够捕捉与PDE算子对齐的未解析结构，在复杂测试中显著优于传统多项式丰富化。
AI.keywords: 自适应有限元, 变分丰富化, 算子相容结构, 误差减少, Galerkin方法
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种超越传统多项式的变分丰富化（variational enrichment）方法，通过引入紧凑且符合问题特征的函数来弥补h/p自适应有限元在处理复杂结构时的不足。创新点在于 quotient-Schur 分析的引入，不仅去除了冗余，还提供了误差减少的保证。这一框架具有通用性，在多类复杂问题和算例中表现出显著性能提升。

title: ProBAG: Prototype-Guided Boundary-Aware Graph Diffusion for Weakly Supervised Histopathology Segmentation
comments: 12 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted by MICCAI Workshop (COMPAYL) 2026
summary: Weakly supervised semantic segmentation enables histopathology tissue segmentation from image-level annotations, avoiding costly pixel-level labeling by expert pathologists. However, CAM-based methods often localize only highly discriminative regions and remain unreliable near tissue interfaces. We propose ProBAG, a stage-1 pseudo-mask generator that combines dataset-specific visual prototypes with pathology-aligned CONCH text prototypes over multi-scale frozen UNI features. ProBAG introduces two complementary mechanisms: class-wise power recalibration that reshapes inter-class competition while preserving the total foreground activation mass at each pixel, and one-step graph diffusion in which feature affinities are penalized by a late-transformer attention-context discrepancy used as a soft structural boundary cue. The resulting stage-1 pseudo-masks require neither CRF nor an external segmentation model; for complete two-stage comparison, they additionally supervise a downstream Phikon-FPN segmenter. Experiments on BCSS-WSSS and LUAD-HistoSeg show consistent gains over recent WSSS approaches, while ablations indicate that pathology-aligned text semantics provide the largest improvement and graph refinement provides a smaller complementary gain. The code is available at: https://github.com/wterrr/WSSS

AI.title_translation: ProBAG：用于弱监督组织病理学分割的原型引导边界感知图扩散
AI.tldr: 提出一种名为ProBAG的弱监督病理图像分割方法，利用原型引导和图扩散机制解决了传统CAM在组织交界处定位不准的问题。
AI.motivation: 基于CAM的弱监督方法通常只能定位高度判别性的区域，且在组织交界处不可靠，而病理图像像素级标注成本高昂，因此需要更精确的弱监督组织分割方法。
AI.method: 提出ProBAG伪掩码生成器，结合数据集特定视觉原型与CONCH文本原型、多尺度冻结UNI特征；引入类级能量重校准机制和基于自注意力上下文差异的单步图扩散边界感知机制，并监督下游Phikon-FPN分割器。
AI.result: 在BCSS-WSSS和LUAD-HistoSeg数据集上的实验表明，ProBAG相较于近期的弱监督语义分割方法获得了持续的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: ProBAG通过整合原型引导和边界感知图扩散，有效生成了高质量的病理伪掩码，并在弱监督组织病理学分割任务中取得了优于现有方法的性能。

title: Instruction Alignment for Binary Code Representation Learning
comments: In proceedings of the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)
summary:
Binary code representation learning is a fundamental problem in software security and reverse engineering. Existing methods mainly learn function-level embeddings that capture coarse-grained semantic relationships between binary functions, but they largely ignore fine-grained instruction-level correspondences. This limitation misses valuable supervision signals available from compiler debug information, which can support the learning of more accurate and interpretable binary code representations.
  We propose to leverage instruction alignment knowledge to further improve binary code representation learning. Our preliminary study reveals that models finetuned for function-level binary code similarity exhibit substantially better instruction alignment than their pre-trained model, suggesting a strong correlation between instruction alignment and function-level embedding quality. Motivated by this observation, we design a training approach that explicitly incorporates instruction alignment as an auxiliary training objective. Our experiments show that instruction alignment training improves retrieval accuracy and provides more discriminative signal for the model's similarity judgments.

title: Causal Structure is Inducible but Functionally Decoupled: The Routing/Readout Boundary of a Typed Mechanism Library
summary: When a language model answers an interventional question, the computation it must perform depends on the type of evidence the query requires. We report a decoupling in how a transformer organizes causal knowledge: slot-by-type structure induced by type-level supervision organizes routing, yet remains functionally decoupled from answer readout. We establish this with a typed mechanism library -- discrete mechanism slots partitioned by evidence type, auditable at the state level -- on a causal-world benchmark with exact interventional ground truth, under a frozen protocol, at two scales (22.6M and 125M). Four preregistered findings. (i) Origin. Slot-by-type organization is induced by type-level supervision: absent in architecturally identical unsupervised controls, not buyable by content-free gating labels, and statistically attributable to the supervision signal, replicating at 125M under a powered preregistered protocol (all nine cells passed). (ii) Boundary. The induced structure is a typed routing index with a sharp routing/readout boundary: slot codes scaffold routing but do not drive answer readout ($|Δ\hat{y}| \le 3.4\times10^{-6}$, zero collateral, three seeds, stable across a 5.6x scale window) -- we therefore make no behavioral-editability claim. (iii) Cost. The structure is free: LM quality matches a parameter-matched monolith within 0.0082 nats. (iv) Trust. The library state is exactly local under edit and bit-exactly revertible -- 250 single-edit and 1,000 stacked reverts per seed, zero failures. We further find that the unsupervised null itself moves with scale, so comparisons reusing a null calibrated at one scale may be confounded at another. Every claim is tied to a preregistered, machine-checkable criterion archived before the data it governs; the full audit trail, including one criterion we failed and how the frozen protocol handled it, is released as an appendix.

title: HyperANFIS: Enhancing Rule Representation and Interpretability in Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Systems via Hyperbolic Geometry
summary: The adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) is an interpretable reasoning framework capable of generating explicit IF-THEN fuzzy rules, making it suitable for tasks requiring transparent reasoning. However, existing ANFIS models generally construct rule antecedents and perform inference in Euclidean space, limiting their representational capacity and predictive performance. To address this issue, we propose Hyperbolic ANFIS (HyperANFIS), a hyperbolic extension of ANFIS. HyperANFIS preserves the fuzzy semantics and core architecture of conventional ANFIS while performing rule-prototype learning, rule activation, and consequent aggregation in hyperbolic space. It also retains the ability to generate interpretable IF-THEN rules. By exploiting the representational properties of hyperbolic geometry, HyperANFIS strengthens the fuzzy inference process, thereby improving predictive accuracy, inter-rule collaboration, and the credibility of its interpretable rules. Experimental results show that HyperANFIS consistently outperforms the standard ANFIS baseline and various ANFIS variants across all datasets, while also generating higher-quality fuzzy rules.

title: Policy-Induced Hand Priors in Humanoid Dual-Arm Manipulation: Diagnosing and Mitigating Initial-Pose Dependence
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies are expected to operate robustly across variations in the robot's initial configuration, yet aggregate task success can conceal pose-specific failures and inappropriate hand selection. This work investigates initial-pose dependence in VLA-based humanoid dual-arm manipulation. We characterize the initial-condition-dependent early hand preference as a policy-induced hand prior and quantify it using HandPriorScore, residual hand bias, and target responsiveness. Evaluations across multiple policies and 17 initial configurations reveal strong initial-pose--policy interactions: the same pose produces substantially different success rates across policies, while a single policy exhibits large performance variation across poses. Specific initial arm configurations can suppress or induce an asymmetric hand preference, with the resulting effect varying in direction and strength across policies. Wrist-camera observations also influence hand selection and task performance. Expanding initial-pose coverage in the training dataset substantially improves robustness, while targeted augmentation around a low-performing configuration increases its success rate. Comparisons across training configurations show that sufficient exposure to the target simulation task is beneficial, whereas the effect of real or auxiliary data depends on pose coverage, simulation ratio, and observation availability. These findings characterize a pose-conditioned hand prior, identify a localized initial arm configuration as a causal handle on hand-selection behavior, and demonstrate how data coverage and training composition affect initial-pose robustness.

title: Achieving Near-Zero-Overhead Multi-Model Hierarchical Classification in Real-Time Detection Pipelines
comments: 14 pages, 17 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to Journal of Real-Time Image Processing
summary: Edge-deployed vision systems in target recognition, surveillance, autonomous vehicles, and drone domains require hierarchical inference pipelines where a detection model identifies objects of interest and downstream classifiers provide fine-grained attribute analysis. Running all models on the GPU creates a serial bottleneck that limits real-time throughput as pipeline stages grow. Modern edge SoCs pair GPUs with dedicated neural accelerators (NPUs, DLAs) capable of concurrent execution, yet deploying custom models on these accelerators remains impractical due to strict operator constraints, quantization incompatibilities, and an undocumented end-to-end pipeline. We target NVIDIA Jetson DLA cores as the representative platform. We present a five-step methodology for zero GPU fallback DLA INT8 deployment of classification backbones, comprising architecture adaptation, manual dynamic range workaround to rescue TensorRT's implicit quantization (recovering 94.0% accuracy from implicit quantization's 75%) for rapid pipeline validation before explicit quantization, quantization-aware training, ONNX graph surgery for DLA compilation, and a concurrent GPU-detection/DLA-classification inference pipeline. We document nine engineering constraints with root-cause analysis and generalizable solutions. Validation on a dual-head person attribute classifier running on DLA alongside a GPU object detector on a Jetson Orin NX demonstrates near-zero pipeline overhead (12.5 vs. 13.3~FPS detector-only at 1080p), with dual-DLA scaling at no additional cost. The methodology is backbone-agnostic and generalizes to any detection-classification edge pipeline.

title: Diagnosis Before Recovery: Turning Agent Failures into Selective Self-Correction
summary: Self-correction is particularly useful when a failure constrains the next repair. Coding agents benefit from this property because compilers, tests, and execution traces turn many failures into typed recovery signals, but broad language-agent tasks often expose only a coarse task failure. This creates a tension for generic recovery playbooks: they broaden the agent's context precisely when the system needs a narrower repair interface, mixing incompatible signals for invalid actions, missing procedures, and strict-format errors. Our insight is that development-set failures can recover part of the missing diagnostic substrate by deciding which recovery interventions are admissible before test-time correction. We propose DARC, a diagnosis-guided recovery harness that profiles task-family failure modes, prunes mismatched interventions from a shared recovery library, and freezes a verifier-selected success-cost policy for deployment. This causal order makes correction selective: the harness first determines what kind of failure can be repaired, then decides how much recovery evidence to spend. In ALFWorld, AppWorld, and XBRL Finance, the same protocol yields an action-validity harness, a procedural-recovery fallback, and a format-precision retrieval policy; in each evaluated setting it improves average task performance over base agents and broad playbooks while reducing environment steps or retrieval budget. Our experiments show that failures need not trigger uniformly more context: DARC turns self-correction from prompt expansion into recovery-interface design. DARC provides a practical route toward more reliable agents in domains where compiler-like feedback is absent: making failures actionable before making contexts larger.

title: The Sleeping Agent: What Gist-Based Context Compression Loses and Why
comments: 7 pages, 5 tables, appendices. Code and results at https://github.com/kyrkewood/sleeping-agent
summary: Gist-based context compression---summarising older conversation history into compact representations---is a common approach in long-horizon language model agents, yet its effect on different types of memory retrieval is poorly understood. We use Salience-Weighted Consolidation (SWC), a biologically-inspired compression framework motivated by sleep-based memory consolidation, as a diagnostic probe to study when gist compression helps and when it hurts. SWC scores conversation history by salience, partitions it into priority tiers, and applies structured gist abstraction to mid-priority content. Evaluating four conditions on all ten LoCoMo conversations---1,935 matched text-only questions in total, 1,501 used in the primary aggregate after excluding Category 5 (adversarial) questions---at temperature 0, we find a consistent task-type interaction: gist compression substantially outperforms truncation on multi-hop reasoning and single-hop factual questions, but temporal questions remain substantially harder under compression, with compressed conditions scoring well below the full-context reference on the conversations where both are evaluated. We trace this failure to a specific mechanism: the gist abstraction prompt preserves relational and event structure while discarding dates and times. A preservation analysis across all ten conversations confirms the mechanism: an approximately 20-fold increase in temporal expression preservation (3.05% to 62.39%) with a one-sentence prompt modification, while named entity and event preservation rates barely change (x1.02 and x1.11), demonstrating that the fix is a precision instrument. The prompt modification recovers +0.314 [0.254, 0.375] judge accuracy on category-2 (temporal) questions in the matched set. Code and results: https://github.com/kyrkewood/sleeping-agent.

title: VOLA: Improving Open-World Driving by VLM-Based Semantic Attribute Prediction
summary: Driving in the real world is open-world: a car may encounter a fallen mattress, a deer, or other objects outside its training data. Naming them is not enough. The system must know how to treat each region: can it drive over it, and how severe would a collision be? We therefore shift scene perception from category labels to dense action-relevant attributes, where each pixel is labeled by how it should affect motion rather than by object name. We instantiate this general formulation with two ordered attributes: 7-rank drivability and 5-rank vulnerability. We read Qwen3.5 image-token hidden states directly as a spatial semantic representation. A lightweight boundary-aware decoder then turns this coarse token grid into sharp full-resolution attribute maps. The whole process requires neither autoregressive text generation nor an external mask model such as SAM. We train on dense attribute labels built in CARLA and test transfer to real scenes and to novel obstacles never seen in training. We compare with vision-only segmenters trained on the same attributes and prompted VLM segmenters. Our model matches strong vision-only segmenters on familiar categories and improves transfer to real open-world anomalies, reaching 69.4% mean vulnerability-rank recall versus 57.1% for the best vision-only baseline and 53.9% for the best prompted VLM baseline. These results show that VLM image tokens provide useful semantic cues for transferring driving attributes to objects outside the training vocabulary.

title: Proof-Valid Caching under Premise Erasures: Local Structural Limits and Shared-Workload Gains
summary: We study reliable query recovery under independent premise erasures in semantically transparent caching systems, where every cached object must be a logical consequence of the premise base. Recovery succeeds only when the query remains derivable from surviving premises and the cache. Under a deterministic canonical-witness regime, we prove a query-local projection theorem and an exact residual-leaf law: recovery fails exactly when an erased base leaf retains a cache-free path to the query. Single-query design becomes weighted partial path interception. For shared workloads, we introduce semantic modules and derive exact reliability laws under joint and maximal-error criteria. The shared-module cache is exactly optimal under exact module routing and homogeneous costs, whereas optimal selection in general derivation DAGs is NP-complete at depth two. Against a coded benchmark recovering workload-relevant leaf payloads, MDS parity caching is optimal up to one packet. Leaf-only transparency incurs a first-order overhead inversely proportional to the erasure rate; shared modules multiply that inverse-erasure-rate scaling by the module-to-leaf cost ratio divided by the number of protected leaves. A Datalog instance and Monte Carlo checks illustrate the theory. For derivation-structured content, the results provide exact stochastic-erasure counterparts of function-correcting storage and an exact distributional quantification of maximal recoverability.
