In this paper, we provide a detailed and in-depth characterization of symmetry increase together with a principled framework for its reduction: (i) For any given feature space and input symmetry group, we prove that the increased symmetry admits an infimum determined by the structure of the feature space; (ii) Building on this foundation, we develop a computable algorithm to derive this infimum, and propose practical guidelines for feature design to prevent harmful symmetry increases. (iii) Under standard regularity assumptions, we demonstrate that for most equivariant maps, our guidelines effectively reduce symmetry increase. To complement our theoretical findings, we provide visualizations and experiments on both synthetic datasets and the real-world QM9 dataset. The results validate our theoretical predictions.

AI.title_translation: 减少等变神经网络中的对称性增加
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了等变神经网络中对称性增加的现象，并提出了相应的理论框架、计算算法和设计准则，有效解决了该问题导致的表达能力退化。
AI.motivation: 等变神经网络在处理对称输入时存在表达能力退化的现象（即输出表示对超出输入对称性的变换具有不变性，数学本质是等变映射导致的对称性增加），此前缺乏对该现象底层原因的严谨理解以及通用的减少策略，因此本研究旨在提供深入的表征与原则性的减少框架。
AI.method: （1）证明了在给定特征空间和输入对称群下，增加的对称性存在由特征空间结构决定的下确界；（2）开发了计算该下确界的算法，并提出了防止有害对称性增加的实用特征设计准则；（3）在标准正则性假设下验证了该准则的有效性，并通过合成数据集及QM9真实数据集进行了实验。
AI.result: 理论分析证明了对称性增加下确界的存在性，可视化和在合成数据集及QM9真实数据集上的实验结果验证了理论预测的正确性，表明所提准则能有效减少对称性增加。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过理论分析和实验验证，深入阐明了等变神经网络中对称性增加的本质，并提出了有效的减少该现象的原则性框架与实用准则。
AI.translation: 等变神经网络（ENN）已在科学领域的众多应用中发挥了重要作用。尽管它们在表示几何结构方面具有非凡的能力，但在处理对称输入时，ENN的表达能力会退化：输出表示对超出输入对称性的变换具有不变性。这种现象的数学本质是，一个对称输入在经过等变映射处理后，经历了对称性的增加。虽然先前研究记录了特定情况下的对称性增加，但对其潜在原因的严谨理解以及通用的减少策略仍然缺乏。在本文中，我们对对称性增加进行了详细而深入的表征，并提供了一个减少该现象的原则性框架：（i）对于任何给定的特征空间和输入对称群，我们证明了增加的对称性存在一个由特征空间结构决定的下确界；（ii）在此基础之上，我们开发了一种可计算的算法来推导该下确界，并提出了防止有害对称性增加的实用特征设计准则；（iii）在标准正则性假设下，我们证明了对于大多数等变映射，我们的准则能有效减少对称性增加。为了补充我们的理论发现，我们在合成数据集和真实世界的QM9数据集上提供了可视化和实验。结果验证了我们的理论预测。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了等变神经网络中由等变映射引起的“对称性增加”现象及其导致的表达能力退化。文章在理论上证明了增加对称性的下确界存在性，开发了计算该下确界的算法，提出了特征设计的实用准则，并通过合成数据与QM9数据集验证了这些方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 等变神经网络, 对称性增加, 几何结构, 特征设计, 表达能力
AI.comments: 该论文深入探讨了等变神经网络中长久以来被忽视的“对称性增加”现象，不仅在理论上证明了下确界的存在，还提出了可计算的算法和实用的特征设计准则，对于提升等变神经网络的表达能力具有重要意义。

title: Poly-Dialectal Neural Machine Translation System for Bangla Regional Dialects
summary: Regional dialectal variation poses a fundamental challenge to natural language processing (NLP) in Bangla, where over 240 million speakers communicate across diverse regional variants that diverge significantly from Standard Colloquial Bangla (SCB) in phonology, morphology, and lexicon. Contemporary neural machine trans- lation (NMT) architectures and large language models (LLMs) predominantly as- sume a homogeneous language distribution, resulting in severe performance degra- dation when translating low-resource regional dialects. In this work, we present a unified Poly-Dialectal Neural Machine Translation System capable of multi-directional translation across 12 Bangla regional dialects without routing through an inter- mediary standard pivot. We compile the largest multi-dialect parallel corpus for Bangla to date, comprising 51,531 non-null parallel sentence pairs across 12 di- alects, incorporating 2,500 expert-verified, bidirectional parallel sentence pairs for five previously unaddressed dialects. Evaluating sequence-to-sequence architec- tures under Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation (DoRA), our fine-tuned BanglaT5 model achieves state-of-the-art translation performance (29.26 BLEU, 57.26 chrF++), outperforming NLLB-200 (615M) and mBART-50 (611M) while preserving morphological coherence. Furthermore, we conduct a systematic cross- dialectal transfer analysis and dataset scaling study, establishing empirical thresh- olds for low-resource dialect adaptation. Finally, we deploy the optimized INT8- quantized model as an open-access web application to promote digital inclusion for marginalized dialect communities. The complete dataset is publicly available at Mendeley Data (https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/v9cf66fk2t/2).

AI.title_translation: 面向孟加拉语区域方言的多方言神经机器翻译系统
AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个统一的多方言孟加拉语机器翻译系统，利用新型平行语料库和微调的BanglaT5模型，实现了12种方言之间的高效直接互译。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语区域方言在语音、形态和词汇上与标准语差异巨大，导致现有的NMT和LLM在翻译低资源方言时性能严重退化，缺乏一个统一的、能直接进行多方言互译的系统。
AI.method: 构建了包含12种方言的大型多方言平行语料库（51,531个句子对），并采用权重分解低秩自适应（DoRA）技术微调BanglaT5模型，实现了无标准语中介的多方向翻译。
AI.result: 微调后的BanglaT5模型达到了最先进的翻译性能（29.26 BLEU，57.26 chrF++），超越了NLLB-200和mBART-50，并成功部署了INT8量化的开源网络应用。
AI.conclusion: 通过基于DoRA微调的BanglaT5模型，实现了孟加拉语12种区域方言之间的高效、直接互译，为低资源方言保护和数字化包容性做出了重要贡献。
AI.translation: 区域方言变异对孟加拉语的自然语言处理（NLP）构成了根本性挑战。孟加拉语拥有超过2.4亿说法语的人口，分布在不同的区域变体中，这些变体在语音、形态和词汇上与标准口语孟加拉语（SCB）有很大差异。当代的神经机器翻译（NMT）架构和大语言模型（LLM）主要假设语言分布是同质的，这导致在翻译低资源区域方言时性能严重下降。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种统一的多方言神经机器翻译系统，能够实现12种孟加拉语区域方言之间的多方向翻译，而无需通过中间的标准枢纽进行路由。我们编制了迄今为止最大的孟加拉语多方言平行语料库，涵盖12种方言的51,531个非空平行句子对，其中包括针对5种先前未涉及方言的2,500个经专家验证的双向平行句子对。在权重分解低秩自适应（DoRA）下评估序列到序列架构，我们微调的BanglaT5模型实现了最先进的翻译性能（29.26 BLEU，57.26 chrF++），在保持形态连贯性的同时，性能优于NLLB-200（615M）和mBART-50（611M）。此外，我们进行了系统的跨方言迁移分析和数据集扩展研究，建立了低资源方言适应的经验阈值。最后，我们将优化后的INT8量化模型部署为开源Web应用程序，以促进边缘化方言社区的数字包容性。完整数据集已在Mendeley Data公开提供（https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/v9cf66fk2t/2）。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种统一的多方言神经机器翻译系统，能够实现12种孟加拉语区域方言之间的直接多向翻译，无需标准语作为中介。作者构建了目前最大的孟加拉语多方言平行语料库，并利用DoRA技术微调BanglaT5模型，取得了优于现有大模型的翻译性能。
AI.keywords: 孟加拉语方言, 神经机器翻译, 多方言并行语料库, DoRA, 低资源语言处理
AI.comments: 该论文针对孟加拉语方言资源稀缺的痛点，构建了首个多方言平行语料库，并创新性地提出了不依赖标准语中介的多方言神经机器翻译系统，在保持形态一致性方面取得了突破性进展。

title: Distributed Nash Equilibrium Seeking with Logarithmic Bit Rates over Digital Channels
summary: This paper introduces quantization techniques to reduce the communication complexity in the distributed Nash equilibrium (NE) seeking problem, achieving an exponential reduction in bit rates over digital channels. The goal of distributed NE seeking algorithms is to coordinate agents in a network game toward equilibrium through iterative message exchanges among them via a communication network. The computational complexity of this distributed algorithm critically depends on network communication overhead in the digital channel, motivating the development of communication reduction mechanism. Regarding this, we proposed some quantizers based on sparsification and uniform quantization through a general class of ultimate-boundedness-based quantizers. Based on this, we propose a Passivity-Based NE seeking Algorithm with Time-varying scaling Error state Quantization (PBA-TEQ), and show that the linear convergence can be achieved under a sufficient condition. Moreover, when employing either the scalarization quantizer or the greedy quantizer, both belonging to the ultimate-boundedness-based quantizers, within the PBA-TEQ framework, we establish a lower bound on communication complexity of $\log_2(\mathcal{O}(nd))$ bit rates per transmission to achieve unbiased linear convergence, with $n$ being the number of agents and $d$ being the dimension of the decision state of the network game. Numerical simulation examples are provided to validate our theoretical results.

AI.title_translation: 数字信道下具有对数比特率的分布式纳什均衡求解
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型量化分布式纳什均衡求解算法，在数字信道下实现了对数级的极低通信比特率并保证线性收敛。
AI.motivation: 为了减少分布式纳什均衡求解问题中数字通信信道的通信开销和网络通信复杂度。
AI.method: 提出了一类基于终极有界性的通用量化器（结合了稀疏化和均匀量化），并在此基础上设计了基于无源性的带有时变缩放误差状态量化算法（PBA-TEQ）。
AI.result: 理论上证明了在PBA-TEQ框架下采用标量化或贪婪量化器时，实现无偏线性收敛所需的每个传输周期的通信比特率下限为 $\log_2(\mathcal{O}(nd))$。仿真实验验证了理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功设计了一种基于无源性的带有时变缩放误差状态量化的分布式纳什均衡求解算法（PBA-TEQ），在数字通信信道下实现了对数级的极低通信比特率，且能保证无偏的线性收敛。
AI.translation: 本文引入量化技术以降低分布式纳什均衡（NE）求解问题中的通信复杂度，在数字信道上实现了比特率的指数级减少。分布式NE求解算法的目标是通过通信网络中智能体之间的迭代消息交换，协调网络博弈中的智能体趋向均衡。该分布式算法的计算复杂度严重依赖于数字信道中的网络通信开销，这激发了通信削减机制的发展。对此，我们基于一类通用的基于终极有界性的量化器，提出了一些基于稀疏化和均匀量化的量化器。在此基础上，我们提出了基于无源性的带有时变缩放误差状态量化算法（PBA-TEQ），并证明了在充分条件下可以实现线性收敛。此外，当在PBA-TEQ框架内采用同属于基于终极有界性量化器的标量化量化器或贪婪量化器时，我们确立了每次传输实现无偏线性收敛所需的 $\log_2(\mathcal{O}(nd))$ 比特率的通信复杂度下限，其中 $n$ 是智能体数量，$d$ 是网络博弈决策状态的维度。数值仿真算例验证了我们的理论结果。
AI.summary: 本文研究了数字通信信道下分布式纳什均衡（NE）求解的通信效率问题。通过引入基于终极有界性的量化器（含稀疏化和均匀量化），提出了一种新型的无源性量化算法（PBA-TEQ），在实现对数级极低通信比特率（$\log_2(\mathcal{O}(nd))$）的同时，保证了网络能够以线性速率收敛到纳什均衡。
AI.keywords: 分布式纳什均衡, 量化通信, 对数比特率, 无源性, 稀疏化量化
AI.comments: 该论文在分布式纳什均衡求解中引入了基于稀疏化和均匀量化的对数级比特率量化技术，不仅在理论上实现了通信复杂度的指数级降低，还保证了线性收敛性，对资源受限的分布式网络优化具有重要意义。

title: From Safety Documentation to Safety Knowledge Support: An Evidence-Grounded LLM Framework for Medical Devices
summary:
Medical devices are becoming more software-intensive, connected, and AI-enabled. Their development requires risk-management evidence aligned with ISO 14971 and, for software, IEC 62304. This evidence must be kept consistent across requirements, design decisions, software changes, verification results, complaints, and post-market data. These tasks are costly and depend on scarce safety and domain experts.
  Large language models (LLMs) may reduce parts of this effort because medical-device safety work is highly document-based. However, current LLM-based safety-engineering studies often address isolated methods, rely on generic prompting or public examples, and provide limited support for source links, traceability, uncertainty handling, lifecycle updates, and recorded expert review. This limits their use in regulated medical-device development.
  This paper argues that the central research problem is not safety-text generation, but source-linked safety-knowledge support. We propose an evidence-grounded framework that connects device artifacts, controlled knowledge storage and retrieval, method-specific generation of candidate safety items, critique and uncertainty checks, and recorded expert review. The framework prepares, links, checks, and updates candidate safety artifacts for expert decision-making. It does not decide whether a device is safe and does not provide regulatory approval. We also outline an evaluation strategy using non-public or newly built medical-device case studies and expert reference analyses to assess coverage, correctness, relevance, traceability, duplicate rate, unsupported claims, and review effort.

AI.title_translation: 从安全文档到安全知识支持：面向医疗设备的基于证据的大语言模型框架
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于证据的LLM框架，通过提供来源链接、可追溯性检查和专家评审支持，解决医疗器械软件安全工程中合规成本高、缺乏可信度的问题。
AI.motivation: 现代医疗器械越来越依赖软件和AI，其开发需要严格符合ISO 14971和IEC 62304等标准，保持跨生命周期数据的持续一致性成本高昂且依赖稀缺专家；现有LLM安全研究多为孤立方法且缺乏来源链接、可追溯性及专家评审支持，难以满足受监管的医疗器械开发要求。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于证据的框架，连接设备工件、受控的知识存储与检索、特定方法的候选安全项生成、批判与不确定性检查，以及记录在案的专家评审；并设计了基于非公开或新建医疗器械案例研究及专家参考分析的评估策略。
AI.result: 提出并规划了一个证据接地的LLM安全知识支持框架，并制定了涵盖覆盖率、正确性、相关性、可追溯性、重复率、无支撑声明及评审工作量等多维度的评估策略。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了一个面向医疗设备开发的、基于证据的LLM安全知识支持框架，通过连接设备工件、知识检索、候选安全项生成、不确定性检查与专家评审，克服了现有LLM在医疗安全工程中缺乏可追溯性和可信度的局限。
AI.translation:
医疗设备正变得越来越软件化、互联化和具备AI功能。它们的开发需要符合ISO 14971标准的风险管理证据，对于软件而言还需要符合IEC 62304标准。这些证据必须在需求、设计决策、软件变更、验证结果、投诉和上市后数据之间保持一致。这些任务成本高昂，且依赖于稀缺的安全和领域专家。
大语言模型（LLM）可能会减少这部分工作量，因为医疗设备的安全工作在很大程度上是基于文档的。然而，当前基于LLM的安全工程研究往往解决的是孤立的方法，依赖于通用的提示或公共示例，并且在来源链接、可追溯性、不确定性处理、生命周期更新和记录的专家评审方面提供的支持有限。这限制了它们在受监管的医疗设备开发中的应用。
本文认为，核心研究问题不是安全文本的生成，而是基于来源链接的安全知识支持。我们提出了一个基于证据的框架，该框架连接了设备工件、受控的知识存储与检索、特定方法的候选安全项生成、批判与不确定性检查以及记录在案的专家评审。该框架为专家的决策准备、链接、检查和更新候选安全工件。它不决定设备是否安全，也不提供监管批准。我们还概述了一种评估策略，使用非公开或新构建的医疗设备案例研究以及专家参考分析来评估覆盖率、正确性、相关性、可追溯性、重复率、无支撑声明和评审工作量。
AI.summary: 论文探讨了利用大语言模型（LLM）支持医疗器械安全工程的挑战与对策。针对现有LLM应用缺乏可追溯性和来源链接的问题，文章提出了一种基于证据的框架，将设备工件、知识检索、安全项生成、不确定性检查与专家评审相结合，旨在为受监管的医疗设备开发提供可靠的安全知识支持。
AI.keywords: 医疗器械, 大语言模型, 安全工程, 证据接地, 可追溯性
AI.comments: 该论文针对医疗器械软件开发中复杂的安全文档和合规标准（如ISO 14971和IEC 62304），创新性地提出了一种基于证据的大语言模型（LLM）安全知识支持框架。与以往孤立的文本生成方法不同，该框架强调可追溯性、来源链接、不确定性处理以及专家评审，切中医疗器械监管严格和专家资源稀缺的痛点，具有很高的实用价值和工业应用潜力。

title: SoftWater: Class-Aware Rate Allocation for Softmax Quantization
summary: Post-training quantization pipelines routinely leave the softmax output layer in high precision. Yet in small LLMs with modern vocabularies, the head holds 15--30\% of all parameters, so a nominal ``2-bit'' model with an fp16 head can store several times as many bits per weight. We pose softmax-layer quantization as a rate-distortion problem under the KL divergence between the original and quantized output distributions. A second-order analysis reveals a class-aware geometry: quantization error is weighted jointly by feature covariance and class-specific softmax curvature. A separability approximation replaces the $Kn\times Kn$ Cholesky with one $n\times n$ factorization rescaled per class, making the lattice encodable by successive interference cancellation, with both statistics from a single forward pass. The resulting method, SoftWater, gives fine grids to frequent, low-variance classes and coarse grids to rare ones, a large gap under Zipfian token distributions. Across five models from 1B to 32B, SoftWater outperforms the released WaterSIC quantizer (near-optimal under linear-layer WMSE but not output KL) at matched head rates on 59 of 60 test points, using none of that pipeline's refinements and cutting head-induced KL by $6.5\times$--$8.3\times$ at 2 bits. On Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct with quantized bodies, a 2-bit head removes 45--60\% of stored bytes for a $2.9$--$3.7\%$ perplexity increase. Because the class-side statistic comes from calibration data, matching calibration to the deployment domain gives the lowest KL on that domain throughout. On a tied model, a 4-bit head is near-lossless and a 2-bit head costs under 4\% perplexity, making head quantization of such models practical.

AI.title_translation: SoftWater：用于Softmax量化的类感知率分配
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为SoftWater的softmax层量化方法，通过类别感知率分配，在2-bit量化下显著减少大语言模型存储，同时将KL散度降低数倍且仅带来微小的困惑度增加。
AI.motivation: 在小型大语言模型中，modern vocabularies使得softmax输出层（head）占据了模型参数的15%到30%，导致标称的低比特模型实际存储占用依然很高。现有的后训练量化通常让softmax层保持高精度，因此需要一种有效的softmax量化方法来减少存储。
AI.method: 将softmax层量化建模为KL散度下的率失真问题，通过二阶分析揭示类别感知几何，并采用可分性 approximation 简化分解，结合连续干扰消除（SIC）进行格码编码，仅通过单次前向传递获取统计数据。
AI.result: 在5个1B到32B的模型上，SoftWater在相同head速率下，在60个测试点中的59个上优于WaterSIC quantizer，在2-bit时将head引起的KL散度降低了6.5到8.3倍，且2-bit head仅带来2.9%到3.7%的困惑度增加。
AI.conclusion: SoftWater有效地解决了小语言模型中softmax输出层的量化问题，通过类别感知的率分配，在保持极低困惑度增加的同时大幅减少了模型存储，使softmax层量化变得实用可行。
AI.translation: 训练后量化流水线通常以高精度保留 softmax 输出层。然而，在具有现代词汇的小型 LLM 中，头部占据了所有参数的 15--30%，因此标称的“2位”模型加上 fp16 头部可以存储每个权重几倍的位数。我们将 softmax 层量化建模为原始输出分布与量化输出分布之间的 KL 散度下的率失真问题。二阶分析揭示了类别感知的几何形状：量化误差由特征协方差和特定于类别的 softmax 曲率共同加权。可分性近似将 $Kn\times Kn$ Cholesky 分解替换为一个 $n\times n$ 的分解，按类别进行重新缩放，使得该格可以通过连续干扰消除来进行编码，且两项统计数据均来自单次前向传递。由此产生的方法 SoftWater 为频繁、低方差的类别提供了精细的网格，而为稀疏类别提供了粗糙的网格，在 Zipfian 词表分布下形成了巨大的差距。在从 1B 到 32B 的五个模型中，在匹配的头部速率下，SoftWater 在 60 个测试点中的 59 个上优于发布的 WaterSIC 量化器（在线性层 WMSE 下接近最优，但不是输出 KL），且没有使用该流水线的任何改进，在 2 位时将头部引起的 KL 降低了 $6.5\times$--$8.3\times$。在带有量化主体的 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 上，2 位头部移除了 45--60% 的存储字节，困惑度仅增加 $2.9$--$3.7\%$。由于类别端统计数据来自校准数据，将校准与部署域相匹配可在整个过程中提供该域最低的 KL。在一个绑定模型上，4 位头部几乎无损，2 位头部损失低于 4% 的困惑度，使得此类模型的头部量化变得实用。
AI.summary: SoftWater是一种针对大语言模型softmax输出层的类别感知率分配量化方法。它将量化建模为KL散度下的率失真问题，通过二阶分析和可分性近似，实现了对不同类别的高效量化，在大幅减少模型存储的同时有效控制了困惑度的增加。
AI.keywords: Softmax Quantization, Rate-Distortion, Large Language Models, KL Divergence, Successive Interference Cancellation
AI.comments: 该论文针对大语言模型中高精度Softmax输出层带来的存储瓶颈，提出了一种基于率失真理论和KL散度的类别感知量化方法（SoftWater）。其创新点在于通过二阶分析推导出类别感知几何，并利用可分性近似简化计算，使高压缩率下的量化性能显著优于传统方法。这对于边缘设备上部署小型LLM具有重要意义。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Probabilistic Constrained Clustering from Entangled Pairwise Supervision
summary: Pairwise constrained clustering typically relies on hard must-link/cannot-link labels, whereas realistic pairwise supervision may be real-valued and entangle intrinsic ambiguity, expert judgment, and stochastic corruption. Existing deep constrained clustering (DCC) methods mainly target hard, expert-agnostic constraints, treating soft labels mostly numerically rather than semantically. We formalize this setting as uncertainty-aware probabilistic constrained clustering (UPCC), defining a canonical aleatoric target through a heterogeneous observation process and analyzing its conditional identifiability. We introduce ProbPair, an angular pairwise objective for probabilistic relations, and build ECI-PP, an estimator--corrector--integrator framework that refines imperfect supervision via belief estimation, correction, and reliability-aware integration. Across challenging probabilistic supervision settings, experiments on diverse benchmarks show that ECI-PP outperforms state-of-the-art DCC methods and remains robust with a shared default configuration.

AI.title_translation: 来自纠缠成对监督的不确定感知概率约束聚类
AI.tldr: 论文提出了UPCC与ECI-PP框架，有效解决现实中含糊不清且带有噪声的成对约束聚类问题，提升了聚类性能与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的深度约束聚类（DCC）方法主要依赖于硬的必须链接/不能链接标签，无法很好地处理现实中具有内在模糊性、专家主观判断以及随机噪声的实数值成对监督信号。
AI.method: 提出了概率约束聚类框架（UPCC），引入了针对概率关系的角成对目标（ProbPair），并构建了一个通过信念估计、校正和可靠性感知集成来精炼不完美监督的估计器-校正器-集成器框架（ECI-PP）。
AI.result: 在各种具有挑战性的概率监督设置下，多样化基准测试的实验表明，ECI-PP超越了当前最先进的DCC方法，并且在使用共享的默认配置时依然保持强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ECI-PP框架成功解决了现实世界中含有不确定性和噪声的成对约束聚类问题，在多个基准测试中展现出优于现有最先进DCC方法的性能和强大的鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 成对约束聚类通常依赖于硬性的必须链接/不能链接标签，而现实中的成对监督可能是实数值的，并且纠缠了内在的模糊性、专家判断和随机噪声。现有的深度约束聚类（DCC）方法主要针对硬性的、不考虑专家差异的约束，主要从数值上而不是语义上处理软标签。我们将此设置形式化为不确定性感知的概率约束聚类（UPCC），通过异构观测过程定义了规范的偶然不确定性目标，并分析了其条件可辨识性。我们引入了ProbPair（一种针对概率关系的角成对目标），并构建了ECI-PP（一个通过信念估计、校正和可靠性感知集成来精炼不完美监督的估计器-校正器-集成器框架）。在具有挑战性的概率监督设置下，对各种基准测试的实验表明，ECI-PP优于最先进的DCC方法，并且在使用共享的默认配置时保持鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了不确定性感知的概率约束聚类问题，针对现实世界中复杂的成对监督信息（包含模糊性和噪声），提出了UPCC形式化定义、ProbPair目标函数以及ECI-PP估计-校正-集成框架，实验证明其显著优于现有最先进的DCC方法。
AI.keywords: 约束聚类, 不确定性感知的概率约束聚类, 成对监督, 深度聚类, 鲁棒学习
AI.comments: 该论文针对现实中成对监督信息往往带有模糊性、专家主观判断或随机噪声的问题，提出了一个新颖的不确定性感知的概率约束聚类框架。通过对异构观测过程建模及提出置信度估计、校正与积分的机制，有效提升了聚类算法在复杂监督信号下的鲁棒性与性能。

title: LoSA: Near-Lossless Sparse Attention for Training-Free Video Diffusion Acceleration
summary: Video diffusion transformers are costly to sample: every denoising step applies self-attention over a long 3D token sequence, a quadratic cost that dominates as resolution and duration grow. Sparse attention reduces this cost without retraining, but existing methods pursue aggressive sparsity, where further speedup costs disproportionately more attention fidelity. We target the opposite end of this trade-off: fix near-lossless fidelity by construction, and remove as much computation as this constraint permits. Two observations make this regime practical: roughly 40% of block interactions can be removed while retaining 99% of the attention mass, and the high-mass support remains stable across denoising steps. We propose LoSA, a training-free sparse-attention method that fixes a retained-mass threshold of 99% rather than a sparsity ratio: it measures exact block attention masses at one early dense step, keeps, for each head and query block, the smallest key/value block set meeting the threshold, and reuses the frozen block indices for all remaining steps. On Wan2.1-1.3B, LoSA alone gives a $1.36\times$ speedup with a 0.06-point VBench Overall drop. The benefit is largest under composition: combined with feature caching, LoSA reaches a $3.2\times$ speedup on HunyuanVideo at a 0.02-point drop, versus 0.32 points for the strongest sparse baseline at comparable speed. Across three video diffusion transformers and speedups up to $3.2\times$, LoSA consistently achieves the best training-free speed-quality trade-off.

AI.title_translation: LoSA：用于免训练视频扩散加速的近无损稀疏注意力
AI.tldr: LoSA通过设定近乎无损的注意力质量阈值并复用稀疏索引，实现了无训练的视频扩散模型高效加速。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer中自注意力机制计算成本高昂，而现有稀疏注意力方法追求激进稀疏度导致注意力保真度下降严重，因此需要一种在近乎无损保真度前提下最大化移除计算量的方法。
AI.method: 提出LoSA方法，固定99%的保留注意力质量阈值而非稀疏比例；在早期稠密步中测量精确的块注意力质量，为每个头和查询块保留满足阈值的最小键/值块集合，并在后续所有去噪步骤中重用这些冻结的块索引。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1-1.3B上仅使用LoSA即可实现1.36倍加速且VBench总体评分仅下降0.06分；与特征缓存结合时，在HunyuanVideo上实现了3.2倍加速，VBench评分仅下降0.02分。
AI.conclusion: LoSA是一种高效且通用的无训练视频扩散加速方法，通过固定保留质量阈值并在整个去噪步骤中重用索引，实现了卓越的速度与画质权衡。
AI.translation: 视频扩散Transformer的采样成本高昂：每个去噪步骤都要在漫长的3D标记序列上应用自注意力，随着分辨率和时长的增长，这种二次方成本占据了主导地位。稀疏注意力在无需重新训练的情况下降低了这一成本，但现有方法追求激进的稀疏度，进一步的加速会导致注意力保真度 disproportionately 严重下降。我们针对这种权衡的另一端：通过构建来固定近乎无损的保真度，并在该约束允许的范围内尽可能多地移除计算。两个观察结果使得这种方案切实可行：大约40%的块交互可以在保留99%注意力质量的同时被移除，并且高权重支持在整个去噪步骤中保持稳定。我们提出了LoSA，这是一种无需训练的稀疏注意力方法，它固定了99%的保留质量阈值而不是稀疏度比例：它在早期的一个稠密步中测量精确的块注意力质量，为每个头和查询块保留满足该阈值的最小键/值块集合，并在所有剩余步骤中重用这些冻结的块索引。在Wan2.1-1.3B上，仅LoSA就能带来1.36倍的加速，VBench整体得分下降0.06点。这种优势在组合使用时最大：与特征缓存相结合，LoSA在HunyuanVideo上实现了3.2倍的加速，得分仅下降0.02点，而在同等速度下最强的稀疏基线得分下降了0.32点。在三个视频扩散Transformer和高达3.2倍的加速下，LoSA始终实现了最佳的无训练速度-质量权衡。
AI.summary: LoSA是一种无训练的视频扩散稀疏注意力加速方法，通过固定99%的注意力质量保留阈值并跨去噪步复用块索引，在保持极高画质（近乎无损）的同时实现了显著的推理加速。
AI.keywords: Video Diffusion Transformers, Sparse Attention, Training-Free Acceleration, Near-Lossless Fidelity
AI.comments: LoSA通过反向思维，从“保持近乎无损的注意力保真度”出发去寻找最大计算缩减，而不是一味追求激进的稀疏度。这种方法在保证画质几乎不掉的前提下实现了显著加速，且无需重新训练，非常实用。

title: How Far from Clinical Deployment? Evaluating the Complete Unsupervised Domain Adaptation Pipeline in Medical Imaging
summary: Deploying unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) in clinical practice requires choosing which algorithm to use and which of its trained models to ship. However, the deployment (target) domain is unlabeled, so models cannot be evaluated directly on it, leaving it unclear which to select. We address this by evaluating the complete UDA pipeline, considering both adaptation and label-free selection together. Our study covers eleven clinically relevant cross-domain scenarios from nine medical imaging datasets, with ten UDA algorithms and 13 label-free selection methods (validators), evaluating over 80,000 trained models in total. By this, we find that a capable adapted model usually exists, but identifying it without target labels is difficult: the validator-selected models leave a large and structural target performance gap to the best available one, with no evaluated validator consistently reliable. Towards closing it, we explore two strategies, ensembling and a small target-labeling budget; both narrow this gap but do not close it entirely. Overall, deployable UDA depends on the complete pipeline; addressing the less explored selection step could bring much of current UDA closer to clinical use.

AI.title_translation: 距离临床部署还有多远？评估医学影像中完全无监督的域自适应流程
AI.tldr: 通过评估医学影像中超过8万个UDA模型的完整流程，发现无标签条件下的模型选择是阻碍其临床部署的主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 在临床实践中部署无监督域自适应（UDA）需要选择算法及训练好的模型，但由于目标域无标签，无法直接评估，导致最佳模型的选择成为难题。该研究旨在评估包含自适应和无标签选择在内的完整UDA流程，以明确其距离临床部署的差距。
AI.method: 评估了包含11个临床相关跨域场景、9个医学影像数据集、10种UDA算法以及13种无标签选择方法（验证器）的完整流程，总共评估了超过80,000个训练好的模型，并探索了集成和少量目标标签预算两种策略。
AI.result: 研究发现虽然通常存在能力优秀的自适应模型，但在没有目标标签的情况下很难识别它们；验证器选择的模型与最佳模型之间存在较大且结构化的性能差距，没有一个验证器能持续保持可靠。集成和少量目标标签预算策略能够缩小这一差距，但无法完全弥合。
AI.conclusion: 可部署的UDA取决于完整的流水线；解决较少被探索的模型选择步骤，才能使当前的UDA更接近临床应用。
AI.translation: 在临床实践中部署无监督域自适应（UDA）需要选择使用哪个算法以及发布其哪个训练好的模型。然而，部署（目标）域是无标签的，因此无法直接对其进行模型评估，导致不清楚该选择哪一个。我们通过评估包含自适应和无标签选择在内的完整UDA流程来解决这个问题。我们的研究涵盖了来自9个医学影像数据集的11个临床相关的跨域场景，共使用了10种UDA算法和13种无标签选择方法（验证器），总共评估了超过80,000个训练好的模型。通过这项研究，我们发现通常存在一个能力优秀的自适应模型，但在没有目标标签的情况下很难识别它：验证器选择的模型与最佳可用模型之间存在着巨大且结构化的目标性能差距，并且没有一个被评估的验证器是持续可靠的。为了缩小这一差距，我们探索了两种策略：集成和少量的目标标签预算；两者都缩小了这一差距，但并未完全弥合。总体而言，可部署的UDA取决于完整的流水线；解决较少被探索的选择步骤可以使当前的UDA更接近临床使用。
AI.summary: 该论文全面评估了医学影像中无监督域自适应（UDA）的完整流程，发现尽管存在优质模型，但无标签状态下的模型选择仍然极其困难，现有的验证方法均不可靠，需重点攻克模型选择这一环节以推进临床应用。
AI.keywords: 医学影像, 无监督域自适应, 模型选择, 临床部署, 域泛化
AI.comments: 该论文对医学影像中无监督域自适应（UDA）的完整流程进行了大规模评估，揭示了当前无监督模型选择的局限性并探讨了潜在解决方案，对推动UDA技术的临床落地具有重要意义。

title: Mechanist: AI as a Scientific Instrument for Discovering the Mechanisms of Intelligence
summary: AI models have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet the mechanisms underlying their capabilities and the risks they may pose remain poorly understood. As AI development becomes faster and increasingly automated, mechanistic exploration remains largely manual, widening the gap between what models can do and our ability to understand and control them. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mechanist, an agentic system that uses AI as a scientific instrument for the autonomous discovery of mechanisms underlying AI intelligence. To support autonomous mechanistic discovery, we construct an interpretability-focused knowledge graph of approximately 13,000 papers and integrate it with a multidisciplinary database of 43 million papers spanning 26 fields. We further curate a library of 32 foundational methods for mechanism analysis, causal intervention, and validation. Compared with Claude Code and existing AI-scientist systems, Mechanist generates more valuable mechanism hypotheses and executes experiments more reliably. Mechanist also demonstrates a progression from discovering model behaviors to explaining and controlling AI models. Specifically, Mechanist first uncovers a counterintuitive safety risk in scientific laboratories, showing that unsafe traits can transfer across modalities through apparently safe training data. Mechanist then develops a mechanism theory of belief, revealing how models represent world knowledge, form beliefs, infer the beliefs of others, and how these mechanisms emerge during pretraining. Finally, Mechanist translates these mechanistic insights into practical interventions that improve model performance across diverse scenarios and steer scientific foundation models toward generating DNA sequences with specified properties.

AI.title_translation: Mechanist：作为发现智能机制的科学仪器的AI
AI.tldr: Mechanist是一个旨在自主发现、解释和控制AI模型内部机制的智能体系统。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI模型取得了巨大成功，但其底层机制和风险仍知之甚少；当前的机制探索主要依赖人工，远远落后于AI模型的发展速度，导致模型能力与人类理解和控制能力之间的差距不断扩大。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含约13000篇论文的可解释性专注知识图谱，并与包含4300万篇跨学科论文的数据库集成；同时整合了一个包含32种基础方法的库，用于机制分析、因果干预和验证。
AI.result: Mechanist生成的机制假设比现有系统更有价值，实验执行更可靠；它发现了跨模态传递不安全特性的风险，揭示了模型信念的机制理论，并成功开发了改进模型性能和引导科学基础模型生成特定DNA序列的实用干预措施。
AI.conclusion: Mechanist成功展示了利用AI作为科学仪器来自动发现、解释和控制AI模型机制的可行性和强大能力，有助于弥合模型能力与人类理解之间的差距。
AI.translation: AI模型在各个领域取得了显著成功，然而其能力背后的机制以及可能带来的风险仍然知之甚少。随着AI开发变得更快且日益自动化，机制探索在很大程度上仍然是人工的，这拉大了模型能做的事情与我们理解和控制它们的能力之间的差距。为了弥合这一差距，我们推出了Mechanist，这是一个将AI用作科学仪器以自主发现AI智能底层机制的智能体系统。为了支持自主机制发现，我们构建了一个包含约13,000篇论文的聚焦于可解释性的知识图谱，并将其与一个跨越26个领域的4300万篇论文的多学科数据库进行了整合。我们还策划了一个包含32种用于机制分析、因果干预和验证的基础方法的库。与Claude Code和现有的AI科学家系统相比，Mechanist生成了更有价值的机制假设，并更可靠地执行实验。Mechanist还展示了从发现模型行为到解释和控制AI模型的进展。具体而言，Mechanist首先揭示了科学实验室中的一个反直觉的安全风险，表明不安全特性可以通过表面上安全的训练数据在模态之间转移。然后，Mechanist开发了一种信念的机制理论，揭示了模型如何表示世界知识、形成信念、推断他人的信念，以及这些机制如何在预训练期间出现。最后，Mechanist将这些机制见解转化为实用的干预措施，以提高模型在各种场景下的性能，并引导科学基础模型生成具有指定特性的DNA序列。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Mechanist，这是一个旨在自主发现AI智能底层机制的智能体系统。它通过集成庞大的文献知识图谱与分析方法库，实现了从发现模型行为到解释和控制AI模型的全过程，有效提升了人类理解和控制AI的能力。
AI.keywords: 可解释AI, 机制发现, 智能体系统, 知识图谱, 科学仪器
AI.comments: Mechanist通过结合大规模知识图谱和智能体系统，实现了对AI模型内部机制的自动化探索与干预，代表了可解释性研究领域向自动化迈出的重要一步。

title: Clustered Randomized Smoothing for Stochastic Prediction Functions
summary: Modern stochastic predictors can model rich, multi-modal outcome distributions. However, this expressive power comes with challenges in ensuring robust predictions $-$ a critical requirement in safety-critical domains. Randomized smoothing is a leading technique for improving robustness, particularly against adversarial perturbations. Yet, in stochastic multi-modal regression settings, randomized smoothing often fails due to mode collapse, yielding averaged predictions that do not reflect the underlying distribution. To address this limitation, we propose clustered $α$-smoothing, a framework that (1) partitions noisy samples using an arbitrary clustering algorithm, (2) applies $α$-smoothing locally within each cluster, and (3) combines the resulting predictions into a mixture distribution. By interpreting the smoothing distribution as a mixture of $α$-smoothers, we derive a lower bound on the probability that the smoothed prediction lies within a union of compact regions corresponding to distinct modes. We empirically evaluate our framework on two benchmarks, demonstrating substantial improvements over state-of-the-art methods. In stochastic trajectory prediction on a driving simulator dataset, our approach achieves, on average, a $27\%$ lower Wasserstein distance to the ground-truth distribution compared to $α$-smoothing. In quadrotor control, where modes correspond to distinct feasible paths to a target, our method reduces the collision rate by $81\%$ relative to the state-of-the-art randomized smoothing.

AI.title_translation: 随机预测函数的聚类随机平滑法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于随机预测函数的“聚类α-平滑”框架，解决了多模态回归中的模态坍塌问题，在自动驾驶和无人机控制中大幅降低了误差与碰撞率。
AI.motivation: 现代随机预测器能够建模丰富的多模态结果分布，但这带来了鲁棒性挑战。传统的随机平滑技术在处理随机多模态回归时容易发生“模态坍塌”，产生无法反映真实底层分布的平均化预测结果。因此，需要开发一种新的平滑框架来解决多模态下的鲁棒性保障问题。
AI.method: 提出聚类α-平滑框架：(1) 使用任意聚类算法对加噪样本进行分区；(2) 在每个簇内局部应用α-平滑；(3) 将预测结果组合成混合分布，并通过理论推导给出平滑预测落入不同模态区域概率的下限。
AI.result: 在驾驶模拟器数据集的随机轨迹预测中，该方法相比α-smoothing将Wasserstein距离平均降低了27%；在四旋翼无人机控制中，相比最先进的随机平滑方法，将碰撞率降低了81%。
AI.conclusion: 本论文提出的聚类α-平滑框架有效克服了传统随机平滑在多模态回归中的模态坍塌问题，为安全关键领域的随机预测提供了鲁棒性强且分布保真度高的解决方案。
AI.translation: 现代随机预测器可以建模丰富、多模态的结果分布。然而，这种表达能力在确保鲁棒预测方面带来了挑战——这是安全关键领域的一项关键要求。随机平滑是提高鲁棒性（尤其是对抗对抗性扰动）的领先技术。然而，在随机多模态回归设置中，由于模态坍塌，随机 smoothing 经常失效，产生的平均化预测无法反映底层分布。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了聚类 α-平滑，该框架包括：(1) 使用任意聚类算法对噪声样本进行分区，(2) 在每个簇内局部应用 α-平滑，以及 (3) 将所得预测组合成混合分布。通过将平滑分布解释为 α-平滑器的混合，我们推导出了平滑预测位于对应于不同模态的紧凑区域并集内的概率的下限。我们在两个基准测试中对我们的框架进行了经验评估，证明了其相比先进方法的实质性改进。在驾驶模拟器数据集的随机轨迹预测中，我们的方法与 α-平滑相比，平均将到真实分布的 Wasserstein 距离降低了 27%。在四旋翼控制中（其中的模态对应于到达目标的独特可行路径），与最先进的随机 smoothing 相比，我们的方法将碰撞率降低了 81%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“聚类α-平滑”的新型框架，旨在解决随机预测函数在多模态回归中由于随机平滑导致的模态坍塌问题。该框架通过对加噪样本进行聚类、局部应用α-平滑并组合成混合分布，在理论上保证了鲁棒性，并在自动驾驶和无人机控制等基准测试中显著超越了现有最先进的方法。
AI.keywords: 随机平滑, 鲁棒性, 多模态回归, 聚类α-平滑, 安全关键领域
AI.comments: 该论文针对现代随机预测函数在多模态分布下容易发生模态坍塌（mode collapse）的痛点，提出了聚类α-平滑（clustered α-smoothing）框架。创新点在于将聚类算法与随机平滑相结合，能够有效保持多模态预测的丰富性和鲁棒性，在自动驾驶轨迹预测和无人机避障控制等安全关键领域展现出显著优势。

title: Search and Rescue on the Plane
summary: We study a planar variant of the search and rescue problem whereby an agent starting at an arbitrary position $P_{θ,r} = (r\cosθ, r\sinθ)$ in the plane must locate an object at an unknown position on the positive $x$-axis and deliver it to the origin. Our main contribution is to characterize the optimal form of any competitive algorithm, derive closed-form expressions for the competitive ratio, and identify a critical angle $θ^* \approx 15.6^\circ$ which yields a phase transition to optimal competitive search and delivery in the following sense. For each angle $-π\leq θ\leq π$ we compute a checkpoint (landing position on the $x$-axis) where the agent must go first prior to initiating a search on the $x$-axis in order to optimize the competitive ratio of search and delivery. We show that if $|θ| \geq θ^*$ then the checkpoint is at the origin, while if $|θ| < θ^*$ then the agent should land at the checkpoint $(r \cdot k_{|θ|}, 0)$ on the $x$-axis, where $k_{|θ|}$ is a real number given by an explicit formula we present.

AI.title_translation: 平面上的搜救问题
AI.tldr: 本文研究了平面上的搜救问题，找出了最优竞争算法，并发现了由起始角度决定的搜索策略相变现象。
AI.motivation: 为了解决平面上的搜救问题（即从平面上任意位置出发寻找x轴上的未知目标并将其运回原点），并刻画最优竞争算法及探索其中的相变现象。
AI.method: 研究了平面搜救问题的变体，通过数学推导刻画了竞争算法的最优形式，推导了竞争比的闭式表达式，并计算了不同起始角度下的最优检查点（在x轴上的降落位置）。
AI.result: 研究发现了一个约 $15.6^\circ$ 的临界角，当起始角度绝对值大于等于该临界角时，最优检查点在原点；当小于该临界角时，代理应该前往x轴上的特定检查点，并给出了明确的公式。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功刻画了平面搜救问题中竞争算法的最优形式，推导出了竞争比的闭式表达式，并确定了导致最优竞争搜索与运送发生相变的临界角。
AI.translation: 我们研究了搜救问题的一个平面变体，其中从平面上任意位置 $P_{\theta,r} = (r\cos\theta, r\sin\theta)$ 出发的代理必须定位正 $x$ 轴上未知位置的一个物体并将其交付到原点。我们的主要贡献是刻画了任何竞争算法的最优形式，推导出了竞争比的闭式表达式，并识别出一个临界角 $\theta^* \approx 15.6^\circ$，它在以下意义上产生了通往最优竞争搜索与交付的相变。对于每个角度 $-\pi \leq \theta \leq \pi$，我们计算了一个检查点（在 $x$ 轴上的着陆位置），代理在开始在 $x$ 轴上搜索之前必须首先前往该检查点，以优化搜索和交付的竞争比。我们表明，如果 $|\theta| \ge \theta^*$，则检查点位于原点；而如果 $|\theta| < \theta^*$，则代理应降落在 $x$ 轴上的检查点 $(r \cdot k_{|\theta|}, 0)$ 处，其中 $k_{|\theta|}$ 是由我们给出的显式公式确定的实数。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了平面上的搜救问题，代理需从平面任意点出发找到x轴上的未知目标并送回原点。主要贡献在于确定了最优竞争算法的形式、竞争比的闭式解，并发现了一个约 $15.6^\circ$ 的临界角，该角度标志着最优搜索与运送策略的相变。
AI.keywords: 搜救问题, 平面几何, 竞争算法, 相变, 竞争比
AI.comments: 该论文研究了平面上的搜救问题，通过理论推导得出了竞争算法的最优形式和竞争比的闭式解，并发现了关于角度的相变现象（临界角），在理论分析上具有一定的深度和创新性。

title: Localizing to Debias: A Patch-Level Benchmark and Baseline for Weakly Supervised Spatial Anomaly Detection
summary: Despite growing interest in weakly supervised video anomaly detection (WSVAD), current methods struggle to bridge the gap between coarse temporal supervision and fine-grained spatial reasoning. A key obstacle is the tendency of temporal detectors to latch onto background and scene-level cues rather than truly discriminative anomaly evidence. This background bias raises ethical concerns: models may inadvertently associate anomalies with societal or environmental context rather than authentic crime-related cues. Without spatial grounding, such biases remain hidden and unauditable. To address this, we propose SST-WSVADL, a sparse spatio-temporal framework that bridges temporal anomaly detection with fine-grained spatial localization. Rather than processing all spatial regions indiscriminately, SST-WSVADL progressively focuses on the most anomaly-relevant spatio-temporal regions through dynamic sparsification, naturally suppressing background dominant content while preserving discriminative evidence. The temporal and spatial branches are coupled end-to-end via motion-aware regularization that guides sparsification toward dynamically informative regions, without relying on external detectors or vision-language prompts. We publicly release frame-level spatial annotations and a method-agnostic evaluation protocol for three public datasets: UCF-Crime, XD-Violence, and MSAD. These resources enable the community to audit spatial biases in WSVAD predictions, supporting progress toward more ethical and accountable anomaly detection. Experiments demonstrate that SST-WSVADL is competitive with prior methods across benchmarks while enabling localization and patch-level auditability of scene bias, providing a reproducible foundation for interpretability-oriented evaluation of WSVAD models.

AI.title_translation: 定位以消除偏差：弱监督空间异常检测的补丁级基准与基线
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SST-WSVADL的稀疏时空框架，通过动态稀疏化和运动感知正则化解决弱监督视频异常检测中的背景偏差问题，并提供了补丁级的空间注释和评估协议。
AI.motivation: 当前的弱监督视频异常检测（WSVAD）方法难以弥合粗粒度时间监督与细粒度空间推理之间的差距，且时间检测器易受背景和场景级线索的干扰而产生背景偏差和伦理问题，因此需要进行空间扎根以消除偏差并提高可审计性。
AI.method: 提出SST-WSVADL稀疏时空框架，通过动态稀疏化聚焦于最相关的时空区域，并利用运动感知正则化端到端耦合时间与空间分支，无需依赖外部检测器或视觉-语言提示。
AI.result: 实验表明，SST-WSVADL在多个基准测试中表现出与先前方法相竞争的性能，同时能够实现空间定位和场景偏差的补丁级可审计性。
AI.conclusion: SST-WSVADL框架有效桥接了弱监督视频异常检测中的粗粒度时间监督与细粒度空间推理，在保持竞争力的同时实现了补丁级的场景偏差审计，为弱监督视频异常检测的可解释性评估奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 尽管人们对弱监督视频异常检测（WSVAD）的兴趣日益增长，但当前的方法仍在弥合粗粒度时间监督与细粒度空间推理之间的差距方面存在困难。一个关键障碍是时间检测器倾向于捕捉背景和场景级线索，而不是真正具有辨别力的异常证据。这种背景偏见引发了伦理担忧：模型可能会无意中将异常与社会或环境背景联系起来，而不是与真实的犯罪相关线索联系起来。如果没有空间扎根，这些偏见将仍然隐藏且无法审计。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SST-WSVADL，一个将时间异常检测与细粒度空间定位桥接起来的稀疏时空框架。SST-WSVADL不是无差别地处理所有空间区域，而是通过动态稀疏化逐步聚焦于最具异常相关的时空区域，自然地抑制背景主导的内容，同时保留有辨别力的证据。时间分支和空间分支通过运动感知正则化进行端到端耦合，该正则化引导稀疏化朝向动态信息丰富的区域，而不依赖于外部检测器或视觉-语言提示。我们公开了三个公共数据集（UCF-Crime、XD-Violence和MSAD）的帧级空间注释和与方法无关的评估协议。这些资源使社区能够审计WSVAD预测中的空间偏差，支持朝着更具伦理性和可问责性的异常检测迈进。实验表明，SST-WSVADL在各项基准测试中与先前的方法具有竞争力，同时支持场景偏差的定位和补丁级可审计性，为基于可解释性的WSVAD模型评估提供了可重现的基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SST-WSVADL框架用于弱监督视频异常检测，通过动态稀疏化和运动感知正则化实现了从粗粒度时间监督到细粒度空间定位的跨越，抑制了背景偏见并提供了补丁级的可审计基准。
AI.keywords: 弱监督视频异常检测, 空间异常检测, 动态稀疏化, 背景偏差消除, 可解释性基准
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了弱监督视频异常检测中的细粒度空间定位基准与基线，通过动态稀疏化与运动感知正则化，解决了时间检测器容易关注背景和场景线索的偏见问题，提升了模型的可解释性与公平性。

title: Secure Coverage Enhancement in Aerial Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface-Assisted High-Speed Train Communication Systems
comments: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Vehicular Technology
summary: High-speed trains (HSTs) have become a prominent means of transportation, requiring high data rates and reliable communication services for HST passengers. However, the wireless channels in HST communication systems are susceptible to various security threats, including eavesdropping. Addressing these security concerns is therefore of critical importance. One promising technology for enhancing security is the integration of a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) on an unmanned aerial vehicle, referred to as an aerial reconfigurable intelligent surface (ARIS). This technology offers significant potential for improving wireless network performance, though it also introduces unique challenges in terms of physical layer security (PLS). This paper investigates the PLS of ARIS-aided HST communication systems. A problem of maximizing the weighted sum secrecy rate is formulated by jointly optimizing the active beamforming at the base station (BS) and the phase shift at the ARIS, subject to constrains on the BS transmit power and the unit modulus of the ARIS reflecting coefficient. To address this problem, a joint optimization algorithm is proposed using the block coordinate descent method. Specifically, the problem is decomposed into two subproblems: active beamforming design and ARIS phase shift optimization. The active beamforming is optimally designed via the successive convex approximation technique, while the ARIS phase shift is efficiently updated using the alternating direction method of multipliers technique. Simulation results demonstrate the rapid convergence of the proposed algorithm, which achieves a higher secrecy rate compared to existing methods in the literature.
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Vehicular Technology

AI.title_translation: 无人机可重构智能表面辅助的高铁通信系统中的安全覆盖增强
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于ARIS的高铁通信系统物理层安全增强方案，通过联合优化算法实现了更高的保密速率。
AI.motivation: 高速铁路通信系统中的无线信道容易受到窃听等安全威胁，传统的安全机制难以满足高铁乘客对高数据速率和高安全性的需求，因此需要利用无人机搭载的可重构智能表面（ARIS）来增强物理层安全（PLS）和覆盖范围。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于块坐标下降（BCD）方法的联合优化算法，将问题分解为两个子问题：利用逐次凸逼近（SCA）技术优化基站的主动波束形成，以及利用交替方向乘子法（ADMM）更新ARIS的相移。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的算法具有快速的收敛性，并且与文献中现有方法相比，能够实现更高的保密速率。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功提出了一种针对ARIS辅助的高铁通信系统的安全覆盖增强方案，通过联合优化基站主动波束形成和ARIS相移，显著提升了系统的保密速率，并通过仿真验证了算法的有效性与收敛性。
AI.translation: 高速铁路（HST）已成为一种重要的交通工具，需要为HST乘客提供高数据速率和可靠的通信服务。然而，HST通信系统中的无线信道容易受到各种安全威胁，包括窃听。因此，解决这些安全问题至关重要。增强安全性的一个有前景的技术是将可重构智能表面（RIS）集成到无人机上，称为空中可重构智能表面（ARIS）。该技术为提高无线网络性能提供了巨大潜力，但也带来了物理层安全（PLS）方面的独特挑战。本文研究了ARIS辅助的HST通信系统的PLS。通过联合优化基站（BS）的主动波束形成和ARIS的相移，构建了一个最大化加权求和保密速率的问题，同时满足BS发射功率和ARIS反射系数单位模的约束。为了解决该问题，提出了一种基于块坐标下降法的联合优化算法。具体而言，该问题被分解为两个子问题：主动波束形成设计和ARIS相移优化。主动波束形成通过逐次凸逼近技术进行最优设计，而ARIS相移则利用交替方向乘子法技术进行高效更新。仿真结果证明了所提算法的快速收敛性，与文献中的现有方法相比，该算法实现了更高的保密速率。
AI.summary: 本文研究了无人机搭载可重构智能表面（ARIS）辅助的高铁通信系统中的物理层安全问题，通过联合优化基站主动波束形成和ARIS相移来最大化加权求和保密速率，并提出了一种高效的分解优化算法。
AI.keywords: 高速铁路, 无人机可重构智能表面, 物理层安全, 联合优化, 块坐标下降法
AI.comments: 该论文针对高速铁路通信系统中的物理层安全问题，创新性地引入了无人机搭载的可重构智能表面（ARIS）技术，并提出了基于块坐标下降法的联合优化算法。算法结合了逐次凸逼近和交替方向乘子法，具有收敛速度快、保密速率高的优势。

title: Network Topology Reconfiguration: Optimal Transition Planning
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Network topology reconfiguration (NTR) can reduce power system operating costs by co-optimizing generation dispatch and substation switching, but the reported savings describe a target operating point rather than a way to reach it. Reaching this operating point requires a sequence of intermediate operating points, each satisfying the AC power flow equations and thermal limits; because each topology admits its own feasible dispatch region, a naive transition that switches or redispatches first can drive intermediate flows past their thermal limits. Existing methods leave this gap open: snapshot NTR identifies a target but not a route. We formulate the Optimal Transition Planning (OTP) problem, co-optimizing the switching sequence and dispatch trajectory subject to AC feasibility at every intermediate point. We solve this problem with a receding-horizon framework: a DC planner proposes a trajectory that is certified against an AC feasibility filter, and infeasible topologies are excluded using reusable combinatorial cuts. Case studies on congested PGLib-OPF systems up to 1354-bus show that the method produces AC-feasible transitions that reduce operating cost by up to 18.4% compared to the no-switching ACOPF solution on commodity hardware.

AI.title_translation: 网络拓扑重构：最优过渡规划
AI.tldr: 该论文针对电力系统网络拓扑重构，提出了确保中间状态交流可行性的最优过渡规划（OTP）方法，实现了安全经济的轨迹过渡。
AI.motivation: 现有的网络拓扑重构（NTR）方法通常只关注目标运行点的成本节约，而忽略了从初始状态到达目标状态的中间过渡阶段，盲目切换或重新调度极易导致中间功率流超过热限制。
AI.method: 提出最优过渡规划（OTP）问题，并采用滚动时域框架求解：由直流规划器提出轨迹，通过交流可行性滤波器进行认证，利用可重用的组合割平面排除不可行拓扑。
AI.result: 在高达1354节点的拥堵PGLib-OPF系统上的案例研究表明，该方法能够产生交流可行的过渡方案，与无切换的ACOPF解相比，可将运行成本降低高达18.4%。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出的最优过渡规划（OTP）方法能够安全、经济地实现电网拓扑重构的中间过渡，在确保交流可行性的同时显著降低了电力系统运行成本。
AI.translation: 网络拓扑重构（NTR）可以通过协同优化发电机调度和变电站投切来降低电力系统运行成本，但已报道的节省量描述的是一个目标运行点，而不是到达该点的方法。到达此运行点需要一系列中间运行点，每个运行点都需满足交流潮流方程和热限制；由于每个拓扑都有其自身的可行调度区域，盲目的切换或先重新调度可能会导致中间潮流超过其热限制。现有方法留下了这一空白：快照NTR确定了目标但没有确定路线。我们提出了最优过渡规划（OTP）问题，在每个中间点满足交流可行性的前提下，协同优化切换序列和调度轨迹。我们使用滚动时域框架解决此问题：直流规划器提出一条轨迹，通过交流可行性滤波器进行认证，并使用可重用的组合割平面排除不可行的拓扑。对高达1354节点的拥堵PGLib-OPF系统的案例研究表明，该方法在普通硬件上产生了交流可行的过渡方案，与无切换的ACOPF解相比，运行成本降低高达18.4%。
AI.summary: 论文研究了电力系统网络拓扑重构（NTR）中的过渡规划问题，提出了通过联合优化切换序列和调度轨迹来实现安全过渡的最优过渡规划（OTP）方法，并在滚动时域框架下利用直流规划、交流滤波和组合割平面技术实现了高效求解，验证了其在降低运行成本和保证交流可行性方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 网络拓扑重构, 最优过渡规划, 交流潮流, 滚动时域框架, 组合割平面
AI.comments: 本文针对电力系统网络拓扑重构中长期被忽视的过渡路径规划问题，提出了最优过渡规划（OTP）模型，并通过结合直流规划器、交流可行性滤波器与组合割平面的滚动时域框架成功解决了该问题，具有很高的实用价值和理论创新性。

title: Token-Level Credit Assignment Optimization for Generative Document Retrieval
summary:
Generative retrieval models perform document retrieval by autoregressively generating document identifiers (DocIDs). This process naturally forms a sequential decision problem, where each decoding step selects a DocID token and the complete token sequence determines the retrieved document. However, retrieval effectiveness is typically evaluated only after the full DocID is generated, creating a mismatch between token-level generation and document-level relevance supervision. As a result, existing reinforcement learning methods for generative retrieval mostly rely on sequence-level rewards, where the same document-level feedback is propagated to all decoding steps. Such coarse-grained feedback makes it difficult to identify which token decisions are responsible for successful or failed retrieval.
  In this work, we propose a fine-grained reinforcement learning framework for generative retrieval with token-level relevance rewards. Instead of assigning a single reward to the entire generated DocID, we estimate step-wise rewards by measuring how each token decision changes the expected retrieval quality of the corresponding generation trajectory. This enables more precise credit assignment and encourages the policy to favor token decisions that contribute more directly to document-level relevance. We further develop practical reward estimation strategies tailored to the DocID generation process and incorporate them into a policy optimization framework. Experiments on retrieval benchmarks show that our method consistently outperforms sequence-level reward baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of fine-grained supervision for aligning autoregressive DocID generation with retrieval objectives.

AI.title_translation: 生成式文档检索的Token级信用分配优化
AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对生成式文档检索的Token级信用分配强化学习方法，通过细粒度奖励优化显著提升了检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成式检索模型通常在生成完整的DocID后才评估检索效果，导致序列级奖励无法精准识别是哪个Token决策导致了检索的成功或失败，存在标记级生成与文档级相关性监督之间的不匹配问题。
AI.method: 提出一个细粒度的强化学习框架，通过测量每个Token决策如何改变对应生成轨迹的预期检索质量来估计逐步奖励，实现更精确的信用分配并优化策略。
AI.result: 在检索基准上的实验表明，该方法一致地优于序列级奖励基线，证明了细粒度监督在对齐自回归DocID生成与检索目标方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的Token级信用分配优化框架有效缓解了生成式文档检索中的奖励粒度粗糙问题，实验证明其在多个检索基准上均优于现有的序列级奖励基线。
AI.translation:
生成式检索模型通过自回归生成文档标识符（DocID）来执行文档检索。这个过程自然地形成了一个序列决策过程，其中每个解码步骤选择一个DocID Token，完整的Token序列决定了检索到的文档。然而，检索效果通常仅在生成完整的DocID后才进行评估，这导致了Token级生成与文档级相关性监督之间的不匹配。因此，现有的生成式检索强化学习方法大多依赖于序列级奖励，即相同的文档级反馈被传播到所有解码步骤。这种粗糙的反馈使得很难识别哪些Token决策对成功或失败的检索负有责任。
在这项工作中，我们为具有Token级相关性奖励的生成式检索提出了一个细粒度的强化学习框架。我们不为整个生成的DocID分配单一奖励，而是通过测量每个Token决策如何改变相应生成轨迹的预期检索质量来估计逐步奖励。这实现了更精确的信用分配，并鼓励策略倾向于那些更直接促进文档级相关性的Token决策。我们进一步开发了针对DocID生成过程定制的实用奖励估计策略，并将其纳入策略优化框架中。在检索基准上的实验表明，我们的方法一致地优于序列级奖励基线，证明了细粒度监督在对齐自回归DocID生成与检索目标方面的有效性。
AI.summary: 该论文针对生成式文档检索中序列级奖励反馈粗糙的问题，提出了一种基于Token级相关性奖励的细粒度强化学习框架，通过估计每一步Token决策对检索质量的影响来实现精确的信用分配，实验表明该方法有效提升了检索性能。
AI.keywords: 生成式文档检索, 强化学习, 信用分配, Token级奖励, 策略优化
AI.comments: 该论文针对生成式文档检索中自回归生成DocID存在的信用分配问题，创新性地提出了基于Token级别的细粒度强化学习框架，有效解决了序列级奖励无法识别具体Token贡献的痛点，对推进生成式检索技术具有重要意义。

title: Predicting Functions, Not Features: KANs with Function-Space Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) introduce explicit functional representations by parameterizing each network edge as a learnable univariate function. However, existing KAN-based segmentation models optimize edge functions only through objectives defined after edge aggregation, leaving individual functions without an explicit pre-aggregation learning target. To address this limitation, we propose Function-Space Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning (FS-JEPA) for medical image segmentation. Our FS-JEPA framework moves predictive learning into the pre-aggregation function space of KANs. A masked online branch predicts structured signatures of sampled KAN edge functions generated by a full-context exponential moving average target branch, while shared edge indices preserve correspondence between predictions and targets. Rather than predicting an isolated edge response, we represent each sampled edge function using a multi-radius signature composed of function evaluations around its input anchor. This structured representation captures local functional variations that cannot be characterized by a single response and provides a more informative predictive target. The function-space objective is jointly optimized with the segmentation loss during training, while the predictive branch is removed at inference. Experiments on five medical image segmentation benchmarks show that our FS-JEPA achieves the best average Dice and outperforms the strongest competing KAN-based method by +2.25 percentage points.

AI.title_translation: 预测函数而非特征：结合函数空间联合嵌入预测学习的KAN用于医学图像分割
AI.tldr: 本文提出了FS-JEPA框架，将预测学习引入KAN的预聚合函数空间，通过多半径函数签名优化提升了医学图像分割的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于KAN的分割模型仅通过边缘聚合后的目标来优化边缘函数，导致单个函数缺乏显式的预聚合学习目标，无法充分发挥KAN中显式函数表示的优势。
AI.method: 提出Function-Space Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning (FS-JEPA)框架，将预测学习引入KANs的预聚合函数空间。使用带有掩码的在线分支预测由全上下文指数移动平均目标分支生成的采样KAN边缘函数的结构化签名（多半径签名），并在训练时与分割损失联合优化，推理时移除预测分支。
AI.result: 在五个医学图像分割基准测试上的实验表明，FS-JEPA实现了最佳的平均Dice，并比最强的竞争KAN方法高出2.25个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于函数空间联合嵌入预测学习的KAN医学图像分割方法（FS-JEPA），通过引入多半径特征捕捉局部函数变化，在五个医学图像分割基准测试中取得了最佳的平均Dice得分，展现出强大的性能。
AI.translation: 柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络（KANs）通过将每个网络边缘参数化为可学习的一元函数，引入了显式的函数表示。然而，现有的基于KAN的分割模型仅通过边缘聚合后定义的优化目标来优化边缘函数，这使得各个函数缺少显式的预聚合学习目标。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了用于医学图像分割的函数空间联合嵌入预测学习（FS-JEPA）。我们的FS-JEPA框架将预测学习转移到KANs的预聚合函数空间中。带掩码的在线分支预测由全上下文指数移动平均目标分支生成的采样KAN边缘函数的结构化签名，同时共享边缘索引保持了预测与目标之间的对应关系。为了避免预测孤立的边缘响应，我们使用由其输入锚点周围的函数评估组成的多半径签名来表示每个采样的边缘函数。这种结构化表示捕获了无法由单一响应表征的局部函数变化，并提供了更具信息量的预测目标。函数空间目标在训练期间与分割损失联合优化，而在推理时移除预测分支。在五个医学图像分割基准测试上的实验表明，我们的FS-JEPA实现了最佳的平均Dice，并且比最强的竞争KAN方法高出2.25个百分点。
AI.summary: 本文针对医学图像分割提出了一种基于函数空间的联合嵌入预测学习（FS-JEPA）框架，改进了KANs在边缘函数优化上的局限性，通过引入多半径结构化签名预测目标并在五个基准测试上验证了其优越性能。
AI.keywords: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), 医学图像分割, 函数空间, 联合嵌入预测学习 (JEPA), 深度学习
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将预测学习引入Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs)的聚合前函数空间，提出了FS-JEPA框架，有效解决了传统KAN边缘函数缺乏显式优化目标的问题，在医学图像分割任务上取得了显著性能提升。

title: Do Not Forget the Obvious - RISC: A Risk-Informed Slice-Coverage Protocol for Safe Autonomous Driving
comments: 14 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Safe and Defensive Autonomous Driving (SDAD). Non-archival workshop paper
summary: Aggregate metrics may not fully reflect performance in insufficiently examined high-risk driving conditions. We propose RISC (Risk-Informed Slice Coverage), a practical protocol for risk-guided stress testing and coverage-qualified evaluation. Risk-guided stress testing directs a finite audit budget toward risk-relevant sub-datasets, called risk slices, while coverage-qualified evaluation reports results together with explicit statements about which slices are sufficiently or insufficiently covered. The protocol translates safety concerns into machine-readable risk slices, uses lightweight signals to tag candidate data, selects a compact audit set by risk, and qualifies the results using coverage evidence. An LLM can optionally support this process by surfacing relevant but potentially overlooked conditions during test planning, thereby helping engineers not to forget the obvious. RISC is model-agnostic and can be applied to perception modules, driving models, and other autonomous-driving subsystems. We instantiate the protocol for monocular pedestrian perception using 1,000 frames from the Zenseact Open Dataset, image statistics, and a YOLO-based detector proxy. In this proof-of-concept study, risk-guided selection increases critical failure discovery from 34.0% under random sampling to 98.5%. RISC provides a lightweight, assurance-oriented evaluation layer that complements scenario categorization, coverage assessment, and broader testing-and-verification workflows.

AI.title_translation: 切勿忽视显而易见的事——RISC：一种用于安全自动驾驶的风险知情切片覆盖协议
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为RISC的风险知情切片覆盖协议，通过将测试预算集中于高风险场景并结合大语言模型，大幅提升了自动驾驶系统关键故障的发现率。
AI.motivation: 聚合指标往往无法充分反映自动驾驶系统在未被充分检查的高风险驾驶条件下的性能，因此需要一种风险引导的压力测试和覆盖率合格评估协议来克服这一缺陷。
AI.method: 提出RISC协议，将安全关注点转化为机器可读的风险切片，利用轻量级信号标记候选数据，按风险选择紧凑的审计集，并使用覆盖率证据对结果进行限定。可选地利用大语言模型（LLM）在测试规划中揭示可能被忽视的条件。
AI.result: 在基于Zenseact开放数据集的单目行人感知概念验证研究中，风险引导选择将关键故障发现率从随机抽样的34.0%大幅提升至98.5%。
AI.conclusion: RISC协议通过风险引导的压力测试和覆盖率合格评估，显著提升了自动驾驶系统在极端和高风险条件下的故障发现率，是一种轻量、实用且具有模型无关性的安全验证补充方案。
AI.translation: 聚合指标可能无法完全反映自动驾驶系统在未被充分检查的高风险驾驶条件下的性能。我们提出了RISC（风险知情切片覆盖），这是一个用于风险引导压力测试和覆盖合格评估的实用协议。风险引导的压力测试将有限的审计预算引导至风险相关的子数据集（称为风险切片），而覆盖合格评估则将结果与明确的陈述一起报告，指出哪些切片被充分或不充分覆盖。该协议将安全关切转化为机器可读的风险切片，使用轻量级信号标记候选数据，按风险选择紧凑的审计集，并使用覆盖证据对结果进行限定。大语言模型可以可选地支持此过程，在测试规划期间浮现相关但可能被忽视的条件，从而帮助工程师不会忘记显而易见的事。RISC是模型无关的，可应用于感知模块、驾驶模型和其他自动驾驶子系统。我们使用Zenseact开放数据集中的1000帧、图像统计数据和一个基于YOLO的检测器代理，为单目行人感知实例化了该协议。在这项概念验证研究中，风险引导选择将关键故障发现从随机抽样的34.0%提高到98.5%。RISC提供了一个轻量级的、面向保证的评估层，补充了场景分类、覆盖评估以及更广泛的测试和验证工作流。
AI.summary: 本文提出了RISC（风险知情切片覆盖）协议，用于自动驾驶的安全导向压力测试和评估。该协议通过识别风险切片、分配审计预算、结合大语言模型辅助测试规划以及使用覆盖证据来限定结果，显著提高了高风险条件下的故障发现率。
AI.keywords: 自动驾驶, 风险引导测试, 切片覆盖, 安全评估, 压力测试
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种风险驱动的切片覆盖协议（RISC），用于自动驾驶安全测试。其创新点在于将传统测试预算向高风险场景倾斜，并结合大语言模型（LLM）防范测试盲区，有效提升了关键故障的发现率。方法兼具实用性与模型无关性，对自动驾驶安全性验证具有重要意义。

title: Greedy approaches for Gold Grabbing on subclasses of split graphs
summary: The Gold Grabbing Game is a combinatorial game on vertex-weighted graphs in which two players alternately remove vertices while maintaining graph connectivity, aiming to maximize the total collected weight. Although the literature has primarily focused on strategies that guarantee victory, the question of optimality --- i.e., maximizing total gain --- remains less explored. In this work, we investigate the behavior of the greedy strategy in this setting. We show that this approach is not optimal for general split graphs, highlighting structural limitations of this class. On the other hand, we prove that for complete split graphs $CS_{(2,n)}$, the greedy strategy yields a sequence of moves that maximizes the game value. As a consequence, the first player does not lose when the number of vertices is even. These results contribute to a better understanding of the structural conditions that ensure the optimality of simple strategies in graph-based combinatorial games.

AI.title_translation: 分裂图子类上的黄金抢夺游戏贪心方法
AI.tldr: 本文研究了贪心策略在分裂图黄金抢夺游戏中的最优性，发现其在一般分裂图上非最优，但在特定完全分裂图上是最优的。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有文献主要关注保证胜利的策略，但关于最大化总收益（最优性）的问题探索较少，本文旨在研究贪心策略在黄金抢夺游戏这一设定下的行为。
AI.method: 通过理论分析，研究了贪心策略在一般分裂图以及完全分裂图CS_(2,n)上的表现与结构局限性。
AI.result: 贪心策略对于一般分裂图不是最优的，但对于完全分裂图CS_(2,n)可以产生最大化游戏价值的移动序列，当顶点数偶数时先手不会输。
AI.conclusion: 贪心策略在一般分裂图上不是最优的，但在完全分裂图CS_(2,n)上能达到博弈的最优价值，且当顶点数为偶数时先手不会输。
AI.translation: 黄金抢夺游戏是顶点加权图上的一种组合游戏，两个玩家交替移除顶点，同时保持图的连通性，旨在最大化收集到的总权重。尽管现有文献主要集中在保证胜利的策略上，但关于最优性（即最大化总收益）的问题探索较少。在这项工作中，我们研究了该设定下贪心策略的行为。我们表明，这种方法对于一般分裂图并不是最优的，突出了该类图的结构局限性。另一方面，我们证明了对于完全分裂图 $CS_{(2,n)}$，贪心策略产生的移动序列能够最大化游戏价值。因此，当顶点数量为偶数时，先手玩家不会输。这些结果有助于更好地理解确保图基组合博弈中简单策略最优性的结构条件。
AI.summary: 本文研究了黄金抢夺游戏在分裂图子类上的贪心策略。研究发现，贪心策略在一般分裂图上无法保证最优性，但在特定的完全分裂图CS_(2,n)上是最优的，从而揭示了确保图组合博弈中简单策略最优性的结构条件。
AI.keywords: Gold Grabbing Game, split graphs, greedy strategy, game theory, graph connectivity
AI.comments: 该论文研究了黄金抢夺游戏在分裂图子类上的贪心策略，指出了贪心策略在一般分裂图上的局限性，并证明了其在完全分裂图CS_(2,n)上的最优性，为图博弈中简单策略的最优性提供了新的结构性见解。

title: Towards Truly Unsupervised Evaluation of Feature Selection
summary: Feature selection is one of the most important and fundamental tasks in data mining, tackled by a family of methods with an established set of evaluation techniques to measure the quality of a specific method. Most of the methods commonly used for the unsupervised evaluation of feature selection algorithms suffer from critical design flaws which question their unsupervised nature. In this paper, we provide a critical discussion on the established allegedly unsupervised evaluation techniques, and shed light on the reasons why they are not truly unsupervised but, at best, supervised evaluation under an unsupervised downstream task. We also propose a novel, truly unsupervised evaluation framework to measure the quality of the feature selection algorithms without any form of information about the labels. The proposed framework utilizes unsupervised Principal Component Analysis, and optimal transport to measure the quality of the feature selection methods in a truly unsupervised manner.

AI.title_translation: 迈向真正无监督的特征选择评估
AI.tldr: 本文指出了现有无监督特征选择评估方法的不足，并提出了一种基于主成分分析和最优传输的真正无监督评估框架。
AI.motivation: 大多数常用的特征选择算法无监督评估方法存在严重的设计缺陷，它们并非真正的无监督，而充其量只是在无监督下游任务下的有监督评估。因此，亟需一种真正无需标签信息的无监督评估框架。
AI.method: 批判性地讨论了现有所谓的“无监督”评估技术，并提出了一种基于无监督主成分分析（PCA）和最优传输（optimal transport）的新型真正无监督评估框架，完全不依赖任何标签信息。
AI.result: 提出了一个不依赖任何标签信息的新型真正无监督特征选择评估框架，利用无监督主成分分析和最优传输来衡量特征选择方法的质量。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功指出了现有无监督特征选择评估方法的局限性，并提出了一个真正无需标签信息的创新评估框架，推动了该领域的发展。
AI.translation: 特征选择是数据挖掘中最重要和最基础的任务之一，有一系列成熟的评估技术来衡量特定方法的质量。大多数常用的无监督特征选择算法评估方法都存在严重的设计缺陷，对其无监督本质提出了质疑。在本文中，我们对现有的所谓无监督评估技术进行了批判性讨论，并阐明了它们为什么不是真正的无监督评估，充其量只是无监督下游任务下的有监督评估。我们还提出了一种新颖、真正无监督的评估框架，在没有任何标签信息的情况下衡量特征选择算法的质量。所提出的框架利用无监督主成分分析和最优传输，以真正无监督的方式衡量特征选择方法的质量。
AI.summary: 本文针对特征选择中无监督评估方法存在的监督泄露问题进行了批判性分析，并创新性地提出了一种利用主成分分析和最优传输来实现真正无监督评估的全新框架。
AI.keywords: 特征选择, 无监督评估, 主成分分析, 最优传输
AI.comments: 本文指出了现有无监督特征选择评估方法中的设计缺陷，即它们实际上依赖于下游任务的监督信息。作者提出了一种真正基于主成分分析和最优传输的无监督评估框架，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: Numerical methods for the simulation of quantum walks and quantum annealing
comments: 15 pages, 6 figures. This paper covers the numerical details of https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.01312
summary: It is known that Chebyshev based polynomial approximation gives a near-optimal rate of convergence for calculating a function of a Hermitian matrix. However, previous work has not discussed the option of true minimax approximation, nor the specifics of writing a high performance implementation with a rigorous analysis of errors. This work provides such an analysis and an open-source implementation of three approximation methods in C++.
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures. This paper covers the numerical details of https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.01312

AI.title_translation: 量子游走与量子退火模拟的数值方法
AI.tldr: 该论文针对量子游走和量子退火模拟，研究了极小极大逼近等矩阵函数计算方法，进行了严谨的误差分析，并提供了高性能的C++开源实现。
AI.motivation: 尽管基于切比雪夫的多项式逼近在计算厄米矩阵函数时具有近乎最优的收敛速度，但以往的研究尚未探讨真正的极小极大逼近选项，也缺乏高性能实现与严谨的误差分析。
AI.method: 研究并实现了三种逼近方法（包括极小极大逼近），进行了严谨的误差分析，并使用C++编写了高性能的开源实现。
AI.result: 提供了一项包含严谨误差分析的工作，以及包含三种逼近方法的C++开源实现。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过对极小极大逼近等三种方法进行严谨的误差分析和高性能C++实现，为量子游走和量子退火的数值模拟提供了高效且可靠的数值工具。
AI.translation: 众所周知，基于切比雪夫的多项式逼近为计算厄米矩阵的函数提供了近乎最优的收敛速度。然而，先前的研究并未讨论真正的极小极大逼近（minimax approximation）选项，也没有对高性能实现及其误差进行严谨的分析。本研究提供了这样的分析，并给出了一个用C++编写的包含三种逼近方法的开源实现。
AI.summary: 该论文探讨了用于模拟量子游走和量子退火的数值方法，填补了以往研究中对真正极小极大逼近（minimax approximation）讨论的空白，进行了严谨的误差分析，并开发了包含三种逼近方法的高性能C++开源实现。
AI.keywords: Chebyshev approximation, minimax approximation, quantum walks, quantum annealing, numerical simulation
AI.comments: 该论文填补了使用极小极大逼近处理厄米矩阵函数的空白，并提供了高性能的开源实现和严谨的误差分析，对量子游走和量子退火的数值模拟具有重要推动作用。

title: Reconfiguring Geovisualization in the Age of Generative AI: Insights from Domain Experts
summary: GenAI is increasingly integrated into geovisualization, yet its broader implications for professional practice are insufficiently understood. To examine these implications, we conducted semi-structured interviews with 20 geovisualization experts. The interviews were structured around four broad analytical domains: Data, Ideation, Prototyping, and Iteration, while also encouraging participants to reflect on issues that extend beyond these activities. Our findings show that GenAI expands the capabilities of geovisualization, particularly in terms of data handling, creative exploration, and rapid prototyping, but does not simply remove existing constraints. Instead, key bottlenecks are shifting from production to judgment and verification. As routine technical tasks become more automated, professional value increasingly depends on spatial reasoning, contextual interpretation, aesthetic and ethical judgment, and the ability to assess whether AI-generated outputs are appropriate for use. At the same time, GenAI introduces new challenges regarding provenance, interpretability, and accountability, raising questions about how responsibility should be distributed across models, developers, practitioners, institutions, and users. These shifts are particularly significant in geovisualization because spatial representations are constrained by geographic reality and must balance scientific validity, visual expression, and technical implementation. We therefore argue that responsible GenAI in geovisualization requires domain-specific approaches to spatial validation, provenance, uncertainty communication, human oversight, and accountable use. This study provides an expert-grounded perspective on how GenAI is reconfiguring geovisualization as a practice of spatial knowledge production. It also identifies implications for future professional practice, education, system design, and governance.

title: Preference Tree Optimization: Enhancing Goal-Oriented Dialogue with Look-Ahead Simulations
comments: 13 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at an ICLR 2025 workshop
summary: Developing dialogue systems capable of engaging in multi-turn, goal-oriented conversations remains a significant challenge, especially in specialized domains with limited data. This research proposes a novel framework called Preference Tree Optimization (PTO), designed to iteratively improve agent models in such dialogue systems, by generating preference data using a method called Preference Tree with Look-Ahead. Focusing on Motivational Interviewing (MI) -- a counseling technique aimed at facilitating behavioral change -- we leverage virtual patients and an oracle evaluator to simulate conversations and generate rich preference datasets. By combining this method with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), we aim to enhance the agent's decision-making capabilities over iterative training cycles. The proposed framework addresses data scarcity and advances the development of more nuanced and effective dialogue systems in goal-oriented domains. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that the PTO framework enhances dialogue agents' performance in goal-oriented conversations within the domain of Motivational Interviewing (MI). Models trained with PTO consistently outperformed the baseline in key metrics such as session satisfaction and working alliance. Additionally, incorporating look-ahead simulations led to improved long-term planning and more effective conversational strategies, with deeper look-ahead configurations yielding the most stable and high-scoring results.

title: Learning Loco-Manipulation From SMPC Demonstrations With Sparse Offline-to-Online RL
summary: Integrating locomotion and manipulation is essential for robot autonomy, but scaling standard Reinforcement Learning (RL) to complex tasks is severely bottlenecked by the slow, manual process of dense reward shaping. To bypass this limitation, we leverage Sample-based Model Predictive Control (SMPC) entirely in simulation as an automated, rapidly tunable expert to generate massive offline datasets. Because this data solves the fundamental exploration problem, we can train an off-policy RL agent using purely sparse task rewards, drastically reducing the time required to learn new skills and eliminating the need for manual tuning. Integrating this high-level agent with a low-level dynamic stability controller yields more optimal behaviors that strictly align with true task objectives, ultimately allowing the learned policies to surpass the original optimal control teacher. We validate the robustness of this sim-to-real framework by successfully deploying complex loco-manipulation skills across different morphologies, including an arm-equipped Spot quadruped and a G1 humanoid.

title: Draw This First
summary: We invert the typical formulation of sketch generation: instead of drawing strokes in order, we predict a 2D field that defines the order in which strokes are drawn. We use a pretrained latent flow-matching transformer to supply the image prior to predict an intermediate representation, while training the VAE's decoder to predict the order field, stroke mask, and stroke segmentation. We vectorize the predicted segmentation into polylines and sort them by the field, producing an ordered vector sketch. Our model can predict an ordered vector sketch from a text description or derender an image into ordered vectors; for either, it follows text instructions specifying the order of drawing.

title: Polynomial-Time Singular Witnesses for Non-SNS Sign Patterns
summary: Sign-nonsingularity asks whether every real matrix with prescribed entry signs is nonsingular. Polynomial-time algorithms recognize square sign-nonsingular patterns through their connection with even directed cycles, but recognition does not itself produce an exact numerical witness in the negative case. We give a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm that, for any square sign pattern $A$, either reports that $A$ is sign-nonsingular or outputs $B\in\mathbb{Z}^{n\times n}$ and $z\in\mathbb{Z}^n\setminus\{0\}$ such that $\operatorname{sgn}(B)=A$ and $Bz=0$. After normalizing a perfect matching, an even directed cycle yields two determinant terms of opposite signs. Making either term dominant produces endpoint realizations with opposite determinant signs. Changing their magnitudes one coordinate at a time exposes an affine sign-changing step, whose zero is rational; clearing its denominator gives the integer witness. Entries of $B$ have $O(n^2\log n)$ bits, and entries of $z$ have $O(n^3\log n)$ bits. The result settles Conjecture 14.12.4 in the Handbook of Satisfiability.

title: A Comparison of Malware Image Transformations Using Grad-CAM and Hybrid Learning Models
comments: To appear as a chapter in the book "Artificial Intelligence for Cyber Defense in Emerging Threats", to be published by Springer by early 2027
summary: Recent studies have shown that binary-to-image representations can enable effective machine learning-based results for malware detection and classification. However, performance can vary significantly, depending on the technique used to convert binaries to images. Furthermore, the explainability and interpretability of image-based models is largely unexplored within the malware domain. In this research, we employ Gradient-weighted Class Activation Maps (Grad-CAM) as an eXplainable AI (XAI) tool, which we use to analyze eight distinct image types derived from malware samples. We provide quantitative faithfulness and stability metrics for Grad-CAM heatmaps and we compare these heatmaps to High-Resolution Class Activation Mappings (HiResCAM). We also show that Grad-CAM heatmaps can provide useful information for malware classification. Specifically, we show that a Random Forest model trained on features extracted from Grad-CAM images via a MobileNetV2 Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model achieves a test accuracy of 0.777 across 17 malware families, exceeding a previous benchmark of 0.750 for this same dataset. A key finding of this research is that for the malware image transformations considered, accuracy and explanation faithfulness do not coincide, e.g., image transformation techniques that produce the most faithful explanations yield only mid-tier accuracy.

title: Better Slots, Better Worlds: Representation Quality & Robustness in Object-Centric World Models
comments: Published at Model-Based RL in the Era of Generative World Models Workshop at RLC 2026
summary: Learning world models from offline trajectories enables agents to accomplish different tasks through planning. Object-centric (OC) representations, which decompose a scene into a set of slots that bind to its objects, have been proposed as an inductive bias for world models that are more sample-efficient and generalize better. Yet prior object-centric world models (OCWMs) take the slot encoder as given and evaluate only in-distribution, leaving open whether the object-centric bias actually delivers for planning and what within the OCWM drives it. We conduct a controlled study of OCWMs for visual model-predictive control along two axes: object-centric representation quality and generalization under distribution shift relative to scene-centric models. We find that (i) planning success correlates positively with unsupervised slot-quality metrics (FG-ARI, mBO), though the gains saturate at high slot quality; (ii) with well-bound slots, the auxiliary proprioception inputs and masking inductive bias that prior methods relied on become unnecessary; and (iii) under unseen distribution shifts, the OCWM with well-bound slots is more robust overall than the end-to-end trained scene-centric LeWM, while DINO-WM, built on similar frozen pretrained features, remains competitive -- pointing to pretrained features as a key contributor to robustness.

title: Faithful, Sufficient and Understandable: Rethinking Graph Counterfactual Explanations via Discrete Diffusion Inversion
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) achieve strong predictive performance on graph-structured data across domains such as chemistry, biology, and network analysis, yet they provide no intrinsic explanation of their predictions. This limits their adoption in high-stakes and safety-critical settings. Counterfactual explanations address this by revealing the minimal structural modifications that would change a model's prediction. On graphs, however, such a modification is hard to produce. The search space is discrete and combinatorial, and a valid answer must respect categorical node and edge types together with domain rules such as chemical valency in the case of molecular graphs. Existing explainers give up one of two things. Either edits are not held on the data manifold, or the search does not span the full edit space. We propose Graph Diffusion Counterfactual Explanation via Inversion (GDCE-I), which gives up neither. A discrete denoising diffusion model with a novel discrete inversion scheme enables distribution-aware edits leveraging the whole domain edit space. We further address the incomplete and inconsistent evaluation of graph counterfactuals by deriving a framework of explanation desiderata and applying it to every method under one shared protocol. Across four benchmarks, GDCE-I outperforms related work by a large margin on the defined framework. For the molecular domain, we further qualitatively show that GDCE-I attains interpretable in-distribution solutions.

title: NAE: Normalizing AutoEncoder
summary: We consider the setting of Normalizing flows with approximate inverses, an established paradigm spanning both full-dimensional ($d=D$) and bottleneck ($d<D$) settings, and group these models under the term flow autoencoders. We present a theoretical investigation into their training dynamics and prove that the proposed loss used by existing approaches is suboptimal; specifically, both encoder and decoder surrogates must be optimized in alignment with reconstruction loss. Guided by these insights, we propose Normalizing Autoencoder (NAE), which employs a novel conditional loss that aligns the surrogate loss gradient with that of reconstruction loss, directly improving upon the current standard. Extensive experiments across molecule generation, tabular data, and image benchmarks demonstrate that NAE achieves state of the art performance. Our work highlights the importance of loss alignment in flow autoencoders and establishes NAE as a powerful generative framework.

AI.title_translation: NAE：归一化自编码器
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了流自编码器中损失不对齐的问题，并提出通过条件损失对齐梯度的归一化自编码器（NAE），在多项生成任务中达到了 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的带有近似逆的归一化流（即流自编码器）所使用的损失函数是次优的，编码器和解码器的代理损失必须与重构损失保持对齐才能优化训练动态。
AI.method: 提出了归一化自编码器（NAE），引入一种新型的条件损失函数，使编码器和解码器代理损失的梯度与重构损失梯度保持对齐。
AI.result: 在分子生成、表格数据和图像基准测试上的广泛实验表明，NAE 取得了最先进（SOTA）的生成性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了流自编码器中损失对齐的重要性，并成功将 NAE 确立为一个高效且强大的生成框架。
AI.translation: 我们考虑带有近似逆的归一化流设置，这是一个涵盖全维（d=D）和瓶颈（d<D）设置的成熟范式，并将这些模型统称为流自编码器。我们对它们的训练动态进行了理论研究，证明现有方法所采用的提议损失是次优的；具体而言，编码器和解码器的代理损失都必须与重构损失保持对齐。在这些见解的指导下，我们提出了归一化自编码器（NAE），它采用一种新型的条件损失，使代理损失梯度与重构损失梯度相一致，直接改进了当前的标准方法。在分子生成、表格数据和图像基准测试上的广泛实验表明，NAE 达到了最先进的性能。我们的工作强调了流自编码器中损失对齐的重要性，并将 NAE 确立为一个强大的生成框架。
AI.summary: 本文对流自编码器的训练动态进行了理论探究，发现现有方法的损失函数存在次优性。为此，作者提出了归一化自编码器（NAE），通过新型条件损失将代理损失梯度与重构损失梯度对齐，显著提升了在分子、表格和图像生成等任务上的性能。
AI.keywords: 归一化流, 自编码器, 生成模型, 损失对齐, 归一化自编码器
AI.comments:
创新点：本文从理论层面指出了现有流自编码器损失函数的次优性，揭示了代理损失与重构损失梯度对齐的重要性，并提出了创新的条件损失机制。
重要性：修正了流自编码器训练中的基础性缺失，为结合归一化流与自编码器的生成模型提供了更坚实的理论支撑和高效训练范式。
局限性：摘要中未讨论该条件损失函数的额外计算开销及其在大规模高维数据上的扩展性。

title: Look What the Probes Dragged In! Real-World Chest X-ray Shortcuts in MedCLIP
comments: 11 pages, 3 figure, poster presentation at the joint FAIMI, BRIDGE, and EPIMI workshop at MICCAI 2026 (Strasbourg, France) conference
summary: Vision-language models, such as contrastive language-image pre-training (CLIP)-based approaches, have reached state-of-the-art (SOTA) results in medical artificial intelligence. However, recent work reveals that CLIP-based models remain vulnerable to shortcuts. We investigate how real-world shortcuts manifest across different layers of the medical CLIP-based model, MedCLIP, and its vision encoder, a frozen ResNet-50. We attach 17 linear classification probes to the intermediate layers of the ResNet-50 and train them on three different dataset configurations and targets: NIH-CXR14 (pneumothorax) and PadChest (cardiomegaly and pneumothorax). This setup allows us to observe model behaviour during evaluation using subgroup-based calibration and layer-wise confidence curves. We find that the final linear probes achieve a high AUROC but poor calibration in the models. The layer-wise confidence analyses suggest that shortcuts emerge at different depths. Patterns consistent with localised shortcuts, such as drains, appear at later layers, while patterns consistent with diffuse shortcuts, such as scanner-specific noise patterns, emerge earlier, aligning with previous work. Finally, we conduct a manual analysis of the images, which reveals data quality issues in both NIH-CXR14 and PadChest. Our findings underscore that even SOTA models remain vulnerable to shortcuts, and the need for high-quality and well-annotated datasets to draw solid conclusions. Code can be found on our GitHub: https://github.com/nikodice4/MedCLIP_shortcuts.
