title: Tight Nonasymptotic Local Convergence of Sinkhorn-Knopp
summary: We revisit the Sinkhorn-Knopp (SK) algorithm for the matrix scaling problem. Despite extensive literature on the global convergence of SK and its variants, its local linear convergence behavior remains less understood. We address this gap by providing the first nonasymptotic local analysis of SK that matches the rate obtained from existing asymptotic Jacobian-based arguments. We show that under certain connectivity conditions, SK is a polynomial-time algorithm for doubly stochastic matrix scaling. With the developed tools, we showcase the local suboptimality of SK and provide accelerated variants. Finally, for dense matrices, we improve the complexity of existing first-order matrix scaling algorithms from $O(\tfrac{n^{7/3}}{\varepsilon^{2/3}})$ to $O(\tfrac{n^{9/4}}{\sqrt{\varepsilon}})$.

AI.title_translation: Sinkhorn-Knopp算法的紧致非渐近局部收敛性
AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了Sinkhorn-Knopp (SK) 算法，首次提供了SK算法的非渐近局部分析，其收敛速率与现有渐近分析结果一致。研究表明在特定连通性条件下，SK算法是双随机矩阵缩放问题的多项式时间算法，并在此基础上提出了加速变体，同时改进了密集矩阵的第一阶矩阵缩放算法的复杂度。
AI.motivation: 尽管Sinkhorn-Knopp (SK) 算法及其变体的全局收敛性已有广泛文献，但其局部线性收敛行为仍有待深入理解。本文旨在弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 本文提供了SK算法的首次非渐近局部分析，并开发了新的工具来展示SK的局部次优性，进而提出了加速变体。此外，还改进了现有第一阶矩阵缩放算法的复杂度分析。
AI.result: 1. 首次提供了与现有渐近Jacobian方法结果一致的SK算法非渐近局部分析。2. 在特定连通性条件下，证明SK是双随机矩阵缩放问题的多项式时间算法。3. 揭示了SK算法的局部次优性，并提出了加速变体。4. 将密集矩阵的第一阶矩阵缩放算法的复杂度从$O(\tfrac{n^{7/3}}{\varepsilon^{2/3}})$改进到$O(\tfrac{n^{9/4}}{\sqrt{\varepsilon}})$。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过对Sinkhorn-Knopp算法进行紧致非渐近局部收敛分析，不仅加深了对其局部行为的理解，还证明了其在特定条件下的多项式时间特性，并提出了加速改进，显著降低了密集矩阵缩放算法的复杂度。
AI.translation: 我们重新审视了用于矩阵缩放问题的Sinkhorn-Knopp (SK) 算法。尽管关于SK及其变体的全局收敛性已有大量文献，但其局部线性收敛行为仍鲜为人知。我们通过提供SK算法的首次非渐近局部分析来弥补这一空白，其速率与现有基于Jacobian的渐近论证所获得的速率相匹配。我们表明，在某些连通性条件下，SK是双随机矩阵缩放问题的多项式时间算法。借助开发的工具，我们展示了SK的局部次优性并提供了加速变体。最后，对于密集矩阵，我们将现有第一阶矩阵缩放算法的复杂度从$O(\tfrac{n^{7/3}}{\varepsilon^{2/3}})$改进到$O(\tfrac{n^{9/4}}{\sqrt{\varepsilon}})$。
AI.summary: 本文对Sinkhorn-Knopp (SK) 算法进行了首次非渐近局部收敛分析，填补了其局部收敛行为理解不足的空白。研究证明在特定连通性下，SK是双随机矩阵缩放问题的多项式时间算法。在此基础上，文章揭示了SK的局部次优性并提出了加速变体，同时将密集矩阵的第一阶矩阵缩放算法的复杂度从$O(\tfrac{n^{7/3}}{\varepsilon^{2/3}})$优化至$O(\tfrac{n^{9/4}}{\sqrt{\varepsilon}})$。
AI.keywords: Sinkhorn-Knopp, 矩阵缩放, 局部收敛, 非渐近分析, 复杂度改进
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于首次提供了Sinkhorn-Knopp算法的非渐近局部收敛分析，这对于理解该算法在实际应用中的精细行为至关重要。通过匹配现有渐近分析结果，并提出加速变体，该研究不仅深化了理论理解，也为实际应用提供了更高效的工具。尤其是在密集矩阵缩放算法复杂度上的改进，具有重要的实践意义。

title: A comparison of CNN architectures for Alzheimer's disease detection in single-view MRI scans
comments: Accepted at SPIE Optics + Photonics 2026 for oral presentation. 14 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables
summary: Alzheimer's disease is a leading cause of death with no cure. Therefore, early detection is critical to slow progression and preserve quality of life. Diagnosis relies on medical history, cognitive tests, physical exams, and MRI brain scans, making deep learning suitable for Alzheimer's classification. This work proposes a benchmark that evaluates ten different convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures (including ResNet, DenseNet, MobileNet, EfficientNet, and VGG family models) under the same held-out test split protocol. A two-stage transfer learning and full fine-tuning pipeline is introduced to perform training using a class-balanced subset (3,900 images) derived from the OASIS medical imaging dataset, comprising 86,437 single-view MRI brain scans labeled into four classifications of Alzheimer's disease: Non-Demented, Very Mild Dementia, Mild Dementia, and Moderate Dementia. The best results were achieved by VGG16, with a 0.9637 validation accuracy and a 0.9533 test accuracy score. A key finding documented in this work is the difficulty of classifying the transition from Non-Demented to Very Mild Demented stages, observed consistently across all ten architectures.
comment: Accepted at SPIE Optics + Photonics 2026 for oral presentation. 14 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables

AI.title_translation: 用于单视图MRI扫描中阿尔茨海默病检测的CNN架构比较
AI.tldr: 本文对比了十种CNN架构在MRI扫描阿尔茨海默病检测中的性能，发现VGG16表现最好，但所有模型在识别无痴呆到极轻度痴呆的过渡期时都很困难。
AI.motivation: 阿尔茨海默病缺乏治愈手段，早期检测对于延缓病情进展和保持生活质量至关重要；由于诊断依赖于MRI脑部扫描，深度学习非常适合用于阿尔茨海默病的分类，因此需要对不同的CNN架构进行系统的基准评估。
AI.method: 提出一个基准测试，在相同的留出测试集协议下评估十种不同的CNN架构（如ResNet、DenseNet、MobileNet、EfficientNet和VGG系列），并引入两阶段迁移学习和全微调流水线，使用来自OASIS数据集的3,900张类别平衡的单视图MRI图像进行训练。
AI.result: VGG16取得了最佳性能，验证准确率为0.9637，测试准确率为0.9533；所有十种架构在对“无痴呆”到“极轻度痴呆”的过渡阶段进行分类时均表现出一致的困难。
AI.conclusion: VGG16在单视图MRI扫描的阿尔茨海默病检测中表现最优，验证准确率达0.9637，测试准确率达0.9533。然而，所有测试的模型在区分“无痴呆”到“极轻度痴呆”这一过渡阶段时都面临共同的挑战。
AI.translation: 阿尔茨海默病是导致死亡的主要原因且目前无法治愈。因此，早期检测对于延缓病情进展和保持生活质量至关重要。诊断依赖于病史、认知测试、体格检查和MRI脑部扫描，这使得深度学习非常适合用于阿尔茨海默病的分类。本研究提出了一个基准测试，在相同的留出测试集协议下评估了十种不同的卷积神经网络（CNN）架构（包括ResNet、DenseNet、MobileNet、EfficientNet和VGG系列模型）。引入了一个两阶段迁移学习和全微调流水线，使用从OASIS医学成像数据集中提取的类别平衡子集（3,900张图像）进行训练，该数据集包含86,437张单视图MRI脑部扫描图像，被标记为阿尔茨海默病的四种分类：无痴呆、极轻度痴呆、轻度痴呆和中度痴呆。最佳结果由VGG16取得，验证准确率为0.9637，测试准确率为0.9533。本工作记录的一个关键发现是，在所有十种架构中都一致观察到，对从无痴呆到极轻度痴呆阶段的过渡进行分类存在困难。
AI.summary: 本文建立了一个基准测试，评估了十种CNN架构在单视图MRI扫描中检测阿尔茨海默病的性能。通过使用两阶段迁移学习和来自OASIS数据集的平衡子集进行训练，VGG16取得了最高精度。研究还发现，所有模型在识别从无痴呆向极轻度痴呆的过渡阶段时都存在困难。
AI.keywords: 阿尔茨海默病, 卷积神经网络, 磁共振成像, 迁移学习, 基准测试
AI.comments: 该论文对多种主流CNN架构在阿尔茨海默病MRI扫描检测任务上进行了系统的基准测试，创新点在于使用统一的测试集协议评估了十种模型，并揭示了从无痴呆到极轻度痴呆阶段分类的通用难点。

title: TRACE: A Modular Framework for RIS-Assisted Channel Estimation and Differential Channel-Aware Reconfiguration
comments: 14 pages, 18 figures, Submitted to IEEE TCoM for review on 18th July 2026
summary: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS) research tightly couples channel-estimation, control and communication, yet existing implementations often rely on fixed algorithmic pipelines, making it difficult to compare alternative estimation, tracking and communication strategies under identical conditions and to study low-overhead RIS adaptation under time-varying channels. This paper addresses both challenges through two complementary contributions. First, it presents TRACE (Toolkit for RIS-assisted channel-estimation, adaptive control and communication experimentation), a modular socket-based framework that decouples the transmitter, radio environment, controller and receiver through separate control- and data-plane interfaces, enabling reproducible evaluation across substitutable modules. Second, it proposes the differential channel-aware RIS update (DCAR) algorithm, which estimates channel perturbations from reduced probe observations using a regularized differential update to reduce retraining overhead. TRACE is validated through interchangeable minimum mean square error and orthogonal matching pursuit channel-estimation, Gaussian random walk and Gauss--Markov channel evolution, BPSK, QPSK and 16-QAM modulation techniques and multiple RIS sizes, without modifying the underlying framework. Within TRACE, DCAR is observed to reduce pilot overhead and computational complexity while maintaining beamforming performance close to Kalman-filter-based tracking under time-varying channels.
comment: 14 pages, 18 figures, Submitted to IEEE TCoM for review on 18th July 2026

AI.title_translation: 可重构智能表面辅助信道估计和差分信道感知重构的模块化框架TRACE
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个名为TRACE的模块化框架，用于可重构智能表面（RIS）辅助的信道估计、控制和通信。TRACE通过解耦不同组件，实现了不同策略的可复现评估。同时，论文还提出了一种名为DCAR的差分信道感知RIS更新算法，该算法通过减少探测观测和使用正则化差分更新来降低信道重训练的开销。实验结果表明，TRACE框架支持多种信道估计、信道演化、调制和RIS尺寸的灵活配置，而DCAR算法在保持性能的同时，显著降低了导频开销和计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 现有RIS实现通常依赖固定的算法流程，难以在相同条件下比较不同的信道估计、跟踪和通信策略，也难以研究在时变信道下低开销的RIS自适应问题。
AI.method: 提出TRACE (Toolkit for RIS-assisted channel-estimation, adaptive control and communication experimentation) 框架，这是一个模块化的、基于套接字的框架，通过独立的控制和数据平面接口解耦了发射机、无线电环境、控制器和接收机。同时，提出了一种差分信道感知RIS更新（DCAR）算法，该算法利用正则化的差分更新，从简化的探测观测中估计信道扰动，以减少重训练开销。
AI.result: TRACE框架通过可替换的最小均方误差和正交匹配追踪信道估计器、高斯随机游走和高斯-马尔可夫信道演化、BPSK、QPSK和16-QAM调制技术以及多种RIS尺寸进行了验证，且无需修改底层框架。在TRACE框架中，DCAR算法在时变信道下，将导频开销和计算复杂度降低了，同时保持了接近卡尔曼滤波器跟踪的波束成形性能。
AI.conclusion: TRACE框架提供了一个灵活且可复现的平台，用于评估RIS辅助通信系统中的不同组件和策略。DCAR算法是一种有效的低开销方法，可以在时变信道下实现RIS的自适应重构，性能接近更复杂的跟踪算法。
AI.translation: 可重构智能表面（RIS）的研究将信道估计、控制和通信紧密耦合在一起，但现有的实现通常依赖于固定的算法流程，这使得在相同的条件下比较替代的估计、跟踪和通信策略，以及研究时变信道下低开销的RIS自适应变得困难。本文通过两项互补的贡献解决了这些挑战。首先，它提出了TRACE（用于RIS辅助信道估计、自适应控制和通信实验的工具包），一个模块化的、基于套接字的框架，通过分离的控制和数据平面接口将发射机、无线电环境、控制器和接收机解耦，从而能够跨可替换模块进行可复现的评估。其次，它提出了差分信道感知RIS更新（DCAR）算法，该算法利用简化的探测观测和正则化差分更新来估计信道扰动，以减少重新训练的开销。TRACE通过可替换的最小均方误差和正交匹配追踪信道估计、高斯随机游走和高斯-马尔可夫信道演化、BPSK、QPSK和16-QAM调制技术以及多种RIS尺寸进行了验证，而无需修改底层框架。在TRACE中，观察到DCAR算法在时变信道下，在保持波束成形性能接近卡尔曼滤波器跟踪的同时，减少了导频开销和计算复杂度。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了TRACE，一个模块化的框架，用于评估RIS辅助信道估计和通信，并引入了DCAR算法，一种用于RIS更新的低开销方法。TRACE通过解耦系统组件，实现了不同算法的可复现比较。DCAR算法通过利用差分信道信息，减少了信道估计的开销和计算复杂度，同时在时变信道下保持了良好的性能。
AI.keywords: 可重构智能表面, 信道估计, 模块化框架, DCAR算法, 低开销自适应, 时变信道, TRACE, RIS, Channel Estimation, Modular Framework, DCAR Algorithm, Low-overhead Adaptation, Time-varying Channels, TRACE
AI.comments: 该研究提出的TRACE 框架在 RIS 领域具有重要意义，它解决了现有实现难以进行公平比较和低开销自适应的问题。模块化的设计提高了可复现性和灵活性，使得研究者可以方便地替换和评估不同的算法模块。DCAR 算法的提出是该研究的一大亮点，它有效地降低了信道估计的开销，这对于资源受限的 RIS 系统尤为重要。然而，该算法在极端时变信道或复杂环境下的性能仍需进一步验证。

title: MiDashengLM-Gen: Unified Audio Scene Generation via LLM-Driven Autoregressive Flow Matching
summary: Generating coherent audio scenes that simultaneously blend speech, music, and sound effects remains a significant challenge. Current approaches typically rely on a disjointed pipeline where a frozen, decoupled text encoder feeds a separate audio decoder, limiting cross-modal optimization and leading to poor speech intelligibility. To overcome these limitations, we introduce MiDashengLM-Gen, an end-to-end framework that couples a pre-trained Large Language Model (LLM) with per-token conditional flow matching for autoregressive, variable-length mixed-audio scene generation. MiDashengLM-Gen represents a first approach for general text-to-audio generation with one end-to-end trained model. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that MiDashengLM-Gen drastically improves speech intelligibility over existing unified models. On the Seed-TTS benchmark, English Word Error Rate (WER) drops from 12.15% to 2.79%, approaching the performance of dedicated Text-to-Speech (TTS) systems (1.24%). Furthermore, the framework extends effectively to multilingual settings, yielding highly competitive multilingual WERs compared to existing baselines. Lastly, the model maintains competitive mixed-audio generation quality on the MECAT benchmark. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/xiaomi-research/midashenglm-gen and https://huggingface.co/mispeech/midashenglm-gen, and the demo page is available at https://xingws.github.io/midashenglm-gen-demo/.

AI.title_translation: MiDashengLM-Gen：基于大语言模型驱动的自回归流匹配的统一音频场景生成
AI.tldr: MiDashengLM-Gen是一个端到端的音频场景生成框架，通过结合大语言模型与流匹配技术，显著提升了统一音频生成中的语音可懂度。
AI.motivation: 当前的音频生成方法通常依赖于脱节的管道（冻结的文本编码器输入至独立的音频解码器），这限制了跨模态优化并导致语音可懂度较差，因此需要开发一种端到端的统一生成框架。
AI.method: 引入了MiDashengLM-Gen框架，将预训练大语言模型与逐标记条件流匹配相结合，实现自回归、可变长度的混合音频场景生成。
AI.result: 在Seed-TTS基准测试中，英语词错误率（WER）从12.15%大幅降至2.79%，接近专用TTS系统（1.24%）；在多语言设置中表现出极具竞争力的WER，并在MECAT基准测试上保持了有竞争力的混合音频生成质量。
AI.conclusion: MiDashengLM-Gen成功打破了传统音频生成中各模态脱节的限制，通过端到端训练和流匹配技术，在保证混合音频生成质量的同时，大幅提升了语音可懂度，为通用文本到音频生成提供了新范式。
AI.translation: 生成同时融合语音、音乐和音效的相干音频场景仍然是一个重大挑战。当前的方法通常依赖于脱节的管道，即冻结的、解耦的文本编码器馈送单独的音频解码器，这限制了跨模态优化并导致语音可懂度差。为了克服这些限制，我们介绍了MiDashengLM-Gen，这是一个端到端框架，它将预训练的大语言模型（LLM）与逐标记条件流匹配相结合，用于自回归、可变长度的混合音频场景生成。MiDashengLM-Gen代表了使用一个端到端训练模型进行通用文本到音频生成的第一种方法。实证评估表明，MiDashengLM-Gen显着提高了现有统一模型的语音可懂度。在Seed-TTS基准测试中，英语词错误率（WER）从12.15%降至2.79%，接近专用文本到音频（TTS）系统的性能（1.24%）。此外，该框架有效地扩展到多语言设置，与现有基线相比产生了极具竞争力的多语言WER。最后，该模型在MECAT基准测试中保持了有竞争力的混合音频生成质量。代码和检查点可在 https://github.com/xiaomi-research/midashenglm-gen 和 https://huggingface.co/mispeech/midashenglm-gen 获取，演示页面可在 https://xingws.github.io/midashenglm-gen-demo/ 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了MiDashengLM-Gen，这是一个端到端的音频场景生成框架，结合了预训练大语言模型和自回归流匹配技术，用于生成包含语音、音乐和音效的混合音频。该方法显著改善了语音可懂度，并在多个基准测试中展现出卓越的性能。
AI.keywords: 音频场景生成, 大语言模型, 流匹配, 语音可懂度, 端到端框架
AI.comments: 该论文首次提出了一种基于大语言模型与自回归流匹配的端到端统一音频场景生成框架，有效解决了传统脱节管道导致的语音可懂度差的问题，在语音可懂度和多语言设置上取得了显著提升。

title: ResPCC: A Loss-Resilient Neural Point Cloud Codec over Lossy Networks
summary: Point cloud compression (PCC) is critical for efficient storage and transmission of 3D data. While recent learning-based PCC methods achieve good rate-distortion (R-D) performance, they generally rely on ideal transmission conditions. In practice, packet loss is a common issue and can severely distort latent features, causing coordinate drift and geometric degradation. To address this challenge, we present ResPCC, the first end-to-end neural point cloud codec designed to offer intrinsic resilience against data loss. Our framework is loss-rate-aware and adapts to diverse packet loss conditions. At the encoder, we introduce a Condition-Adaptive Latent Modulation (CALM) module to adjust latent feature distributions according to the perceived loss rate, as well as a Spatial-Channel Interleaving (SCI) mechanism that transforms channel-wise data extinction into spatially scattered element-wise missing patterns. At the decoder, we develop a Mask-Aware Graph-based Latent Restoration (MGLR) module, followed by a Dictionary-based Refinement (DBR) stage to recover corrupted features and align them with canonical priors. Evaluations on ShapeNet and SemanticKITTI under 5\% to 30\% packet loss rates show that ResPCC consistently delivers superior stability and R-D performance over baselines. Our framework maintains high reconstruction fidelity under lossy conditions, providing a reliable solution for 3D data transmission over practical networks. Code is available at https://github.com/starrynight314/ResPCC.

AI.title_translation: ResPCC：面向有损网络的抗丢包神经点云编解码器
AI.tldr: ResPCC是首个抗丢包的神经点云编解码器，通过创新的编码端调制与解码端恢复机制，在有损网络中实现了卓越的点云重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于学习的点云压缩方法通常依赖于理想的传输条件，但在实际应用中，丢包会导致潜变量严重失真，进而引发坐标漂移和几何退化。为此，需要设计一个对数据丢失具有内在鲁棒性的神经点云编解码器。
AI.method: 提出了一种端到端神经点云编解码器ResPCC。在编码端引入条件自适应潜变量调制（CALM）模块和空间-通道交织（SCI）机制；在解码端开发了掩码感知图基潜变量恢复（MGLR）模块和基于字典的精炼（DBR）阶段。
AI.result: 在ShapeNet和SemanticKITTI数据集上，在5%至30%的丢包率下进行评估，结果表明ResPCC相比基线方法持续提供更优的稳定性和率失真（R-D）性能，在有损条件下保持了高重建保真度。
AI.conclusion: ResPCC是首个针对丢包网络设计的端到端神经点云编解码器，在各种丢包率下均表现出卓越的稳定性和率失真性能，为3D数据在实际网络中的可靠传输提供了有效方案。
AI.translation: 点云压缩（PCC）对于3D数据的有效存储和传输至关重要。虽然最近基于学习的PCC方法取得了良好的率失真（R-D）性能，但它们通常依赖于理想的传输条件。在实践中，丢包是一个常见问题，会严重扭曲潜在特征，导致坐标漂移和几何退化。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了ResPCC，这是第一个旨在提供抗数据丢失内在鲁棒性的端到端神经点云编解码器。我们的框架具有丢包率感知能力，能够适应各种丢包条件。在编码器端，我们引入了一个条件自适应潜变量调制（CALM）模块，根据感知的丢包率调整潜变量分布，以及一个空间-通道交织（SCI）机制，将通道级的数据消亡转化为空间分散的元素级缺失模式。在解码器端，我们开发了一个掩码感知图基潜变量恢复（MGLR）模块，随后是一个基于字典的精炼（DBR）阶段，以恢复损坏的特征并将其与规范先验对齐。在ShapeNet和SemanticKITTI上，在5%至30%的丢包率下进行的评估表明，与基线相比，ResPCC始终提供卓越的稳定性和R-D性能。我们的框架在有损条件下保持了高重建保真度，为3D数据在实际网络中的传输提供了一个可靠的解决方案。代码可在 https://github.com/starrynight314/ResPCC 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ResPCC，这是首个能够适应各种丢包率、对数据丢失具有内在鲁棒性的端到端神经点云编解码器。该方法通过在编码端进行自适应调制与交织，以及在解码端进行基于图的特征恢复与精炼，有效解决了有损网络中的点云几何退化问题。
AI.keywords: 点云压缩, 神经编解码器, 丢包恢复, 条件自适应潜变量调制, 空间-通道交织
AI.comments: ResPCC创新性地结合了丢包率感知、条件自适应潜变量调制、空间-通道交织以及基于掩码的图神经网络恢复，有效解决了神经点云编码在丢包网络中的几何退化问题，具有很高的实用价值。

title: A uniform elliptic reduction, an order-matching criterion, and precision benchmarks for the strong-coupling Birman-Schwinger analysis of the lattice three-boson trimer
summary: We study the strong-coupling Birman-Schwinger analysis of the three-boson lattice Schroedinger operator at the exceptional quasimomentum K = pi. First, we provide an exact closed-form benchmark for the fiber Fredholm determinant at a distinguished flat momentum, valid for every quasimomentum K, obtained via a uniform elliptic reduction of the two-dimensional lattice integral. Second, we formulate and prove a general order-matching criterion. This criterion decides whether a leading-order Fredholm determinant asymptotic, with relative accuracy of order 1/mu, suffices to determine the constant-order additive correction in the strong-coupling energy, or if the next-order refinement is required. Applying the criterion at K = pi, we derive the complete strong-coupling ground-state asymptotics, including the coefficient of the order 1/mu term. The results are cross-validated against the exact closed-form benchmark and two independent high-precision numerical schemes. Furthermore, we determine the corresponding spectral gap and prove an exact Fredholm-determinant underestimation factor equal to 2. Additionally, we independently confirm that the previously established K = 0 constant is correctly derived and requires no analogous refinement. Finally, we compare the orders of asymptotic precision controlled across recent lattice few-body models and draw a structural parallel with the parity classification of topological band structures.

AI.title_translation: 格子三玻色子三聚体强耦合Birman-Schwinger分析的一致椭圆约化、阶数匹配准则与精度基准
AI.tldr: 本文通过一致椭圆约化和阶数匹配准则，建立了强耦合三玻色子格子三聚体的高精度渐近分析框架。
AI.motivation: 为了解决强耦合下三玻色子格子薛定谔算子在特殊拟动量下的渐近精度控制问题，填补现有强耦合Birman-Schwinger分析中关于高阶修正项确定机制的空白。
AI.method: 采用了一致椭圆约化（uniform elliptic reduction）将二维格子积分转化为闭式基准，建立了阶数匹配准则（order-matching criterion），并结合了两种独立的高精度数值方案进行交叉验证。
AI.result: 推导出了完整的强耦合基态渐近式（包含1/mu阶项的系数），证明了精确的Fredholm行列式低估因子为2，并确定了相应的谱隙。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功给出了强耦合三玻色子三聚体在例外拟动量下的精确渐近结果，确立了一致椭圆约化和阶数匹配准则，并通过多方验证确保了结果的准确性。
AI.translation: 我们研究了例外拟动量 K = pi 处三玻色子格子薛定谔算子的强耦合 Birman-Schwinger 分析。首先，通过二维格子积分的一致椭圆约化，我们给出了适用于任意拟动量 K 的特定平坦动量处纤维 Fredholm 行列式的精确闭式基准。其次，我们提出并证明了一个通用的阶数匹配准则。该准则用于判定具有相对精度阶 1/mu 的主阶 Fredholm 行列式渐近是否足以确定强耦合能量中的常数阶加性修正，或者是否需要更高阶的求精。通过在 K = pi 处应用该准则，我们推导出了完整的强耦合基态渐近式，包括 1/mu 阶项的系数。所得结果通过精确的闭式基准和两个独立的高精度数值方案进行了交叉验证。此外，我们确定了相应的谱隙，并证明了精确的 Fredholm 行列式低估因子等于 2。最后，我们独立证实了先前建立的 K = 0 常数推导正确且无需类似的求精，并比较了近期格子少体模型中所控制的渐近精度阶数，指出了与拓扑能带结构宇称分类的结构相似性。
AI.summary: 本文针对强耦合下的三玻色子格子薛定谔算子，通过一致椭圆约化导出了精确的闭式基准，并证明了用于判断是否需要高阶修正的阶数匹配准则，从而得到了完整的强耦合基态渐近结果并进行了高精度验证。
AI.keywords: Birman-Schwinger分析, 三玻色子系统, 格子薛定谔算子, 强耦合渐近, Fredholm行列式
AI.comments: 本文在强耦合三玻色子格子薛定谔算子的研究中取得了重要进展，通过一致椭圆约化、阶数匹配准则以及高精度数值验证，完善了Birman-Schwinger分析，对于理解少体系统谱性质具有重要理论价值。

title: Uniformly Stable Minimal Weyl--Heisenberg Measurements Approaching the SIC Benchmark
summary: Informational completeness (IC) guarantees that an inverse exists, not that it is statistically well conditioned. For minimal rank-one Weyl--Heisenberg (WH) measurements, covariance makes the nonidentity projector-Gram spectrum proportional to the fiducial's ambiguity intensities, with eigenvalues \(d|χ_φ(u)|^2\), turning stability into an explicit worst-direction design problem; write \(λ\) for its smallest nonidentity eigenvalue. Haar fiducials are IC almost surely while \(\mathbb E[λ^{-1}]=\infty\), and an explicit geometric family used to establish balanced informationally complete measurements in every dimension has a normalized spectral floor bounded above by an exponentially decaying envelope. We then construct a hierarchy of minimal measurements. A cyclic family with exactly \(d^2\) outcomes in every integer dimension has floors \(Θ(d^{-3})\) for odd \(d\) and \(Θ(d^{-5})\) for even \(d\); a finite-field family for \(q=2^m\) obeys the uniform bound \(λ\ge4/9\). Our main result treats every prime-power dimension of characteristic \(p\ge5\). A balanced one-coordinate perturbation repairs the zero ambiguity axis of a cubic Alltop state, gives an attained floor uniformly bounded below by a positive constant, and confines the entire nonidentity spectrum to \([L_q,U_q]\) with \(U_q/L_q\to1\). Its SIC-normalized minimum tends to one, and \(λ(φ_q)/Λ_q^\star\to1\) for the global finite-field WH max--min optimum \(Λ_q^\star\), without assuming SIC existence. The complete spectrum determines the exact finite-sample Hilbert--Schmidt error of canonical linear inversion at \(I/d\), while its lower edge controls local Fisher efficiency and canonical-shadow bounds.

AI.title_translation: 最小 Weyl-Heisenberg 测量在稳定性上接近 SIC 基准
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了几种新的最小 Weyl-Heisenberg (WH) 测量方法，特别是在素数幂维度下，其稳定性接近了量子信息理论中的 SIC (Symmetric Informationally Complete) 测量基准。研究表明，通过对立方 Alltop 态进行扰动，可以实现一个在整个频谱上都有下界的测量，并且该下界接近理论最优值，这对于提高量子态估计的精度和效率至关重要。
AI.motivation: 该研究的动机是寻找具有良好统计稳定性的最小 Weyl-Heisenberg (WH) 测量方法，特别是那些能够接近对称信息完全 (SIC) 测量的基准的测量方法。现有的信息完备性 (IC) 测量方法在统计上可能条件不佳，而 WH 测量方法的稳定性问题被转化为一个优化设计问题，需要关注其最小特征值。
AI.method: 该研究首先分析了最小秩一 Weyl-Heisenberg (WH) 测量方法的协方差特性，将其稳定性问题转化为一个最差方向设计问题，并引入了最小非恒定特征值 λ。在此基础上，研究人员构造了一系列最小测量方法：一种在所有整数维度下具有 d^2 个结果的循环族，以及一种用于有限域的族。对于特征为 p≥5 的素数幂维度，研究人员提出了一种平衡的单坐标扰动方法，修复了立方 Alltop 态的零模糊轴，实现了频谱的下界，并使频谱比趋近于 1。
AI.result: 对于特征为 p≥5 的素数幂维度，该研究构建的测量方法实现了正的下界，整个非恒定频谱被限制在 [Lq, Uq] 区间内，且 Uq/Lq 趋近于 1。其 SIC 归一化的最小值趋近于 1，并且最小-最大最优值 λ(φq)/Λq* 趋近于 1，而无需假设 SIC 的存在。该测量方法的完整频谱可以确定标准线性逆估计的精确有限样本 Hilbert-Schmidt 误差，其频谱下限控制着局部 Fisher 效率和标准阴影界。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功构建了一系列在素数幂维度下具有良好统计稳定性的最小 Weyl-Heisenberg (WH) 测量方法，其性能接近 SIC 测量基准。通过对立方 Alltop 态进行扰动，实现了频谱的均匀下界和频谱比的优化，证明了在不依赖 SIC 存在性的前提下，可以达到接近理论最优的测量性能。这些结果为提高量子信息处理的精度和效率提供了新的理论基础。
AI.translation: 信息完备性（IC）保证了逆的存在，但不能保证其统计条件良好。对于最小秩一 Weyl-Heisenberg（WH）测量，协方差使得非恒定投影图的 Gram 谱与特征值的模糊强度成正比，特征值为 d|χ_φ(u)|^2，将稳定性转化为一个明确的最差方向设计问题；用 λ 表示其最小的非恒定特征值。Haar 特征几乎肯定地是信息完备的，而 E[λ^{-1}]=∞，并且用于在每个维度中建立平衡信息完备测量的显式几何族具有一个由指数衰减包络之上限的归一化谱下限。然后，我们构造了一个最小测量值的层级。在每个整数维度中恰好有 d^2 个结果的循环族，对于奇数 d 其下限为 Θ(d^{-3})，对于偶数 d 其下限为 Θ(d^{-5})；对于 q=2^m 的有限域族，其服从均匀下界 λ≥4/9。我们的主要结果处理了特征为 p≥5 的每个素数幂维度。一个平衡的单坐标扰动修复了立方 Alltop 态的零模糊轴，给出了一个被正数下界均匀限制的下界，并将整个非恒定谱限制在 [L_q, U_q] 内，其中 U_q/L_q→1。其 SIC 归一化的最小值趋近于 1，并且对于全局有限域 WH 最大-最小最优值 Λ_q^*，λ(φ_q)/Λ_q^*→1，而无需假设 SIC 的存在。完整频谱确定了在 I/d 处的标准线性逆估计的精确有限样本 Hilbert-Schmidt 误差，而其下限控制着局部 Fisher 效率和标准阴影界。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一系列新的最小 Weyl-Heisenberg (WH) 测量方法，旨在提高信息完备性测量的统计稳定性。研究特别关注了素数幂维度下的情况，通过对立方 Alltop 态进行单坐标扰动，成功构建了一种测量方法，其频谱下界被正数均匀限制，且频谱比趋近于 1。该方法在统计稳定性上接近了 SIC 测量的基准，并且其性能指标（如最小-最大最优值）趋近于理论最优值。此外，该测量方法的频谱特性还能够精确确定线性逆估计的误差，并控制局部 Fisher 效率和阴影界。
AI.keywords: Weyl-Heisenberg 测量,对称信息完全测量,统计稳定性,量子测量设计,素数幂维度
AI.comments: 该研究在理论上取得了显著进展，特别是在素数幂维度下构建了接近 SIC 基准的最小 WH 测量方法，解决了长期存在的统计稳定性问题。然而，实际应用中这些方法的实现复杂度和计算成本可能较高，需要进一步的研究来评估其在实际量子设备中的可行性。

title: Two-Stage Deformable-Convolutional Inverse Design of Nanophotonic Absorbers from Optical Spectra
summary: Data-driven inverse design enables efficient generation of nanophotonic structures with prescribed optical responses, but spectrum-to-geometry mapping remains challenging due to non-uniqueness and fine geometric features. This work presents a two-stage deformable-convolutional framework for reconstructing metal--insulator--metal resonator geometries from 80-dimensional absorption spectra. The spectrum is projected to a $150\times4\times4$ latent representation and decoded into a $64\times64$ resonator mask. Training combines supervised reconstruction with least-squares adversarial refinement initialized from the best supervised checkpoint. A three-run ablation compares deformable convolution with plain convolution, involution, Dynamic Conv, and ODConv under the same architecture. The proposed model achieves $20.79\pm0.31$~dB PSNR and $0.8501\pm0.0082$ SSIM, improving over plain convolution by 2.16~dB and 0.0831, respectively. It further achieves Dice $0.9623\pm0.0027$, IoU $0.9342\pm0.0038$, and boundary F-score $0.9550\pm0.0027$. Spectral consistency evaluated using a frozen forward surrogate yields RMSE $0.0805\pm0.0013$ and $R^2=0.7923\pm0.0065$. Learned offsets show stronger adaptive sampling at coarse and intermediate decoder stages. Overall, deformable sampling with supervised initialization and adversarial refinement improves spectrum-conditioned geometry reconstruction.

AI.title_translation: 基于光学光谱的纳米光子吸收器两阶段可变形卷积逆设计
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用两阶段可变形卷积和对抗训练从光学光谱高精度重建纳米光子谐振器几何结构的方法。
AI.motivation: 尽管数据-driven逆设计能够高效生成具有规定光学响应的纳米光子结构，但由于光谱到几何映射存在非唯一性和精细几何特征，该映射仍然具有很大挑战。
AI.method: 提出一个两阶段可变形卷积框架，将光谱投影到潜在表示并解码为谐振器掩膜，结合了监督重建与初始化自最佳监督检查点的最小二乘对抗精细化训练。
AI.result: 模型实现了 20.79 dB PSNR 和 0.8501 SSIM，比普通卷积分别提高了 2.16 dB 和 0.0831；Dice 系数达到 0.9623，IoU 为 0.9342，边界 F-score 为 0.9550，光谱一致性 RMSE 为 0.0805，$R^2$ 为 0.7923。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于两阶段可变形卷积与对抗精细化的框架能够高精度地从光学光谱重建金属-绝缘体-金属谐振器几何结构，显著优于传统普通卷积方法。
AI.translation: 数据驱动的逆设计能够高效生成具有规定光学响应的纳米光子结构，但由于非唯一性和精细的几何特征，光谱到几何结构的映射仍然充满挑战。本工作提出了一种两阶段可变形卷积框架，用于从80维吸收光谱重建金属-绝缘体-金属谐振器几何结构。光谱被投影到一个 $150\times4\times4$ 的潜在表示中，并解码为一个 $64\times64$ 的谐振器掩膜。训练结合了监督重建与由最佳监督检查点初始化的最小二乘对抗精细化。三次消融实验在相同架构下比较了可变形卷积与普通卷积、involution、Dynamic Conv以及ODConv。所提出的模型实现了 $20.79\pm0.31$ dB PSNR 和 $0.8501\pm0.0082$ SSIM，分别比普通卷积提高了 2.16 dB 和 0.0831。它还实现了 $0.9623\pm0.0027$ 的 Dice、$0.9342\pm0.0038$ 的 IoU 以及 $0.9550\pm0.0027$ 的边界 F-score。使用冻结的前向替代模型评估的光谱一致性产生了 $0.0805\pm0.0013$ 的 RMSE 和 $R^2=0.7923\pm0.0065$。学习到的偏移量在解码器的粗糙和中间阶段显示出更强的自适应采样。总体而言，具有监督初始化和对抗精细化的可变形采样改善了光谱条件下的几何结构重建。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种两阶段可变形卷积框架，用于从光学光谱逆向设计纳米光子吸收器结构，通过结合监督重建与对抗精细化，实现了高精度的几何结构重建。
AI.keywords: 纳米光子学逆设计, 可变形卷积, 光谱到几何映射, 生成对抗网络, 金属-绝缘体-金属谐振器
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将两阶段可变形卷积架构应用于纳米光子学吸收器的逆向设计，有效克服了传统光谱到几何结构映射中的非唯一性与精细特征恢复难题。消融实验充分验证了可变形卷积相较于普通卷积及其他变体的优越性。

title: CoQui: A Coordinate-Conditioned Quantum Implicit Generative Adversarial Network for End-to-End Image Generation
summary: Quantum generative adversarial networks (QGANs) have attracted increasing attention for image generation using parameterized quantum circuits. Existing amplitude-based approaches face two key limitations: pixel locations are typically encoded by computational-basis indices or address qubits, causing quantum resources to grow with image resolution; meanwhile, jointly decoding many pixels from normalized quantum states introduces probability competition among pixels and limits precise pixel-wise control. To address these issues, we reformulate quantum image generation as coordinate-conditioned implicit function learning. Our method takes spatial coordinates and latent variables as inputs, uses a classical embedding network to generate input-dependent circuit parameters, and evaluates a variational quantum circuit at each coordinate. Pixel intensities are directly obtained from the expectation value of a dedicated color qubit, and a complete image is generated by querying all spatial coordinates. This design decouples image resolution from address-qubit requirements and avoids shared probability-normalization constraints across pixels. We further design a specialized variational quantum circuit to provide structural inductive bias for coordinate-conditioned generation. Simulated experiments on two benchmark datasets show that our method outperforms FRQI-based generation and PQWGAN in visual and quantitative quality while using fewer qubits, and also achieves better generation quality than the corresponding classical baseline.

AI.title_translation: CoQui：用于端到端图像生成的坐标条件量子隐式生成对抗网络
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为CoQui的新型量子隐式GAN，通过坐标条件生成和参数化量子电路，在减少量子比特的同时实现了高质量的端到端图像生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于振幅的量子生成对抗网络（QGAN）存在两个主要局限：一是像素位置编码导致量子资源随图像分辨率增长；二是联合解码多个像素会导致像素间的概率竞争，限制了精确的像素级控制。
AI.method: 提出CoQui方法，将空间坐标和潜变量作为输入，通过经典嵌入网络生成依赖于输入的电路参数，在每个坐标处评估变分量子电路，并通过专用颜色量子比特的期望值直接获取像素强度。
AI.result: 在两个基准数据集上的模拟实验表明，该方法在视觉和定量质量上均优于基于FRQI的生成方法和PQWGAN，且使用更少的量子比特，同时实现了比相应经典基线更好的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: CoQui方法通过坐标条件量子隐式对抗生成网络，成功解耦了图像分辨率与地址量子比特的需求，并在模拟实验中展现出优于现有量子及经典基线方法的性能。
AI.translation: 量子生成对抗网络（QGANs）在使用参数化量子电路进行图像生成方面受到了越来越广泛的关注。现有的基于振幅的方法面临两个主要局限性：像素位置通常由计算基指数或地址量子比特编码，导致量子资源随图像分辨率增长；同时，从归一化量子状态中联合解码许多像素会引入像素间的概率竞争，并限制了精确的像素级控制。为了解决这些问题，我们将量子图像生成重新构想为坐标条件隐式函数学习。我们的方法将空间坐标和潜变量作为输入，使用经典的嵌入网络生成输入依赖的电路参数，并在每个坐标处评估变分量子电路。像素强度直接从专用颜色量子比特的期望值中获得，通过查询所有空间坐标生成完整图像。这种设计将图像分辨率与地址量子比特需求解耦，并避免了像素间共享的概率归一化约束。我们进一步设计了一种专门的变分量子电路，为坐标条件生成提供结构归纳偏置。在两个基准数据集上的模拟实验表明，我们的方法在使用更少量子比特的同时，在视觉和定量质量上均优于基于FRQI的生成方法和PQWGAN，并且实现了比相应的经典基线更好的生成质量。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了CoQui，一种坐标条件量子隐式生成对抗网络，用于端到端图像生成。通过将量子图像生成重新构想为坐标条件隐式函数学习，该方法解耦了图像分辨率与地址量子比特的需求，避免了像素间的概率竞争，并在模拟实验中取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.keywords: 量子生成对抗网络, 隐式神经表示, 图像生成, 参数化量子电路, 坐标条件生成
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将量子图像生成与坐标条件隐式神经表示相结合，有效解决了传统QGAN中量子资源随分辨率剧增以及像素概率竞争的问题，具有很高的研究价值。

title: Hamilton-Zero: A Neural Tensor-Network Foundation Model for Ground States of Arbitrary Quadratic Qubit Hamiltonians
summary: A central promise of useful quantum advantage is the ability to compute ground states of Hamiltonian systems beyond the reach of classical simulation methods. Here we demonstrate that this problem can be effectively amortized across an arbitrary and universal set of Hamiltonians by a foundation model with $\sim0.5$B variational parameters, trained with contemporary techniques from large language models and deep reinforcement learning. To do this, we formulate $\text{spin-}1/2$ quantum ground-state learning as manifold variational optimisation over centrally odd scalar functions on $\mathrm{SU}(2)^N$. This replaces explicit Hilbert-space vector amplitudes with manifold functions on which the Hamiltonian acts through Lie derivatives, evaluated by custom automatic differentiation primitives. We prove that the resulting variational principle on this manifold preserves the $\text{spin-}1/2$ sector's ground-state upper bound using the Peter-Weyl theorem, then pre-train our foundation model on a dataset of hundreds of thousands of different Hamiltonian systems, varying the connection topology, system size, interaction types and strengths, bringing together a century of many-body literature. Using a novel $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ replica-exchange Langevin sampler and sharded natural-gradient optimisation, we train our model with our own extension of the Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (KFAC) optimiser on system sizes up to 64 qubits. On a held-out generalisation dataset, we fine-tune our model on system sizes of up to 1024 qubits, and evaluate on systems up to 8100 qubits.

AI.title_translation: Hamilton-Zero：用于任意二次量子比特哈密顿量基态的神经张量网络基础模型
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Hamilton-Zero的约5亿参数神经张量网络基础模型，通过流形变分优化和先进的深度学习技术，成功求解高达8100个量子比特的量子基态。
AI.motivation: 传统经典模拟方法在计算超越其能力的哈密顿量系统基态时存在巨大局限，因此迫切需要开发一种能够跨越任意通用哈密顿量集合、实现高效计算的量子基础模型。
AI.method: 将自旋-1/2量子基态学习表述为$\mathrm{SU}(2)^N$上奇标量函数的流形变分优化；利用Lie导数评估哈密顿量作用；结合$\mathrm{SU}(2)$副本交换朗之万采样器、分片自然梯度优化以及扩展的KFAC优化器对约5亿参数的神经张量网络基础模型进行预训练和微调。
AI.result: 成功预训练了包含约5亿变分参数的基础模型，支持多达64个量子比特的系统训练，并在保留的泛化数据集上微调至高达1024个量子比特，最终在高达8100个量子比特的系统上进行了评估。
AI.conclusion: Hamilton-Zero成功展示了利用大模型技术和神经张量网络解决大规模任意量子哈密顿量基态计算的强大能力，为量子多体物理的研究开辟了新的基础模型路线。
AI.translation: 实现有用的量子优势的一个核心承诺是能够计算超出经典模拟方法能力的哈密顿系统基态。在此，我们证明了通过一个拥有约5亿变分参数的基础模型，利用来自大语言模型和深度强化学习的现代技术进行训练，这个问题可以跨越任意且通用的哈密顿量集合得到有效摊销。为此，我们将自旋-1/2量子基态学习表述为$\mathrm{SU}(2)^N$上中心奇标量函数的流形变分优化。这用流形函数代替了显式的希尔伯特空间向量振幅，哈密顿量通过Lie导数作用于这些函数，并通过自定义自动微分原语进行评估。我们证明了该流形上产生的变分原理利用Peter-Weyl定理保持了自旋-1/2扇区的基态上限，然后在包含数十万个不同哈密顿系统的数据集上预训练了我们的基础模型，这些系统改变了连接拓扑、系统大小、相互作用类型和强度，汇集了一个世纪的多体文献。利用新颖的$\mathrm{SU}(2)$副本交换朗之万采样器和分片自然梯度优化，我们使用我们自己扩展的Kronecker因子近似曲率（KFAC）优化器在高达64个量子比特的系统大小上训练了我们的模型。在保留的泛化数据集上，我们将模型微调到高达1024个量子比特的系统大小，并在高达8100个量子比特的系统上进行了评估。
AI.summary: 论文提出了Hamilton-Zero——一个包含约5亿参数的神经张量网络基础模型，用于求解任意二次量子比特哈密顿量的基态。通过将量子基态学习转化为$\mathrm{SU}(2)^N$上的流形变分优化，并结合深度学习与强化学习训练技术，该模型成功扩展至高达8100个量子比特的系统，展现了强大的泛化与求解能力。
AI.keywords: 量子基态, 基础模型, 神经张量网络, $\mathrm{SU}(2)$流形, 变分优化
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种名为Hamilton-Zero的基础模型，通过结合大语言模型和深度强化流派的现代技术，利用约5亿参数的神经张量网络解决任意二次量子量子比特哈密顿量的基态计算问题。创新性地将量子基态学习表述为流形变分优化，突破了传统经典模拟方法的限制，并在高达8100个量子比特的系统上进行了评估，具有里程碑式的意义。

title: Nonisomorphic Graphs Can Share an Arbitrarily Large Fraction of Their Vertex-Deleted Cards
summary: For a graph $G$, its vertex deck is the multiset of graphs obtained by deleting one vertex. Bowler, Brown, and Fenner (BBF) proposed $2\lfloor(n-1)/3\rfloor$ as the maximum possible overlap between the decks of two nonisomorphic $n$-vertex graphs, for all sufficiently large $n$. We first give an explicit pair of connected nonisomorphic graphs on $78$ vertices with at least $51$ common cards, exceeding BBF's predicted value of $50$. We then construct, for every even $r\ge4$, families at arbitrarily large orders whose overlap fraction is asymptotically at least $1-1/r$. Consequently, for every $α<1$, infinitely many pairs have more than $αn$ common cards, so the attainable fraction is arbitrarily close to the full deck. For representative instances, the predicted overlaps were also checked by complete deck generation and isomorphism testing with Brendan McKay's nauty tools.

AI.title_translation: 非同构图可以共享其顶点删减卡片中任意大比例的部分
AI.tldr: 非同构图可以共享任意接近1的顶点删减卡片比例，从而推翻了先前的预测。
AI.motivation: 检验和挑战Bowler、Brown和Fenner（BBF）关于两个非同构n顶点图之间卡片最大可能重叠数的预测。
AI.method: 通过构造一个含78个顶点的显式连通非同构图对（具有51个公共卡片），并利用渐近构造方法为每个偶数r构建在大阶数下重叠分数至少为1-1/r的图族。使用nauty工具进行了验证。
AI.result: 找到了78个顶点且有51个公共卡片的显式非同构图对（超过预测的50），并证明对于任意α<1，存在无穷多图对的公共卡片超过αn，重叠比例可任意接近完整卡片。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了非同构图可以共享其顶点删减卡片中任意大比例的公共卡片，反驳了先前的猜想，对图重构领域具有重要贡献。
AI.translation: 对于一个图 $G$，其顶点卡片集是通过删除一个顶点所得到的子图的多重集。Bowler、Brown和Fenner (BBF) 曾提出，对于所有足够大的 $n$，两个 $n$ 顶点非同构图的卡片集之间的最大可能重叠数为 $2\lfloor(n-1)/3\rfloor$。我们首先给出了一个由78个顶点组成的显式连通非同构图对，它们至少有51个公共卡片，超过了BBF预测的50。接着，对于每个偶数 $r\ge4$，我们构造了在任意大阶数下重叠分数渐近至少为 $1-1/r$ 的图族。因此，对于每个 $\alpha<1$，存在无穷多的图对具有超过 $\alpha n$ 个公共卡片，从而使得可达到的重叠比例可以任意接近完整卡片。对于具有代表性的实例，所预测的重叠也通过Brendan McKay的nauty工具进行了完整的卡片生成和同构测试验证。
AI.summary: 本文研究了图的顶点卡片重叠问题，构造了78个顶点的显式非同构图对超越了先前的最大重叠预测，并证明了非同构图可以共享任意接近1的顶点卡片比例。
AI.keywords: 图重构猜想, 顶点卡片, 非同构图, 重叠分数
AI.comments: 本文推翻了此前关于非同构图顶点删减卡片最大重叠数的经典预测，通过构造出具有极高重叠比例的非同构图族，推进了对图重构猜想（Reconstruction Conjecture）边界的理解。创新性在于提供了显式反例和渐近构造。

title: Causal inference for group-contaminated structured outcomes: observable quotients, lossless reduction and exact randomization inference
summary: Structured potential outcomes such as microscopy images may be recorded after an unknown, unit-specific transformation. If that transformation can depend on treatment, covariates or the intrinsic outcome, raw-coordinate analyses may mix biological effects with acquisition geometry. We study the unrestricted observation model X = Γ . Y(A) and characterize its observable information: a target is uniformly recoverable exactly when it is constant on group orbits, while a Borel maximal invariant retains every measurable invariant target. We then distinguish observability from statistical losslessness. A quotient-faithful reconstruction theorem shows that quotient reduction is sufficient for the full transformed experiment exactly when the conditional law of the raw observation given treatment, covariates and the quotient has a parameter-free version. Conditional Haar contamination on a compact group yields Blackwell equivalence as a special case; it is not imposed in the main model. We also separate independent site-specific product actions from shared diagonal actions and show why componentwise canonicalization can discard relative cross-site information. Under explicit metric and kernel regularity, an approximate-contamination theorem bounds quotient-law Wasserstein error and the induced perturbation of population maximum mean discrepancy. For finite-support multichannel lattice images, we construct a maximal invariant under integer translations and quarter turns, combine its characteristic Gaussian kernel with a complete paired-swap test, and retain the original simulations and RxRx1 HUVEC study. Under the sharp null, the quotient test rejected in 0.052 of simulation replicates; at unit effect strength its power was 0.992. The primary RxRx1 contrast had an enumerated paired-swap p-value of 0.0078.

AI.title_translation: 群污染结构化结果的因果推断：可观测商、无损约简与精确随机化推断
AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对群污染结构化结果（如图像）的因果推断方法，通过群商约简和精确随机化检验，消除了未知几何变换带来的干扰，在理论和实际细胞图像分析中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 结构化潜在结果（如显微图像）可能在未知单位特定变换下记录，而该变换可能依赖于处理、协变量或内在结果，导致原始坐标分析将生物效应与采集几何混淆，因此需要发展一种能够滤除此类几何污染的严谨因果推断方法。
AI.method: 研究了无约束观测模型，刻画了可观测信息，证明了商忠实重建定理，推导了近似污染定理，并针对有限支撑多通道格子图像构建了平移和旋转的不变性特征以及完整的成对交换检验。
AI.result: 在模拟实验中，强零假设下的拒绝率为0.052，效应强度为1时的统计功效达到0.992；在RxRx1 HUVEC实际研究中，枚举的成对交换p值为0.0078。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入群商约简与精确随机化推断，该研究成功解决了群污染结构化结果的因果效应估计难题，兼具理论深度与极高的应用价值。
AI.translation: 结构化潜在结果（例如显微镜图像）可能是在经历了一个未知的、特定于单位的变换之后被记录的。如果该变换取决于处理、协变量或内在结果，那么原始坐标分析可能会将生物学效应与采集几何形状混淆。我们研究了无约束观测模型 $X = \Gamma \cdot Y(A)$ 并刻画了其可观测信息：当且仅当一个目标在群轨道上保持常数时，它才是均匀精确可恢复的，而一个Borel极大不变量则保留了所有可测的不变量目标。接着，我们区分了可观测性与统计上的无损性。一个商忠实重建定理表明，当且仅当给定处理、协变量和商的原始观测的条件律具有无参数版本时，商约简才足以应对完整的变换实验。紧凑群上的条件Haar污染作为特例导出了Blackwell等价性；它并未在主模型中被强加。我们还将独立的位置特定乘积作用与共享的对角作用区分开来，并展示了为什么分量规范化会丢弃相对的跨位置信息。在显式的度量和核正则性下，一个近似污染定理界定了商律的Wasserstein误差以及诱导出的总体最大均值差异的扰动。对于有限支撑的多通道格子图像，我们构建了在整数平移和四分之一转下的极大不变量，将其特征高斯核与一个完整的成对交换检验相结合，并保留了原始模拟和RxRx1 HUVEC研究。在尖锐零假设下，商检验在0.052的模拟重复中被拒绝；在单位效应强度下，其功效为0.992。主要的RxRx1对照具有0.0078的枚举成对交换p值。
AI.summary: 本文研究了群污染结构化结果的因果推断问题，提出了可观测商、无损约简和精确随机化推断方法。通过商忠实重建定理和近似污染定理，有效解决了由于未知几何变换导致的因果效应混淆，并在模拟和实际细胞图像数据中验证了方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 因果推断, 结构化结果, 群商约简, 随机化推断, 不变性理论
AI.comments: 该论文从群论和不变性理论出发，深刻剖析了具有群污染的结构化结果（如显微图像）的因果推断问题。其创新之处在于提出了无损约简和群商映射，有效规避了几何变换对生物效应的影响，在方法论和实际应用（如RxRx1 HUVEC数据集）中均展现出卓越的效能。

title: Latent variable models for simultaneous EOV identification and removal in population-based SHM
summary: The robust treatment of environmental and operational variability (EOV) is an open challenge in population-based structural health monitoring (PBSHM). The difficulty is compounded in the case that the EOV signals are unmeasured. A common approach in conventional SHM is to apply \emph{projection-based} methods that discard subspaces of healthy feature data, reasoning that the EOV signal dominates the variance of the measured features. However, a common pitfall of projection-based approaches is that when damage acts close to the same variance-dominant direction, damage sensitivity is removed along with the EOV. An alternative identifying assumption for the removal of particular unmeasured EOVs is slowness; the latent EOV process is characterised by its long temporal correlation. In this paper, the latent EOV is cast as a state-space Gaussian process, enabling tractable $\mathcal{O}(T)$ inference via a Kalman filter. A robust hierarchical Bayesian identification framework is developed that enables population-level identification of latent EOVs and EOV-free residual features, using a Laplace approximation. The approach is first validated on a single laboratory-scale benchmark structure from the literature, subject to thermal EOVs, demonstrating robust damage detection and EOV recovery. The method is then applied to a simulated nine-turbine offshore wind farm with staggered deployment and damage, where it delivers a substantial true-positive uplift over projection and cointegration-based baselines at matched false-positive rates.

AI.title_translation: 基于群体结构健康监测中同时识别和去除EOV的潜变量模型
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于潜变量模型和分层贝叶斯的框架，用于在群体结构健康监测中稳健地识别和消除未测量的环境与工变异，同时保留损伤检测能力。
AI.motivation: 在群体结构健康监测（PBSHM）中，处理未测量的环境与工变异（EOV）是一个公开的挑战。传统的基于投影的方法容易在去除EOV的同时滤除损伤敏感性，因此需要一种基于“缓慢变化”假设的新替代方法来同时识别和去除未测量的EOV。
AI.method: 将潜变量EOV建模为状态空间高斯过程，通过卡尔曼滤波器实现易处理的 $\mathcal{O}(T)$ 推理，并利用拉普拉斯近似开发了一个强大的分层贝叶斯识别框架，用于群体级的潜变量EOV识别和无EOV的残差特征提取。
AI.result: 在实验室热力EOV基准结构上验证了该方法，证明了其具有强大的损伤检测和EOV恢复能力；在模拟的九风机海上风电场应用中，在匹配的误报率下，该方法显著提升了真阳性率。
AI.conclusion: 该论文成功开发并验证了一个基于潜变量模型的群体级EOV识别与消除框架，在实验室基准结构和海上风电场模拟中均展现出优异的损伤检测和EOV恢复性能。
AI.translation: 群体结构健康监测（PBSHM）中环境与工变异（EOV）的鲁棒处理是一个公开的挑战。当EOV信号未被测量时，这种困难会加剧。传统SHM中的一种常见方法是应用“基于投影”的方法，丢弃健康特征数据的子空间，其理由是EOV信号主导了测量特征的方差。然而，基于投影的方法的一个常见陷阱是，当损伤作用于接近同一方差主导方向的位置时，损伤敏感性会随EOV一起被移除。用于移除特定未测量EOV的另一种识别假设是缓慢变化；潜在的EOV过程以其长期的时序相关性为特征。在本文中，潜变量EOV被构建为状态空间高斯过程，通过卡尔曼滤波器实现易处理的 $\mathcal{O}(T)$ 推理。开发了一个鲁棒的分层贝叶斯识别框架，使用拉普拉斯近似实现群体水平的潜变量EOV和无EOV残差特征的识别。该方法首先在文献中的单个实验室规模基准结构（受热力EOV影响）上进行了验证，证明了其稳健的损伤检测和EOV恢复能力。然后，该方法被应用于一个具有交错部署和损伤的模拟九风机海上风电场，在匹配的假阳性率下，它比基于投影和协整的基线实现了显著的真阳性提升。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种基于潜变量模型的群体结构健康监测新方法，利用状态空间高斯过程和分层贝叶斯框架，在未测量环境与工变异（EOV）的情况下实现了鲁棒的EOV识别与消除，并在实验和模拟风电场中证明了其优于传统投影和协整方法的性能。
AI.keywords: 群体结构健康监测, 环境与工变异, 潜变量模型, 状态空间高斯过程, 分层贝叶斯方法
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种基于潜变量模型的群体结构健康监测（PBSHM）框架，创新性地结合了状态空间高斯过程和分层贝叶斯方法，有效解决了未测量环境与工变异（EOV）的识别与消除问题，克服了传统投影方法容易误删损伤敏感特征的缺陷。

title: Beyond Local Power: Functional Connectivity Analysis for Subject-Independent Learning Style Recognition
comments: 7 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for publication at 4th IEEE International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Mechatronics Systems 2026
summary: Identifying individual learning styles optimizes pedagogical efficacy. While traditional questionnaires are structured, behavioral tracking methods require prolonged interaction log accumulation. To overcome these temporal constraints, this paper proposes an objective Electroencephalography (EEG) approach evaluating Phase Locking Value (PLV) connectivity against localized features across the Active-Reflective (AR) and Verbal-Visual (VV) Felder-Silverman dimensions. EEG signals were recorded from 28 participants during Raven's Advanced Progressive Matrices tasks. Support Vector Machine classification used Leave-One-Subject-Out Cross-Validation (LOSO-CV) alongside a 70:30 intra-subject split. The VV dimension achieved 70.00% subject-level accuracy driven by distinct fronto-occipital polarization. Conversely, the AR dimension yielded lower cross-subject generalizability (55.56%) due to overlapping executive networks and a "Systematic Neural Inversion" phenomenon, where stable individual connectivity signatures operated diametrically opposed to global boundaries (up to 20-0 voting margins). Ultimately, these outcomes demonstrate that rigid "one-size-fits-all" classifiers are bounded by biological diversity, emphasizing the need for future adaptive feature transformation techniques to bridge the cross-subject generalization gap.
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for publication at 4th IEEE International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Mechatronics Systems 2026

AI.title_translation: 超越局部功率：用于主题无关学习风格识别的功能连接分析
AI.tldr: 通过脑电图功能连接分析（PLV）来识别学习风格，发现视觉-言语维度具有较好的跨被试识别准确率，而主动-反射维度受限于神经反演现象。
AI.motivation: 传统学习风格识别依赖结构化问卷或需长期积累行为日志的时间受限方法，为此该论文旨在提出一种客观的脑电图（EEG）方法，通过评估相位锁定值（PLV）连接与局部特征，实现不依赖特定被试的学习风格识别。
AI.method: 招募了28名被试在完成瑞文高级推理矩阵任务时记录EEG信号；利用相位锁定值（PLV）评估功能连接；采用支持向量机（SVM）分类器结合留一被试交叉验证（LOSO-CV）和70:30的被试内划分进行分类。
AI.result: VV维度实现了70.00%的被试级准确率，主要由独特的额-枕极化驱动；而AR维度由于重叠的执行网络和“系统性神经反演”现象，跨被试泛化能力较低（55.56%）。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，基于EEG的VV维度识别具有良好的跨被试泛化能力，而AR维度的泛化受限于生物多样性与“系统性神经反演”现象，凸显了未来开发自适应特征转换技术的必要性。
AI.translation: 识别个体学习风格可优化教学效果。传统问卷具有结构性，而行为追踪方法需要长时间的交互日志积累。为了克服这些时间限制，本文提出了一种客观的脑电图（EEG）方法，在Felder-Silverman模型的主动-反射（AR）和言语-视觉（VV）维度上，评估相位锁定值（PLV）连接与局部特征。在被试完成瑞文高级推理矩阵任务时记录了28名参与者的EEG信号。支持向量机分类使用了留一被试交叉验证（LOSO-CV）以及70:30的被试内划分。VV维度在独特的额-枕极化驱动下实现了70.00%的被试级准确率。相反，由于重叠的执行网络和“系统性神经反演”现象（其中稳定的个体连接特征与全局边界截然相反，投票差额高达20-0），AR维度产生的跨被试泛化能力较低（55.56%）。最终，这些结果表明，僵化的“一刀切”分类器受到生物多样性的限制，强调了未来需要自适应特征转换技术来弥合跨被试泛化差距。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种基于脑电图相位锁定值（PLV）连接的主观无关学习风格识别方法，探讨了Felder-Silverman模型的Active-Reflective和Verbal-Visual两个维度。结果表明VV维度具有较好的跨被试准确率，而AR维度受限显著，突显了生物多样性对“一刀切”分类器的限制以及未来自适应特征转换的需求。
AI.keywords: 脑电图 (EEG), 学习风格识别, 功能连接, 相位锁定值 (PLV), 跨被试泛化
AI.comments: 该论文通过脑电图（EEG）功能连接分析（PLV）来识别个体学习风格，突破了传统问卷和行为追踪的局限。创新点在于探讨了跨被试识别的局限性并揭示了“系统性神经反演”现象，对未来自适应教育神经科学具有重要启发。

title: Adaptive Bregman Proximal Stochastic Gradient with a Stabilized Barzilai--Borwein Step Size
summary: Bregman proximal stochastic gradient (BPSG) methods bring variance-reduced composite optimization to objectives whose geometry is poorly captured by Euclidean smoothness. Their performance, however, remains sensitive to the step size: raw stochastic curvature estimates can fluctuate sharply, whereas line searches add repeated proximal evaluations. We introduce Ada-BPSG, a line-search-free BPSG method that couples the SAGA gradient table with a stabilized Barzilai--Borwein (BB) candidate. A mediant aggregates incremental secant information so that nearly singular local ratios receive little weight, and an explicit safeguard translates the resulting curvature estimate into the bounded step-size sequence required for convergence. This design yields a direct analytical chain from relative smoothness and component-wise variance control to convergence in finite-dimensional normed spaces. We prove an $O(n/K)$ ergodic rate for convex objectives, a restarted linear rate under relative quadratic growth, and an $O(1/K)$ bound for a Bregman proximal residual in the nonconvex setting. On logistic regression and sparse nonnegative matrix factorization, Ada-BPSG combines low objective values with substantially less sensitivity to the initial step size than standard variance-reduced baselines, while avoiding line search.

AI.title_translation: 具有稳定 Barzilai--Borwein 步长的自适应 Bregman 近端随机梯度法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需线搜索、对步长不敏感的自适应 Bregman 近端随机梯度优化方法 Ada-BPSG。
AI.motivation: Bregman近端随机梯度（BPSG）方法在处理非欧几里得几何特征的目标函数时表现出色，但其性能高度依赖于步长。原始的随机曲率估计容易剧烈波动，而线搜索则会导致重复的近端计算。为此，需要开发一种无需线搜索且对步长不敏感的自适应BPSG方法。
AI.method: 引入Ada-BPSG方法，结合SAGA梯度表与稳定化的Barzilai--Borwein（BB）候选步长，利用中位数（mediant）聚合增量割线信息，并采用显式保护机制将曲率估计转换为有界步长序列。
AI.result: 证明了在凸目标函数下具有 $O(n/K)$ 的遍历收敛率，在相对二次增长下具有重启的线性收敛率，以及在非凸设置下 Bregman 近端残差具有 $O(1/K)$ 的界。实验表明，在逻辑回归和稀疏非负矩阵分解中，Ada-BPSG 降低了对初始步长的敏感性并取得了较低的目标值。
AI.conclusion: Ada-BPSG方法通过结合SAGA梯度表和稳定化的Barzilai--Borwein步长，成功解决了Bregman近端随机梯度方法中的步长敏感性和线搜索开销问题，在理论和实验上均表现出色。
AI.translation: Bregman近端随机梯度（BPSG）方法将方差约减复合优化引入到几何特征无法被欧几里得平滑度很好捕捉的目标函数中。然而，它们的性能仍然对步长敏感：原始的随机曲率估计可能会剧烈波动，而线搜索则会增加重复的近端评估。我们引入了Ada-BPSG，这是一种无需线搜索的BPSG方法，它将SAGA梯度表与稳定化的Barzilai--Borwein（BB）候选步长相结合。中位数（mediant）聚合了增量的割线信息，使得接近奇异的局部比率权重很小，并且一个显式的保护机制将所得的曲率估计转化为收敛所需的有界步长序列。这种设计产生了从相对光滑性和分量方差控制到有限维赋范空间收敛性的直接分析链。我们证明了凸目标函数的 $O(n/K)$ 遍历收敛率、相对二次增长下的重启线性收敛率，以及非凸设置下Bregman近端残差的 $O(1/K)$ 界。在逻辑回归和稀疏非负矩阵分解上，Ada-BPSG结合了低目标值与比标准方差约减基准明显更低的初始步长敏感性，同时避免了线搜索。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 Ada-BPSG，一种无需线搜索的自适应 Bregman 近端随机梯度方法，它通过结合 SAGA 梯度表和稳定化的 Barzilai--Borwein 步长来提高优化性能，在保持低计算开销的同时显著增强了对初始步长的鲁棒性，并具备完善的理论收敛保证。
AI.keywords: Bregman proximal stochastic gradient, Barzilai--Borwein step size, variance reduction, relative smoothness, non-Euclidean optimization
AI.comments: 该论文针对Bregman近端随机梯度方法对步长敏感的问题，提出了一种无需线搜索的自适应方法，通过稳定的Barzilai--Borwein步长和中位数聚合策略，有效提高了算法的稳定性和对初始步长的鲁棒性，并在凸、相对二次增长及非凸设置下提供了严密的收敛性保证。

title: The SLT 2026 SmartGlasses Challenge: Benchmarking Egocentric Multi-Talker Speech Recognition and Understanding with Audio-Language Models
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) have created new opportunities for wearable speech interfaces, with smart glasses providing an egocentric platform for continuous audio sensing and assistance. However, speech recognition and understanding in this setting remain challenging because of dynamic acoustic conditions, speaker overlap, and the spatial ambiguity introduced by wearer-centered recording geometry. To support systematic evaluation in this setting, we introduce the IEEE SLT 2026 SmartGlasses Challenge for egocentric multi-speaker speech processing. The challenge consists of two tracks, Dyadic Dialogue Understanding and Multi-party Meeting Understanding, and jointly evaluates Time-Stamped Speaker-Attributed Automatic Speech Recognition (TSA-ASR) and Spoken Language Understanding (SLU). It is built on a 106-hour four-channel egocentric speech dataset containing 714 sessions collected in real-world scenarios. This paper describes challenge tasks, dataset construction, submissions, and summarizes the main findings from the shared evaluation. The results show that heavy speaker overlap remains a major factor affecting TSA-ASR performance, while paralinguistic acoustic understanding continues to be difficult for current audio-language models in complex SLU settings. Further details can be found on the official challenge website.

AI.title_translation: SLT 2026智能眼镜挑战赛：使用音频语言模型对第一人称视角多说话人语音识别与理解进行基准测试
AI.tldr: IEEE SLT 2026智能眼镜挑战赛引入了一个106小时的第一人称视角语音数据集，用于基准测试多说话人语音识别与理解，揭示了当前音频语言模型在重叠语音和复杂理解上的局限性。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型和多模态大模型取得了进展，但由于动态声学条件、说话人重叠以及佩戴者中心记录几何结构带来的空间模糊性，智能眼镜等可穿戴设备上的语音识别与理解仍然充满挑战，因此需要建立一个系统化的评估基准。
AI.method: 推出了包含两个赛道（双人对话理解和多方会议理解）的挑战赛，基于106小时的四通道第一人称视角语音数据集，联合评估时间戳说话人归属自动语音识别（TSA-ASR）与语音语言理解（SLU）。
AI.result: 评估结果表明，严重的说话人重叠仍然是影响TSA-ASR性能的主要因素，同时当前的音频语言模型在复杂的SLU设置中进行副语言声学理解依然非常困难。
AI.conclusion: IEEE SLT 2026智能眼镜挑战赛成功推动了第一人称视角多说话人语音处理的研究，实验表明重叠语音和复杂的SLU设置仍是当前音频语言模型面临的主要挑战。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）和多模态大模型（MLLMs）的最新进展为可穿戴语音接口创造了新的机遇，智能眼镜为持续音频感知和辅助提供了一个第一人称视角平台。然而，由于动态声学条件、说话人重叠以及佩戴者中心记录几何结构引入的空间模糊性，这种环境下的语音识别和理解仍然具有挑战性。为了支持该环境下的系统化评估，我们推出了IEEE SLT 2026第一人称视角多说话人语音处理智能眼镜挑战赛。该挑战赛包含两个赛道：双人对话理解和多方会议理解，并联合评估时间戳说话人归属自动语音识别（TSA-ASR）和语音语言理解（SLU）。它建立在一个包含714个会话、在真实场景中收集的106小时四通道第一人称视角语音数据集之上。本文描述了挑战赛任务、数据集构建、提交情况，并总结了共享评估的主要发现。结果表明，严重的说话人重叠仍然是影响TSA-ASR性能的主要因素，而当前的音频语言模型在复杂的SLU设置中进行副语言声学理解仍然很困难。更多详情可在官方挑战赛网站上查阅。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了IEEE SLT 2026智能眼镜挑战赛，旨在对第一人称视角下的多说话人语音识别与理解进行基准测试。挑战赛基于一个106小时的真实多通道语音数据集，分为双人对话和多方会议两个赛道，评估了TSA-ASR和SLU任务，并指出了当前音频语言模型在重叠语音和声学理解上面临的瓶颈。
AI.keywords: Smart Glasses, Egocentric Speech, Audio-Language Models, Multi-Talker Speech Recognition, Spoken Language Understanding
AI.comments: 该挑战赛聚焦于智能眼镜这一新兴可穿戴设备平台，针对真实场景下的第一人称视角多说话人语音识别与理解任务进行了基准测试。其创新点在于结合了时间戳说话人归属自动语音识别（TSA-ASR）与语音语言理解（SLU），并通过106小时的四通道真实数据集，指出了当前音频语言模型在处理重叠语音和副语言声学理解方面的局限性。

title: Direct Acceleration of Stochastic Root-Finding Without Variance Reduction and Regularization
summary: Acceleration for deterministic root-finding problems has been extensively studied in recent years; specifically, the anchor-based, or Halpern-type methods achieve optimal convergence rates with respect to the operator norm. However, acceleration via these methods does not directly carry over to stochastic setting due to accumulation of errors, unless one enforces diminishing variance via increasing batch sizes or variance reduction techniques. In this work, we show that another class of acceleration, namely the dual-anchor mechanism, extends to the stochastic setting without such error accumulation, in contrast to anchor-based algorithms. Consequently, we cleanly achieve $O(ε^{-3})$ complexity with iteration-independent batch size, without any variance reduction or double-loop recursive regularization, for stochastic root-finding (resp. fixed-point) problems with cocoercivity (resp. square-nonexpansivity) in expectation. For strongly monotone operators, the same algorithm attains a sharper $\widetilde{O} (ε^{-2})$ complexity, nearly matching the lower bound in terms of $ε$-dependence.

AI.title_translation: 无需方差缩减与正则化的随机求根直接加速
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需方差缩减和正则化的直接加速方法来解决随机求根问题，并达到了近乎最优的复杂度。
AI.motivation: 确定性求根问题的加速方法（如锚点基/Halpern型方法）由于误差累积无法直接应用于随机设置，除非采用增加批大小或方差缩减技术，而本文旨在探讨是否可以通过另一类加速机制（双锚点机制）在随机设置中避免误差累积。
AI.method: 利用双锚点机制（dual-anchor mechanism）处理随机求根问题，不依赖方差缩减技术、递增批大小或双循环递归正则化。
AI.result: 对于具有期望余强制性的随机求根（或不动点）问题，在迭代独立批大小下实现了 $O(ε^{-3})$ 的复杂度；对于强单调算子，算法达到了更尖锐的 $\widetilde{O} (ε^{-2})$ 复杂度，几乎匹配下界。
AI.conclusion: 通过双锚点机制，无需方差缩减和正则化即可直接加速随机求根和不动点问题，达到近乎最优的理论复杂度。
AI.translation: 近年来，确定性求根问题的加速得到了广泛研究；具体而言，基于锚点或Halpern型的方法在算子范数方面实现了最优收敛速率。然而，由于误差的累积，这些方法的加速无法直接推广到随机设置中，除非通过增加批大小或方差缩减技术来强制减小方差。在这项工作中，我们表明另一类加速机制（即双锚点机制）可以扩展到随机设置中，且不会出现这种误差累积，这与基于锚点的方法形成对比。因此，对于具有期望余强制性（resp. 平方非扩张性）的随机求根（resp. 不动点）问题，我们在不需要任何方差缩减或双循环递归正则化的前提下，采用与迭代无关的批大小，干净利落地实现了 $O(ε^{-3})$ 的复杂度。对于强单调算子，该算法获得了更尖锐的 $\widetilde{O} (ε^{-2})$ 复杂度，在 $ε$ 依赖性方面几乎匹配了下界。
AI.summary: 本文证明了双锚点机制可以直接扩展到随机求根问题中，从而在无需方差缩减、递增批大小或正则化的前提下，实现了对具有特定性质的随机求根和不动点问题的直接加速，并取得了近乎最优的收敛复杂度。
AI.keywords: 随机求根, 算法加速, 双锚点机制, 方差缩减, 复杂度界限
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将双锚点机制引入随机求根问题，摆脱了传统方法对方差缩减和正则化的依赖，简化了算法结构，并在理论上达到了近乎最优的复杂度。

title: Model-Consistent Structured-Hankel Matrix Completion for 3D Sparse Multi-frequency Electromagnetic Source Reconstruction
summary: Reconstruction of 3D electromagnetic currents from sparse, multi-frequency, far-field radiation data is severely ill-posed because sparse sampling masks specific current Fourier modes and the missing spectrum enlarges the null space of the forward operator. Although structured-Hankel completion can recover missing spectrum by exploiting the finite rate of innovations structure of a compactly supported geometrically sparse source, it treats current components independently without guaranteeing compatibility with the model. This often renders non-physical solutions that violate model consistency. To resolve this, we propose a training-free Maxwell-model-consistent 3D structured-Hankel framework (MC-Hankel) that alternates joint low-rank Hankel completion with an exact, closed-form projection onto the true Maxwell synthesis subspace while enforcing conjugate symmetry and noise-aware data fidelity. Across tests on two source models, three sparse sampling rates (30\%, 40\%, and 50\% of a Nyquist-sampled grid), and clean versus noisy (10 dB SNR additive white Gaussian noise) conditions, MC-Hankel consistently outperforms sub-sampled Fourier inversion, scale-normalized $\ell_1$-compressed sensing baseline, and the standard joint 3D annihilating filter-based low-rank Hankel matrix completion approach (ALOHA). Across all considered source-noise-sampling configurations, MC-Hankel improves mean peak SNR (PSNR) by 0.65-4.22 dB and tri-planer structural similarity (3D SSIM) by $0.0266$-$0.0703$, reduces relative full-volume $\ell_2$ reconstruction error by $7.4\%$-$38.9\%$, and brings non-physical model residuals down to machine precision over standard joint 3D ALOHA with merely 17\% computational overhead. Exact signed-rank tests are underpowered for five paired trials, so statistical conclusions are reported together with paired bootstrap intervals, effect sizes, and small-sample limitations.

AI.title_translation: 用于3D稀疏多频电磁源重建的模型一致性结构化汉克尔矩阵补全
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合麦克斯韦模型一致性的结构化汉克尔矩阵补全框架，用于高效、物理一致的3D稀疏电磁源重建。
AI.motivation: 3D电磁电流的重建由于稀疏采样和缺失频谱而严重病态。尽管结构化Hankel补全可以恢复缺失频谱，但它独立处理电流分量，无法保证与物理模型的兼容性，从而导致违反模型一致性的非物理解。
AI.method: 提出了一种无需训练的Maxwell模型一致性3D结构化汉克尔框架（MC-Hankel），该框架将联合低-rank Hankel补全与精确的、闭式投影交替进行，投影到真实的Maxwell合成子空间中，同时强制共轭对称性和噪声感知的数据保真度。
AI.result: 在多种源模型、稀疏采样率和噪声条件下，MC-Hankel在PSNR、3D SSIM和相对全量$\ell_2$重建误差方面均持续优于亚采样傅里叶反演、$\ell_1$压缩感知和标准ALOHA方法，同时将非物理模型残差降低到机器精度。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种无需训练的Maxwell模型一致性3D结构化汉克尔框架（MC-Hankel），在稀疏、多频电磁源重建中表现出卓越的准确性、物理一致性和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 从稀疏的多频远场辐射数据中重建3D电磁流是严重病态的，因为稀疏采样掩盖了特定的电流傅里叶模态，并且缺失的谱扩大了前向算子的零空间。尽管结构化Hankel补全可以通过利用紧支撑几何稀疏源的有限创新率结构来恢复缺失的谱，但它独立处理电流分量，无法保证与模型的兼容性。这通常会导致违反模型一致性的非物理解。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种无需训练的Maxwell模型一致的3D结构化Hankel框架（MC-Hankel），该框架将联合低秩Hankel补全与精确的、闭式投影交替进行，投影到真实的Maxwell合成子空间中，同时强制共轭对称性和噪声感知的数据保真度。在两个源模型、三个稀疏采样率（奈奎斯特采样网格的30%、40%和50%）以及干净与噪声（10 dB SNR加性高斯白噪声）条件下的测试中，MC-Hankel的表现始终优于亚采样傅里叶反演、尺度归一化的$\ell_1$压缩感知基线以及标准的基于联合3D消灭滤波器的低秩Hankel矩阵补全方法（ALOHA）。在所有考虑的源-噪声-采样配置中，相比标准联合3D ALOHA，MC-Hankel将平均峰值信噪比（PSNR）提高0.65-4.22 dB，三平面结构相似性（3D SSIM）提高0.0266-0.0703，相对全体积$\ell_2$重建误差降低7.4%-38.9%，并将非物理模型残差降至机器精度，仅带来17%的计算开销。精确符号秩检验对于五次配对试验来说检验力不足，因此统计结论与配对自助区间、效应量和小样本局限性一同报告。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为MC-Hankel的无需训练框架，用于3D稀疏多频电磁源重建。该方法通过将低秩汉克尔矩阵补全与麦克斯韦模型的一致性投影相结合，克服了传统方法产生非物理解的缺陷，在实验中展现出极高的重建精度和物理合理性。
AI.keywords: 电磁源重建, 结构化汉克尔矩阵补全, 麦克斯韦模型一致性, 压缩感知, 稀疏采样
AI.comments: 该论文针对3D稀疏多频电磁源重建问题，创新性地结合了结构化汉克尔矩阵补丁与麦克斯韦模型的一致性约束，提出了无需训练的MC-Hankel框架。该方法有效解决了传统方法产生的非物理学解问题，并在不同噪声和采样率下显著优于现有基线。

title: Parallel Machine Scheduling with a Singler Server and Loading-Unloading Operations
summary: This paper investigates a parallel machine scheduling problem featuring a single common server responsible for both loading and unloading operations. Each job consists of a unit-time loading operation, non-preemptive processing on one of \(m\) identical machines, and a unit-time unloading operation executed by the same server. The objective is to minimize the makespan. Unlike classical loading-only common-server models, our setting requires the server to handle an unloading operation immediately after a job's processing phase concludes. We prove that the corresponding decision problem is strongly NP-complete when the number of machines is given as part of the input. Furthermore, we analyse the worst-case performance of the List Scheduling (LS) and Longest Processing Time (LPT) heuristics. For three machines, we establish that Algorithm LS achieves an approximation ratio of at most \(5/2\). For an arbitrary fixed \(m \ge 3\), we show that the general LS bound approaches \(4-3/m\) as the number of jobs grows, whereas for Algorithm LPT, we prove the finite-instance ratio $3-\frac{2}{m}+\frac{(m-1)(m-2)}{mn}.$ Thus, for each fixed \(m\), the LPT bound approaches \(3-2/m\) as the number of jobs grows.

AI.title_translation: 带单一服务器和装卸操作的并行机调度
AI.tldr: 本文研究了带单一装卸服务器的并行机调度问题，证明了其强NP完全性，并分析了LS与LPT启发式算法的最坏情况性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的公共服务器模型通常只考虑装载操作，而实际生产中装卸操作往往是连续且不可分割的。为了更贴近现实并扩展经典模型，研究带有单一共享服务器且同时负责装卸操作的并行机调度问题。
AI.method: 通过理论分析研究决策问题的计算复杂性（证明强NP完全性），并分析列表调度（LS）和最长处理时间（LPT）启发式算法在不同条件下的最坏情况性能边界（近似比）。
AI.result: 证明了当机器数量作为输入时该决策问题是强NP完全的；对于3台机器，LS算法的近似比至关重要地不超过5/2；对于任意固定的$m \ge 3$，LS算法的界随作业数增长趋近于$4-3/m$，而LPT算法的界随作业数增长趋近于$3-2/m$。
AI.conclusion: 证明了该问题在机器数作为输入一部分时是强NP完全的，并通过理论分析得出了LS和LPT启发式算法在不同机器数和作业数下的渐近及有限实例的最坏情况性能界。
AI.translation: 本文研究了一个并行机调度问题，其特点是具有一个负责装载和卸载操作的单一公共服务器。每个作业由一个单位时间的装载操作、在$m$台相同机器之一上的非抢占式处理，以及由同一服务器执行的单位时间卸载操作组成。目标是最小化最大完工时间。与传统的仅有装载的公共服务器模型不同，我们的设定要求服务器在作业处理阶段结束后立即执行卸载操作。我们证明了当机器数量作为输入的一部分给出时，相应的决策问题是强NP完全的。此外，我们分析了列表调度（LS）和最长处理时间（LPT）启发式算法的最坏情况性能。对于三台机器，我们确立了LS算法的近似比至关重要地不超过$5/2$。对于任意固定的$m \ge 3$，我们证明了随着作业数量的增长，一般的LS界趋近于$4-3/m$，而对于LPT算法，我们证明了其有限实例比为$3-\frac{2}{m}+\frac{(m-1)(m-2)}{mn}$。因此，对于每个固定的$m$，随着作业数量的增长，LPT界趋近于$3-2/m$。
AI.summary: 本文研究了带有单一共享装卸服务器的并行机调度问题，旨在最小化最大完工时间。作者证明了该问题的强NP完全性，并分析了LS和LPT启发式算法在不同情况下的最坏性能保证。
AI.keywords: 并行机调度, 单一服务器, 装卸操作, 启发式算法, 最坏情况性能分析
AI.comments: 该论文研究了带单一服务器及装卸操作的并行机调度问题，拓展了传统的仅有装载操作的模型，证明了其强NP完全性，并给出了列表调度（LS）和最长处理时间（LPT）启发式算法的最坏情况性能分析。此研究在制造系统调度优化方面具有重要的理论价值。

title: The Advective Fisher-Rao Geometry of Deterministic Measure Transport
summary:
A novel advective Fisher-Rao metric is introduced for optimization tasks on paths of probability measures governed by the continuity equation. This metric is shown to lead to optimal descent directions.
  It is then shown that this metric arises naturally from three different perspectives: As the rescaled zero-noise limit of the Fisher-Rao metric on path measures, as the expected value of the second variation of the Freidlin--Wentzell large deviation rate functional, and as the Hessian of the Benamou--Brenier action functional from dynamic optimal transport.
  We supplement this geometric construction with computational experiments. Here, we demonstrate empirically that the advective Fisher-Rao metric yields the desired optimal fitting of probability densities, whereas the Gauss--Newton method yields optimal fitting of velocity fields.

title: Domain-Aware Lightweight Spectral-Grouped Convolutions for Hyperspectral Fish Freshness Classification
summary: Hyperspectral imaging (HSI) offers nondestructive assessment of fish freshness by detecting biochemical alterations across spectral bands. However, conventional deep learning approaches do not fully address the particular characteristics of HSI data, such as spectral dominance over spatial textures, ordinal label structure, and a small number of training samples. We propose SGNet (Spectral-Grouped Network), a lightweight architecture that separates spectral and spatial feature extraction using grouped convolutions and a depthwise spatial pathway. A dual attention mechanism that couples channel-wise squeeze-and-excitation with spatial gating adaptively highlights informative features. SGNet achieves 97.8% classification accuracy and 0.64 days mean absolute error (MAE) with just 4.75M parameters when tested on our newly developed 16-day refrigerator-stored salmon fillet dataset. Ablation studies validate the contribution of each component, while comparisons demonstrate a five- to eighteen-fold parameter reduction relative to ResNet-50 and Vision Transformers. Our findings indicate that domain-aware design supports precise, real-time freshness prediction for industrial implementation.

title: Capability-Adaptive Cryptanalysis with Reduced-Space Quantum Verification
summary: Efficient integration of cryptanalytic evidence with quantum verification remains a fundamental challenge in hybrid classical-quantum cryptanalysis. This work presents a capability-adaptive cryptanalytic framework that unifies linear cryptanalysis, differential cryptanalysis, and side-channel leakage analysis within a common candidate-space reduction architecture, followed by reduced-space quantum verification through amplitude amplification. A formal mathematical model is developed for candidate-space construction, adaptive filtering, verification-space reduction, and complexity characterization, supported by the oretical results establishing the relationship between candidate-space contraction and quantum verification effort. A Hamiltonian formulation is further introduced to provide a physically realizable interpretation of the reduced-space verification process. Evaluation using statistically generated cryptanalytic observations demonstrates that the proposed framework reduces an initial candidate-key hypothesis space of 4096 candidates to an effective candidate space of 13 hypotheses, corresponding to an overall reduction of approximately 99.683%. Consequently, the Grover verification requirement decreases from 50 iterations to only 2 iterations, yielding an approximately 25-fold reduction in verification effort, while reduced-space amplitude amplification achieves a target-state success probability of approximately 94.53%. These results demonstrate that adaptive cryptanalytic filtering can substantially reduce quantum verification complexity while preserving cryptanalytic admissibility, providing a practical foundation for capability-aware hybrid cryptanalysis and reduced-space quantum search.

title: How Organizations Use AI: Evidence from ChatGPT
summary: We study how organizations use frontier generative AI by linking ChatGPT Enterprise account records to usage, worker roles, task classifications, and public-company financial data through March 2026. These linked data enable a privacy-preserving analysis of adoption, worker roles, and message-level tasks at scale: for instance, the worker-level sample we analyze at the six-month adoption horizon includes over 1,500 organizations and over 17 million messages. We document four facts about enterprise AI adoption and use. First, ChatGPT Enterprise usage has grown rapidly due to a combination of new firm adoption and growing intensity among existing adopters. Second, U.S.-based public company adoption is concentrated among larger, more valuable, and more R&D- and SG&A-intensive firms. Third, active use within adopting firms spans job functions and seniority levels, with especially high usage intensity among early-career workers. Fourth, ChatGPT Enterprise usage encompasses a broad range of knowledge work tasks, including writing, technical work, communication, and information synthesis. In aggregate, these results suggest that firms differ widely in the speed, breadth and purpose of their enterprise AI adoption, and that they are still actively learning how to integrate AI into organizational workflows.

title: Regime-Gated Residual Mixture-of-Experts for Cross-Sectional Volatility Forecasting
summary: Financial volatility is regime dependent, yet incorporating regime information into neural networks can also destabilize training. This paper asks where such information should enter a neural cross-sectional volatility forecasting model. We study five-day realized-volatility forecasts for 1,027 U.S. equities using a rolling walk-forward evaluation framework in which information, model capacity, hyperparameter tuning, and random seeds are matched across architectures. We propose RG-ResMoE, a regime-gated residual mixture-of-experts architecture in which regime information is used only for expert routing rather than for direct forecasting. The base predictor models volatility from stock features, while a gating network uses regime state variables to route residual corrections. RG-ResMoE consistently outperforms a capacity-matched MLP in both forecasting accuracy and training stability in the main U.S. study. Similar gains are observed on an independent Japanese panel. The integration pathway is decisive: appending the same regime variables directly to the forecasting input degrades both predictive performance and training stability, whereas restricting them to the routing gate improves accuracy and Value-at-Risk calibration. Hard routing consistently underperforms soft routing. The results suggest that, in compact neural volatility forecasting models, the primary value of mixture-of-experts models lies less in increasing model capacity than in controlling how nonstationary regime information influences prediction.

title: Large Language Model-Driven Small-Capitalization Trading: Integrating Financial News Sentiment, Macroeconomic Indicators, and Technical Signals
summary: Large language models can extract richer signals from financial news than fixed sentiment lexicons, and recent work has explored feeding such signals into portfolio construction. We study an uncertainty-aware construction that feeds model-predicted risk -- decomposed into aleatoric and epistemic components -- directly into the covariance matrix of portfolio allocators, rather than treating portfolio risk as fixed or adjusting only expected returns. We evaluate the pipeline on Russell 2000 equities under three stock-selection regimes: a pure-alpha trigger that isolates abnormal stock moves not explained by macro indicators, a pure-beta trigger that captures macro-indicator moves before the stock itself fires, and a beta trigger in which both channels agree. Across the full holding-period grid, the separated pure-alpha and pure-beta legs usually dominate the beta intersection on Sharpe and return. Two horizons are especially informative. At one day, pure beta can work under low and moderate transaction costs because it captures immediate lead-lag spillovers from liquid macro and sector indicators into exposed small-cap stocks, but this advantage disappears at 100 bps when turnover and microstructure noise dominate. At 40 days, pure beta works for a different reason: slower macro repricing overtakes the firm-specific pure-alpha channel. The strongest conservative row is pure beta with GPT-4o mini sentiment, a Student-t target, a 40-day holding period, and risk parity allocation, reaching Sharpe 2.33 at 100 bps. The results suggest that stock-selection regime and allocator choice matter at least as much as the sentiment model, and that separating firm-specific and macro-exposure triggers is more informative than requiring both to fire simultaneously.

title: Un-EVIMO: Unsupervised Event-Based Independent Motion Segmentation
summary: Event cameras are a novel type of biologically inspired vision sensor known for their high temporal resolution, high dynamic range, and low power consumption. Because of these properties, they are well-suited for processing fast motions that require rapid reactions. Although event cameras have recently shown competitive performance in unsupervised optical flow estimation, performance in detecting independently moving objects (IMOs) is lacking behind, although event-based methods would be suited for this task based on their low latency and HDR properties. Previous approaches to event-based IMO segmentation have been heavily dependent on labeled data. However, biological vision systems have developed the ability to avoid moving objects through daily tasks without being given explicit labels. In this work, we propose the first event framework that generates IMO pseudo-labels using geometric constraints. Due to its unsupervised nature, our method can handle an arbitrary number of not predetermined objects and is easily scalable to datasets where expensive IMO labels are not readily available. We evaluate our approach on the EVIMO dataset and show that it performs competitively with supervised methods, both quantitatively and qualitatively.

title: Weak Correlations as the Underlying Principle for Linearization of Gradient-Based Learning Systems
comments: 41 pages; 10 pages main tex; 0 figures. Aviv Orly added new results requested by the ICLR reviewers after the discussion phase had ended
summary: Deep learning models, such as wide neural networks, can be conceptualized as nonlinear dynamical physical systems characterized by a multitude of interacting degrees of freedom. Such systems in the infinite limit, tend to exhibit simplified dynamics. This paper delves into gradient descent-based learning algorithms, that display a linear structure in their parameter dynamics, reminiscent of the neural tangent kernel. We establish this apparent linearity arises due to weak correlations between the first and higher-order derivatives of the hypothesis function, concerning the parameters, taken around their initial values. This insight suggests that these weak correlations could be the underlying reason for the observed linearization in such systems. As a case in point, we showcase this weak correlations structure within neural networks in the large width limit. Exploiting the relationship between linearity and weak correlations, we derive a bound on deviations from linearity observed during the training trajectory of stochastic gradient descent. To facilitate our proof, we introduce a novel method to characterise the asymptotic behavior of random tensors.

title: Sibson $α$-Mutual Information and Its Variational Representations
summary: Information measures can be constructed from Rényi divergences much like mutual information from Kullback-Leibler divergence. One such information measure is known as Sibson $α$-mutual information and has received renewed attention recently in several contexts: concentration of measure under dependence, statistical learning, hypothesis testing, and estimation theory. In this paper, we survey and extend the state of the art. In particular, we introduce variational representations for Sibson $α$-mutual information and employ them in each described context to derive novel results. Namely, we produce generalized Transportation-Cost inequalities and Fano-type inequalities. We also present an overview of known applications, spanning from learning theory and Bayesian risk to universal prediction.

title: Deep Activity Model: A Generative Approach for Human Mobility Pattern Synthesis
summary: Human mobility plays a crucial role in transportation, urban planning, and public health, but current approaches face important limitations. Existing deep learning models tend to overlook the semantic interdependencies among activities and households and rely on restricted GPS data, while activity-based models depend on rigid assumptions and extensive data, making them costly and difficult to adapt to new regions, especially those with limited conventional travel data. To address these limitations, we propose a generative Transformer model that uses socio-demographic and household attributes to synthesize daily activity chains, with a location module assigning spatial zones to produce complete daily trajectories. Trained on open-source and widely available household travel survey data and then fine-tuned with local data, the model captures national activity patterns and transfers effectively to California, Washington, and Mexico City. This approach offers potential for advancing synthetic human mobility modeling and provides urban planners and policymakers with improved tools for simulating transportation systems and supporting decisions in urban development and public health. Its practical utility is demonstrated through large-scale traffic simulations in Los Angeles County. Compared to the SCAG Activity-Based Model (ABM), the proposed method produces consistent spatial demand patterns, achieving an activity location cosine similarity of 0.997 and a network-level vehicle-miles-traveled Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 4.97%. Compared to real-world observations from Caltrans PeMS, the simulated traffic achieves MAPE of 5.85% for traffic volume and 4.36% for speed on California's I-405 corridor, presenting the practicality of learning-based synthetic mobility for regional simulation and planning.

title: A Tax-Subsidy Scheme for Efficient Investment in Renewable Generation Capacity
summary: The impact of energy production significantly affects system sustainability, which has enabled a shift towards renewable energy sources. Thus, producer behavior is crucial in electricity markets to achieve sustainability goals. In this paper, we address two key challenges comprising electricity markets and generation investment. Firstly, electricity markets typically are operated with competitive market clearing and merit-order dispatch, which neglects negative externalities from pollution. A Pigouvian tax is proposed in order to investigate the impacts of these externalities on electricity prices and resolve this issue. Secondly, renewable energy sources entail low operational costs, which result in lower system prices and reduced profits for producers. Furthermore, producers face high investment costs when moving into renewable energy resources, which leads to strategic investment decisions. In order to mitigate this strategic behavior, subsidies are proposed equal to producers' contribution to consumer surplus. These subsidies incentivize producers to decrease prices and increase consumer surplus, so, producers would be motivated to invest in socially optimal generation capacity. Finally, we demonstrate that implementing the proposed tax and subsidy does not increase the regulator's information burden.

title: Causal Agent based on Large Language Model
summary: The large language model (LLM) has achieved significant success across various domains. However, the inherent complexity of causal problems and causal theory poses challenges in accurately describing them in natural language, making it difficult for LLM to comprehend and use them effectively. Causal methods are not easily conveyed through natural language, which hinders LLM's ability to apply them accurately. Additionally, causal datasets are typically tabular, while LLM excels in handling natural language data, creating a structural mismatch that impedes effective reasoning with tabular data. To address these challenges, we have equipped the LLM with causal tools within an agent framework, named the Causal Agent, enabling it to tackle causal problems. The causal agent comprises tools, memory, and reasoning modules. In the tool module, the causal agent calls Python code and uses the encapsulated causal function module to align tabular data with natural language. In the reasoning module, the causal agent performs reasoning through multiple iterations with the tools. In the memory module, the causal agent maintains a dictionary instance where the keys are unique names and the values are causal graphs. To verify the causal ability of the causal agent, we established a Causal Tabular Question Answer (CausalTQA) benchmark consisting of four levels of causal problems: variable level, edge level, causal graph level, and causal effect level. CausalTQA consists of about 1.4K for these four levels questions. Causal agent demonstrates remarkable efficacy on the four-level causal problems, with accuracy rates all above 80\%. Through verification on the real-world dataset QRData, the causal agent is 6\% higher than the original SOTA. title: Priority based inter-twin communication in vehicular digital twin networks
comments: This is an Accepted Manuscript of an article published by Taylor & Francis Group in the International Journal of Parallel, Emergent & Distributed Systems on 02 Sep 2024
summary: With the advancement and boom of autonomous vehicles, vehicular digital twins (VDTs) have become an emerging research area. VDT can solve the issues related to autonomous vehicles and provide improved and enhanced services to users. Recent studies have demonstrated the potential of using priorities in acquiring improved response time. However, since VDT is comprised of intra-twin and inter-twin communication, it leads to a reduced response time as traffic congestion grows, which causes issues in the form of accidents. It would be encouraging if priorities could be used in inter-twin communication of VDT for data sharing and processing tasks. Moreover, it would also be effective for managing the communication overhead on the digital twin layer of the cloud. This paper proposes a novel priority-based inter-twin communication in VDT to address this issue. We formulate the problem for priorities of digital twins and applications according to their categories. In addition, we describe the priority-based inter-twin communication in VDT in detail and algorithms for priority communication for intra-twin and inter-twin are designed, respectively. Finally, experiments on different priority tasks are conducted and compared with two existing algorithms, demonstrating our proposed algorithm's effectiveness and efficiency.

title: A New First-Order Meta-Learning Algorithm with Convergence Guarantees
summary:
Learning new tasks by leveraging prior experience is a fundamental trait of intelligent systems. While Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML) is a leading approach, it suffers from significant computational and memory overhead due to the requirement of computing second-order meta-gradients. We propose \textbf{FO-B-MAML}, a novel first-order variant of MAML derived from a bi-level optimization perspective. Our framework introduces a new expression of the meta-gradient, defined as the derivative of the solution of a perturbed optimization problem. This formulation allows the meta-gradient to be estimated using various finite difference methods; in this work, we propose and analyze two simple yet effective estimators: a forward and a symmetric approximation.
  Unlike existing first-order methods like FO-MAML and Reptile, which suffer from irreducible bias, we prove that FO-B-MAML converges to a stationary point of the meta-objective. Notably, the symmetric estimator achieves an improved $\mathcal{O}(δ^{2/3})$ bias rate, strictly enhancing previous first-order theory. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the MAML objective violates standard smoothness assumptions; we show instead that its smoothness constant grows with the norm of the meta-gradient. This property theoretically justifies the use of normalized or clipped-gradient methods (SNGDM) over vanilla gradient descent.
  Our empirical results validate these advancements: FO-B-MAML achieves high accuracy, closely following second-order MAML performance. Crucially, our method bypasses the ``activation bottleneck'' of second-order approaches, maintaining a flat memory footprint even when scaling to deep, activation-heavy CNNs and Transformers.

title: ReXrank: A Public Leaderboard for AI-Powered Radiology Report Generation
summary: AI-driven models have demonstrated significant potential in automating radiology report generation for chest X-rays. However, there is no standardized benchmark for objectively evaluating their performance. To address this, we present ReXrank, https://rexrank.ai, a public leaderboard and challenge for assessing AI-powered radiology report generation. Our framework incorporates ReXGradient, the largest test dataset consisting of 10,000 studies, and three public datasets (MIMIC-CXR, IU-Xray, CheXpert Plus) for report generation assessment. ReXrank employs 8 evaluation metrics and separately assesses models capable of generating only findings sections and those providing both findings and impressions sections. By providing this standardized evaluation framework, ReXrank enables meaningful comparisons of model performance and offers crucial insights into their robustness across diverse clinical settings. Beyond its current focus on chest X-rays, ReXrank's framework sets the stage for comprehensive evaluation of automated reporting across the full spectrum of medical imaging.

title: Spherical Area-Preserving Parameterization via Energy Minimization
summary: We propose a novel method, called spherical authalic energy minimization (SAEM), for computing spherical area-preserving parameterizations of genus-zero closed surfaces, with strong theoretical foundations. The global convergence of the associated computational algorithm is theoretically guaranteed. In addition, we introduce a Riemannian bijective correction method that ensures the bijectivity of the resulting mapping under mild assumptions. Numerical experiments show that SAEM effectively minimizes area distortion and achieves bijective mappings, outperforming state-of-the-art methods. Finally, we demonstrate the practical utility of SAEM in shape description.
