AI.title_translation: RoboHarness：通过上下文自适应增强视觉-语言-动作模型鲁棒性的记忆增强策略框架
AI.tldr: RoboHarness是一个无需微调的记忆增强策略框架，通过双记忆检索、多模态归因与动态干预，显著提升了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）机器人在复杂环境下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型作为通用机器人控制器，在面对分布外（OOD）任务的感知噪声和环境变化时，由于缺乏长期记忆、因果失效归因和动态干预能力，其鲁棒性受到根本性限制。
AI.method: 提出RoboHarness框架，包含在线的双记忆RAG、归因驱动的视觉-语言编排器、可扩展的Model Context Protocol (MCP)干预，以及离线记忆巩固模块，无需对VLA策略进行参数微调。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-PRO和LIBERO-RoboHarness基准测试中，基于$\pi_0$、$\pi_{0.5}$和SmolVLA三个骨干模型，RoboHarness实现了平均绝对成功率提升56.6%，其中在长视距任务链条中实现了89.1%的显著绝对提升。
AI.conclusion: RoboHarness通过结合双记忆RAG、归因驱动的编排器和MCP干预，有效解决了VLA模型在OOD任务中的鲁棒性问题，并在多个基准测试中展现出巨大的性能提升。
AI.translation: 尽管视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型作为通用机器人控制器很有前景，但由于缺乏长期记忆、因果失效归因和动态干预能力，它们在分布外（OOD）任务中对感知噪声和环境变化的鲁棒性仍然受到根本性限制。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了RoboHarness，这是一个记忆增强策略 harness，它无需进行参数微调即可为冻结的VLA策略升级以实现鲁棒的上下文自适应。具体而言，RoboHarness通过对比式双记忆检索增强生成（RAG）的在线流水线、由多模态大模型实现的归因驱动视觉-语言编排器以及可扩展的模型上下文协议（MCP）干预来运行，同时离线记忆巩固模块将执行轨迹持续提炼为可靠的先验。在LIBERO-PRO和我们提出的LIBERO-RoboHarness基准测试中，对三个骨干模型（$\pi_0$、$\pi_{0.5}$和SmolVLA）进行的实验评估表明，RoboHarness实现了56.6%的平均绝对成功率增长。这包括在长视距任务链中89.1%的显著绝对提升。项目主页和源代码见 https://github.com/LZY-1021/RoboHarness。
AI.summary: 本文提出了RoboHarness，一个用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的记忆增强策略框架。它通过在线检索增强生成（RAG）、多模态大模型归因、模型上下文协议（MCP）干预以及离线记忆巩固，在不微调参数的情况下实现了强大的机器人上下文自适应和鲁棒性提升，大幅提高了长视距任务的成功率。
AI.keywords: Vision-Language-Action models, Robot robustness, In-context adaptation, Memory-augmented policy, Retrieval-Augmented Generation
AI.comments: 该论文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在分布外（OOD）任务中缺乏长期记忆和鲁棒性的痛点，提出了一种名为RoboHarness的记忆增强策略。其最大创新在于无需对底层VLA模型进行参数微调，便能通过在线检索、多模态大模型归因与MCP干预，以及离线记忆巩固实现高效的上下文自适应，实验效果提升显著。

title: Etna: An evaluation platform for property-based testing
summary:
Property-based testing is a mainstay of functional programming, boasting a rich literature, an enthusiastic user community, and an abundance of tools~ -- so many, indeed, that new users may have difficulty choosing. Moreover, any given framework may support a variety of strategies for generating test inputs; even experienced users may wonder which are better in any given situation. Sadly, the PBT literature, though long on creativity, is short on rigorous comparisons to help answer such questions.
  We present ETNA, a platform for empirical evaluation and comparison of PBT techniques. ETNA incorporates a number of popular PBT frameworks and testing workloads from the literature, and its extensible architecture makes adding new ones easy, while handling the technical drudgery of performance measurement.
  To illustrate its benefits, we use ETNA to carry out several experiments with popular PBT approaches in Rocq, Haskell, OCaml, Racket, and Rust, allowing users to more clearly understand best practices and tradeoffs.

AI.title_translation: Etna：一个用于属性测试的评估平台
AI.tldr: Etna是一个用于跨语言评估和比较属性测试（PBT）框架及策略的统一平台。
AI.motivation: 属性测试（PBT）工具和生成策略繁多，但文献中缺乏严格的经验比较来帮助新老用户在特定情况下选择最佳工具或策略。
AI.method: 开发了名为ETNA的评估平台，该平台整合了多个流行的PBT框架和测试工作负载，具有可扩展的架构并能处理性能测量的技术细节，并以此在多种编程语言中进行了实验。
AI.result: 使用ETNA平台在Rocq、Haskell、OCaml、Racket和Rust等语言中对流行的PBT方法进行了多项实验，帮助用户更清晰地了解最佳实践和性能权衡。
AI.conclusion: Etna平台通过提供可扩展的架构和跨语言的实验支持，成功解决了PBT领域缺乏严格经验对比的问题，帮助用户更好地理解不同测试策略和框架的优缺点。
AI.translation:
属性测试是函数式编程的中流砥柱，拥有丰富的文献、热情的用户群体以及大量的工具——工具之多，以至于新用户在选择时可能会感到困难。此外，任何给定的框架可能支持多种生成测试输入的策略；甚至经验丰富的用户也可能想知道在特定情况下哪种策略更好。遗憾的是，PBT文献虽然富有创造性，但缺乏严格的比较来帮助回答这些问题。
我们提出了ETNA，一个用于经验评估和比较PBT技术的平台。ETNA整合了文献中的许多流行PBT框架和测试工作负载，其可扩展的架构使得添加新框架变得容易，同时处理了性能测量的技术繁琐工作。
为了说明其好处，我们使用ETNA在Rocq、Haskell、OCaml、Racket和Rust中对流行的PBT方法进行了几项实验，使用户能够更清楚地了解最佳实践和权衡。
AI.summary: Etna是一个用于属性测试（PBT）技术的经验评估与比较平台，旨在解决PBT领域缺乏严格对比的问题。它整合了多种流行框架和工作负载，支持多语言实验，帮助用户理解不同测试策略的权衡。
AI.keywords: 属性测试, 评估平台, 函数式编程, 经验评估, 测试生成
AI.comments: 该论文针对属性测试（PBT）领域缺乏严格基准测试和比较的现状，推出了Etna评估平台。通过整合多种主流语言的PBT框架和测试工作负载，为开发者和研究人员评估PBT策略提供了标准化的工具，具有较高的实用价值和学术意义。

title: Diffusion-Guided Cooperative Policy Learning for Target Tracking Based on Underwater Mobile Agent Networks
summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) provides a promising solution for cooperative target tracking in networks of autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs). However, existing methods still face three major challenges: 1) policy non-stationarity caused by concurrent updates among multiple agents; 2) inefficient policy learning caused by the heterogeneous quality of experiences accumulated during exploration; and 3) policy drift between stochastic exploration and deterministic execution under dynamic underwater disturbances. To address these challenges, this paper develops a four-layer hierarchical MARL architecture comprising global training scheduling, multi-agent coordination, local policy generation, and real-time action execution. Building on this architecture, we propose a Supervised Diffusion-Aided MARL (SDA-MARL) algorithm with three closely coupled mechanisms. First, a dual-decision policy integrates a diffusion-based generative branch with a Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) branch, while segregated experience pools reduce training interference between the two branches. Second, a supervised sample-selection mechanism identifies high-quality tracking transitions and uses their actions to guide reverse diffusion, enabling the generative policy to concentrate on effective regions of the action space. Third, a behavioral-cloning loss transfers diffusion-generated actions to the deterministic DDPG Actor, thereby aligning exploration with execution and suppressing policy drift. Experiments conducted in six-degree-of-freedom underwater environments across multiple AUV-target configurations show that SDA-MARL achieves faster convergence, higher tracking accuracy, more consistent inter-AUV velocities, and shorter tracking paths than the compared MARL methods.

AI.title_translation: 基于水下移动智能体网络的目标跟踪扩散引导协同策略学习
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合扩散模型的监督式多智能体强化学习算法（SDA-MARL），解决了水下多AUV协同目标跟踪中的策略非平稳和策略漂移问题，实现了更快、更准的跟踪。
AI.motivation: 现有的多智能体强化学习方法在水下自主航行器网络协同目标跟踪中，面临并发更新导致的策略非平稳性、探索经验质量参差不齐导致的学习效率低下，以及动态水下干扰下随机探索与确定性执行之间的策略漂移这三大主要挑战。
AI.method: 开发了一个四层分层MARL架构，并提出了监督式扩散辅助MARL（SDA-MARL）算法，包含双决策策略、监督式样本选择机制以及行为克隆损失函数。
AI.result: 六自由度水下环境中的多重AUV-目标配置实验表明，SDA-MARL相较于对比的MARL方法，实现了更快的收敛速度、更高的跟踪精度、更一致的AUV间速度以及更短的跟踪路径。
AI.conclusion: SDA-MARL算法通过四层分层架构与三大紧密耦合机制，成功解决了水下动态环境中多AUV协同目标跟踪的策略非平稳、经验异质及策略漂移等挑战，实验验证了其卓越性能。
AI.translation: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）为自主水手航行器（AUV）网络中的协同目标跟踪提供了有前景的解决方案。然而，现有方法仍面临三大主要挑战：1）多个智能体并发更新导致的策略非平稳性；2）探索过程中积累的异质经验质量导致的低效策略学习；3）在动态水下干扰下，随机探索与确定性执行之间的策略漂移。为了应对这些挑战，本文开发了一个包含全局训练调度、多智能体协调、局部策略生成和实时动作执行的四层分层MARL架构。在此架构基础上，我们提出了一种具有三个紧密耦合机制的监督式扩散辅助MARL（SDA-MARL）算法。首先，双决策策略将基于扩散的生成分支与深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）分支相结合，同时隔离的经验池减少了两个分支之间的训练干扰。其次，监督样本选择机制识别高质量的跟踪转换，并利用其动作为反向扩散提供引导，使生成策略能够集中于动作空间的有效区域。第三，行为克隆损失将扩散生成的动作转移到确定性的DDPG演员网络中，从而使探索与执行保持一致，并抑制策略漂移。在多种AUV-目标配置的六自由度水下环境中进行的实验表明，与对比的MARL方法相比，SDA-MARL实现了更快的收敛速度、更高的跟踪精度、更一致的AUV间速度以及更短的跟踪路径。
AI.summary: 本文针对水下移动智能体网络中的协同目标跟踪问题，提出了一种监督式扩散辅助多智能体强化学习（SDA-MARL）算法。该算法采用四层分层架构，结合扩散生成分支与DDPG分支、监督式样本选择及行为克隆损失，有效解决了策略非平稳、经验异质和策略漂移等挑战，在水下实验中展现出显著的性能优势。
AI.keywords: 水下自主航行器 (AUV), 多智能体强化学习 (MARL), 协同目标跟踪, 扩散模型, 策略漂移
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种创新的扩散引导多智能体强化学习架构，有效应对了水下动态环境中的策略非平稳性、探索经验异质性和策略漂移问题，在水下移动智能体网络的目标跟踪任务中表现出优异的收敛速度和跟踪精度。

title: Evaluation and Hardening of LLM System Instructions Against Extraction via Encoding Attacks
comments: An earlier version of this manuscript will appear in the proceedings of IEEE Cyber-AI 2026 Conference. Project source code is available at https://github.com/Keysight/LLM-EncodeGuard
summary: System Instructions in Large Language Models (LLMs) are commonly used to enforce safety policies, define agent behavior, and protect sensitive operational context in agentic AI applications. These instructions may contain sensitive information such as API credentials, internal policies, and privileged workflow definitions, making system instruction leakage a critical security risk highlighted in the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. Without incurring the overhead costs of reasoning models, many LLM applications rely on refusal-based instructions that block direct requests for system instructions, implicitly assuming that prohibited information can only be extracted through explicit queries. We introduce an automated evaluation framework that tests whether system instructions remain confidential when extraction requests are re-framed as encoding or structured output tasks. Across seven common models and 46 verified system instructions, we observe high attack success rates (>0.7) for structured serialization where models refuse direct extraction requests but disclose protected content in the requested serialization formats. We further demonstrate a mitigation strategy based on one-shot instruction reshaping using a Chain-of-Thought reasoning model, indicating that even subtle changes in wording and structure of system instructions can significantly reduce attack success rate without requiring model retraining.
comment: An earlier version of this manuscript will appear in the proceedings of IEEE Cyber-AI 2026 Conference. Project source code is available at https://github.com/Keysight/LLM-EncodeGuard

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型系统指令的评估与加固，以防御通过编码攻击进行的提取
AI.tldr: 研究人员发现，即使大型语言模型（LLM）拒绝直接提取系统指令，它们仍然可能通过编码或结构化输出任务泄露敏感信息。他们开发了一个评估框架，并在七种模型中发现了高攻击成功率。他们还提出了一种基于“思维链”推理模型进行一次性指令重塑的缓解策略，该策略可以在不重新训练模型的情况下显著降低攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）的系统指令可能包含敏感信息，如API凭证和内部策略，因此系统指令泄露是一个关键的安全风险。许多LLM应用依赖于拒绝式指令来保护这些信息，但这种方法假设只有直接查询才会导致泄露。
AI.method: 开发了一个自动评估框架，用于测试在提取请求被重构为编码或结构化输出任务时，系统指令是否能保持机密性。随后，研究人员使用“思维链”推理模型展示了一种缓解策略，该策略通过一次性重塑指令来减少泄露。
AI.result: 在七种常见模型和46个已验证的系统指令上进行测试，发现结构化序列化攻击的成功率很高（>0.7），模型会拒绝直接提取请求，但在请求的序列化格式中泄露受保护的内容。指令重塑策略显著降低了攻击成功率。
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型（LLM）的系统指令容易受到编码和结构化输出任务的攻击，即使它们能拒绝直接提取。然而，通过使用“思维链”推理模型进行一次性指令重塑，可以在不进行模型重新训练的情况下，显著提高系统指令的安全性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）中的系统指令通常用于强制执行安全策略、定义代理行为以及保护代理AI应用程序中的敏感操作上下文。这些指令可能包含敏感信息，如API凭证、内部策略和特权工作流定义，使得系统指令泄露成为OWASP LLM应用程序Top 10所强调的关键安全风险。在不产生推理模型的高额成本的情况下，许多LLM应用程序依赖于拒绝式指令来阻止对系统指令的直接请求，并隐含地假设禁止信息只能通过显式查询来提取。我们引入了一个自动评估框架，用于测试当提取请求被重新构建为编码或结构化输出任务时，系统指令是否仍然保密。在七种常见模型和46个已验证的系统指令上，我们观察到结构化序列化攻击的高成功率（>0.7），模型会拒绝直接提取请求，但在所请求的序列化格式中会泄露受保护的内容。我们进一步展示了一种基于一次性指令重塑（使用思维链推理模型）的缓解策略，表明即使对系统指令的措辞和结构进行微妙的更改，也无需重新训练模型即可显著降低攻击成功率。
AI.summary: 本研究评估并加固了大型语言模型（LLM）的系统指令，以防御通过编码攻击进行的提取。研究发现，即使LLM拒绝直接提取指令，它们仍可能通过编码或结构化输出任务泄露敏感信息。研究人员开发了一个评估框架，并证明了指令重塑作为一种缓解策略的有效性，该策略可以在不重新训练模型的情况下显著降低攻击成功率。
AI.keywords: 系统指令,大型语言模型,安全风险,编码攻击,指令重塑
AI.comments: 这项研究揭示了LLM系统指令的一个重要安全漏洞，即它们容易受到编码和结构化输出任务的攻击。研究提出的评估框架和基于指令重塑的缓解策略具有实际意义，特别是考虑到其无需重新训练模型即可实现。然而，未来研究可以进一步探索更复杂的攻击向量以及更鲁棒的防御机制。

title: Social Meaning in Large Language Models: Structure, Magnitude, and Pragmatic Prompting
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly exhibit human-like patterns of pragmatic and social reasoning. This paper addresses two related questions: do LLMs approximate human social meaning not only qualitatively but also quantitatively, and can prompting strategies informed by pragmatic theory improve this approximation? To address the first, we introduce two calibration-focused metrics distinguishing structural fidelity from magnitude calibration: the Effect Size Ratio (ESR) and the Calibration Deviation Score (CDS). To address the second, we derive prompting conditions from two pragmatic assumptions: that social meaning arises from reasoning over linguistic alternatives, and that listeners infer speaker knowledge states and communicative motives. Applied to a case study on numerical (im)precision across three frontier LLMs, we find that all models reliably reproduce the qualitative structure of human social inferences but differ substantially in magnitude calibration. Prompting models to reason about speaker knowledge and motives most consistently reduces magnitude deviation, while prompting for alternative-awareness tends to amplify exaggeration. Combining both components is the only intervention that improves all calibration-sensitive metrics across all models, though fine-grained magnitude calibration remains only partially resolved. LLMs thus capture inferential structure while variably distorting inferential strength, and pragmatic theory provides a useful but incomplete handle for improving that approximation.

AI.title_translation: 大语言模型中的社会意义：结构、幅度和语用提示
AI.tldr: 大语言模型能准确模拟人类社会推理的结构，但在推断强度上存在偏差，结合说话者知识与动机的语用学提示可以有效改善这一校准问题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地展现出类人的语用和社会推理模式，但目前尚不清楚它们在数量上是否近似人类的社会意义，以及受语用学理论启发的提示策略是否能改善这种近似。
AI.method: 引入了两种校准聚焦的指标（效应量比率ESR和校准偏差分数CDS），并通过数值（不）精确性的案例研究，在三个前沿LLM上测试了基于语用学假设推导出的不同提示词条件。
AI.result: 所有模型都能可靠地重现人类社会推断的定性结构，但在幅度校准上存在实质性差异；提示模型推理说话者的知识和动机最能持续减少幅度偏差，而替代意识提示倾向于放大夸大，两者的结合是唯一能全面改善校准指标的干预措施。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型能够捕捉人类社会推断的结构，但在推断强度上存在扭曲；基于语用学的提示词可以部分改善这种幅度校准，但仍未完全解决。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地表现出人类般的语用和社会推理模式。本文解决了两个相关的问题：LLM是否不仅在定性上，而且在定量上近似人类的社会意义，以及受语用学理论启发的提示策略是否能改善这种近似？为了解决第一个问题，我们引入了两个关注校准的指标，它们区分了结构保真度与幅度校准：效应量比率（ESR）和校准偏差分数（CDS）。为了解决第二个问题，我们从两个语用学假设推导出了提示条件：社会意义产生于对语言替代方案的推理，以及听者推断说话者的知识状态和沟通动机。通过对三个前沿LLM的数值（不）精确性案例研究，我们发现所有模型都能可靠地重现人类社会推断的定性结构，但在幅度校准上存在实质性差异。提示模型推理说话者的知识和动机最能持续减少幅度偏差，而提示替代意识往往会放大夸大。结合这两个成分是唯一能改善所有模型中所有对校准敏感指标的干预措施，尽管细粒度的幅度 calibration 仍然只得到了部分解决。因此，LLM捕获了推论结构，同时可变地扭曲了推论强度，而语用学理论为改善这种近似提供了一个有用但不完整的抓手。
AI.summary: 该研究探讨了大语言模型在多大程度上能够从定性和定量上近似人类的社会意义推理。通过引入ESR和CDS两个量化指标以及应用语用学原理设计的提示词策略，发现在数值不精确性的案例中，LLM虽然能很好地捕捉推理的结构，但在推断强度（幅度）上存在畸变，且基于语用学的提示能够部分改善这种校准。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 社会意义, 语用学推理, 幅度校准, 提示词策略
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了ESR和CDS两个量化指标来评估大语言模型在社会意义推理方面的结构保真度与幅度校准，并通过语用学理论指导提示词设计，对理解和改进LLM的社会/语用推理能力具有重要价值。

title: On Data-Driven Koopman Representations of Nonlinear Delay Differential Equations
summary: This work establishes a rigorous bridge between infinite-dimensional delay dynamics and finite-dimensional Koopman learning, with explicit and interpretable error guarantees. While Koopman analysis is well-developed for ordinary differential equations (ODEs) and partially for partial differential equations (PDEs), its extension to delay differential equations (DDEs) remains limited due to the infinite-dimensional phase space of DDEs. We propose a finite-dimensional Koopman approximation framework based on history discretization and a suitable reconstruction operator, enabling a tractable representation of the Koopman operator via kernel-based extended dynamic mode decomposition (kEDMD). Deterministic error bounds are derived for the learned predictor, decomposing the total error into contributions from history discretization, kernel interpolation, and data-driven regression. Additionally, we develop a kernel-based reconstruction method to recover discretized states from lifted Koopman coordinates, with provable guarantees. Numerical results demonstrate reliable prediction of nonlinear delay systems, with potential relevance to future control applications.

AI.title_translation: 论非线性时滞微分方程的数据驱动Koopman表示
AI.tldr: 本文将Koopman算子理论严格扩展到非线性时滞微分方程（DDE），提出了基于kEDMD的有限维近似框架，并给出了可证明的误差界限。
AI.motivation: 虽然Koopman分析在常微分方程（ODE）和部分微分方程（PDE）中得到了很好的发展，但由于时滞微分方程（DDE）具有无限维相空间，其在DDE中的扩展仍然有限，因此需要建立严格的理论与计算桥梁。
AI.method: 提出基于历史离散化和适当重构算子的有限维Koopman近似框架，利用核扩展动态模态分解（kEDMD）实现易处理的表示，并发展了基于核的状态重构方法。
AI.result: 推导出了学习预测器的确定性误差界限（将总误差分解为历史离散化、核插值和数据驱动回归的贡献），开发了带可证明保证的核重构方法，并通过数值实验验证了对非线性时滞系统的可靠预测。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功建立了时滞微分方程与有限维Koopman学习之间的严格理论桥梁，提供了包含全方位误差界限和状态重构方法的实用框架。
AI.translation: 本研究建立了无限维时滞动力学与有限维Koopman学习之间的严格桥梁，并具有显式且可解释的误差保证。虽然Koopman分析针对常微分方程（ODE）和部分微分方程（PDE）的发展较为成熟，但由于时滞微分方程（DDE）具有无限维相空间，其在DDE中的扩展仍然受限。我们提出了一种基于历史离散化和适当重构算子的有限维Koopman近似框架，通过核扩展动态模态分解（kEDMD）实现了Koopman算子的易处理表示。推导了所学预测器的确定性误差界限，将总误差分解为历史离散化、核插值和数据驱动回归的贡献。此外，我们开发了一种基于核的重构方法，以从提升的Koopman坐标中恢复离散化状态，并具有可证明的保证。数值结果表明了对非线性时滞系统的可靠预测，对未来的控制应用具有潜在的关联性。
AI.summary: 本文针对非线性时滞微分方程（DDE），提出了一种基于历史离散化与kEDMD的有限维Koopman近似框架。研究推导了显式的确定性误差界限，并开发了状态重构方法，数值结果证明了其在非线性时滞系统预测中的有效性。
AI.keywords: Koopman算子, 时滞微分方程, 扩展动态模态分解, 误差界限, 数据驱动建模
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将Koopman算子理论扩展到无限维的时滞微分方程（DDE），通过历史离散化和核扩展动态模态分解（kEDMD），给出了显式且可解释的误差保证。这为处理复杂非线性时滞系统提供了一个强有力的数学框架和数据驱动工具。

title: BLADE: Better Language Answers through Dialogue and Explanations
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based educational assistants often provide direct answers offering little incentive for students to explore or engage with course materials. We present BLADE (Better Language Answers through Dialogue and Explanations), a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) based conversational assistant grounded in course-specific content that guides students toward relevant materials through citation-grounded dialogue rather than delivering unsourced solutions. We evaluate BLADE in an advanced undergraduate NLP course with extensive instructional resources, where locating and synthesizing relevant material is a central challenge. During quizzes, students are assigned to one of three conditions: BLADE only, direct course materials only, or both; we measure performance and resource usage. Results show that students consistently select BLADE over direct materials when both are available, and that quiz performance is highest when students use BLADE alone. In contrast, simultaneous use of both resources is associated with significantly lower performance, suggesting that combining modalities may introduce cognitive load without benefit. These findings show the potential of RAG-based assistants as a citation-grounded interface for applying course content under open-book exam-like conditions, while cautioning that adding direct-material access does not necessarily help, and may hinder, in-task performance.

AI.title_translation: BLADE：通过对话与解释获得更好的语言答案
AI.tldr: BLADE是一种基于RAG的教育对话助手，它不直接给答案，而是通过引文对话引导学生，经验证能显著提升学生的测验表现。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的教育助手通常直接给出答案，无法激励学生探索或参与课程材料，因此需要开发一种通过对话和引用指导学生寻找相关材料的系统。
AI.method: 开发了BLADE（一种基于检索增强生成RAG的对话式助手），并通过在一门高级本科自然语言处理（NLP）课程中进行测验评估，将学生随机分配到BLADE唯一、直接课程材料唯一、或两者结合的三种条件中，测量其表现和资源使用情况。
AI.result: 结果表明，当两种资源都可用时，学生更倾向于选择BLADE；仅使用BLADE时学生的测验成绩最高，而同时使用两类资源则会导致显著较低的成绩，暗示多模态结合可能在没有带来好处的同时引入了认知负荷。
AI.conclusion: 基于RAG的对话助手BLADE能够有效提升学生在开卷考试/测验中的表现并促进其对课程材料的探索，但盲目叠加直接材料访问可能会因认知负荷过高而阻碍任务表现。
AI.translation: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的教育助手通常提供直接答案，几乎无法激励学生探索或参与课程材料。我们提出了BLADE（通过对话与解释获得更好的语言答案），这是一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）的对话助手，以特定课程内容为基础，通过基于引用的对话引导学生寻找相关材料，而不是提供无来源的解决方案。我们在一个拥有丰富教学资源的高级本科NLP课程中评估了BLADE，在该课程中查找和综合相关材料是一个核心挑战。在测验期间，学生被分配到以下三种条件之一：仅限BLADE、仅限直接课程材料、或两者兼有；我们测量了表现和资源使用情况。结果表明，当两者都可用时，学生始终选择BLADE而不是直接材料，并且当学生单独使用BLADE时，测验表现最高。相比之下，同时使用这两种资源与显著较低的表现相关，这表明结合多种模态可能会引入认知负荷而没有好处。这些研究结果表明了基于RAG的助手作为在开卷考试类条件下应用课程内容的引用基础界面的潜力，同时也警告说，增加直接材料的访问不一定有帮助，甚至可能阻碍任务表现。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了BLADE，这是一种基于RAG的教育对话助手，旨在通过引文基础的对话引导学生学习而非直接给出答案。实验表明，使用BLADE能显著提高学生测验表现并受到学生青睐，但同时结合直接材料访问可能会由于认知负荷而阻碍表现。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 教育助手, 检索增强生成 (RAG), 引用溯源, 认知负荷
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将RAG技术应用于教育领域，通过引导式对话和引文溯源代替直接给答案，有效促进了学生的自主学习。实验设计严谨，揭示了信息过载（双重资源带来的认知负荷）对学生表现的负面影响，对未来智能教育助手的开发具有重要指导意义。

title: Significance and Stability Analysis of Genotype-Environment Interaction using GxEStat
summary: Genotype-environment (GxE) interactions can influence the performance of genotypes across diverse environments, limiting the reliability of genotype evaluation and selection in breeding programs. In-depth analysis of GxE interactions is therefore essential for understanding how genetic advantages or defects are expressed under varying environmental conditions and for identifying superior and stable genotypes. This study presents an integrated computational framework for GxE analysis that combines significance and stability evaluation within a unified analytical workflow. The framework incorporates the mixed effect modeling to quantify the significance of environment, genotype, and GxE effects, together with multiple stability analysis approaches for characterizing genotype adaptability, environmental representativeness, and performance consistency across environments. To support reproducible statistical analysis, we develop GxEStat, an interactive R platform that automates model construction, parameter estimation, statistical inference, and graphical visualization. GxEStat substantially improves analytical efficiency, reproducibility, and accessibility for multi-environment trial analysis. Applications to real breeding datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework for practical breeding research. Codes are available at https://github.com/mason-ching/GxEStat.

AI.title_translation: 基于GxEStat的基因型-环境互作显著性与稳定性分析
AI.tldr: 本文开发了名为GxEStat的R交互式平台，通过整合混合效应模型与稳定性分析，实现了高效、可重复的基因型-环境互作（GxE）评估。
AI.motivation: 基因型-环境（GxE）互作会影响基因型在不同环境下的表现，限制育种项目中基因型评估和选择的可靠性，因此需要深入分析以识别表现优异且稳定的基因型。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合混合效应模型（量化环境、基因型及GxE效应显著性）与多种稳定性分析方法（评估适应性、环境代表性和表现一致性）的综合计算框架，并开发了基于R的交互式平台GxEStat。
AI.result: 实际育种数据集的应用表明，该框架在实际育种研究中能有效评估基因型与环境的互作，GxEStat平台显著提高了多环境试验分析的分析效率、可重复性和可访问性。
AI.conclusion: GxEStat作为一个集成了显著性与稳定性分析的综合计算框架和R平台，能够有效简化多环境试验中GxE互作的分析流程，提高育种研究的效率与可靠性。
AI.translation: 基因型-环境（GxE）互作会影响基因型在不同环境下的表现，从而限制育种项目中基因型评估和选择的可靠性。因此，深入分析GxE互作对于理解遗传优势或缺陷在不同环境条件下的表达以及识别优良且稳定的基因型至关重要。本研究提出了一个集成计算框架，将显著性评估和稳定性评估结合在一个统一的分析工作流中。该框架结合了混合效应模型来量化环境、基因型和GxE效应的显著性，以及多种稳定性分析方法来表征基因型的适应性、环境代表性和跨环境的表现一致性。为了支持可重复的统计分析，我们开发了GxEStat，这是一个交互式R平台，可自动完成模型构建、参数估计、统计推断和图形可视化。GxEStat显著提高了多环境试验分析的分析效率、可重复性和可访问性。在实际育种数据集上的应用证明了该框架在实际育种研究中的有效性。代码可在 https://github.com/mason-ching/GxEStat 获取。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了GxEStat，一个用于基因型-环境（GxE）互作分析的集成计算框架与R平台。该平台结合了混合效应模型与多种稳定性分析方法，旨在评估基因型在多环境试验中的显著性、适应性和稳定性，从而提高育种选择的可靠性和分析效率。
AI.keywords: 基因型-环境互作, 混合效应模型, 稳定性分析, R平台, 育种研究
AI.comments: 该论文开发了一个名为GxEStat的R交互式平台，将混合效应模型与多种稳定性分析方法相结合，实现基因型-环境（GxE）互作的显著性和稳定性综合评估，有效提升了多环境试验分析的效率和可重复性。

title: Uncertainty as a Planning Signal: Multi-Turn Decision Making for Goal-Oriented Conversation
summary: Goal-oriented conversational systems require making sequential decisions under uncertainty about the user's intent, where the algorithm must balance information acquisition and target commitment over multiple turns. Existing approaches address this challenge from different perspectives: structured methods enable multi-step planning but rely on predefined schemas, while LLM-based approaches support flexible interactions but lack long-horizon decision making, resulting in poor coordination between information acquisition and target commitment. To address this limitation, we formulate goal-oriented conversation as an uncertainty-aware sequential decision problem, where uncertainty serves as a guiding signal for multi-turn decision making. We propose a Conversation Uncertainty-aware Planning framework (CUP) that integrates language models with structured planning: a language model proposes feasible actions, and a planner evaluates their long-term impact on uncertainty reduction. Experiments on multiple conversational benchmarks show that CUP consistently improves success rates while requiring fewer interaction turns. Further analysis demonstrates that uncertainty-aware planning contributes to more efficient information acquisition and earlier confident commitment.

AI.title_translation: 将不确定性作为规划信号：面向目标导向对话的多轮决策
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为CUP的新框架，利用不确定性作为引导信号来协调大语言模型与结构化规划，从而在目标导向对话中实现更高效的多轮决策。
AI.motivation: 现有的目标导向对话系统面临挑战：结构化方法依赖预定义模式，而大语言模型方法缺乏长远决策能力，导致在多轮对话中信息获取与目标确定之间的协调较差。为此，需要将不确定性作为多轮决策的引导信号。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为CUP（Conversation Uncertainty-aware Planning）的框架，将语言模型与结构化规划相结合：由语言模型提出可行操作，再由规划器评估这些操作对减少不确定性的长期影响。
AI.result: 在多个对话基准测试上的实验表明，CUP在减少交互轮次的同时，持续提高了任务成功率，且实现了更高效的信息获取和更早的自信承诺。
AI.conclusion: CUP框架通过将不确定性引入多轮决策规划，有效提升了目标导向对话系统的成功率并减少了交互轮次，实现了高效的信息获取与确信的目标承诺。
AI.translation: 目标导向对话系统需要在对用户意图不确定的情况下做出顺序决策，算法必须在多个轮次中平衡信息获取与目标承诺。现有方法从不同角度解决这一挑战：结构化方法能够进行多步规划但依赖于预定义的模式，而基于大语言模型的方法支持灵活的交互但缺乏长远决策能力，导致信息获取与目标承诺之间的协调较差。为了解决这一局限性，我们将目标导向对话构想为一个不确定性感知顺序决策问题，其中不确定性作为多轮决策的引导信号。我们提出了对话不确定性感知规划框架（CUP），它将语言模型与结构化规划结合起来：语言模型提出可行操作，规划器评估它们对减少不确定性的长期影响。在多个对话基准上的实验表明，CUP在需要更少交互轮次的同时，持续提高了成功率。进一步的分析表明，不确定性感知规划有助于更高效的信息获取和更早的自信承诺。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为CUP的对话不确定性感知规划框架，将大语言模型与结构化规划相结合，利用不确定性作为多轮决策的引导信号，以解决目标导向对话中信息获取与目标承诺协调不佳的问题。实验证明该方法能有效提升成功率并减少交互轮次。
AI.keywords: 目标导向对话, 不确定性感知, 序列决策, 大语言模型, 对话规划
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将不确定性作为规划信号，有机结合了传统结构化规划的长期决策优势与大语言模型的灵活交互能力，较好地解决了目标导向对话中信息获取与目标确定的平衡问题。

title: Weaves, Wires, and Morphisms: Formalizing and Implementing the Algebra of Deep Learning
summary: Despite deep learning models running well-defined mathematical functions, we lack a formal mathematical framework for describing model architectures. Ad-hoc notation, diagrams, and pseudocode poorly handle nonlinear broadcasting and the relationship between individual components and composed models. This paper introduces a categorical framework for deep learning models that formalizes broadcasting through the novel axis-stride and array-broadcasted categories. This allows the mathematical function underlying architectures to be precisely expressed and manipulated in a compositional manner. These mathematical definitions are translated into human manageable diagrams and machine manageable data structures. We provide a mirrored implementation in Python (pyncd) and TypeScript (tsncd) to show the universal aspect of our framework, along with features including algebraic construction, graph conversion, PyTorch compilation and diagram rendering. This lays the foundation for a systematic, formal approach to deep learning model design and analysis.

AI.title_translation: 编织、连线与同态：深度学习代数的形构与实现
AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个用于深度学习模型架构的范畴论形式化框架，解决了广播机制和模型组合的数学描述难题，并提供了跨语言的实现。
AI.motivation: 尽管深度学习模型运行着定义良好的数学函数，但目前缺乏用于描述模型架构的形式化数学框架；临时的符号、图表和伪代码难以处理非线性广播以及各个组件与组合模型之间的关系。
AI.method: 引入了一个基于范畴论的深度学习模型框架，通过新颖的轴-步幅（axis-stride）和数组广播（array-broadcasted）范畴来形式化广播机制，并提供了Python（pyncd）和TypeScript（tsncd）的镜像实现。
AI.result: 实现了将架构的底层数学函数精确表达和组合操作，能够转化为人类可读的图表和机器可管理的蓝图，并支持代数构造、图转换、PyTorch编译和图表渲染。
AI.conclusion: 该论文建立了一个系统化、形式化的深度学习模型设计与分析基础，通过范畴论解决了模型架构描述的难题。
AI.translation: 尽管深度学习模型运行着定义良好的数学函数，但我们仍缺乏用于描述模型架构的形式化数学框架。临时的符号、图表和伪代码很难处理非线性广播以及各个组件与组合模型之间的关系。本文引入了一个针对深度学习模型的范畴论框架，通过新颖的轴-步幅和数组广播范畴将广播机制形式化。这使得模型架构背后的数学函数能够以组合的方式被精确表达和操作。这些数学定义被转化为人类易读的图表和机器可管理的数据结构。我们在Python (pyncd) 和TypeScript (tsncd) 中提供了镜像实现，展示了我们框架的通用性，其特性包括代数构造、图转换、PyTorch编译和图表渲染。这为深度学习模型设计和分析的系统化、形式化方法奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于深度学习模型的范畴论框架，通过引入轴-步幅和数组广播范畴形式化了广播机制，从而能够精确地表达、组合和操作模型架构，并在Python和TypeScript中实现了该框架。
AI.keywords: 深度学习, 范畴论, 模型架构, 形式化验证, 数组广播
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了范畴论框架来对深度学习模型架构进行严格的数学建模，解决了长期以来深度学习缺乏统一形式化描述的问题，并在Python和TypeScript中实现了相应的工具，具有很高的理论与应用价值。

title: ReCodeAgent: A Multi-agent Workflow for Language-Agnostic Translation and Validation of Large-Scale Repositories
summary: Most repository-level code translation and validation techniques have been evaluated on a single source-target programming language (PL) pair, owing to the complex engineering effort required to adapt new PL pairs. Programming agents can enable PL-agnosticism in repository-level code translation and validation: they can synthesize code across many PLs and autonomously use existing tools specific to each PL's analysis. However, state-of-the-art has yet to offer a fully autonomous agentic approach for repository-level code translation and validation of large-scale programs. This paper proposes ReCodeAgent, an autonomous multi-agent approach for language-agnostic repository-level code translation and validation. Users only need to provide the project in the source PL and specify the target PL for ReCodeAgent to automatically translate and validate the entire repository. ReCodeAgent is the first technique to achieve high translation success rates across many PLs. We compare the effectiveness of ReCodeAgent with four alternative neuro-symbolic and agentic approaches to translate 118 real-world projects, with 1,975 LoC and 43 translation units for each project, on average. The projects cover 6 PLs and 4 PL pairs. Our results demonstrate that ReCodeAgent consistently outperforms prior techniques on translation correctness, improving test pass rate by 60.8% on ground-truth tests, with an average cost of $15.3. We also perform process-centric analysis of ReCodeAgent trajectories to confirm its procedural efficiency. Finally, we investigate how the design choices (a multi-agent vs. single-agent architecture) influence ReCodeAgent performance: on average, the test pass rate drops by 40.4%, and trajectories become 28% longer and persistently inefficient.

AI.title_translation: ReCodeAgent：一个用于大规模代码库语言无关翻译与验证的多智能体工作流
AI.tldr: ReCodeAgent 是首个多智能体代码库翻译与验证框架，能够跨多种编程语言自动化进行大规模代码转译，其测试通过率较现有方法提升了 60.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有的代码库级代码翻译与验证技术大多局限于单一的源-目标编程语言对，因为适配新语言对需要复杂的工程投入。虽然编程智能体有潜力实现语言无关的代码翻译，但目前尚缺乏一种完全自主的、适用于大规模程序的大语言模型多智能体方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 ReCodeAgent 的自主多智能体方法。用户提供源语言项目和目标语言，ReCodeAgent 利用多智能体工作流自主完成整个代码库的翻译与验证，并结合特定语言的分析工具。
AI.result: 在包含 6 种编程语言、4 个语言对、118 个真实项目（平均每个项目 1,975 行代码、43 个翻译单元）的测试中，ReCodeAgent 的测试通过率比现有技术提高了 60.8%，平均成本为 15.3 美元。与单智能体架构相比，多智能体架构的测试 pass rate 提高了 40.4%，且轨迹更短、效率更高。
AI.conclusion: ReCodeAgent 是首个实现多编程语言支持的代码库级自主代码翻译与验证框架。实验表明，它在翻译正确性和测试通过率上显著优于现有方法，同时验证了多智能体架构在复杂编程任务中的关键作用。
AI.translation: 大多数代码库级别的代码翻译和验证技术由于适配新的编程语言对需要复杂的工程投入，通常仅在单一的源-目标编程语言（PL）对上进行评估。编程智能体可以实现代码库级别代码翻译和验证的语言无关性：它们能够跨多种 PL 合成代码，并自主使用针对每个 PL 分析的具体现有工具。然而，最先进的技术尚未提供一种完全自主的智能体方法来进行大规模程序的代码库级代码翻译和验证。本文提出了 ReCodeAgent，这是一种用于语言无关的代码库级代码翻译和验证的自主多智能体方法。用户只需提供源 PL 中的项目并指定目标 PL，ReCodeAgent 即可自动翻译和验证整个代码库。ReCodeAgent 是第一项在许多 PL 中实现高翻译成功率的技术。我们将 ReCodeAgent 的有效性与四种替代的神经符号学和智能体方法进行了比较，这些方法用于翻译 118 个真实世界的项目，平均每个项目有 1,975 行代码（LoC）和 43 个翻译单元。这些项目涵盖了 6 种 PL 和 4 种 PL 对。我们的结果表明，ReCodeAgent 在翻译正确性上始终优于先前技术，在基准测试上的测试通过率提高了 60.8%，平均成本为 15.3 美元。我们还对 ReCodeAgent 的执行轨迹进行了以过程为中心的分析，以确认其程序效率。最后，我们研究了设计选择（多智能体与单智能体架构）如何影响 ReCodeAgent 的性能：平均而言，单智能体架构的测试通过率下降了 40.4%，执行轨迹变长了 28% 且持续低效。
AI.summary: ReCodeAgent 是一个自主的多智能体工作流，旨在实现大规模代码库的语言无关代码 translation 和 validation。通过多智能体协作，该方法能够跨多种编程语言自动化完成代码转译与测试，并在真实项目评估中显著超越现有技术，展示了卓越的翻译正确性与效率。
AI.keywords: 代码翻译, 多智能体, 语言无关, 软件工程, 大语言模型
AI.comments: ReCodeAgent 提出了一种新颖的多智能体工作流，能够实现跨多种编程语言的代码库级代码翻译与验证。其创新之处在于通过多智能体协作替代了传统的单对语言定制化开发，显著提升了翻译的正确性和成功率，且具备较好的经济成本优势。消融实验也证实了多智能体架构相较于单智能体架构的优越性。

title: TEMPER: Testing Emotional Perturbation in Quantitative Reasoning
comments: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026. 30 pages, 4 figures, 29 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/atahandokme/temper-5400 Code: https://github.com/atahandokme/temper-colm2026
summary: Large language models are trained and evaluated on quantitative reasoning tasks written in clean, emotionally neutral language. However, real-world queries are often wrapped in frustration, urgency or enthusiasm. Does emotional framing alone degrade reasoning when all numerical content is preserved? To investigate this, a controlled emotion translation framework is developed that rewrites problems into emotional variants while preserving all quantities and relationships. Using this framework, Temper-5400 (5,400 semantically verified emotion-neutral pairs) is constructed across GSM8K, MultiArith, and ARC-Challenge, and evaluated on eighteen models (1B to frontier scale). Two core results emerge: First, emotional framing reduces accuracy by 2-10 percentage points even though all numerical content is preserved. Second, neutralizing emotional variants recovers most of the lost performance, showing both that the degradation is tied to emotional style rather than content corruption and that neutralization can serve as a lightweight inference-time mitigation. Non-emotional paraphrases cause no such degradation, implicating emotional content rather than surface-level changes. Beyond emotion specifically, the benchmark construction procedure offers a controllable instrument for stylistic translation and robustness evaluation.
comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026. 30 pages, 4 figures, 29 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/atahandokme/temper-5400 Code: https://github.com/atahandokme/temper-colm2026

AI.title_translation: TEMPER：测试定量推理中的情感扰动
AI.tldr: 研究发现情绪化的提示词包装会使大语言模型的定量推理准确率下降2-10个百分点，但通过情绪中和可以恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 现实世界的查询通常包含挫折、紧迫感或热情等情绪，而大语言模型主要在清洁、情感中立的语言上进行训练和评估，因此需要研究仅情绪化框架是否会在保留所有数字内容的情况下降低模型的推理能力。
AI.method: 开发了一个受控的情感转换框架，将定量推理问题重写为情绪变体（保持数量和关系不变），构建了包含5,400对语义验证的中性-情绪样本对的Temper-5400基准，并在18个不同规模的模型上进行了评估。
AI.result: 情绪化框架导致准确率下降了2-10个百分点，而中和情绪变体可以恢复大部分失去的性能；相比之下，非情感的复述不会引起这种性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 情绪化 framing 会显著损害大语言模型在量化推理任务上的性能，但这种退化可以通过轻量级的情绪中和方法有效恢复，证明了该现象是由情绪风格而非内容损坏引起的。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型在用干净、情感中立的语言编写的定量推理任务上进行训练和评估。然而，现实世界的查询往往包裹着沮丧、紧迫或热情。当所有的数字内容都被保留时，单凭情感框架是否会降低推理能力？为了调查这一点，开发了一个受控的情感转换框架，将问题重写为情感变体，同时保留所有的数量和关系。使用这个框架，构建了 Temper-5400（跨越 GSM8K、MultiArith 和 ARC-Challenge 的 5,400 个语义验证的中性-情感对），并在十八个模型（从 1B 到前沿规模）上进行了评估。得出了两个核心结果：首先，尽管保留了所有的数字内容，情感框架仍使准确率降低了 2-10 个百分点。其次，中和情感变体恢复了大部分丢失的性能，这表明性能退化与情感风格而非内容损坏有关，并且中和可以作为一种轻量级的推理时缓解措施。非情感释义不会引起这种退化，这暗示了情感内容而不是表面变化。除了具体的情感之外，基准构建过程为风格转换和鲁棒性评估提供了一个可控的工具。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了情绪化语言对大语言模型定量推理能力的影响，开发了情感转换框架并构建了Temper-5400基准。研究发现，尽管数字内容保持不变，但情绪化包装会导致模型准确率下降2-10个百分点，而通过情绪中和可以恢复大部分性能。
AI.keywords: 定量推理, 大语言模型, 情绪扰动, 鲁棒性评估, 情感转换框架
AI.comments: 该论文切入点新颖，关注大语言模型在真实场景中常遇到的情绪化指令问题，通过构建Tempr-5400基准，揭示了单纯情绪化包装对量化推理能力的负面影响，并提出了轻量级的推理时缓解策略（情绪中和），具有很高的实用价值和学术启发意义。

title: Robotic Manipulation is Vision-to-Geometry Mapping: Vision-Geometry Backbones over Language and Video Models
summary: At its core, robotic manipulation is a problem of vision-to-geometry mapping ($f(v) \rightarrow G$). Physical actions are fundamentally defined by geometric properties like 3D positions and spatial relationships. Consequently, we argue that the foundation for generalizable robotic control should be a vision-geometry backbone, rather than the widely adopted vision-language or video models. Conventional VLA and video-predictive models rely on backbones pretrained on large-scale 2D image-text or temporal pixel data. While effective, their representations are largely shaped by semantic concepts or 2D priors, which do not intrinsically align with the precise 3D geometric nature required for physical manipulation. Driven by this insight, we propose the Vision-Geometry-Action (VGA) model, which directly conditions action generation on pretrained 3D representations. Specifically, VGA replaces conventional language or video backbones with a pretrained 3D world model, establishing a seamless vision-to-geometry mapping that translates visual inputs directly into physical actions. To further enhance geometric consistency, we introduce Progressive Volumetric Modulation and jointly train action and 3D property prediction to preserve geometric representations. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach. Across simulation benchmarks, VGA outperforms leading VLA, 3D-VLA, and WAM baselines, including $π_{0.5}$, OpenVLA-OFT, GeoVLA, and Motus. In real-world deployments, VGA surpasses $π_{0.5}$ under unseen viewpoints and accurately follows language instructions for target grasping. These results highlight that operating on native 3D representations, rather than relying primarily on language or video priors, offers a promising direction toward generalizable physical intelligence. Project page: https://hcplab-sysu.github.io/VisionGeometryActionModel.

AI.title_translation: 机器人操作即视觉到几何映射：基于语言和视频模型的视觉-几何骨干网
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为VGA的新型机器人操作模型，它抛弃了传统的2D视觉-语言或视频骨干网，转而采用3D世界模型作为骨干网，通过视觉-几何映射实现了卓越的机器人操作泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）和视频预测模型主要依赖2D图文或时间像素数据的预训练，其表示受语义概念或2D先验主导，无法本质上对齐物理操作所需的精确3D几何属性。因此，作者主张将机器人操作的本质视为视觉到几何的映射，并需要一个专用的视觉-几何骨干网络。
AI.method: 提出了Vision-Geometry-Action（VGA）模型，用预训练的3D世界模型代替传统的语言或视频骨干网络，直接将视觉输入映射为物理动作；引入渐进体积调制（Progressive Volumetric Modulation），并联合训练动作和3D属性预测以保持几何一致性。
AI.result: 在仿真基准测试中，VGA表现优于领先的VLA、3D-VLA和WAM基线模型（如$\pi_{0.5}$、OpenVLA-OFT、GeoVLA和Motus）；在真实世界部署中，VGA在未见视角下超越了$\pi_{0.5}$，并能准确跟随语言指令进行目标抓取。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出的VGA模型证明了基于预训练3D表示进行视觉-几何映射在机器人操作中的优越性，克服了传统VLA在3D空间理解上的不足，为实现更具泛化能力的物理智能提供了有前景的途径。
AI.translation: 核心本质上，机器人操作是一个视觉到几何映射的问题（$f(v) \rightarrow G$）。物理动作根本上由3D位置和空间关系等几何属性所定义。因此，我们认为通用机器人控制的基础应该是视觉-几何骨干网，而不是广为采用的视觉-语言或视频模型。传统的VLA和视频预测模型依赖于在大规模2D图像-文本或时间像素数据上预训练的骨干网。尽管有效，但它们的表征在很大程度上受到语义概念或2D先验的塑造，这与物理操作所需的精确3D几何本质并未内在对齐。基于这一洞察，我们提出了视觉-几何-动作（VGA）模型，该模型直接基于预训练的3D表征进行动作生成。具体而言，VGA用预训练的3D世界模型替换了传统的语言或视频骨干网，建立了一个无缝的视觉-几何映射，将视觉输入直接转化为物理动作。为了进一步增强几何一致性，我们引入了渐进体积调制，并联合训练动作和3D属性预测以保持几何表征。大量的实验验证了我们方法的有效性。在仿真基准测试中，VGA超越了领先的VLA、3D-VLA和WAM基线，包括 $\pi_{0.5}$、OpenVLA-OFT、GeoVLA和Motus。在真实世界的部署中，VGA在未见视角下超越了 $\pi_{0.5}$，并且能够准确按照语言指令进行目标抓取。这些结果突显出，操作原生3D表征（而非主要依赖语言或视频先验）为通往通用物理智能提供了一个有前景的方向。
AI.summary: 该论文提出将机器人操作定义为视觉到几何的映射，并开发了Vision-Geometry-Action (VGA) 模型。VGA用预训练的3D世界模型取代了传统的视觉-语言或视频骨干网络，结合渐进体积调制技术，实现了直接从视觉到物理动作的精准映射，在仿真和真实世界的机器人操作任务中取得了优异的性能。
AI.keywords: 机器人操作, 视觉-几何映射, 3D世界模型, 具身智能, 渐进体积调制
AI.comments: 该论文指出了当前具身智能领域普遍依赖视觉-语言模型（VLA）或视频模型的局限性，即缺乏对3D物理几何本质的直接对齐。文章创新性地提出将机器人操作建模为“视觉到几何映射”，并引入Vision-Geometry-Action（VGA）模型，利用3D世界模型作为骨干网络。这一思路切中物理操作的核心需求，对提升机器人泛化能力和鲁棒性具有重要意义。

title: Utilizing Inpainting for Keypoint Detection for Vision-Based Control of Robotic Manipulators
summary: We present a novel visual servoing framework for controlling a robotic manipulator in configuration space using only natural visual features. To train our data-driven keypoint detector, we attach ArUco markers along the robot body, use their centers as keypoint labels, and apply image inpainting to remove the markers and reconstruct the occluded regions. This produces automatically labeled, markerless robot images without requiring accurate camera calibration or robot models. At runtime, a second inpainting model reconstructs robot regions that are partially occluded, enabling continuous keypoint detection. An Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) further improves temporal consistency and robustness of the keypoint estimates. We demonstrate successful model-free, vision-based control using natural robot features under both full visibility and partial occlusion. To show broader applicability, we also extend the perception pipeline to two-module and three-module soft origami arms and qualitatively evaluate keypoint detection and temporal tracking on these platforms.

AI.title_translation: 利用图像修复技术进行机器人机械臂视觉控制的关键点检测
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需相机标定或机器人模型的视觉控制框架，利用图像修复技术自动标注训练数据并处理运行时的遮挡问题，实现了机械臂和软体臂的稳健关键点检测与视觉伺服。
AI.motivation: 为了解决基于视觉的机器人机械臂控制中，传统数据-driven关键点检测器需要繁琐的手工标注、精确相机标定或机器人模型的问题，同时克服运行时的遮挡挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的视觉伺服框架。首先通过在机器人身体上附加ArUco标记获取中心作为关键点标签，并利用图像修复技术去除标记和重建遮挡区域，从而自动生成无标记的训练图像；在运行时，利用第二个图像修复模型重建部分遮挡的区域，并通过无迹卡尔曼滤波（UKF）提升关键点估计的时序一致性与鲁棒性。
AI.result: 成功展示了在完全可见和部分遮挡情况下，基于自然机器人特征的无模型、基于视觉的控制；同时成功将感知管道扩展到了两模块和三模块的软 origami 机械臂，验证了其广泛适用性。
AI.conclusion: 利用图像修复技术能够有效实现无标定、无模型的数据驱动机器人关键点检测，并在完全可见及部分遮挡情况下支持稳定的视觉伺服控制。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种新颖的视觉伺服框架，仅使用自然视觉特征在构型空间中控制机器人机械臂。为了训练我们的数据驱动关键点检测器，我们在机器人身体上附加了ArUco标记，将其中心作为关键点标签，并应用图像修复技术移除标记并重建被遮挡的区域。这产生了自动标注的无标记机器人图像，而无需精确的相机标定或机器人模型。在运行时，第二个图像修复模型重建了部分遮挡的机器人区域，从而能够进行连续的关键点检测。无迹卡尔曼滤波（UKF）进一步提高了关键点估计的时序一致性和鲁棒性。我们在完全可见和部分遮挡的情况下，展示了成功的无模型、基于视觉的控制，使用了自然的机器人特征。为了展示更广泛的适用性，我们还将感知管道扩展到了双模块和三模块软折纸手臂，并在这些平台上对关键点检测和时序跟踪进行了定性评估。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种利用图像修复技术进行机器人操作视觉控制的关键点检测框架。通过自动生成无标记图像训练集并结合无迹卡尔曼滤波，该方法在无需精确相机标定或机器人模型的情况下，实现了完全可见及部分遮挡环境下的连续关键点检测与稳健的视觉伺服控制。
AI.keywords: 视觉伺服, 关键点检测, 图像修复, 机器人操作, 无模型控制
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地利用图像修复（Inpainting）技术解决了机器人视觉伺服中关键点自动标注与遮挡处理的难题，无需相机标定或机器人精确模型，具有很强的创新性和实用性，且推广到了软体折纸机械臂。

title: Credo: Declarative Control of LLM Pipelines via Beliefs and Policies
summary: Agentic AI systems are becoming commonplace in domains that require long-lived, stateful decision-making in continuously evolving conditions. As such, correctness depends not only on the output of individual model calls, but also on how to best adapt when incorporating new evidence or revising prior conclusions. However, existing frameworks rely on imperative control loops, ephemeral memory, and prompt-embedded logic, making agent behavior opaque, brittle, and difficult to verify. This paper introduces Credo, which represents semantic state as beliefs and regulates behavior using declarative policies defined over these beliefs. This design supports adaptive, auditable, and composable execution through a database-backed semantic control plane. We showcase these concepts in a decision-control scenario, where beliefs and policies declaratively guide critical execution choices (e.g., model selection, retrieval, corrective re-execution), enabling dynamic behavior without requiring any changes to the underlying pipeline code.

AI.title_translation: Credo：通过信念和策略对LLM流水线进行声明式控制
AI.tldr: Credo是一个通过信念和政策实现LLM流水线声明式控制的框架，提高了AI代理的可审计性和动态适应能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的代理式AI系统框架依赖于命令式控制循环、短暂的记忆和嵌入提示词的逻辑，导致代理行为不透明、脆弱且难以验证。
AI.method: 引入Credo框架，将语义状态表示为信念，并使用定义在这些信念上的声明式政策来规范行为，通过数据库支持的语义控制平面实现。
AI.result: 通过决策控制场景展示了Credo的概念，信念和政策可以声明式地指导关键执行选择（如模型选择、检索、纠错重新执行），在无需修改底层流水线代码的情况下实现动态行为。
AI.conclusion: Credo通过信念和策略实现了LLM流水线的声明式控制，提供了一个可适应、可审计且可组合的数据库支持的语义控制平面，有效提升了代理式AI系统的正确性和可验证性。
AI.translation: 具有自主性的AI系统在需要长期、有状态决策且环境持续演变的领域中正变得司空见惯。因此，其正确性不仅取决于单个模型调用的输出，还取决于在引入新证据或修正先前结论时如何进行最佳适应。然而，现有框架依赖于命令式控制循环、短暂的记忆以及嵌入在提示词中的逻辑，这使得代理行为不透明、脆弱且难以验证。本文介绍了Credo，它将语义状态表示为信念，并使用在这些信念上定义的声明式政策来规范行为。这种设计通过一个由数据库支持的语义控制平面，支持自适应、可审计且可组合的执行。我们在一个决策控制场景中展示了这些概念，其中信念和政策声明式地指导关键的执行选择（例如，模型选择、检索、纠错重新执行），从而实现动态行为，而无需对底层流水线代码进行任何修改。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Credo，一个用于大模型流水线的声明式控制框架。它通过将语义状态表示为信念并使用策略进行规范，解决了传统命令式框架的不透明和脆弱问题，实现了适应性强、可审计且可组合的AI系统执行。
AI.keywords: LLM Pipelines, Declarative Control, Beliefs and Policies, Agentic AI, Semantic State
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种新颖的声明式控制框架Credo，将大模型流水线的语义状态建模为“信念”，并通过“策略”进行规范，克服了传统命令式控制循环的不透明性和脆弱性，为构建可验证、可审计的代理式AI系统提供了重要思路。

title: Hardness, Tractability and Density Thresholds of finite Pinwheel Scheduling Variants
summary:
The k-Visits problem is a recently introduced finite version of Pinwheel Scheduling [Kanellopoulos et al., SODA 2026]. Given the deadlines of n tasks, the problem asks whether there exists a schedule of length kn executing each task exactly k times, with no deadline expiring between consecutive visits (executions) of each task.
  In this work we prove that 2-Visits is strongly NP-complete even when the maximum multiplicity of the input is equal to 2, settling an open question from [Kanellopoulos et al., SODA 2026] and contrasting the tractability of 2-Visits for simple sets. On the other hand, we prove that 2-Visits is in RP when the number of distinct deadlines is constant, thus making progress on another open question regarding the parameterization of 2-Visits by the number of numbers. We then generalize all existing positive results for 2-Visits to a version of the problem where some tasks must be visited once and some other tasks twice, while providing evidence that some of these results are unlikely to transfer to 3-Visits.
  Lastly, we establish bounds for the density thresholds of k-Visits, analogous to the $(5/6)$-threshold of Pinwheel Scheduling [Kawamura, STOC 2024]; in particular, we show a $\sqrt{2}-1/2\approx 0.9142$ lower bound for the density threshold of 2-Visits and prove that the density threshold of k-Visits approaches $5/6\approx 0.8333$ for $k \to \infty$.

AI.title_translation: 有限 Pinwheel 调度变体的硬度、易解性与密度阈值
AI.tldr: 论文证明了 2-Visits 调度问题在多重限制下是强 NP 完全的，给出了其在特定参数下的多项式时间算法，并探究了随着 k 增加其密度阈值的变化规律。
AI.motivation: 解决近期提出的关于有限 Pinwheel 调度变体（k-Visits 问题）的计算复杂性与参数化复杂性的公开问题，并探究其密度阈值。
AI.method: 通过复杂性理论证明 2-Visits 的强 NP 完全性与 RP 算法；将现有正面结果推广到混合访问版本；建立 k-Visits 密度阈值的数学上下界。
AI.result: 证明了 2-Visits 在最大重数为 2 时是强 NP 完全的，在不同截止期限为常数时属于 RP；将结果推广到混合访问版本；确定了 2-Visits 的密度阈值下限约为 0.9142，且当 k 趋于无穷时 k-Visits 的密度阈值趋近于 5/6。
AI.conclusion: 2-Visits 问题在通用情况下是强 NP 完全的，但在特定限制下可解；同时，研究给出了 k-Visits 问题的密度阈值界限，证明当 k 趋于无穷时其阈值趋近于 5/6。
AI.translation:
k-Visits 问题是 Pinwheel Scheduling 的一个近期引入的有限版本 [Kanellopoulos 等人，SODA 2026]。给定 n 个任务的截止期限，该问题询问是否存在一个长度为 kn 的调度方案，使得每个任务恰好执行 k 次，且每个任务的连续访问（执行）之间没有截止期限过期。
在本工作中，我们证明了即使在输入的属最大重数等于 2 时，2-Visits 也是强 NP 完全的，这解决了 [Kanellopoulos 等人，SODA 2026] 的一个公开问题，并与简单集合的 2-Visits 的易解性形成了对比。另一方面，我们证明了当不同截止期限的数量为常数时，2-Visits 属于 RP，从而在关于用数字数量对 2-Visits 进行参数化的另一个公开问题上取得了进展。然后，我们将 2-Visits 的所有现有正面结果推广到了这样一个版本：其中某些任务必须被访问一次，而其他某些任务必须被访问两次，同时提供了证据表明其中一些结果不太可能扩展到 3-Visits。
最后，我们建立了 k-Visits 密度阈值的界限，类似于 Pinwheel Scheduling 的 $(5/6)$ 阈值 [Kawamura，STOC 2024]；特别是，我们展示了 2-Visits 密度阈值的 $\sqrt{2}-1/2\approx 0.9142$ 下界，并证明了当 $k \to \infty$ 时，k-Visits 的密度阈值接近 $5/6\approx 0.8333$。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了有限 Pinwheel 调度变体 —— k-Visits 问题，证明了 2-Visits 的强 NP 完全性与特定条件下的易解性，推广了混合访问版本的正面结果，并建立了该问题关于密度阈值的上下界。
AI.keywords: Pinwheel Scheduling, k-Visits, NP-completeness, Density Thresholds, Algorithmic Complexity
AI.comments: 该论文深入研究了有限 Pinwheel 调度变体（k-Visits 问题）的计算复杂性与密度阈值，解决了先前文献中的多个公开问题，具有重要的理论价值。

title: A Structure-Preserving GSAV Exponential Integrator for Smectic-A Liquid Crystals
summary:
The modified Landau--de Gennes (mLdG) theory provides a powerful continuum framework for modeling smectic-A (SmA) liquid crystals by coupling the tensorial orientational order parameter $\mathbf{Q}$ with the scalar positional order parameter $u$.
  In this paper, we develop and analyze a structure-preserving generalized scalar auxiliary variable exponential integrator (GSAV-EI) scheme for the fully coupled mLdG system.
  The key ingredient is a backward Euler-type reformulation of the exponential integrator, which reveals a coercive discrete structure suitable for energy estimates and error analysis. Moreover, it eliminates the mesh-dependent time-step restriction ($τ\lesssim h^2$) required in the existing GSAV-EI error analysis and provides a transparent connection between exponential time-differencing and implicit time-stepping methods. Building on this reconstructed structure, we prove unconditional modified-energy stability and establish optimal-order fully discrete error estimates.
  Numerical experiments in two and three dimensions validate the theoretical convergence rates, verify the discrete energy-dissipation law, and illustrate the self-assembly dynamics of the SmA phase.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于Smectic-A液晶的保结构GSAV指数积分器
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于Smectic-A液晶模型的保结构GSAV指数积分器，消除了时间步长限制，证明了无条件能量稳定性和最优收敛阶。
AI.motivation: 为了克服现有GSAV-EI误差分析中对网格相关的严格时间步长限制（tau \lesssim h^2），并有效模拟耦合了取向和位置序参量的Smectic-A液晶系统。
AI.method: 发展并分析了一种结构保持的广义标量辅助变量指数积分器（GSAV-EI）方案，核心在于采用了一种后向欧拉式的指数积分器重构方法。
AI.result: 证明了该方案的无条件修正能量稳定性和最优阶全离散误差估计；通过二维和三维数值实验验证了理论收敛率、离散能量耗散定律以及SmA相的自组装动力学。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功开发并理论分析了一种用于SmA液晶mLdG系统的结构保持GSAV指数积分器，实现了无条件能量稳定和最优误差估计，并通过二维和三维数值实验验证了其有效性。
AI.translation:
修正的Landau-de Gennes (mLdG) 理论通过将张量取向序参量 $\mathbf{Q}$ 与标量位置序参量 $u$ 耦合，为建模 Smectic-A (SmA) 液晶提供了一个强有力的连续统框架。
在本文中，我们针对全耦合的 mLdG 系统开发并分析了一种保结构的广义标量辅助变量指数积分器（GSAV-EI）方案。
核心要素是对指数积分器进行后向欧拉式的重新表述，这揭示了一种适用于能量估计和误差分析的强制性离散结构。此外，它消除了现有 GSAV-EI 误差分析所需的网格相关时间步长限制（$\tau \lesssim h^2$），并提供了指数时间差分与隐式时间步进方法之间的透明联系。基于这一重建的结构，我们证明了无条件修正能量稳定性，并建立了最优阶的全离散误差估计。
二维和三维的数值实验验证了理论收敛阶，证实了离散能量耗散定律，并阐明了 SmA 相的自组装动力学。
AI.summary: 本文针对Smectic-A液晶的修正Landau-de Gennes模型，提出了一种结构保持的GSAV指数积分器。通过后向欧拉式的重构，消除了网格相关的时间步长限制，证明了无条件能量稳定性和最优误差估计，并通过数值实验进行了验证。
AI.keywords: Smectic-A liquid crystals, modified Landau-de Gennes theory, exponential integrator, generalized scalar auxiliary variable, structure-preserving scheme
AI.comments: 该论文针对Smectic-A液晶的修正Landau-de Gennes模型，提出了一种保持结构的GSAV指数积分器。创新点在于通过后向欧拉式的指数积分器重构，消除了以往分析中对网格相关的严苛时间步长限制，并严格证明了无条件修正能量稳定性和最优收敛阶误差估计。这对于复杂液晶相的数值模拟具有重要意义。

title: DORA Explorer: Improving the Exploration Ability of LLMs Without Training
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents for sequential decision-making struggle to produce diverse outputs. This leads to insufficient exploration, suboptimal solutions, and repeated actions. Actions are generated at the sequence level, but existing sampling strategies, such as temperature scaling, introduce diversity at the token level, not at the sequence level. We introduce DORA EXPLORER (Diversity-Oriented Ranking of Actions), a training-free, inference-time algorithm for improving exploration in LLM agents. DORA generates multiple candidate actions, scores them using sequence-level log-probability statistics, and samples an action via a tunable exploration parameter. We first study exploration in the classic Multi-Armed Bandit setting, where DORA substantially outperforms temperature-based sampling. Our main evaluation is on the Text Adventure Learning Environment Suite (TALES), where prompting strategies fail to explore but DORA delivers consistent gains across model families, e.g., 31.43% (ReAct) -> 45.5% (DORA) for Qwen-2.5 7B in TextWorld. Beyond exploration, DORA prevents common failures, such as getting stuck in loops. Our project is available at: https://dora-explore.github.io/.

AI.title_translation: DORA Explorer：无需训练即可提高大型语言模型的探索能力
AI.tldr: DORA Explorer 是一种无需训练、在推理时运行的算法，通过生成多个候选动作并基于序列级对数概率统计进行评分来提高大型语言模型（LLM）代理的探索能力，从而解决LLM在序列决策中输出多样性不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理在序列决策中难以产生多样化的输出，这导致探索不足、次优解决方案和重复动作。现有的采样策略（如温度缩放）在token级别引入多样性，而非序列级别。
AI.method: DORA EXPLORER（多样性导向的动作排序）是一种无需训练、在推理时运行的算法。它生成多个候选动作，使用序列级对数概率统计对它们进行评分，并通过一个可调的探索参数采样一个动作。
AI.result: 在经典的多臂老虎机设置中，DORA显著优于基于温度的采样。在Text Adventure Learning Environment Suite (TALES) 上，DORA在不同模型家族中都带来了持续的增益，例如，对于TextWorld中的Qwen-2.5 7B，性能从31.43%（ReAct）提高到45.5%（DORA）。此外，DORA还防止了常见的失败，例如陷入循环。
AI.conclusion: DORA Explorer 是一种无需训练的推理时算法，能有效提高大型语言模型代理的探索能力，并在序列决策任务中防止常见失败。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理在序列决策中难以产生多样化的输出。这导致探索不足、次优解决方案和重复动作。动作是在序列级别生成的，但现有的采样策略，如温度缩放，在token级别引入多样性，而非序列级别。我们引入了 DORA EXPLORER（多样性导向的动作排序），这是一种无需训练、在推理时运行的算法，用于提高 LLM 代理的探索能力。DORA 生成多个候选动作，使用序列级对数概率统计对它们进行评分，并通过一个可调的探索参数采样一个动作。我们首先在经典的多臂老虎机设置中研究探索，DORA 在此设置中显著优于基于温度的采样。我们的主要评估是在 Text Adventure Learning Environment Suite (TALES) 上进行的，在该环境中，提示策略未能有效探索，但 DORA 在不同模型家族中都带来了持续的增益，例如，对于 TextWorld 中的 Qwen-2.5 7B，性能从 31.43%（ReAct）提高到 45.5%（DORA）。除了探索之外，DORA 还防止了常见的失败，例如陷入循环。我们的项目可在以下网址获取：https://dora-explore.github.io/。
AI.summary: DORA Explorer 提出了一种无需训练、在推理时运行的算法，旨在解决大型语言模型（LLM）代理在序列决策中输出多样性不足和探索受限的问题。该方法通过生成多个候选动作，并利用序列级对数概率统计进行评分，然后通过可调参数采样动作，从而在序列级别而非token级别引入多样性。实验结果表明，DORA 在多臂老虎机任务中显著优于传统采样方法，并在文本冒险学习环境（TALES）中展示了对LLM代理探索能力的显著提升，同时有效避免了陷入循环等常见失败。
AI.keywords: LLM探索, 序列决策, 无需训练, DORA Explorer, 多样性
AI.comments: DORA Explorer 的创新之处在于它提出了一种无需训练的推理时算法，通过关注序列级别的多样性来解决LLM在探索中的固有缺陷。这与现有基于token级别多样性的方法形成对比，提供了一种更有效且成本更低的方式来提高LLM代理的性能和鲁棒性，尤其是在需要复杂决策和探索的场景中。

title: Towards Human Motion World Models via Executable Behaviour Representations
summary: Human motion world models should capture motion's intentionality by being executable: adaptable to different actions and capable of assessing motion quality. To achieve this, we introduce a domain-specific language ExAct that represents human motions as underspecified programs that can be compiled to a reward model for zero-shot policy inference. By leveraging the compositional nature of ExAct programs, we combine individual policies into executable behaviour representations. We evaluate the utility of the proposed approach by analysing human motion capture for the tasks of human action segmentation and human action anomaly detection. Our results suggest that the improvement in data efficiency and the capture of intuitive relationships between human actions are better than those of task-specific models.

AI.title_translation: 通过可执行行为表示迈向人类运动世界模型
AI.tldr: 提出利用领域特定语言构建人类运动世界模型，实现零样本策略推断，并在动作分割和异常检测中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 人类运动世界模型需要通过具备可执行性（能够适应不同动作并评估运动质量）来捕捉运动的意图性。
AI.method: 引入一种名为ExAct的领域特定语言，将人类运动表示为不完全指定的程序，这些程序可以编译为用于零样本策略推断的奖励模型，并通过组合性质将各个策略结合成可执行的行为表示。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在人类动作分割和人类动作异常检测任务中，展现出了比特定任务模型更好的数据效率和对动作间直观关系的捕捉能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功利用领域特定语言实现了人类运动的可执行行为表示，不仅能够捕捉运动的意图性，还能在动作分割和异常检测任务中超越传统的特定任务模型。

title: Making Gaussian Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks Reliable and Accurate
summary: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) replace fixed activations with learnable univariate edge functions whose behavior depends strongly on the chosen basis. Gaussian radial basis functions provide a simple and efficient alternative to splines, but their accuracy and stability are highly sensitive to the scale parameter \(ε\), which has not been studied systematically. We analyze this dependence through the geometry and conditioning of the first-layer feature matrix. Because the first layer is defined directly on the input domain, any loss of feature distinguishability introduced there propagates through the entire network. Based on this analysis, we identify the practical operating interval \[ ε\in \left[\frac{1}{G-1},\frac{2}{G-1}\right], \] where \(G\) is the number of Gaussian centers. This interval is proposed as a stable design rule rather than a universal optimum. Extensive experiments on function approximation and physics-informed problems confirm its reliability across different collocation densities, grid resolutions, architectures, and input dimensions. We also show how the same principle supports fixed-scale selection, variable-scale models, constrained optimization of \(ε\), and efficient scale search using early-stage training error. These results establish scale selection as a central design principle for reliable and accurate Gaussian KANs.

title: Spend Less, Fit Better: Budget-Efficient Scaling Law Fitting via Active Experiment Selection
summary: Scaling laws are used to plan multi-million-dollar training runs, but fitting those laws can itself cost millions. In modern large-scale workflows, assembling a sufficiently informative set of pilot experiments is already a major budget-allocation problem rather than a routine preprocessing step. We formulate scaling-law fitting as budget-aware sequential experimental design: given a finite pool of runnable experiments with heterogeneous costs, choose which runs to execute so as to maximize extrapolation accuracy in a high-cost target region. We propose $\mathrm{SL}^2$ (Scaling Laws, Spend Less), an uncertainty-aware method for sequentially allocating experimental budget toward the runs most useful for target-region extrapolation. Across a diverse benchmark of scaling-law tasks, $\mathrm{SL}^2$ outperforms classical design-based baselines, and often approaches the performance of fitting on the full experimental set while using only about 10\% of the total training budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/PlanarG/active-sl.

title: Multimodal QUD: Inquisitive Questions from Scientific Figures
summary: Discourse comprehension in complex documents often involves continuously posing and resolving Questions Under Discussion (QUDs). While QUD frameworks have so far focused on text, scientific literature is inherently multimodal: figures convey discourse goals distinct from their textual counterparts, thus invoking implicit questions that the surrounding text answers. In scientific discovery, knowing the right questions to ask is as important as knowing how to answer them, yet this capability remains largely absent in current models. In this work, we extend QUD to multimodal discourse in scientific literature, targeting questions evoked by figures that are (1) inquisitive, i.e., not resolved in the prior context; (2) salient, i.e., relevant to the paper's research claims and addressed later in the paper; (3) grounded in visual insights. To benchmark model capability to generate such questions, we introduce MQUD, a dataset of 1,250 figure-evoked questions from 56 scientific papers, including 708 questions annotated by the original authors of these papers. Our experiments show that open-source VLMs such as Qwen 3.5 predominantly ask questions that can be answered by the figure alone. Fine-tuning on MQUD teaches the model to ask scientifically relevant, inquisitive questions that target the role a figure plays in the paper's argument.

title: Enhancing Linux Privilege Escalation Attack Capabilities of Local LLM Agents
summary: Cloud-based Large Language Models (LLMs) can perform autonomous penetration-testing sub-tasks such as Linux privilege escalation, but raise security, privacy, and sovereignty concerns. Locally hosted open-weight models avoid these issues, yet prior work reports that small open-weight models succeed on only 8-16% of standardized privilege-escalation tasks, far below frontier cloud models. This paper is an empirical study of why small models fail at this task and which engineering techniques close the gap. From execution traces we distill six recurring failure modes, map each to an established enhancement technique, and evaluate five (chain-of-thought prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, structured prompting, history compression, and reflective analysis) as reproducible extensions to the open-source hackingBuddyGPT framework. Under a single shared harness and matched conditions, the set of techniques we evaluate raise two SLMs (Llama3.1 8B, Qwen2.5 7B) from 8% to 67% with guidance, matching guided GPT-4o. A larger open-weight reference model (Llama3.1 70B) reaches 83%. A full-factorial ablation shows that reflection-based techniques contribute most and reveals vulnerability discovery, not exploitation, as the main constraint for local models. We report these as transferable lessons for building reliable local offensive agents as well as to inform defenders.

title: Truthful-in-Expectation Mechanisms for MMS Approximation
summary:
We study fair allocation of indivisible goods among strategic agents with additive valuations. Motivated by impossibility results for deterministic truthful mechanisms, we focus on randomized mechanisms that are \emph{Truthful-in-Expectation (TIE)}. From a fairness perspective, we seek to guarantee every agent a large fraction of their \emph{Maximin Share (MMS)} ex-post. Among other results, Bu~and~Tao~[FOCS 2025] presented a TIE mechanism that guarantees $\frac{1}{n}$-MMS ex-post. First, we present an ordinal TIE mechanism that guarantees $\frac{1}{H_{n-1} + 2}$-MMS ex-post, where $H_k$ is the $k$-th harmonic number ($H_k \simeq \ln k$). This is nearly best possible for ordinal mechanisms, as even non-truthful ordinal allocation algorithms cannot obtain an approximation better than $\frac{1}{H_n}$. We then show that with just a small amount of additional cardinal information, the ex-post guarantee can be improved to $Ω(\frac{1}{\log\log n})$-MMS, at the cost of relaxing the incentive requirement to $(1-\varepsilon(n))$-TIE for negligible $\varepsilon(n)$. Finally, for two agents, we present a TIE mechanism that is $\frac{2}{3}$-MMS ex-post.
  All our mechanisms are ex-ante proportional (thus also providing ``Best-of-Both-Worlds'' results) and run in polynomial time. Moreover, all our results extend to the truncated proportional share (TPS), which is at least as large as the MMS. Our two-agent $\frac{2}{3}$-TPS result is best possible for the TPS.

title: Optimized Deferral for Imbalanced Settings
summary: Learning algorithms can be significantly improved by routing complex or uncertain inputs to specialized experts, balancing accuracy with computational cost. This approach, known as learning to defer, is essential in domains like natural language generation, medical diagnosis, and computer vision, where an effective deferral can reduce errors at low extra resource consumption. However, the two-stage learning to defer setting, which leverages existing predictors such as a collection of LLMs or other classifiers, often faces challenges due to an expert imbalance problem. This imbalance can lead to suboptimal performance, with deferral algorithms favoring the majority expert. We present a comprehensive study of two-stage learning to defer in expert imbalance settings. We cast the deferral loss optimization as a novel cost-sensitive learning problem over the input-expert domain. We derive new margin-based loss functions and guarantees tailored to this setting, and develop novel algorithms for cost-sensitive learning. Leveraging these results, we design principled deferral algorithms, MILD (Margin-based Imbalanced Learning to Defer), specifically suited for expert imbalance settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, showing clear improvements over existing baselines on both image classification and real-world Large Language Model (LLM) routing tasks.

title: Mind the Gap: Structure-Aware Consistency in Preference Learning
summary: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human intent, whether through explicit reward modeling or direct methods such as DPO, fundamentally relies on minimizing a surrogate loss as a proxy for the true pairwise ranking objective. We prove that this reliance is flawed for the standard surrogate losses used: for the equicontinuous hypothesis sets characteristic of neural networks, no standard surrogate provides a meaningful consistency guarantee. Minimizing the surrogate loss to zero can leave the true ranking error arbitrarily high. To resolve this, we formulate LLM alignment within a margin-shifted ranking framework and derive $H$-consistency bounds showing that enforcing a confidence margin $γ$ is not merely beneficial but necessary for consistency. We further introduce Structure-Aware $H$-consistency and a corresponding objective (SA-DPO) that adapts the margin to the semantic distance between responses, preventing instability on near-synonymous pairs. Finally, we analyze the trade-off between the margin required for consistency and the model's finite capacity to satisfy it, revealing a strict hierarchy of surrogate losses: heavy-tailed surrogates (e.g., the Polynomial Hinge family) offer strictly superior consistency guarantees for capacity-bounded models compared to the logistic loss used in DPO. Experiments on UltraFeedback and Argilla DPO-Mix-7k confirm that SA-DPO consistently outperforms DPO and SimPO, with a 58.5% head-to-head win-rate in downstream generation quality.

title: Linear-Core Surrogates: Smooth Loss Functions with Linear Rates for Classification and Structured Prediction
summary: A fundamental dichotomy in the theory of classification sets smoothness against statistical efficiency: smooth surrogate losses such as the logistic loss enable fast $O(1/T)$ optimization but yield slow square-root $H$-consistency bounds, while piecewise-linear losses like the Hinge loss achieve optimal linear $H$-consistency rates but are non-differentiable. We introduce Linear-Core (LC) Surrogates, the first family of explicit convex loss functions that provably resolve this tension. By stitching a linear core to a smooth tail, we construct surrogates that are differentiable everywhere ($C^1$, and even $C^2$ under mild conditions) while retaining strict linear $H$-consistency bounds, the strongest known form of consistency guarantee. We establish these linear bounds across three increasingly complex settings: binary classification, multi-class classification, and structured prediction. To our knowledge, this is the first explicit construction to simultaneously achieve smoothness and linear $H$-consistency in any of these settings. Beyond their theoretical appeal, Linear-Core Surrogates offer practical advantages. In multi-class classification, their constant gradient profile near the decision boundary provides natural robustness to instance-dependent label noise, outperforming Cross-Entropy by 2.6% on corrupted CIFAR-10. In structured prediction, their smoothness enables an unbiased stochastic gradient estimator that bypasses the $O(|Y|^2)$ per-step complexity of exact inference, yielding a 23$\times$ speedup over Structured SVMs on large-vocabulary sequence tagging tasks.

title: Sequential Automorphism Ensemble Decoding with Early Stopping
comments: 5 pages, 5 figures, 1 table, submitted to IEEE Communications Letters
summary: In this paper, a low-complexity approach for the automorphism ensemble decoder (AED) using successive cancellation (SC) as constituent decoders is proposed. The approach sequentially activates sub-decoders and terminates the decoding process based on pre-optimized parameters, derived from the strong correlation observed between the decoding outcome and the SC path metric. An algorithm is proposed to find a list of early termination thresholds that minimize average decoding complexity subject to a block-error rate (BLER) constraint. For various code parameters and a BLER below $10^{-3}$, simulation results show that average decoding complexity is reduced by a factor of at least $6 \times$, and up to $22 \times$, compared to the original AED complexity, with a negligible degradation in BLER.

title: Analytic Bridge Diffusions for Controlled Path Generation
summary:
Most modern bridge-diffusion methods achieve finite-time transport by specifying an interpolation, Schrodinger-bridge, or stochastic-control objective and then learning the associated score or drift field with a neural network. In contrast, we identify a restricted but sufficiently broad analytically solvable class in which, for a deterministic source and a Gaussian-mixture target, the score and all intermediate marginals are explicit and protocol objectives of the type used in this paper can be differentiated without inner stochastic simulation loops. We recast the classical linear--quadratic--Gaussian stochastic-control structure as a transport problem of the Path Integral Diffusion type. Linear dynamics, Gaussian noise, and quadratic running costs reduce the bridge calculation to a matrix Riccati cascade, while the terminal state cost is replaced by a prescribed Gaussian-Mixture terminal probability density.
  Linear Quadratic -- Gaussian Mixture -- Path Integral Diffusion (LQ-GM-PID) thereby turns bridge diffusion from terminal target matching alone into an analytically controlled laboratory for path shaping. We demonstrate this on a 2D corridor task, a 2D multi-entrance task, and a high-dimensional study reaching d=32 and M=16 terminal modes in separate scaling sweeps. We position LQ-GM-PID as an analytically solvable reference model in which score approximations, path-shaping objectives, and protocol-learning procedures can be tested against explicit quantities.

title: CAR: Query-Guided Confidence-Aware Reranking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) relies on evidence ranking to determine what information is exposed to the generator, yet existing retrieval and reranking methods primarily estimate query--document relevance. Relevance, however, is not equivalent to generator-side usefulness: a relevant passage may introduce ambiguity or distraction, whereas a lower-ranked passage may stabilize the generator's answer. We present CAR (Confidence-Aware Reranking), a training-free rank-correction framework that uses query-only answer stability as a control and measures each candidate by the change it induces in sampled-answer semantic stability. This controlled contrast estimates a document's marginal contribution to generator behavior without treating semantic stability as relevance or calibrated correctness. CAR converts these confidence changes into coarse precedence constraints and returns the feasible ranking with minimum Kendall distance from the baseline, preserving existing pairwise preferences unless generator-side evidence supports reversing them. Experiments on NQ, HotpotQA and FEVER across sparse and dense retrievers, seven ranking methods and three generator families show robust improvements. In the BM25-centered main analysis, CAR achieves a \textbf{+5.53\% mean relative NDCG@5 gain}; on the fixed NQ-answerable downstream evaluation, it improves token-level F1 by \textbf{+0.43 points}, with ranking and generation gains strongly aligned across rankers ($ρ= 0.93$). These results position CAR as a deployment-friendly, generator-aware correction layer that complements relevance while preserving informative prior rankings. CAR requires neither task-specific training nor access to model internals such as logits or hidden states, making it applicable to black-box LLMs through generated outputs alone.

title: Text Corpora as Concept Fields: Black-Box Hallucination and Novelty Measurement
comments: 30 pages, 10 figures, 17 tables; additional analysis in appendix added
summary: We introduce the \textbf{Concept Field} of a text corpus: a local drift field with pointwise uncertainty, estimated in sentence-embedding space from the deltas between consecutive sentences. Given a candidate sentence transition, we score its agreement with the field by $ζ$, the mean absolute z-distance between the observed delta and the field's local Gaussian estimate. The score is black-box (no model internals), corpus-attributable (every score traces to nearby corpus sentences), and admits a probabilistically motivated interpretation under a local Gaussian approximation. We support the computation with the introduction of a \textbf{Vector Sequence Database (VSDB)} that stores embeddings together with sequence-position and next-delta metadata. We evaluate this approach on two large-scale settings: hallucination-style groundedness detection over the U.S. Code of Federal Regulations, and novelty detection over Project Gutenberg, where we show Concept Fields achieve strong selective classification performance under a grounded / ungrounded / unsure triage policy. Unlike retrieval-centric baselines, the resulting coverage-risk behavior is similar across both domains, supporting a degree of cross-domain stability for the standardized deviation score. We also sketch how divergence and curl of the Concept Field, computed on dense clusters, surface qualitatively meaningful semantic patterns (logic sources, sinks, and implicit topics), which we offer as hypothesis-generating rather than as a quantitative result. Concept Fields provide a fast, lightweight, and interpretable signal for groundedness and novelty, complementary to LLM-as-judge and white-box detectors.

title: A semi-generating function approach to the stability of implicit-explicit multistep methods for nonlinear parabolic equations
summary: The rigorous stability analysis of high-order implicit-explicit linear multistep (IELM) methods for nonlinear parabolic equations by using discrete energy arguments is a long standing open issue due to their non-A-stability property. A novel semi-generating function approach combined with a global discrete energy analysis is suggested for the stability and convergence of general IELM methods in solving nonlinear parabolic equations. Inspired from the Grenander-Szegő theorem for Toeplitz matrices, the semi-generating function approach is used to handle the three groups of discrete coefficients via three complex polynomials on the unit circle. A unified theoretical framework is then presented to establish the unconditional stability of IELM methods if the minimum eigenvalue of composite convolution kernels for the implicit part is properly large and the spectral norm bound of composite convolution kernels for the explicit part is properly small. An indicator, called implicit-explicit controllability intensity, is then introduced to evaluate the degree of controllability of the implicit part over the explicit part. Some of the existing IELM methods, up to fifth-order time accuracy, are revisited and compared by computing the associated implicit-explicit controllability intensities such that one can choose an IELM method or proper parameter to maintain the unconditional stability for a specific nonlinear parabolic model. We also propose a new parameterized class of IELM methods, up to the ninth-order time accuracy, which satisfy the a priori settings of our theory and have a large value of the implicit-explicit controllability intensity by choosing a proper parameter so that they would be well suited for a wide class of nonlinear parabolic problems.

title: TokenStack: A Heterogeneous HBM-PIM Architecture and Runtime for Efficient LLM Inference
summary: Large language model (LLM) serving is now limited by the key-value (KV) cache. During decode, each new token rereads prior KV state, so attention becomes a bandwidth- and capacity-heavy memory task. HBM-PIM helps by moving attention closer to memory, but current stack organizations still waste resources. In practice, only hot KV blocks benefit from near-memory compute. Weights, activations, and cold KV mainly need dense storage and GPU-visible bandwidth. A uniform HBM-PIM stack makes all layers pay for PIM logic, while a dedicated-PIM design such as AttAcc recovers capacity but shrinks the HBM bandwidth left for GPU-side work. We propose TokenStack, a vertically heterogeneous HBM-PIM architecture for KV-centric LLM serving that leverages HBM4's logic-die substrate. TokenStack separates each stack into dense capacity layers and PIM-enabled compute layers, then uses the logic base die as a stack-local control point that manages cross-layer movement without host-side overhead. The base-die controller handles cross-layer DMA, layered address translation, attention-side gather/broadcast coordination, and inline quantization during migration. On top of this hardware, TokenStack uses topology-aware KV placement, workload-aware eviction, and bounded replication to keep hot KV near PIM compute while moving colder state to dense layers. Using production-derived traces across four models, completed multi-QPS runs show that TokenStack increases geometric-mean token throughput by 1.62x and SLO-compliant serving capacity by 1.70x over AttAcc, and reduces per-token energy by 30-47%.

title: Tools as Continuous Flow for Evolving Agentic Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in orchestrating tools for reasoning tasks. However, existing methods rely on a step-wise paradigm that lacks a global perspective, which causes error accumulation over long horizons and restricts generalization to unseen tools. To overcome these limitations, we propose Tools as Continuous Flow for Evolving Agentic Reasoning (FlowAgent), which reconceptualizes tool chaining as continuous trajectory generation within a semantic space. To systematically evaluate this paradigm, we introduce the first plan-level closed-loop benchmark dedicated to plan-level agentic reasoning in dynamic real-world environments. Specifically, the proposed FlowAgent leverages conditional flow matching to generate continuous latent trajectories, providing a global planning perspective to ensure coherent and robust tool execution. Theoretically, we establish formal bounds on utility convergence and prove that our continuous formulation fundamentally guarantees robust generalization and error attenuation. Empirical evaluations show that FlowAgent achieves superior robustness and adaptability in long-horizon reasoning tasks.

title: simpleposter: A simple baseline for product poster generation
summary: Product poster generation poses distinct challenges beyond general poster design, requiring both faithful preservation of product appearance and precise control over dense, multi-line text layouts. Prior methods typically adopt inpainting frameworks augmented with auxiliary modules such as ControlNet and OCR encoders. However, these approaches introduce architectural complexity and computational overhead while still suffering from text errors and subject extension artifacts. We present SimplePoster, a simple yet effective inpainting-based framework that achieves faithful subject preservation and accurate, position-controllable text rendering without external controllers. Our approach builds on two observations: (1) full-parameter fine-tuning of the base model effectively suppresses subject extension, outperforming ControlNet-based alternatives; and (2) a zero-cost character-level position encoding enables geometry-aware text generation without dedicated layout modules. Experiments show that SimplePoster achieves a $98.7\%$ subject preservation rate, compared to $55.2\%$ for SeedEdit 3.0 and $85.3\%$ for PosterMaker, while also improving text rendering accuracy. Code, models, benchmark and a part of training data will be available at https://github.com/Alibaba-YuFeng/SIMPLEPOSTER

title: Pretraining large language models with MXFP4 on Native FP4 Hardware
summary: Why does full-pipeline FP4 training of large language models often diverge, even when forward activations and activation gradients remain stable? We address this question through a controlled study of MXFP4 quantization in transformer training, progressively enabling FP4 across forward propagation (Fprop), activation gradients (Dgrad), and weight gradients (Wgrad) while holding all other factors fixed. In full pretraining of Llama 3.1-8B on the C4 dataset, we observe that quantizing Wgrad is the primary driver of convergence degradation, whereas FP4 in Fprop and Dgrad alone introduces only modest additional token requirements. To interpret this behavior, we evaluate both structured and stochastic interventions under a controlled experimental setting. We find that stochastic rounding and randomized Hadamard rotations fail to stabilize training once Wgrad is quantized, whereas deterministic Hadamard rotations consistently restore stable optimization. These results suggest that FP4 training instability is driven by structured micro-scaling errors along sensitive gradient paths, rather than by insufficient stochasticity. We run experiments with native MXFP4 support on AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs, enabling controlled investigation of these effects without reliance on software emulation.

title: Omni-Persona: Systematic Benchmarking and Improving Omnimodal Personalization
summary: While multimodal large language models have advanced across text, image, and audio, personalization research has remained primarily vision-language, with unified omnimodal benchmarking that jointly covers text, image, and audio still limited, and lacking the methodological rigor to account for absent-persona scenarios or systematic grounding studies. We introduce Omni-Persona, the first comprehensive benchmark for omnimodal personalization. We formalize the task as cross-modal routing over the Persona Modality Graph, encompassing 4 task groups and 18 fine-grained tasks across ~750 items. To rigorously diagnose grounding behavior, we propose Calibrated Accuracy (Cal), which jointly evaluates correct grounding and appropriate abstention, incorporating absent-persona queries within a unified evaluation framework. On our dedicated experiments, three diagnostic findings emerge: (i) recent open-weight models show a consistent audio-vs-visual grounding gap that RLVR partially narrows via dense rule-based supervision; (ii) recall score and parameter scale are incomplete diagnostics, since strong recall can coexist with absent-persona hallucination and larger models do not always achieve higher Cal, exposing calibration as a separate evaluation axis; and (iii) SFT is limited by the scalability of ground-truth annotation. RLVR improves recall but not calibrated abstention under our reward design, leaving Cal at or below the base model. Omni-Persona thus serves as a diagnostic framework that surfaces the pitfalls of omnimodal personalization, guiding future post-training and reward design.

title: Hyper-FSAD: Training-Free and Language-Free Few-Shot Anomaly Detection via Sparse Hyper Matching
summary: Few-shot anomaly detection (FSAD) is particularly valuable when only a few normal images are available in a new target domain, while anomalous cases are rare, diverse, and difficult to enumerate in advance. However, existing methods often still require task-specific fitting or language prompts, and their patch-level retrieval commonly relies on brittle nearest-neighbor or fixed Top-$p$ rules. We propose \textbf{Hyper-FSAD}, a training-free and language-free framework that performs support-only inference with a frozen visual encoder. We formulate FSAD as support-only scoring in frozen feature space and establish the selective stability of sparse retrieval and sufficient conditions for normal--anomaly separation. Guided by this analysis, \textbf{Sparse Hyper Matching} uses \textit{sparsemax} to adaptively select support patches for each query patch, exactly suppressing below-threshold distractors without a manually specified retrieval hyperparameter. \textbf{Dual-Branch Image Scoring} further combines local reconstruction discrepancies with support-conditioned global <CLS> deviation. Across four industrial and two medical benchmarks, Hyper-FSAD achieves the best overall performance across the 1/2/4-shot settings, while requiring only 52.6\,ms per image and 0.89\,GB GPU memory. The code will be released.
